jobs.title: Senior Mainframe Developer
jobs.description: DESCRIPTION We are an enterprise organization seeking an experienced Senior Mainframe Developer with strong hands\-on expertise in COBOL, JCL, DB2, VSAM, and CICS integration to support our critical applications. In this role, you will be responsible for analyzing existing mainframe applications, identifying dependencies, improving application performance, and supporting modernization and integration initiatives. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in mainframe application development, legacy code analysis, production support, and system enhancement. ### **Key Responsibilities** * Analyze, review, and reverse\-engineer existing mainframe applications to identify dependencies, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement. * Design, develop, test, debug, and maintain COBOL\-based applications. * Develop, execute, and maintain JCL scripts for batch processing and job execution. * Work with DB2 databases, utilizing SQL queries, stored procedures, and performing performance tuning. * Develop and maintain VSAM files and related data processing routines. * Support CICS transaction processing and integration with existing mainframe applications. * Manage and monitor batch jobs using Control\-M, CCS, or similar enterprise scheduling tools. * Troubleshoot production issues, perform root\-cause analysis, and implement permanent fixes. * Participate in application enhancements, legacy modernization, code refactoring, and integration initiatives. * Collaborate with business analysts, QA teams, architects, and cross\-functional technical teams. * Support system testing, QA/UAT, release management, and production deployments. REQUIREMENTS * **Experience:** 10\+ years of overall IT experience, with a heavy focus on mainframe development. * **Core Technologies:** Strong hands\-on development experience with COBOL, JCL, DB2, VSAM, and CICS. * **Scheduling Tools:** Experience with Control\-M, CCS, or other mainframe job scheduling tools. * **Database:** Experience with DB2 SQL, stored procedures, and database performance optimization. * **Systems:** Strong understanding of batch processing and high\-volume transaction processing systems. * **Location:** Must be a local candidate to the Jersey City, NJ area. Non\-local candidates will not be considered. * **Work Setup:** Must be available to work onsite in Jersey City, NJ, four (4\) days per week. ### **Nice\-to\-Have Skills** * Basic knowledge of APIs, middleware, and web services. * Exposure to mainframe modernization initiatives. * Familiarity with distributed systems and cloud integration. * Knowledge of DevOps practices in mainframe environments.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend (AI Platform)
jobs.description: At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most. Affirm's engineering team is building a large\-scale, fault\-tolerant, and global infrastructure that is shared across multiple financial products, merchants, and vendors. Ensuring that our infrastructure is transparently available to all engineers is critical to the success of the business. We pride ourselves on our culture across engineering of writing blameless postmortems as well as writing detailed tech specs and gathering feedback before large changes to systems. The AI Platform team owns Affirm's paved path for building, running, evaluating, and governing AI systems. Our customers are not only Affirm users, but also every engineer and a growing set of production workloads at Affirm. As a team, we are responsible for building and exposing simple, governed interfaces to models, tools, and agents, with identity, cost attribution, reliability, and security built in. Examples of components we own include the LLM Gateway that fronts every approved model (Claude, ChatGPT, and open\-weight models across AWS Bedrock and other providers), the MCP Gateway that mediates and audits tool calls, the Agent Runtime that gives agentic workloads bounded execution, and the evals and observability layer that tells teams whether an AI change is better, cheaper, or safe to ship. We are early: the gateway is in daily use across engineering, the first production agent is live, and the next year takes us from developer productivity to production inference and agents. **What You'll Do** * Plan, execute, and own technical decisions and projects within the AI Platform team, from design through launch and on\-call. * Design and build the gateway, runtime, and evaluation services that take AI workloads at Affirm from pilot to production, securely scaling across millions of users and their transactions. * Make AI spend attributable and governable: build the identity, quota, routing, caching, and failover controls that let teams adopt new models and tools without re\-solving the same platform problems. * Partner with security, infrastructure, and product engineering teams to set the guardrails for agentic workloads and the on\-behalf\-of identity model for tool access. * Create and monitor metrics for your team's systems, and own the operational health of what you ship: monitoring, alerting, runbooks, and on\-call. * Set and improve code review and design standards, and advocate for them beyond your team through writing and tech talks. * Use AI tools and agentic workflows every day as a multiplier for your own code, design review, and operations, and push the team on what a small AI\-native team can deliver. * Educate, mentor, and grow engineers in the team, and drive best practices around design, coding, and testing. **What We Look For** * You have 4\+ years of experience designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale using languages like Python or Kotlin. * You have a track record of developing highly available distributed systems using technologies like AWS, MySQL and Kubernetes. * You have practical experience building with LLMs, agents, or AI frameworks in production: inference APIs, LLM gateways (LiteLLM or similar), MCP, tool calling, evals, or agent runtimes. * You understand AI usage and the infrastructure needed to support and leverage AI workloads across different disciplines. * You have experience defining a technical plan for the delivery of a significant feature or system component with an elegant, simple and extensible design. You write high quality code that is easily understood and used by others. * You are proficient at making significant changes in a large code base, and have developed a suite of tools and practices that enable you and your team to do so safely. * Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders. * You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team. * This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor's degree in a related field. Pay Grade \- N Equity Grade \- 9 **Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range.** Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job\-related skills. Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.) USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $195,000 \- 255,000 USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $173,000\-233,000 \#LI\-Remote **Remote\-first with flexibility built in** Affirm is proud to be a remote\-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in\-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office\-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in\-person onboarding experience. **Benefits designed for you** Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights: * Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents. * Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you. * Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to. * Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount. We're committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we're happy to help. For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law. By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: Company Overview At Agilite, we harness the power of the Microsoft Azure ecosystem to deliver transformative data solutions for our healthcare clients. Our mission is to drive data\-driven insights that improve outcomes, and we’re looking for a skilled Azure Data Engineer to join our team. Visit us at www.agilite.tech . Job Title: Senior Data Engineer Location: Remote Job Type: Full\-Time Overview We are seeking an experienced Azure Data Engineer to design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and infrastructure within the Microsoft Azure ecosystem. The ideal candidate will have expertise in Databricks (Python or Scala), C\#, SQL, and a strong background in data modeling, ETL processes, and data warehousing. With a focus on healthcare datasets, this role requires proficiency in Azure services, data visualization tools, and experience with SCM and CI/CD pipelines to deliver secure, efficient, and high\-quality data solutions. You will also design the science behind framework decomposition, evidence auto\-linking, and a new agent\-context system that tackles retrieval, grounding, and hallucination measurement for AI agents. jobs.title: Software Dev Engineer II, SIFT
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Every day, the people closest to our customers and partners learn things that matter — in meetings, in deal rooms, in the field. For years most of that went nowhere useful: stuck in an inbox, a memory, a note no one opened again. We changed that. We built a product that captures those raw field inputs, automatically finds the patterns hiding across thousands of them, and uses AI to turn what used to be hours of manual report\-writing into minutes — and it's now part of how a large, fast\-growing community does its job every day. That's the part that makes this interesting: it already works, at real scale, for a lot of people — and that raises the bar rather than lowering it. The hard problems now are the ones you only get to when something is genuinely in production and genuinely depended on. How do you keep quality high as usage climbs and the data gets messier? How do you make AI\-generated output people trust instead of double\-check? How do you extend a system people already rely on without breaking what they count on? This is applied AI in the critical path of real work — where "mostly right" isn't good enough and someone notices the moment it's off. That's where you come in. Here's the kind of thing you'd own and solve: * Scale what's already working. Take services that are live and heavily used and make them faster, sturdier, and ready for the next order of magnitude of users and data. * Grow what the product can connect to. Expand the set of tools and integrations the system exposes through the Model Context Protocol (MCP), so the product can plug into more data sources and let AI assistants do more on a user's behalf — safely and reliably. * Raise the quality bar on AI output. Improve how the product turns messy, free\-form input into trustworthy, structured, searchable records — with smarter summarization, tagging, and quality gating so strong output ships and weak output doesn't. * Extend the product thoughtfully. Add new capabilities and data sources to a system people already depend on, without disrupting the workflows they rely on every day. * Make the trends sharper. Improve how the product spots patterns across a huge body of individual stories, so people see what's emerging without digging for it. * Let people talk to their data. Build and refine the natural\-language experiences that let someone ask for what they need — and get an answer built from real data, and only the data they're allowed to see. * Keep it healthy. Own the reliability and operations of what you build, dig into production issues when they happen, and raise the operational bar for the whole team. What sets this apart: you're joining something that already succeeded — and the interesting work is everything that comes next. You get the best of both worlds: the real users, real feedback, and real impact of a product in heavy use, plus a wide\-open set of hard problems around scaling it, deepening the AI, and taking it places it hasn't gone yet. You'll make architectural calls that matter, see your impact quickly because the people using it will tell you exactly what's working, and be expected to lift the engineers around you — mentoring, reviewing designs, and being someone who makes the whole team sharper, not just your own code. We're looking for someone who's built and operated real backend systems at scale, is comfortable improving a live product without breaking it, and is genuinely excited about applying AI to a hard, valuable problem rather than chasing the buzz. jobs.title: Global Manufacturing Capacity Engineer
jobs.description: Amphenol Communications Solutions (ACS), a division of Amphenol Corporation, is a world leader in interconnect solutions for Communications, Mobile, RF, Optics, and Commercial electronics markets. Amphenol Corporation is one of the world’s largest designers and manufacturers of electrical, electronic and fiber optic connectors and interconnect systems, antennas, sensors and sensor\-based products and coaxial and high\-speed specialty cable. ACS has an expansive global presence in research and development, manufacturing, and sales. We design and manufacture a wide range of innovative connectors as well as cable assemblies for diverse applications including server, storage, data center, mobile, RF, networking, industrial, business equipment, and automotive. **Position: Global Manufacturing Capacity Engineer** **Location: Nashua, NH (Global Travel)** Amphenol High Speed Products Group is the market leader for high\-speed, high\-bandwidth electrical connectors and cable assemblies for the Telecom/Datacom market, including AI infrastructure, data centers, storage, servers, routers, and switches. Our products enable the electronics revolution and support major Tier 1 OEMs globally. We have design, sales, engineering, and manufacturing locations worldwide and are currently seeking a Global Manufacturing Capacity Engineer to join our Cable Backplane Systems (CBS) Global NPI organization based in Nashua, NH. **RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Own the CBS global manufacturing capacity planning model and establish one controlled view of demand, secured capacity, constraints, ramp assumptions, and required investments across the manufacturing network. o Translate customer forecasts, program build plans, and allocation assumptions into required production hours, equipment quantities, line capacity, shifts, labor, and site loading by month. o Define and govern standard capacity assumptions including cycle time, OEE, yield, attrition, planned downtime, available manufacturing hours, changeover, maintenance, utilization targets, and ramp curves. o Consolidate site capacity data into a common model that supports consistent comparison across Vietnam, China, Mexico, USA, and future CBS manufacturing locations. o Provide executive\-level visibility of capacity coverage, gaps, timing, mitigation plans, and CapEx requirements before customer demand is impacted. * **Capacity vs. Demand Management \-** Maintain short\-, medium\-, and long\-range capacity models by program, product family, process, site, and equipment family. Show demand hours, secured capacity hours, coverage percentage, and risk status using controlled assumptions. * **Ramp Capacity Planning \-** Model capacity through NPI and production ramp, accounting for phased equipment availability, qualification timing, learning curves, yield maturation, staffing readiness, and expected OEE progression. * **Constraint \& Bottleneck Analysis \-** Identify physical and operational bottlenecks, quantify the magnitude and timing of each gap, and determine whether the constraint is driven by equipment, process, labor, test, material flow, floor space, or readiness. * **Scenario \& Allocation Modeling \-** Evaluate alternative site allocations, production transfers, shift patterns, overtime, equipment redeployment, line conversions, outsourcing, or phased CapEx. Quantify capacity, cost, schedule, and risk tradeoffs for leadership decisions. * **Equipment / CapEx Requirements \-** Convert verified capacity gaps into equipment and line requirements, including quantity, timing, utilization, required operational readiness, and the impact of supplier lead time, installation, debug, and qualification. * **Capacity Governance \-** Lead recurring global capacity reviews with site IE, Planning, Operations, Automation, Finance, and NPI. Maintain assumptions, data ownership, action items, decisions, and mitigation due dates. * **Digital Capacity Platform \-** Develop Power BI dashboards and standardized data structures for capacity, demand, utilization, ramp, and equipment requirements. Support integration with planning, ERP/MRP, MES, equipment, and other approved data sources. * **Data Quality \& Change Control \-** Establish validation rules and revision control for forecast changes, cycle\-time updates, equipment status, site allocations, and other inputs that materially change capacity conclusions. **QUALIFICATIONS:** * Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Operations Research, Mechanical Engineering, or a related quantitative/technical discipline. * 5\+ years of experience in manufacturing capacity planning, Industrial Engineering, production planning, operations analytics, or factory modeling in a high\-volume environment. * Strong knowledge of cycle time, OEE, yield, available hours, utilization, bottleneck analysis, line loading, equipment requirements, and production\-ramp modeling. * Demonstrated ability to convert forecast and demand into machine, line, labor, and capital requirements and to communicate the assumptions behind the analysis. * Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and experience with Power BI are strongly preferred. Experience with ERP/MRP, MES, SQL, Snowflake, or manufacturing databases is a plus. * Experience supporting NPI, factory allocation, production transfers, CapEx planning, or global capacity reviews is strongly preferred. * Strong analytical communication skills with the ability to present complex scenarios, risks, and recommendations clearly to technical and executive audiences. * Ability to manage multiple changing data inputs while maintaining accuracy, traceability, and version control. * Travel \- Approximately 15\-30% domestic and international travel. Amphenol Corporation is proud of our reputation as an excellent employer. Our focus is to provide the highest level of support and responsiveness to both our employees and our customers, the world's largest technology companies. Amphenol Corporation offers the opportunity for career growth within a global organization. We believe that Amphenol Corporation is unique in that every employee, regardless of his or her position, has the ability to positively impact the business. Amphenol is an “Equal Opportunity Employer” \- Minority/Female/Disabled/Veteran/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity/National Origin. For additional company information please visit our website at https://www.amphenol\-cs.com/

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years. #### **ABOUT THE TEAM** The LatticeOS Team builds the foundational software\-defined operating system that powers our family of autonomous systems, sensors, and third\-party integrations. Our work spans edge devices, robotic platforms, and cloud infrastructure, creating a unified operating environment for system orchestration, secure data distribution, and real\-time execution. As a core engineering capability, LatticeOS directly enables mission\-critical operations across all domains, powering both internal products and external developer partners integrating through the Lattice SDK. Our solutions are designed for real\-world deployment in the most demanding operational environments, where reliable middleware, high availability, and seamless hardware\-software integration make the difference between mission success and failure. #### #### **ABOUT THE JOB** As a Senior Software Engineer working in the ProtoKV domain you will design and build the core distributed key\-value infrastructure that underpins state sharing across Lattice OS, focusing on performance, reliability, and consistency guarantees at the edge. They'll own the protobuf schema evolution strategy and API surface, ensuring that services across the mesh can safely publish and consume typed state without breaking contracts. A significant portion of the role involves optimizing for the unique constraints of tactical environments — low\-bandwidth links, intermittent connectivity, and strict latency requirements — where traditional distributed systems assumptions don't hold. You'll also collaborate closely with teams across Lattice to understand consumption patterns, debug cross\-service state issues, and evolve ProtoKV's replication and conflict\-resolution mechanisms as the platform scales to new mission sets. **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or relevant field, or equivalent experience * 6\+ years of professional software development experience, with a focus on distributed systems or data/databases * Deep experience with Python, Go lang, C\+\+, Rust, or similar systems programming languages * Solid distributed\-systems fundamentals. You can reason about replication, consistency, partition behavior, and failure modes, and explain why a given design does or doesn't converge. * Production experience building or operating storage engines, databases, or large\-scale data infrastructure. * Comfort in a systems language. Depth matters more than the specific language you've used. * A bias toward shipping and owning your work. The team is small and what you build is load\-bearing The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top\-tier benefits for full\-time employees, including: ### **Benefits** At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.* ### **Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams** Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information. To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind: * **No Financial Requests:** Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates. * **Please always verify communications:** + Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will *only* come from an @anduril.com address. + Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com. * **Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:** If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links. * **What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:** Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts. ### **Data Privacy** To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant\-privacy\-notice/. jobs.title: Research Scientist, Life Sciences (Computational Chemistry)
jobs.description: **About Anthropic** ------------------- Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. **About the role** ------------------ Anthropic's Life Sciences team is building a research group focused on biological discoveries by combining AI with hands\-on biological research. We're seeking a research scientist who combines deep chemistry knowledge with machine learning expertise to join the team. Our goal is to speed up progress in the life sciences by an order of magnitude, and this role puts that mission into practice. You'll be a computational chemist who knows reactions, synthesis, and medicinal chemistry in depth and has hands\-on experience training and evaluating machine learning models. Above all, you'll build the reinforcement learning environments, datasets, and evaluations that teach Claude chemistry. Working alongside our bench chemists and AI researchers, you'll turn real chemistry problems and experimental data into training tasks and measure whether the models get better at them. This role is fully on\-site in the San Francisco Bay Area. **Key responsibilities** ------------------------ * Design and build reinforcement learning environments for chemistry end to end, including task design, data curation, automated grading, and checks against shortcuts and data leakage * Design and source new experimental datasets, environments, and evaluations with our bench chemists, and external research and academic partners * Develop evaluations that measure model performance on real chemistry tasks, such as reaction outcome prediction, synthesis planning, structure elucidation, and compound design, and feed results back to research teams * Run and analyze training experiments with AI research teams, diagnose where models fail at chemistry, and prioritize what to build next * Ensure datasets and environments are high quality and well documented, including sources, train and test splits, and failure modes * Communicate findings clearly to chemistry, AI research, and life sciences audiences **Minimum qualifications** -------------------------- * PhD in chemistry, computational chemistry, or a related field * Deep knowledge of organic and medicinal chemistry, including reactions, synthesis, and SAR, with experimental data as your ground truth * Strong Python skills and solid machine learning fundamentals, with hands\-on experience training and evaluating models * Comfort navigating ambiguity and defining problems in a rapidly evolving research environment * Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across cross\-functional teams, with strong written and verbal communication skills **Preferred qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience with reinforcement learning, large language models, or building evaluations and benchmarks * Track record of supporting drug discovery programs alongside medicinal and synthetic chemists * Experience curating chemistry datasets from the literature, patents, or lab notebooks, including reaction, ADMET, and spectroscopic data * Cheminformatics and molecular modeling skills, for example RDKit, docking, free energy calculations, or quantum chemistry * Hands\-on synthetic or medicinal chemistry experience at the bench * Publications, patents, or open\-source software demonstrating scientific impact The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $300,000 \- $320,000 USD **Logistics** ------------- **Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience **Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience **Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position **Location\-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. **Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. **We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. **Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. **How we're different** ----------------------- We believe that the highest\-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large\-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long\-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest\-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT\-3, Circuit\-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI \& Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. **Come work with us!** ---------------------- Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: Acoustics ML & DSP Engineer
jobs.description: At Apple, new ideas have a way of quickly becoming extraordinary products, services and customer experiences. Sound is an essential and compelling facet of the customer experience. Apple has assembled a world\-class Acoustics team that enables our customers to experience music with delight, communicate with clarity and appreciate our products without disturbance from noise. In Apple Acoustics we work with obsessive attention to detail, directly contributing to products that ship to millions of people around the world. The Audio System Tuning team is looking for an Acoustics ML and DSP Engineer to innovate on and improve the voice processing features and algorithms in Apple devices. This is an applied, product\-focused role. You will develop, tune and ship ML and DSP algorithms for the voice audio front end across iOS, macOS and wireless products. Your work will keep phone and video calls clear and natural for everyone on the call, and make Siri and voice recognition reliable in real\-world conditions. In this fast\-paced, hands\-on role, you will take algorithms from prototype through on\-device testing into production, where they reach millions of customers. We’re looking for someone who enjoys turning new ideas into real product improvements, and who thrives while balancing several projects at once. **Description** As an Acoustics ML and DSP Engineer, you will develop new speech enhancement algorithms that combine machine learning and DSP, and take them from prototype to production on Apple devices. You will use and extend existing large\-scale data preprocessing, simulation and cloud training pipelines, building new ones where needed. You will tune, optimize and listen to algorithms, and debug issues by tracing them to the data, the model or the signal chain. Your work will improve voice quality and intelligibility for telephony and voice calls in challenging conditions such as echo, double talk and noisy environments, and you will measure the effect of front\-end processing on telephony quality and machine listening applications. You will also follow the state of the art in speech processing and adjacent fields, and work cross\-functionally with tuning, DSP and audio ML colleagues within the team and with partners across the hardware and software organizations. **Preferred Qualifications** Experience with audio DSP, such as echo and double\-talk handling, microphone array processing, beam\-forming, dynamics processing, EQ and noise suppression. Experience with hybrid systems that combine classical signal processing and machine learning. Familiarity with telephony voice quality requirements. Knowledge of front\-end processing for speech recognition and machine listening. Experience with multi\-modal machine learning. Strong coding and debugging skills (Python and C/C\+\+), plus MATLAB for analysis. Knowledge of transducers and their acoustic integration. Curious and eager to try new ideas quickly, while keeping multiple product programs on track. **Minimum Qualifications** MS with 3\+ years of relevant experience, or PhD, in Acoustics, Audio, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or a related field. Solid grasp of acoustics and signal processing fundamentals. Experience shipping audio or speech enhancement ML algorithms from prototype to production. Proficiency with PyTorch and Python, including version control, testing and reproducible experiments. Working knowledge of Max/MSP for real\-time audio prototyping. Experience with causal, streaming models under real\-time latency and compute constraints. jobs.description: A generated interface is only as good as the pieces it's made from. Give a model the wrong pieces and it fails, producing something generic or broken. jobs.title: Full-Stack Robotics & AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Astera** ---------------- Astera Institute is a private foundation supporting ambitious work in science and technology through grants, investments, and in\-house research. Its research programs combine the pace and autonomy of a startup with the freedom to pursue difficult scientific questions. Learn more about Astera’s mission at astera.org/vision. **About the Robotics Lab** -------------------------- We are building a frontier robotics lab at Astera Institute. We believe neuroscience and AI will converge in embodied intelligence: animals and robots face shared challenges of perceiving their surroundings, navigating, manipulating objects, and using memory and reasoning to accomplish tasks in the physical world. Robotics provides a powerful testbed for investigating how biological neural circuits solve these challenges and for developing AI systems that turn perception, learning, and cognition into effective action. Our strategy starts with making robots useful, while developing a mechanistic understanding of how neural circuits can generate intelligent behavior. We aim to continually expand the repertoire of behaviors a robot can perform reliably in real environments, while improving its ability to learn new skills, adapt to changing conditions, and recover from failure. These practical capabilities provide both measurable outcomes and a foundation for investigating deeper principles of intelligence. **Position Summary** -------------------- We are looking for an engineer who can take a learning\-based robotics system from model development to reliable operation on a physical robot. You will work across perception, policy learning, inference, and robot integration, connecting what a model predicts to what a robot actually does. This is a hands\-on engineering role in our Robotics Lab in Emeryville, California. You will work closely with researchers and hardware engineers to develop manipulation capabilities, investigate failures on real robots, and improve the software and models together. **Core Responsibilities** ------------------------- * **Develop models for robotic manipulation.** Fine\-tune and evaluate vision and action models for robotic manipulation, using pretrained models and robot data. * **Connect perception to action.** Build the software that connects cameras and other sensors to model inference and robot commands, including calibration, coordinate transforms, action representations, and control interfaces. * **Optimize models for deployment.** Deploy models on robot hardware and optimize inference latency, memory use, and throughput through profiling, distillation, compilation, and precision changes. * **Build responsive policy execution.** Implement responsive policy execution, including asynchronous inference and action chunking where appropriate. * **Diagnose failures across the stack.** Debug failures across the full system—from observations and model outputs to middleware and physical motion—and build logging, replay, and evaluation tools to understand them. * **Build reusable robot software.** Package robot capabilities with clear interfaces, reproducible configurations, and tests so other team members can use and extend them. **Desired Qualifications** -------------------------- * **Machine learning engineering.** Strong Python skills and practical experience training or fine\-tuning models in PyTorch or a comparable framework. * **Physical robot integration.** Experience integrating learning or perception systems with physical robots, including coordinate frames, sensor calibration, and action or control interfaces. * **Systems debugging and optimization.** Ability to profile software, identify runtime bottlenecks, and debug problems that span models, robotics software, and hardware. * **Practical engineering experience.** A record of building working systems and evaluating them on real tasks, with a clear understanding of your own technical contributions. * **Technical collaboration.** Comfort working closely with researchers and engineers, making practical tradeoffs, and iterating from experimental results. * **Robot learning experience.** Robot learning frameworks such as LeRobot or openpi, imitation learning, or vision\-language\-action models. Helpful, but not required. * **Inference optimization experience.** Model distillation and inference optimization with tools such as ONNX or TensorRT. Helpful, but not required. * **Manipulation and policy execution experience.** Dexterous or contact\-rich manipulation, asynchronous policy execution, or reusable robot skill interfaces. Helpful, but not required. **Why Join Us?** ---------------- Work on both sides of embodied AI: improve the models and build the systems that turn their outputs into useful behavior on physical robots. You will contribute across model development, deployment, and robot integration, with direct access to the physical systems your software controls. You will work alongside robotics researchers, AI engineers, and neuroscientists in a lab that connects practical robot capabilities with deeper questions about learning and intelligence. The role offers broad technical ownership and close collaboration across disciplines. Compensation Range: $180K \- $280K
