You are also the technical lead for our AI builders. You set the standard for how agents are designed, reviewed, and shipped across service lines, you review their work, and you are the person leadership turns to when a build needs a decision. You will embed with the paid media, creator, and ecommerce teams to find where throughput or margin is lost, build the system that fixes it, drive adoption, and move to the next one. This is a builder and a leader role. You ship working systems yourself, and you raise the bar for everyone else who ships them. **What you'll do** ------------------ **Build against the marketing platforms our revenue runs on** * Integrate with the Meta Marketing API, TikTok Business and TikTok Shop APIs, Google Ads API, Snap, Shopify, and affiliate and creator platform APIs: OAuth and token refresh, rate limits, webhooks, and partnership\-access flows. * Build agents and automations for ad launching and QA, budget pacing and reallocation, creative tagging and performance intelligence, anomaly detection, and cross\-platform commission tracking. * Build the reporting layer that shows a brand what actually drove revenue, cross\-referenced against Shopify as the source of truth. **Embed with the teams and ship against real problems** * Sit with paid media, creator and affiliate, CRO, and ecommerce teams. Audit how they work today, map the workflow from input to output, and find the steps that should run automatically. * Turn a messy manual process into a working system inside weeks, not quarters. Define where a human approves and where the system acts on its own, especially where money or brand safety is on the line. * Drive adoption. A system that ships and sits unused does not count. Train the team, gather feedback, and iterate. **Build Innovative AI Driven Marketing SolutionsAI** * Provide technical leadership on product roadmap. Be an expert in building and shipping production ready solutions. * Set the standard for how Avenue Z designs, reviews, documents, and ships agents and automations across service lines, and enforce it through code review and design review. * Review and mentor the engineers and builders already working on AI automation across PR, SEO and AEO, organic social, and ecommerce. Unblock them, raise their quality bar, and own the outcome of their work. * Run the intake and prioritization of automation requests so the team builds what moves revenue, time saved, or client retention, in that order. * Report progress, blockers, and measured impact to the CTO and present to leadership. **Invent new capability** * Build things that create new advantages for the business, not just faster versions of old tasks: autonomous media buying, creative\-to\-landing\-page pipelines, creator performance ranking, and whatever you see next that we have not. **What you won't do** --------------------- * Be a passive project coordinator or a pure strategist with no build capability. * Spend months planning without shipping. * Wait for perfect requirements before building. * Build for novelty instead of business value. * Replace human judgment where brand, strategy, or client context still matters. * Treat marketing as someone else's domain. You have to understand the ad account as well as the people running it. **Who you are** --------------- **Required** * A background in growth marketing. You have personally run paid media on at least one of Instagram and Facebook, Google, or TikTok, and you understand campaign structure, pixels and events, attribution windows, creative testing, and what the numbers mean. * Hands\-on experience working with the Meta Marketing API and the  ity. * Commercially aware: knows the difference between an impressive demo and a system that makes or saves money. * High agency. Does not wait to be assigned the problem. * Good judgment on what should be automated and what should stay human. * Can switch between a conversation with a media buyer and a code review without changing register. **Show us your work** --------------------- We will ask every candidate for a list of projects or code repositories that demonstrate the ability to do this job. Public GitHub repos, private repos you can grant read access to, a Loom walkthrough of a system in production, or a written case study with architecture and results all work. We are looking for: * At least one build against a marketing platform API (Meta, TikTok, Google, Shopify, or similar) that ran in production. * At least one AI agent or automation that replaced real manual work, with the before and after. * Evidence of your coding practice: how you structure a project, handle secrets, test, and document. * If you have led a team, an example of a standard you set and how you enforced it. Candidates who cannot share any work product will not advance. **Your first 90 days** ---------------------- **Days 1 to 15: Learn the work** * Meet the paid media, creator, CRO, and ecommerce leads and the AI builders across service lines. * Get read access to the ad accounts, the platform apps, and the existing agent codebases. Audit what is live, what is half\-built, and what is broken. * Map the highest\-friction, highest\-frequency workflows and prioritize three to five to build or fix first. * Agree success metrics and reporting cadence with the CTO. **Days 16 to 45: Build fast** * Ship your first agent or automation into live use on a named client account. * Review the open work of the existing builders and set the code review and design review standard. * Document logic, approvals, edge cases, and operating rules for everything you ship. **Days 46 to 75: Expand and standardize** * Extend what works to more accounts and teams. Build reusable patterns, templates, and shared tooling. * Introduce a clear framework for human review and escalation, especially for anything that touches spend or client\-facing output. * Take over intake and prioritization of automation requests. **Days 76 to 90: Prove impact** * Present before and after results, adoption, and measured time or money saved to the CTO and CEO. * Recommend the next wave of builds. * Have a team that ships to your standard without you in every review. **Success metrics** ------------------- * Three to five high\-value systems live on real client accounts in the first 90 days. * Measurable reduction in manual work on targeted processes, with the baseline captured before the build. * Strong internal adoption by the teams using the systems. * Reliable performance with clear exception handling. Nothing touches a live ad account or a client without a logged action and a named approver. * The AI builders across service lines shipping to a single documented standard. * A clear roadmap for the next phase of agent development tied to revenue, retention, or cost. **Daily reality** ----------------- * Review a manual process in paid media or creator ops and redesign it into a system. * Build or refine an agent based on yesterday's feedback from a media buyer. * Review another builder's pull request and send it back with what to change. * Wire a new platform endpoint, handle the token refresh, and ship it. * Monitor what is running, fix what failed overnight, and improve reliability. * Ship again. **Reporting** ------------- * Daily: async update to the CTO on builds, blockers, and wins. * Weekly: working session with the CTO on priorities, decisions, and impact. * Monthly: summary of automation impact, adoption, and next opportunities to the CEO. **Benefits** ------------ * Medical, vision, and dental plans * 401(k) plan with 4% employer match * Unlimited PTO * Professional development stipend

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer
jobs.description: **The big picture:** Axios is a respected media company dedicated to providing trustworthy, award\-winning news content in an audience\-first format known as Smart Brevity™. We are looking for a Senior Security Engineer with strong cloud infrastructure and AI security experience to lead our defensive posture, drive threat modeling and vulnerability management, and embed security controls \- including AI\-driven defense and monitoring \- across our platform and automation pipelines. **Why it matters:** As a Senior Security Engineer at Axios, you will architect and implement proactive security strategies to protect our audience, platform, and data assets against evolving threat vectors, including AI\-driven attacks. In this role, you will define our security roadmap, leverage internal and third\-party AI defense tools, and ensure our cloud systems remain resilient, secure by default, and capable of automated threat detection and response. **Responsibilities:** * Lead the architectural design and implementation of security controls across cloud infrastructure, platform services, and AI integrations. * Drive vulnerability management, threat modeling, incident response, and proactive security assessments across AWS, Kubernetes, and AI application environments. * Shape, maintain, and execute the company's long\-term security roadmap in close alignment with engineering and executive leadership. * Embed automated security testing, SAST/DAST, and AI\-driven compliance checks directly into CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure\-as\-code workflows. * Oversee identity and access management (IAM), secrets management, encryption protocols, and zero\-trust architecture standards. * Evaluate, deploy, and maintain internal AI security tools and modern third\-party defensive solutions to detect, mitigate, and respond to AI\-driven threats and sophisticated attack vectors in real time. * Promote a strong security culture across engineering by conducting threat modeling workshops and coaching teams on secure coding and infrastructure practices. * Partner with product, infrastructure, data, and QE teams to ensure security is integrated seamlessly into every stage of the development lifecycle. **Skills:** * Deep expertise in cloud and application security, including threat modeling, vulnerability scanning, penetration testing, IAM, secrets management, AI security, and compliance frameworks. * Strong working knowledge of AWS infrastructure and security controls (IAM, KMS, EKS, RDS, S3\). * Experience hardening Kubernetes clusters, runtime security, container scanning, and network policy enforcement. * Proficiency in integrating SAST/DAST and security automation into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions). * Solid scripting or programming skills in Python, Go, or Bash for security tooling and automated remediation. * Hands\-on experience with SIEM, security logging, automated threat intelligence, and AI\-powered monitoring frameworks (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, or modern SOC tooling). * Demonstrated leadership in driving security initiatives, defining policy, and guiding engineering teams on security risk. * Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to effectively balance security requirements and business agility. **What success looks like:** * **Security \& Compliance:** Focused on proactive security initiatives, including automated vulnerability scans, implementation of controls, remediation, and contributions to the long\-term security roadmap. * **Cloud Security Architecture:** Hardened, reviewed, and optimized AWS and Kubernetes infrastructure security to meet strict compliance, resilience, and least\-privilege access standards. * **DevSecOps \& Automation:** Integrated automated security scans, secret detection, and vulnerability gates seamlessly into CI/CD pipelines without disrupting developer velocity. * **Security Tooling Adoption:** Evaluated, piloted, and deployed advanced security and defensive AI tools that measurably enhanced threat detection speed and reduced exposure risk. * **Threat Detection \& Response:** Established robust security monitoring, SIEM alerting, and incident response playbooks to maintain real\-time visibility and rapid response capabilities across all production platforms. * **Cross\-Functional Security Leadership:** Partnered with engineering, product, and QE teams to instill a security\-first culture, conduct threat modeling workshops, and guide technical teams on risk mitigation. * **AI Defense \& Security:** Evaluated and deployed internal AI security tools and 3rd\-party defensive solutions to proactively safeguard infrastructure, applications, and corporate assets against AI\-driven threats and emerging attack vectors. *Starting salary for this role is in the range of $150,000 \- $180,000 and is dependent on numerous factors, including but not limited to location, work experience, and skills. This range does not include other compensation benefits. Axios' compensation philosophy takes into account the cost of labor differentials across the country. Because this is a remote\-optional job posting, this salary range takes into account all possible locations within the United States, but candidates will only be eligible for the salary range for their location.* Axios is committed to embracing artificial intelligence as a core part of how we work. All team members are expected to actively develop AI literacy and use AI tools to enhance their productivity, creativity, and efficiency. We invest in ongoing learning to ensure every employee is equipped to responsibly and effectively integrate AI into their daily workflows. **What Axios brings to the table besides salary:** * 401(k) with employer match * Robust PPO and High Deductible health insurance options on the Blue Cross Blue Shield network * Employer Health Savings Account (HSA) contribution for the high deductible health plan option * Dental and vision coverage * Primary caregiver 12\-week paid leave * Birth\-givers will have an additional 6\-8 weeks depending on type of delivery, for a total of 18\-20 weeks continuous leave * Generous vacation policy, plus holidays * One mental health day per quarter * Annual learning and development stipend * $100 monthly work\-from\-home stipend * Tele\-mental health services through Headspace * OneMedical membership, including tele\-health services * Personal health advocacy resources through HealthAdvocate * Inclusive fertility, hormonal health and family forming benefits through Carrot Fertility * Access to the Axios Employee Support Fund, which was created to allow employees to request financial support when facing financial hardship or emergencies * Increased work flexibility for parents and caretakers * Virtual company\-sponsored social events * A strong and positive work environment * A commitment to an open, inclusive, and diverse work culture **Equal Opportunity Employer Statement** Axios is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, age, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. Axios makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Scientist
jobs.description: #### **Join Axon and be a Force for Good.** At Axon, we're on a mission to Protect Life. We're explorers, pursuing society's most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other. Life at Axon is fast\-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you'll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter. **Your Impact** We are seeking highly skilled and innovative Machine Learning Scientists to join our AI team, focusing on AI applications (LLM and Computer Vision) in Cloud, Devices and Robotics. As a key member of our research and development efforts, you will play a crucial role in advancing the state\-of\-the\-art in Large Language Models (LLMs), Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), Computer Vision and GenAI technologies for law enforcement and beyond. You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to design, develop, and deploy cutting\-edge LLM, MLLM, CV models and algorithms and solutions that enable intelligent reasoning, perception and understanding of multimodal data. **What You'll Do** Location: any cities with Axon Engineering Hub in US, Vietnam, EU (see https://www.axon.com/company) * US: Seattle, Boston, Scottsdale #### **Responsibilities** * Own one or more key technical areas across LLM, MLLM, CV product portfolio. * Provide technical leadership to junior scientists, guiding the transition of R\&D concepts into impactful Axon product feature. * Research and develop cutting\-edge techniques in LLM, MLLMs, GenAI, and Computer Vision across cloud, devices and sensors based data sources. * Design and implement efficient and scalable MLLM models for inference and analysis of multimodal data. * Explore novel approaches to address challenges in NLP, NLU, Object Detection, Object Recognition, Object Tracking, Segmentation, and Scene Understanding. * Optimize AI models, algorithms for performance, memory footprint, and energy efficiency to meet the requirements of resource\-constrained devices. * Join force with MLEs or firmware or hardware engineers to leverage hardware accelerators and optimize algorithms for specific hardware architectures. * Evaluate the performance of LLM, MLLM, CV models using real\-world datasets and design experiments to validate their effectiveness. * Stay up\-to\-date with the latest research trends and advancements in computer vision, machine learning, and deep learning, MLLMs, GenAI and integrate relevant findings into our projects. * Contribute to patent disclosures, academic publications, and technical documentation to share insights and findings with the broader community. * Experience coach and mentor junior scientists. #### **What You Bring** * PhD and with \+5 years for ML Scientist, \+8 years for Sr. ML Scientist, \+10 years for Principal ML Scientist experience in Computer Science or a related field with a focus on LLM, MLLMs, Computer Vision, GenAI. * Proven track record of research excellence in LLM, MLLM, Computer Vision, Robotics Perception, GenAI, demonstrated through publications in top\-tier conferences or journals. * Strong proficiency in programming languages such as Python, C/C\+\+, experience with deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Keras and experience with ROS or robotic operational system. * Drive one or more phases of the ML development lifecycle: shape datasets, investigate modeling approaches and architectures, train/evaluate/tune models and implement the end\-to\-end training pipeline. * Leverage state\-of\-the\-art research to deliver high quality models enabling multiple AI projects at scale. * Contribute back to the research community via academic publications, tech blogs, open\-source code and contributing to internal/external AI challenges * Experience in developing computer vision algorithms for resource\-constrained devices such as mobile phones, IoT devices, or embedded systems is highly desirable. * Excellent problem\-solving skills, analytical thinking, and the ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a team environment. * Strong communication skills and the ability to effectively present complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences. #### **Benefits that Benefit You** * Competitive salary and 401k with employer match * Discretionary paid time off * Paid parental leave for all * Medical, Dental, Vision plans * Fitness Programs * Emotional \& Mental Wellness support * Learning \& Development programs * And yes, we have snacks in our offices *Benefits listed herein may vary depending on the nature of your employment and the location where you work* ***Location:*** *This role is based out of our Scottsdale, AZ office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in\-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesday through Friday, with flexibility to work remotely on Mondays. We believe connection fuels innovation, and our in\-office culture is designed to support meaningful teamwork and mentorship.* Don't meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long\-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve. Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you're excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. **Important Notes** *The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.* *Some roles may also require legal eligibility to work in a firearms environment.* *We collect personal information from applicants to evaluate candidates for employment. You may request access, deletion, or exercise other CCPA rights at* ***axongreenhousesupport@axon.com*** *or via our* *Axon Privacy Web Form**. For more information, please see the Your California Privacy Rights section of our* *Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice.* *Axon's mission is to Protect Life and is committed to the well\-being and safety of its employees as well as Axon's impact on the environment. All Axon employees must be aware of and committed to the appropriate environmental, health, and safety regulations, policies, and procedures. Axon employees are empowered to report safety concerns as they arise and activities potentially impacting the environment.* *We are an equal opportunity employer that promotes justice, advances equity, values diversity and fosters inclusion. We're committed to hiring the best talent — regardless of race, creed, color, ancestry, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances — and empowering all of our employees so they can do their best work. If you have a disability or special need that requires assistance or accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email* *recruitingops@axon.com.* *Please note that this email address is for accommodation purposes only. Axon will not respond to inquiries for other purposes.* Phishing alert: Axon will never ask you to pay for any part of the hiring process, including training, equipment, or background checks. We do not make job offers via text message, WhatsApp, or instant messaging platforms without a formal interview process. All legitimate job openings are listed on our official careers page at https://www.axon.com/careers. If you receive a suspicious offer or outreach from an email address that is not **@axon.com**, or if you are asked for sensitive personal information (bank details, Social Security Number) prematurely, please ignore the message and report it to recruitingops@axon.com.

jobs.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: Now **We are the people who give possibilities purpose** ---------------------------------------------------- BD is one of the largest global medical technology companies in the world. Advancing the world of health™ is our Purpose, and it’s no small feat. It takes the imagination and passion of all of us—from design and engineering to the manufacturing and marketing of our billions of MedTech products per year—to look at the impossible and find transformative solutions that turn dreams into possibilities. **Job Description** =================== **About the Role** We are seeking a highly experienced Staff Machine Learning Engineer to help advance next\-generation medical technologies for continuous physiological monitoring, disease detection, and predictive clinical decision support. In this role, you will develop clinically meaningful algorithms using multi\-modal healthcare data, including physiological sensor signals, medical device data, electronic health records, imaging data, and other real\-world clinical datasets. You will work in a highly cross\-functional environment with algorithm engineers, data scientists, clinicians, systems engineers, software teams, regulatory specialists, and product leaders to translate complex clinical and physiological problems into validated, deployable algorithmic solutions. This is a senior technical role suited for an engineer with deep expertise in classical machine learning, modern AI/deep learning, physiological signal interpretation, and real\-world deployment across both cloud\-based platforms and edge medical devices. **Key Responsibilities** * Lead the design, development, validation and deployment of AI/ML algorithms for continuous physiological monitoring, novel vital sign and physiological parameter development, disease detection and risk stratification and early warning systems. * Develop algorithms using multi\-modal data sources, including physiological waveforms and time\-series data such as PPG, blood pressure, capnography and other monitoring signals, bedside and wearable sensor data, electronic health records and structured clinical data, etc. * Apply advanced analytical approaches, including: * Classical machine learning models * Statistical modeling and probabilistic inference * Time\-series modeling * Signal processing and feature engineering * Deep learning architectures * Multimodal AI models * Transformer\-based models and foundation\-model approaches where appropriate * Translate clinical and physiological understanding into robust algorithm design, including feature selection, model architecture, performance targets, and clinically interpretable outputs. * Build end\-to\-end algorithm development pipelines for data ingestion, signal quality assessment, annotation, feature extraction, model training, validation, robustness testing, and post\-market performance monitoring where applicable. * Partner with clinical, medical affairs, regulatory, quality, and product teams to ensure algorithms are developed with appropriate clinical context, usability, safety, and regulatory considerations. * Develop and optimize algorithms for cloud environments and for edge or embedded medical devices, accounting for latency, memory, compute, power, cybersecurity, and reliability constraints. * Support verification, validation, documentation, risk analysis, and design controls for regulated medical technology products. * Contribute to intellectual property generation, technical strategy, research roadmaps, and external scientific engagement. **Required Qualifications** * 7\+ years of industry experience in AI/ML, algorithm development, biomedical signal processing, healthcare analytics, medical devices, or related technical areas. * Master’s or PhD degree preferred in Electrical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Computational Biology, or a related engineering or quantitative field. * Deep expertise in machine learning and AI model development, including both classical and modern approaches. * Strong hands\-on experience with physiological time\-series data, biomedical signals, medical device data, or clinical datasets. * Understanding of human physiology, especially as it relates to patient monitoring. * Demonstrated experience developing algorithms from early feasibility through productization or deployment. * Experience working with multi\-modal healthcare data, such as sensor signals, EHR data, imaging data, lab data, and clinical outcomes. * Strong programming skills in Python and experience with ML/AI frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit\-learn, or equivalent tools. * Experience with cloud\-based algorithm development and deployment using platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP. * Experience optimizing models for deployment on constrained environments, including embedded systems, edge devices, or near\-real\-time medical technology platforms. * Strong understanding of model evaluation, use we believe it fosters creativity, innovation, and effective problem\-solving, which are essential in the fast\-paced healthcare industry. For most roles, we require a minimum of 4 days of in\-office presence per week to maintain our culture of excellence and ensure smooth operations, while also recognizing the importance of flexibility and work\-life balance. Remote or field\-based positions will have different workplace arrangements which will be indicated in the job posting. For certain roles at BD, employment is contingent upon the Company’s receipt of sufficient proof that you are fully vaccinated against COVID\-19\. In some locations, testing for COVID\-19 may be available and/or required. Consistent with BD’s Workplace Accommodations Policy, requests for accommodation will be considered pursuant to applicable law. **Why Join Us?** ================ To find purpose in the possibilities, we need people who can see the bigger picture, who understand the human story that underpins everything we do. We welcome people with the imagination and drive to help us reinvent the future of healthcare. At BD, you’ll discover a culture in which you can learn, grow and thrive. We believe that when people connect in person, we learn faster, collaborate more deeply, and build a stronger culture. Join us and enjoy a culture where face\-to\-face collaboration supports your learning, your progress, and your success. **To learn more about BD visit** https://bd.com/careers. Becton, Dickinson, and Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, marital or domestic or civil union status, familial status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetics, disability, military eligibility or veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics. Required Skills Optional Skills . **Primary Work Location** ========================= USA CA \- Irvine Laguna Canyon **Additional Locations** ======================== **Work Shift** ============== At BD, we reward, support and develop our associates through our comprehensive Total Rewards program. We are committed to attracting and retaining high quality talent by providing reward and recognition opportunities that promote a performance\-based culture, as well as a competitive package of compensation and benefits programs. **Benefits may include:** **Health \& Well\-being:** Medical, dental, vision, health savings and flexible spending accounts, life and disability insurance, wellness resources, mental health support, and disease management programs. **Retirement \& Financial Well\-being:** 401(k), deferred compensation programs, financial counseling, DailyPay, and educational savings resources. **Work\-Life Balance \& Family Support:** Paid time off, company holidays, educational assistance, parental leave, adoption assistance, backup care, caregiving support, employee assistance programs, commuter benefits, pet insurance, legal services, and associate discount programs. **Leave Programs:** Bereavement, military, personal, family and medical leave, and jury duty leave. Additional details regarding benefits and well\-being programs can be found in Our Commitment to You. Our salary or hourly rate ranges reward associates fairly and competitively. We regularly review these ranges and factors, such as location, contribute to the range displayed Our pay is based on the role and the necessary skills and education to perform it successfully. The salary or hourly rate offered is determined by the role's specific requirements, including any applicable step rate pay system at the work location. Salary or hourly pay ranges are influenced by labor laws and Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA) requirements applicable to the work location which may also affect the workplace arrangement of the role. **Salary Range Information** $129,600\.00 \- $207,400\.00 USD Annual

jobs.title: Sr Application Security Engineer
jobs.description: **A World\-Class Team** BJ’s Wholesale Club is powered by more than 30,000 team members who make a real impact every day. Whether you're stocking shelves, solving problems or shaping strategy, your work helps families save on what matters most. We’re a team built on purpose and opportunity. Join us and be part of something meaningful. **Why You’ll Love Working at BJ’s** At BJ’s Wholesale Club, our team members are at the heart of everything we do. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, well\-being and future – both on and off the job. When you grow, we grow. **Here’s just some of what you can look forward to:** * **Weekly Pay:** Get paid every week so that you can manage your money on your terms. * **Daily Pay:** Access your earned pay before payday, giving you more flexibility when you need it. (fee may apply.) * **Free BJ’s Memberships:** Enjoy a complimentary The Club Card Membership, plus a free Supplemental Membership for someone in your household.\* * **Generous Paid Time Off:** Take the time you need with vacation, personal, sick days, holidays, bereavement, and jury duty leave.\* * **Flexible and Affordable Health Benefits:** Choose from three medical plans, and access optional dental, vision, Health Savings Account (HSA), and flexible spending account options to fit your lifestyle.\* * **401(k) Retirement Savings Plan:** Build your financial future with a company match (available to team members 18 and older).\* * **Employee Stock Purchase Plan:** Accumulate funds through after\-tax payroll deductions that can be used to purchase shares of BJ’s common stock at a 15% discount.\* * Eligibility requirements vary by position. **Job Summary:** BJ’s is seeking a Senior Application Security Engineer to secure the software behind our digital, e\-commerce, and club\-facing experiences. This is a hands\-on engineering role responsible for threat modeling, operating the application security testing tool chain, and partnering with development, platform, and product teams to build and ship secure software. This is an individual contributor role on the Application Security team, with no direct reports. The engineer in this role is expected to work independently, apply sound technical judgment, and contribute to maturing our Secure SDLC practices against OWASP SAMM, BSIMM, and NIST SSDF. It is well\-suited for an engineer with a software development or security engineering background who wants to deepen their application security specialization, prefers technical depth over management, and can build credibility with developers in a PCI\-regulated retail environment. **Job Responsibiliies:** * Perform threat modeling and security reviews of new and existing applications, APIs, microservices, and third\-party integrations across customer\-facing and internal platforms. * Operate and tune the application security testing toolchain — SAST, DAST, SCA and dependency analysis, secrets detection, infrastructure\-as\-code scanning, and container image scanning — including onboarding applications, expanding coverage, and reducing false positive rates. * Work directly with development teams to remediate security defects and provide recommendations on secure coding practices and fixes. * Implement and maintain security controls within CI/CD pipelines, including policy\-as\-code and automated testing capabilities to support secure software delivery. * Execute Secure SDLC improvements aligned to OWASP SAMM, BSIMM, and NIST SSDF, contributing to maturity assessments and closing assigned gaps. * Work alongside embedded and co\-sourced team members to support application security activities and promote consistent security practices. * Support API security across discovery and inventory, schema and specification validation, and identification of shadow and zombie APIs. * Support the development and maintenance of secure coding guidance and reusable security resources for development teams. * Provide guidance on secure coding practices and participate in developer security awareness and security champions initiatives. * Support PCI DSS 4\.0\.1 application requirements, including secure development practices, change control, client\-side script integrity and monitoring for payment pages, and evidence collection for audits. * Support penetration testing and responsible disclosure activity — scoping input, findings validation, retesting, and root cause analysis to prevent recurrence. * Automate security testing tasks and evidence collection through integrations across security tooling, source control, and Jira to eliminate manual effort. * Perform software supply chain security reviews, including open\-source governance, SBOM generation and review, and evaluation of third\-party and SaaS applications. * Support incident response for application\-layer events, including exploit reproduction, root cause analysis, and recommended control improvements. * Write and maintain application security documentation, runbooks, and standard operating procedures. * Produce metrics and reporting that provide visibility into scanning coverage, Secure SDLC adoption, and the security posture of the application portfolio. **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or equivalent practical experience. * 4–6 years of hands\-on security or software engineering experience, with at least 2 years focused specifically on application or product security. * Working knowledge of at least one modern programming language — Java, C\#/.NET, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or Go — with the ability to read application code and recognize vulnerable patterns. * Working knowledge of the OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10, and OWASP ASVS, with the ability to explain both exploitability and the correct fix to developers. * Hands\-on experience operating enterprise SAST, DAST, and SCA tooling, including onboarding applications and tuning rulesets. * Experience participating in threat modeling using STRIDE or a comparable methodology and translating findings into actionable security requirements. * Experience integrating security testing into CI/CD pipelines. * Experience securing cloud\-native applications in AWS, Azure, and/or GCP, including containerized workloads (Docker required, Kubernetes preferred). * Hands\-on experience with scripting and automation (Python, Bash, PowerShell). * Familiarity with security frameworks and compliance requirements jobs.title: Enterprise Desktop Architect
jobs.description: Bessemer Trust is seeking an experienced Enterprise Desktop Architect to join our Desktop Engineering team. This senior, hands\-on technical role is responsible for defining and continuously evolving the firm's endpoint computing architecture across physical desktops, laptops, virtual desktops, and modern endpoint management platforms. The successful candidate will combine deep technical expertise with architectural vision and strong engineering judgment. This individual will challenge established practices, evaluate emerging technologies, and define an endpoint standard optimized for performance, reliability, security, supportability, and end\-user experience. The role requires the ability to work closely with Information Security and other technology teams to understand risk, quantify the operational and performance impact of security controls, and recommend solutions that provide the appropriate balance between security and functionality. This position is based in our Woodbridge, NJ office with a hybrid schedule of three days in the office and two days remote each week. **Primary Responsibilities** ============================ **Endpoint Strategy \& Architecture** ------------------------------------- * Define and maintain the firm's enterprise endpoint architecture and technology roadmap across desktops, laptops, VDI, endpoint management, identity integration, and application delivery. * Establish and continuously reassess the enterprise desktop standard rather than accepting existing technologies, configurations, or practices by default. * Design, build, and optimize Windows 11 and endpoint configurations for performance, stability, reliability, security, and user experience. * Evaluate endpoint hardware, software, security technologies, management platforms, and emerging capabilities through technical analysis, benchmarking, proof\-of\-concepts, and pilots. * Define standards for provisioning, configuration management, patching, compliance, endpoint lifecycle management, and automation. * Drive adoption of automated application packaging, deployment, patching, and lifecycle management using Tanium and other endpoint\-management technologies, reducing reliance on manual deployment processes. * Translate business and technical requirements into scalable, supportable enterprise solutions. **Security, Performance \& User Experience** -------------------------------------------- * Partner with Information Security to evaluate endpoint security technologies, configurations, and controls. * Assess security controls in the context of risk reduction, endpoint performance, usability, operational complexity, and supportability, and recommend appropriate trade\-offs. * Implement and mature Digital Employee Experience (DEX) and endpoint analytics capabilities, defining meaningful technical and user\-experience metrics, baselines, and service\-level objectives. * Use endpoint telemetry, performance testing, DEX metrics, and operational data to proactively identify performance degradation, recurring issues, and opportunities for improvement. * Provide hands\-on architectural leadership for complex endpoint incidents and drive root\-cause analysis and permanent corrective actions. * Develop automation and engineering solutions that improve consistency, reliability, and operational efficiency. **Technical Leadership** ------------------------ * Serve as the senior technical authority and hands\-on technical escalation point for Desktop Engineering. * Challenge legacy approaches and drive adoption of modern engineering practices and technologies where they provide measurable benefit. * Establish engineering, testing, deployment, documentation, and configuration standards. * Mentor engineers and provide technical leadership for complex or high\-impact initiatives. * Partner across Information Security, Identity, Networking, Infrastructure, Application Delivery, Desktop Support, and other technology teams. * Evaluate vendor solutions and provide technical recommendations for technology selection and strategic investments. **Microsoft 365 \- Desired Experience** --------------------------------------- Microsoft 365 administration experience is desirable but secondary to endpoint architecture responsibilities. Eligible employees may participate in a 401(k) program with a generous profit\-sharing contribution, medical, prescription dental, and vision coverage; life insurance; disability coverage; paid holidays; vacation; and sick time, subject to plan terms and Company policies. **About Bessemer Trust** Bessemer Trust is a family office, overseeing more than $250 billion in assets for over 3,000 individuals and families of substantial wealth. jobs.title: Associate Engineer - Software
jobs.description: ### **Description** We’re looking for an early\-career engineer who cares as much about how a platform feels to use as how it’s built. You’ll work directly with a Principal Engineer who has architected and guided most of our platform, learning to build software that meets real customer needs the first time. This is a hands\-on engineering role across our full stack, from edge device hardware to mobile, web, and developer tooling, with a path to technical leadership.### **Key Responsibilities** * Build, test, and ship features across our platform, including web apps, mobile apps, APIs, SDKs, and CLIs * Participate in architecture and design reviews, and learn to design systems that are scalable, maintainable, and easy to use * Evaluate engineering designs for customer impact: how will this change the experience of installing, configuring, and using the product? * Contribute technical feasibility input to product planning so ideas are grounded in reality before work begins * Look beyond usage metrics to understand real customer satisfaction, using feedback, support patterns, and direct observation * Support the end\-to\-end experience of our edge device hardware, from installation through ongoing operation * Document design decisions and tradeoffs so teams stay aligned and avoid rework * Grow through code review, pairing, and mentorship from senior engineers ### **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience) * Solid programming fundamentals in at least one modern language, demonstrated through coursework, internships, or projects * Curiosity about users: you notice rough edges in the software you use and want to fix them * Clear written and verbal communication, and comfort asking questions and giving feedback * A willingness to learn across a broad technical surface * Nice to have * Exposure to web or mobile development, REST APIs, SDKs, or command\-line tools * Interest in hardware, embedded systems, or IoT * Experience with UX research, usability testing, or customer\-facing work * Open\-source contributions, hackathons, or personal projects **What you’ll gai**n* One\-on\-one mentorship from a Principal Engineer who has shaped most of our platform * Broad exposure across hardware, mobile, web, and developer tooling, with a structured ramp through each area * Early experience making engineering tradeoffs with the customer in mind, a skill that usually takes years to develop * A clear growth path: Associate Software Engineer Software Engineer Senior Software Engineer Staff and beyond ### **Job Benefits** Brivo is a Great Place to Work\-Certified™ company and the global leader in cloud\-based access control and video surveillance. Following our merger with Eagle Eye Networks, we are building the only platform powerful enough to support the future of AI\-driven security. Why Your Work Matters Innovation drives our vibe, but purpose drives our mission. You will work on essential systems that protect the health, safety, and welfare of people and property worldwide. At Brivo, your voice is heard, your talent is respected, and your contributions have a global impact. * *The Brivo Experience:* We thrive on in\-person collaboration and a "one\-team" atmosphere. We embrace our international presence, leveraging diverse ideas and backgrounds to improve our culture and our products. To keep our global teams connected and inspired, we provide a premium onsite experience featuring communal meals, recurring social events, and fully stocked workspaces—ensuring you have everything you need to stay focused while building the future of security. * *Total Rewards:* We support our people with competitive medical, vision, and dental plans (including company\-offset premiums), a 401k with company match, and an unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO) policy that empowers you to take the time you need to maintain a healthy work\-life balance. Individual compensation packages are based on job\-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, training, and market conditions. In addition, Brivonians enjoy a robust benefits and perks package tailored to their work location.### **About Brivo** Brivo and Eagle Eye Networks have come together to create a category\-defining, cloud\-first platform at the intersection of AI and the physical world. Our mission is simple and ambitious: to make physical spaces safer, smarter, and more autonomous—from single\-site businesses to global enterprises. As the unified global leaders in cloud\-based access control and video surveillance, we provide a comprehensive digital foundation for the built environment. By combining Brivo’s pioneering building access platform with Eagle Eye’s AI\-powered video management system (VMS), we have created a system of intelligence that protects over 600 million square feet across 90\+ countries. Every door, camera, and credential in our ecosystem acts as a real\-time sensor, leveraging AI to prevent incidents, improve operations, and enable entirely new workflows across sectors, including commercial real estate, retail, healthcare, education, and critical infrastructure. With a global footprint spanning headquarters in Bethesda, Maryland, and Austin, Texas, and international offices in Amsterdam, London, Bangalore, and Tokyo, we are leveraging our open APIs and cyber\-secure cloud infrastructure to reshape the future of physical security. Join us as we build the world’s most robust platform for video intelligence and smart space automation. Learn more at www.brivo.com. *Brivo is an equal employment opportunity employer and values diversity. Qualified candidates are considered for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, military or veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodations during the application or interview process, please inform us.*

and provisioning pipelines, patch and compliance reporting across macOS, Windows, and Ubuntu * Automate the repetitive work — onboarding and offboarding, access provisioning, inventory reconciliation, reporting — with scripting and the APIs of the tools we already run * Administer and contribute towards the office and engineering network: improve security and user experience * Support engineering infrastructure, including Linux workstations and shared compute resources * Ensure compliance of corporate endpoints and SasS services * Own Tier 1 \+ 2 service desk tickets * Evaluate and implement new tooling: run the trial, make the recommendation, own the rollout * Write and maintain documentation and runbooks so recurring issues become self\-service * Conduct POCs of new solutions for the company * Manage hardware and software inventory, license assignments, and renewal tracking Occasional after\-hours or weekend availability may be needed for planned work such as office moves, equipment refreshes, network changes, or system maintenance. **Priorities: 3\-12 Month Goals** ***First 3 Months*** * Take full ownership of onboarding and offboarding across macOS, Windows, and Ubuntu, and implement zero\-touch where feasible * Own the service desk, serve as the first point of contact for all support tickets and escalations * Fully understand and master the IT asset lifecycle end to end: procurement, assignment, recovery, and retirement ***By 4\-6 Months*** * Implement a patch management program that covers all personnel workstations * Fully audit internal company resources and harden security posture * Document and clean up network segmentation, including the boundary between corporate and engineering environments * Build out the internal knowledge base and measurably reduce the top recurring ticket drivers ***By 6\-12 Months*** * Automate and standardize IT operations across onboarding/offboarding, endpoint provisioning, software deployment, and routine administrative workflows, ensuring appropriate approvals, auditability, and alignment with established policies. * Mature endpoint compliance and vulnerability management by maintaining consistent patching, security baselines, monitoring, and risk\-based remediation across macOS, Windows, and Ubuntu. * Strengthen identity and access management through least\-privilege enforcement, period nce * Experience in a hardware, robotics, manufacturing, or lab environment * Cloud infrastructure exposure (AWS, GCP) * Certifications such as CompTIA Network\+ or Security\+, or a vendor accident, critical illness, and hospital indemnity plans (Voya) * Company\-paid basic life insurance, plus voluntary (supplemental) life for you and your dependents * Short\-term and long\-term disability insurance, fully paid by Cyngn * HSA and FSA (Health \& Dependent Daycare) * Employee Assistance Program * 1:1 Health Concierge * Company 401(k) * Commuter Benefits * Flexible PTO policy * jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Blood Platform
jobs.description: **At Caris, we understand that cancer is an ugly word—a word no one wants to hear, but one that connects us all. That’s why we’re not just transforming cancer care—we’re changing lives.** We introduced precision medicine to the world and built an industry around the idea that every patient deserves answers as unique as their DNA. Backed by cutting\-edge molecular science and AI, we ask ourselves every day: *“What would I do if this patient were my mom?”* That question drives everything we do. But our mission doesn’t stop with cancer. We're pushing the frontiers of medicine and leading a revolution in healthcare—driven by innovation, compassion, and purpose. **Join us in our mission to improve the human condition across multiple diseases. If you're passionate about meaningful work and want to be part of something bigger than yourself, Caris is where your impact begins.** **Position Summary** Caris Life Sciences is one of the largest precision\-oncology platforms in the world, serving hundreds of thousands of molecular cases a year and growing at double\-digit rates. Behind every case is a matched molecular, imaging, and clinical\-outcomes data estate few organizations anywhere can rival, and the clinical software that drives the lab's instruments and processes, captures results, and delivers each patient's report. A patient and an ordering physician are waiting on every one of those reports. The Engineering Manager leads one of the front\-line teams that keep that software reliable and moving. This assignment leads the blood\-platform engineering team, spanning the laboratory information systems behind Caris Assure and Caris Detect blood operations. The team is growing with the blood product roadmap and pairs closely with its Product Manager counterpart. The Engineering Manager \- Clinical Software Products leads a front\-line engineering team in Caris Life Sciences' Clinical Software Engineering organization, reporting to the Senior Director, Clinical Software Engineering. This is a player\-coach position: the Engineering Manager owns delivery, quality, and operational health for an assigned platform team while staying technically engaged in design and code review. The platforms in scope are live, business\-critical clinical systems under SOX financial controls and FDA regulatory requirements, and the Engineering Manager is directly accountable for the supervision, change\-control discipline, and engineering standards those obligations demand. The engineering environment is modern and funded: frontier AI coding assistants are standard\-issue tooling, with agentic workflows across design, implementation, and test generation. Characterization tests and golden\-master replay validation serve as executable evidence for regulated change. Delivery runs on CI/CD with application\-level observability and risk\-based release governance aligned with current FDA Computer Software Assurance guidance. Modernization of established systems is active, funded engineering work. The Engineering Manager runs the team on this model and is accountable for making automation\-first practice its daily norm. **Job Responsibilities** * Manage a front\-line team of software engineers: hiring, onboarding, performance management, coaching, and career development. * Own delivery for the assigned platform: sprint planning, prioritization with the paired Product Manager, estimation, and predictable release execution under regulated change control. * Remain technically engaged: participate in design and architecture reviews, perform code review at a meaningful cadence, and hold the team's engineering standards (testing, documentation, observability) to the level a SOX/FDA\-gated estate requires. * Run the team on an automation\-first operating model: recurring manual engineering and operational work is a defect to engineer away, AI\-assisted workflows are standard daily practice, and automated test and evidence coverage is a first\-class delivery responsibility. * Onboard engineers into the regulated environment, including structured knowledge transfer when a new team member absorbs existing platform scope. * Partner with Application Site\-Reliability Engineering on production readiness, incident response, and post\-incident remediation for the assigned platform, keeping production access inside segregation\-of\-duties requirements. * Maintain team health at a sustainable pace: balanced on\-call/support load, managed work\-in\-progress, and early escalation of capacity risks. * Bring team\-level facts to quarterly capacity and hiring planning: throughput, support load, and skill coverage. * Keep compliance moving at the pace of delivery: change\-control records, review evidence, and documentation to SOX and FDA standards for all team output. * Embed secure SDLC practices in the team: OWASP Top Ten awareness in design and code review, and penetration testing coordinated early in development. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 8\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 2\+ years of direct people\-management or formal team\-lead responsibility for a production software team. * Delivered and operated software subject to FDA, SOX, CLIA, HIPAA, or equivalent regulated\-environment controls. * Managed delivery with agile/scrum practices, including planning, estimation, and stakeholder communication. * Hired and onboarded software engineers. * Led teams that apply automation and AI\-assisted engineering practices in daily delivery, including automated testing, CI/CD, and scripted operations. **Preferred Qualifications** * Worked in healthcare, clinical laboratory, diagnostics, or life sciences software environments. * Demonstrated ability to stay technically engaged while managing: substantive contribution to design review, code review, and architectural decisions on a live production system. * Stood up or reshaped a team while maintaining delivery continuity. * Managed teams that operate production systems with formal on\-call rotations. * Familiarity with structured knowledge\-transfer practices when teams absorb existing platform scope. **Physical Demands** * Ability to sit, stand, and work at a computer for extended periods. **Training** * All job\-specific, safety, and compliance training is assigned based on the job functions associated with this employee. **Other** * This role may require periodic travel to other Caris sites or partner locations. After\-hours response to emergency production issues and participation in escalation rotations may be required. **Conditions of Employment:** Individual must successfully complete pre\-employment process, which includes criminal background check, drug screening, credit check ( applicable for certain positions) and reference verification. This job description reflects management’s assignment of essential functions. Nothing in this job description restricts management’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. Caris Life Sciences is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability.

jobs.title: Staff Frontend Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description Summary** ‎ At Castlight, we are looking for a Staff Frontend Engineer to serve as a high\-impact individual contributor across our consumer health products. You will architect and deploy white\-labeled micro\-frontends, obsess over the details that make web experiences feel exceptional, and operate with a fast\-paced, high\-agency mindset to solve critical user problems week after week. ‎ **How will you make an impact \& Requirements** ‎ **Who You Are:** * **A Craftsperson of Experience:** You are obsessed with the nuances of UX that make an application "feel right"—going far beyond pixel\-matching a design spec to deliver fluid, intuitive, and responsive interfaces. * **A Micro\-Frontend Architect:** You thrive in complex web environments, knowing how to build, scale, and deploy white\-labeled micro\-frontends that integrate seamlessly across diverse consumer touchpoints. * **A High\-Agency "Lone Wolf":** You operate with incredible autonomy. You don't wait for a rigid ticket backlog; you look at the product, figure out the highest\-impact thing you can build or fix this week, and execute fast. * **Agile \& Flexible:** Frameworks are just tools in your belt. While our core ecosystem relies on Angular, you bring deep mastery in modern JavaScript/TypeScript (React, Vue, or Angular) and adapt quickly to tackle the next big challenge. * **Mission\-Driven \& Relentless:** You embrace nimble environments. You seek to eliminate operational friction where you can, push through obstacles when you must, and maintain a high standard of engineering excellence along the way. **Who We Are:** At Castlight, we’re making it as simple as humanly possible for people to navigate the complicated, often frustrating, world of healthcare. We partner with America’s largest employers and health plans, transforming employee benefits into a deeply personalized and guided journey for millions of users. What we build genuinely helps people live happier and healthier lives. **What You'll Do:** Reporting into Engineering Leadership, you will serve as a premier Individual Contributor driving the frontend architecture of our consumer health platforms. You’ll be surrounded with the modern tools and resources you need, given clear ownership, and empowered to operate with maximum speed and impact. In this role, you will: * **Architect \& Scale:** Design, build, and maintain high\-performing, white\-labeled micro\-frontends using Angular, TypeScript, and modern web standards. * **Elevate UX Performance:** Polish consumer\-facing applications to deliver elite performance, accessibility, and micro\-interactions that elevate the overall user experience. * **Drive Weekly Impact:** Prioritize ruthlessly in a fast\-paced environment, identifying and executing on high\-leverage opportunities that move the business and product forward. * **Set Frontend Standards:** Serve as a subject matter expert across frontend architectures, establishing best practices for state management, component reusability, and build pipelines. **Skills \& Qualifications:** * **Technical Expertise:** 8\+ years of professional frontend software engineering experience with deep mastery of modern JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS/SCSS. * **Framework Proficiency:** Expert\-level knowledge in Angular or equivalent deep mastery in modern React/Vue with a proven track record of quick technology adaptation. * **Architecture Experience:** Hands\-on experience designing, deploying, and maintaining micro\-frontend architectures and white\-label design systems at scale. * **Product \& UX Intuition:** A sharp eye for UI design details, rendering performance, web vitals, and creating delightful user interactions. * **Autonomous Execution:** Strong track record as a high\-impact individual contributor who can take ambiguous requirements and ship polished production code quickly. * **Communication:** Ability to articulate complex architectural decisions and technical trade\-offs to both engineering peers and business stakeholders. **What You'll Get:** * **Competitive Compensation:** A highly competitive salary and benefits package. * **Autonomy \& Empowerment:** Work as a trusted high\-impact contributor with minimal bureaucracy and maximum freedom to ship great work. * **Growth Opportunity:** Build high\-visibility, consumer\-scale applications using modern web technologies across critical healthcare touchpoints. * **Work That Matters:** You aren't just writing JavaScript; you're building seamless access points that help millions of people navigate their health and care. ‎ **Compensation Range:** $131,243\.00 to $196,865\.00 *The anticipated base Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, skills, qualifications, geographic location, internal equity, and business needs.*

jobs.description: Description: **Coverage Insurance Experts that guide you from enrollment to peace of mind!** At Catch Coverage, we’re more than an Insurance organization, we’re a team of dedicated, compassionate professionals united by a mission to improve lives and elevate the customer experience. When you join us, you become part of a forward\-thinking, customer\-focused culture that invests in your growth, supports your well\-being, and empowers you to make a meaningful impact on people’s everyday lives. If you’re ready to advance your career in a dynamic, innovative, and genuinely supportive environment, apply today and discover why Catch Coverage is shaping the future of Insurance. **Job Position: Data Engineering \& Analytics Senior Manager** **Job Location:** This position is based in our Clearwater, FL or Fort Lauderdale, FL office. Candidates who live within 50 miles of either office will be required to work on\-site at that location. Candidates who live outside this radius may be considered for a remote work arrangement, subject to company approval and business needs. Remote eligibility is not guaranteed. **PURPOSE OF THE JOB:** The Data Engineering \& Analytics Senior Manager is responsible for making sure Catch Coverage's data is accurate, connected, and trusted across the business. Our call center, Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) operation, and distribution business generate data on calls, leads, enrollments, carrier commissions, agent licensing and contracting, and marketing spend. This role brings it together so leaders can see what is happening and make better decisions. This is a hands\-on leadership role. You will set the direction for our data platform, build and maintain the pipelines and data models behind it, and manage a small team that grows with the function. You will turn complex data into reliable reporting and forecasting for operations, sales, compliance, and finance, while protecting sensitive customer information. **RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Own architecture, build\-versus\-buy decisions, and standards across Snowflake, AWS, orchestration, transformation, and third\-party tooling * Build and run production ETL/ELT pipelines from REST APIs, cloud storage, CRM, Genesys Cloud, Retreaver, carrier and licensing/contracting sources, and book\-of\-business systems, with testing, monitoring, alerting, and documentation * Manage Snowflake operations, including role\-based access, warehouse sizing, query performance, Protected Health Information (PHI) and Personally Identifiable Information (PII) handling, and consumption cost control * Own incident response, including on\-call and escalation procedures, root\-cause analysis, and recovery runbooks * Build dimensional models and curated marts for agents, agencies, carriers, plans, leads, calls, enrollments, policies, and commissions * Deliver a semantic layer and analytics\-ready datasets that power dashboards and controlled self\-service * Produce call center volume and staffing forecasts, including Annual Enrollment Period and Open Enrollment Period seasonality, and commission and revenue forecasts * Support segmentation, attribution, experimentation, and predictive models (such as lead scoring and agent attrition) where they change a decision * Lead, coach, and set priorities for the data team, and hire as the roadmap justifies * Maintain a written quarterly roadmap and intake process for new data requests * Partner in person with operations, sales, compliance, finance, and technology leaders to define requirements and drive adoption of the numbers * Own the data function budget (Snowflake, AWS, software, contractors, vendors), forecast spend, and bring renewal and investment recommendations to leadership Requirements: * 7\+ years in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a closely related role, including 2\+ years leading or mentoring a data team and making architecture or technology decisions * Advanced, current Snowflake experience: data modeling, SQL optimization, RBAC, warehouse and workload management, and cost management * Advanced SQL and strong Python, with a track record of building and running production ETL/ELT pipelines and API integrations * Deep knowledge of data warehousing, dimensional modeling, data quality testing, observability, and cloud object storage * Working statistical competence: forecasting, segmentation, experimentation design, or predictive modeling applied to business decisions * Experience owning or materially influencing a cloud, software, or vendor budget * Ability to explain technical decisions and tradeoffs to non\-technical executives, and to say no with a reason * Ability to work on\-site in Fort Lauderdale or Clearwater, Monday through Friday **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:** * AWS (S3, Lambda, Glue, EventBridge, IAM) * dbt or a comparable transformation framework * Airflow, Dagster, or Prefect * Git\-based workflow and CI/CD for data * Contact\-center, CRM, insurance distribution, lead\-generation, or performance\-marketing data; Medicare or Affordable Care Act (ACA) experience is a strong plus * Experience handling Protected Health Information (PHI) and Personally Identifiable Information (PII) under the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), and working with compliance teams on Centers for Medicare \& Medicaid Services (CMS) and Telephone Consumer Centerfield is headquartered in Silicon Beach and is proud to be recognized by Built in LA as a Best Place to Work in Los Angeles. **Role Overview...** -------------------- We’re looking for a Data Scientist with 2\+ years of experience to turn complex data into models, insights, and recommendations that improve business performance. You’ll tackle problems involving customer behavior, marketing effectiveness, sales conversion, and forecasting, partnering with business stakeholders, data engineers, and machine learning engineers. This role combines a strong foundation in statistics and machine learning with the ability to apply AI and large language models (LLMs) to practical business problems. **Core Responsibilities...** ---------------------------- * Partner with marketing, sales, and operations teams to define business problems, establish success metrics, and identify opportunities to improve conversion, revenue, and efficiency. * Explore and combine data from multiple sources using SQL and Python. Investigate data quality issues, develop features, and document assumptions. * Build and evaluate predictive models for use cases such as customer propensity, lifetime value, segmentation, and forecasting. * Apply statistical analysis and experimentation to understand performance drivers, measure impact, and communicate uncertainty and limitations. * Develop reusable analytical workflows and automate recurring analyses to support faster, more consistent decision\-making. * Collaborate with engineering teams to integrate models into business workflows and monitor their performance over time. * Apply AI and LLMs to use cases such as extracting insights from unstructured data and supporting analytical workflows. Evaluate output quality, reliability, cost, and appropriate handling of data. * Present findings to technical and nontechnical audiences, explain trade\-offs, and recommend clear next steps. **Job Responsibilities...** --------------------------- * 2\+ years of experience in data science or a closely related role applying statistical analysis and machine learning to business problems. * Strong SQL skills and proficiency in Python for data preparation, analysis, modeling, and evaluation. * A solid foundation in statistics and machine learning, including regression, classification, clustering, and hypothesis testing. * Experience with feature engineering, model validation, and selecting appropriate evaluation metrics, including an understanding of overfitting and data leakage. * Ability to work with AI and LLMs, demonstrated through professional, academic, or personal projects.
