jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: At CEC Entertainment, we build careers around great food, family, and fun! Our purpose and our passion is to create the best place for kids and families to eat and play! **Job Description** The **Sr. Software Engineer** is responsible for designing, developing and maintaining business\-critical software for CEC Entertainment as part of a distributed Software Engineering team. The role is full stack in the CEC sense: the same engineer builds C\# applications that run on our NCR Voyix Aloha point\-of\-sale terminals in more than 500 stores, design and develop microservices REST API to run our backend in an efficient way. Well versed with Azure cloud and its services. **Major Responsibilities:** * **Front end.** Develop and maintain web front ends (Angular or React) for internal tools, portals and configuration consoles that support the POS and loyalty platforms. * **Back\-end APIs and Azure services.** Develop, deploy and operate C\# .NET (Core/.NET 8\+) Web APIs, Azure Functions and background services in Microsoft Azure using App Service, API Management, Key Vault, Storage, Service Bus/Event Grid, Azure SQL and Application Insights; own infrastructure\-as\-code and CI/CD pipelines for the services you build. * **POS application development.** Design, develop and maintain the C\# applications that run on Aloha POS terminals (.NET Framework, WinForms) * **Integrations.** Build and maintain integrations with third\-party platforms and vendors — NCR Voyix, FreedomPay, Affirm, Twilio, SEMNOX, Workday and SaaS partners — and with internal platforms such as OmniFun loyalty and the enterprise data hub. * **Engineering quality.** Establish and enforce best practices for secure, scalable, resilient and efficient software: code reviews, unit and integration tests, static analysis, secrets management, structured logging and monitoring, and safe rollout and rollback of store\-impacting releases (pilot stores before fleet). * **Production support.** Provide tier\-3 support for POS and API incidents within the team's protected support capacity, perform root\-cause analysis, and drive permanent fixes into the backlog; participate in an on\-call rotation as required. * **Collaboration and communication.** Work with cross\-functional teams to ensure code quality, testing, piloting, installation and implementation are executed efficiently; communicate technical options, risks and trade\-offs clearly to both technical and business audiences. **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Computer Engineering or similar degree * 8\+ years of professional software development experience, with at least 4 years in C\# and the .NET ecosystem spanning both .NET Framework (WinForms/desktop, COM interop) * Hands\-on experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs — contracts, authentication (OAuth 2\.0 / JWT / API keys), versioning, resilience patterns (retry, circuit breaker, idempotency) and API documentation (OpenAPI). * 3\+ years building and operating solutions on Microsoft Azure: App Service or Azure Functions, API Management, Key Vault, Storage, Azure SQL, messaging (Service Bus/Event Grid), Application Insights, and Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions CI/CD. * Solid front\-end skills with a modern framework (Angular preferred; React), TypeScript, HTML and CSS. * Working knowledge of SQL Server / Azure SQL data modelling and query performance, and of secure coding practices for environments handling payment card and guest data (PCI DSS awareness; secrets never in code or logs; TLS in transit, encryption at rest). * Experience in a fast\-paced Agile / Scrum, continuous\-integration environment using Jira, Confluence and Git\-based workflows (GitHub). * Demonstrated ability to work effectively in and help lead high\-performing, globally distributed development teams. * Strong communication and presentation skills, demonstrated continuous technical learning, and the ability to build relationships across the organization with a sharp focus on the customer — both internal and external. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Direct experience with NCR Voyix Aloha (Aloha Connect / COM interop, Configuration Center, Aloha Kitchen or ATO), or with another enterprise POS platform's extension model. * Experience with payment and loyalty integrations (FreedomPay or similar gateways, tokenization, buy\-now\-pay\-later providers, loyalty/CRM platforms). **Physical Demands:** To perform the duties of this position, the incumbent must have the ability to sit, walk, stand, bend, twist, reach, and carry, lift, pull, push between 1 – 25 lbs. Incumbent must use a computer, with the repetitive movement of both hands. Incumbent must be able to work an 8\-hour shift, with some overtime. Incumbent must also be available to travel to various locations by airplane or by operating a vehicle if needed. *Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.* **\#Diversity \#Inclusion \#Culture** **The Company:** CEC Entertainment, LLC (“CEC”), headquartered in Irving, Texas, is a nationally recognized leader in family dining and entertainment, proudly operating the iconic Chuck E. Cheese, Peter Piper Pizza and Chuck’s Arcade brands. Chuck E. Cheese celebrates over half a million birthdays annually, dedicated to creating joyful, lasting memories through fun, food, and play. As the place Where a Kid Can Be a Kid®, the brand is committed to safety through programs like Kid Check® and community support, having donated more than $24 million to schools and nonprofits. In 2025, Chuck E. Cheese received the “Best in STEM” award and was named one of America’s Greatest Workplaces, highlighting its industry leadership both in innovation and employee well\-being. Peter Piper Pizza offers a neighborhood pizzeria experience with quality food, engaging entertainment, and lifelong memories because fun isn't added on\-“The Fun is Baked In”! Through amusement and connection, families and communities are brought together every day. Both Chuck E. Cheese and Peter Piper Pizza champion play through different attractions to support physical wellness and strengthen motor skills in kids. CEC Entertainment and its franchisees operate nearly 600 Chuck E. Cheese locations and over 120 Peter Piper Pizza venues across 45 states and 18 countries. The company proudly fosters a culture of diversity and celebrates fun and play to unite every family. Learn more at chuckecheese.com and peterpiperpizza.com. **Benefits:** CEC Entertainment offers a wide variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, disability, and 401(k) retirement savings plan to eligible U.S. employees as part of their overall employment package. We also offer job training and career growth opportunities. Chuck E. Cheese is a "Work Today, Get Paid Tomorrow" employer. \* \* \* At CEC Entertainment, we believe that our workforce should reflect the diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives of many guests we serve. jobs.description: Install, maintain, troubleshoot, and repair advanced industrial X\-ray systems at customer facilities worldwide — microfocus X\-ray sources, high\-voltage generator systems, and industrial linear accelerators (LINACs) used in NDT, metrology, and inspection for aerospace, defense, nuclear, automotive, electronics, and energy customers. jobs.description: As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI\-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission\-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI\-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you. **About the Role:** The Platform API team builds the cross\-platform APIs and abstractions that give the CrowdStrike Falcon sensor a consistent programming interface across Windows, Linux, and macOS. The team owns the foundational layer that separates feature development from OS\-specific implementation, including threading, file I/O, hashing, work queues, and memory management. Every engineering team that builds sensor capabilities depends on this layer, so its quality and correctness directly shape how quickly and safely CrowdStrike can deliver protection to customers. The team's scope is growing. A central focus is building a shared platform for on\-sensor machine learning inference runtime: a stable C API, backed by an isolated out\-of\-process service, that runs models on hardware\-accelerated backends on each platform. This runtime will make inference\-based threat detection as accessible to engineering teams as rules\-based detection is today, and it will enable CrowdStrike to bring the next generation of AI\-powered protection to hundreds of millions of endpoints. We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager with deep systems expertise and strong organizational leadership to guide this team. You will own the technical roadmap, lead the inference runtime from early design through production delivery, make key decisions on API design and long\-term compatibility, and build the partnerships needed for broad adoption across the sensor organization. You will collaborate closely with Windows, Linux, and macOS engineering teams, platform infrastructure teams, and partners in product and program management. **What You're Stepping Into** The Platform API team is at an inflection point. As the Falcon sensor continues to grow in capability and reach, a unified, well\-tested platform abstraction layer has become essential to how CrowdStrike builds. Consolidating platform behavior across Windows, Linux, and macOS into a single consistent foundation will improve quality, performance, and delivery speed for every team that builds on the sensor. This is a multi\-year effort, and you will own its roadmap, its strategy, and its execution. At the same time, the team is building one of the most significant new capabilities in the sensor platform: an on\-sensor ML inference runtime designed from the ground up. The API design, execution model, and first production integrations are in active development now. Your leadership will shape how quickly CrowdStrike can deliver AI\-powered detections to hundreds of millions of endpoints, and how easily teams across the company can bring new models to the sensor. If you are energized by building, this is your opportunity to shape a team's identity, expand its scope, and earn broad organizational trust through technical excellence. Your work will be visible across the entire sensor organization, and you will lead a team whose platform the rest of the company relies on every day. **Location:** This role is hybrid, requiring 2x days per week on\-site at one of the posted locations. **What You'll Do:** **Technical leadership** * Set architectural direction for cross\-platform API components, including threading, file I/O, hashing, work queues, and memory management * Lead the architecture and delivery of the centralized platform for on\-sensor ML inference runtime, including C API design for ABI stability and cross\-language use, the out\-of\-process execution and sandboxing model, and backend selection and versioning policy across platforms * Make critical design decisions on what is implemented once versus per platform, what runs in\-process versus out\-of\-process, and how kernel\-mode and user\-mode constraints sh d resource consumption * Experience with hardware\-accelerated inference across GPU, NPU, and Apple Neural Engine (ANE), including hardware capability detection, backend selection, and graceful fallback to CPU * Familiarity with model execution frameworks such as ONNX Runtime, OpenVINO, or Core ML, including runtime versioning and static versus dynamic linking tradeoffs * Experience designing out\-of\-process inference pipelines, including sandboxed execution for resource isolation and fault containment, low\-latency IPC for model input and output, and telemetry for inference performance and hardware utilization * Understanding of the model lifecycle at fleet scale, including staging, versioning, and silent validation before production rollout, particularly for SLM and large language model (LLM) workloads where inference cost and behavioral correctness both matter * Experience designing cross\-language integration surfaces, such as C APIs consumed from Rust, Swift, and C\+\+ * Experience establishing API governance through tooling, such as lint rules, jobs.title: Lead AI & Automation Engineer – Business Process & Healthcare Operations
jobs.description: ### **About the role** We operate multiple businesses, including pharmacy and senior\-living operations, and are building an internal AI and automation capability. We are looking for **one highly hands\-on engineer and problem solver** who can work directly with ownership and employees to identify inefficient processes, repair existing automation, build better systems, integrate software and deploy practical AI throughout the organization. This is **not a strategy\-only AI position and not a prompt\-engineering position**. You should be someone who can observe a broken business process in the morning, understand the systems and data behind it, troubleshoot logs and APIs, build or improve the solution, test it, deploy it and then teach employees how to use it. One of your first priorities will be evaluating and improving existing third\-party bots and automations used in our pharmacy operations. You will become our internal technical owner: understanding what vendors have built, diagnosing problems, determining what should be fixed versus replaced, and making sure our company owns and understands its technology. ### **What you will do** * Spend significant time with employees observing real workflows and identifying repetitive work, data\-entry problems, bottlenecks, errors and opportunities for automation. * Audit, troubleshoot and improve existing bots and vendor\-built automations, including workflows currently supported by outside vendors. * Build production AI and automation solutions using software, APIs, workflow platforms, databases and appropriate AI models. * Integrate business and healthcare systems through APIs, webhooks, database connections, secure file exchange and, where necessary, RPA/UI automation. * Automate document and data\-processing workflows involving PDFs, forms, structured files and other operational information. * Build AI\-assisted workflows with appropriate validation, evaluation, exception handling and human review. * Create reliable systems with logging, monitoring, retries, alerts and clear failure states. * Work with regulated healthcare information and follow company HIPAA/security policies. * Maintain all source code, workflows and documentation in company\-controlled repositories and systems. * Quantify the impact of projects: labor hours eliminated, cycle time, error rates, automation success rate and employee adoption. * Train employees to use AI safely and productively in their own work. * Create reusable AI tools and standards so improvements spread across our pharmacy, senior\-living and other businesses. * Manage technical vendors and hold them accountable for documentation, access, reliability and deliverables. * Work directly with ownership to turn ideas into operating systems rather than presentations. ### **What we are looking for** **Required** * Approximately 5\+ years of hands\-on software engineering, systems integration, automation engineering or equivalent real\-world experience. * Demonstrated history of personally building and deploying production software or automation—not just managing developers. * Strong Python or comparable software\-development skills. * Strong experience with REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, authentication and systems integration. * SQL and practical data\-processing experience. * Experience debugging production systems using logs, error traces and systematic root\-cause analysis. * Experience with Git and professional source\-control practices. * Experience with at least one workflow/automation platform such as n8n, Microsoft Power Automate, Make, Zapier, UiPath or similar. * Hands\-on experience integrating modern LLM/AI APIs into real workflows. * Understanding of testing, AI evaluation, exception handling, observability and production reliability. * Ability to explain technical issues clearly to nontechnical employees. * Curiosity about how businesses actually operate and willingness to sit with employees and watch the work being done. * Willingness and ability to work regularly on\-site in Milton, PA. **Strongly preferred** * Experience in pharmacy, healthcare, senior living or another regulated environment. * Experience handling PHI or other sensitive regulated data. * Familiarity with HIPAA security considerations and Business Associate Agreement requirements. * Familiarity with healthcare interoperability such as FHIR, HL7 and/or NCPDP. * Document\-processing/OCR experience. * RPA experience for legacy systems without modern APIs. * Experience with Docker and AWS, Azure or Google Cloud. * Experience with process mapping, Lean/Six Sigma, root\-cause analysis or operational improvement. * Experience managing outside development or automation vendors. ### **Hybrid schedule** This is **not a fully remote job**. During approximately the first 60–90 days, we expect the successful candidate to spend about four days per week on\-site learning our systems and observing workflows. After the initial discovery and implementation period, we expect the normal schedule to transition to approximately two to three days per week on\-site, depending on active projects. Relocation or signing assistance may be available for an exceptional candidate. ### **What success looks like** Within your first 90 days, you should understand our critical automation environment, establish visibility into existing bot failures, improve several high\-value workflows, put company ownership/documentation standards in place, and provide ownership with a prioritized roadmap of additional AI and automation opportunities. Over time, your job is simple to describe: **Find work that should not require as much human effort as it does today, design a safe and reliable better way, implement it, measure it and make it stick.** ### **Compensation** **Base salary: $150,000–$180,000**, depending on demonstrated capability and experience. Performance bonus. Benefits. Relocation/signing assistance available where appropriate. ### **To apply** Please submit your resume and, where available, links to GitHub, technical projects, portfolio material or other examples of systems you have built. In your application, briefly describe one automation or integration that you personally took from problem identification through production deployment. Tell us what systems were involved, what you personally built, what went wrong along the way and what measurable result the project produced.

maintain DMA’s current\-state, future\-state, and transition architecture, including enterprise standards, principles, reference architectures, and reusable solution patterns. * Partner closely with solution approaches. * Engage early in business initiatives to help shape requirements, evaluate alternatives, identify dependencies, and ensure proposed solutions address the underlying business need direction, and long\-term technology roadmap. * Lead solution architecture for significant business and technology requests, developing solution options, conceptual architectures, trade\-offs, risks, dependencies, and implementation recommendations. * Facilitate architecture and solution\-design discussions across business stakeholders, engineering, data, security, systems, delivery teams, and external vendors to drive well\-informed decisions. * Establish and lead architecture governance, including solution reviews, architecture standards, design decisions, exceptions, dependencies, and technical risk management. * Lead build\-versus\-buy evaluations and assess third\-party solutions for business fit, enterprise alignment, integration, security, data considerations, scalability, supportability, and long\-term maintainability. * Provide architecture leadership for AI\-enabled solutions, including generative AI, intelligent agents, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), document intelligence, automation, Microsoft Copilot, and other emerging technologies. * Help establish architectural standards and governance for AI solutions, partnering with security, data, systems, legal/compliance, and business stakeholders to ensure solutions are appropriately designed, governed, and operationalized. * Partner with engineering leads and delivery teams to validate technical feasibility and translate approved architectures into implementable designs while maintaining alignment with the broader enterprise direction. * Identify opportunities to reduce architectural fragmentation, redundant capabilities, technical debt, unnecessary complexity, and inconsistent technology patterns across DMA’s environment. * Support technology investment and portfolio decisions by identifying opportunities for enterprise reuse, shared capabilities, platform consolidation, modernization, and strategic technology adoption. * Lead, mentor, and develop a team of 2 \- 3 technical professionals while remaining personally engaged in high\-impact enterprise and solution architecture work. * Communicate architecture direction, solution recommendations, investment implications, risks, and trade\-offs clearly to executives, business leaders, and technical teams, building organizational alignment around key technology decisions. * Perform other duties as assigned. **Education and Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience will needs into structured options, architecture recommendations, and decision\-ready materials. * Experience evaluating build\-versus\-buy alternatives, third\-party platforms, vendor solutions, and total lifecycle implications. * Strong working knowledge of cloud architecture, APIs and integration patterns, identity and access management, data platforms, security principles, system lifecycle enterprise knowledge solutions. * Experience with Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365; experience with Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Azure AI services, or comparable enterprise AI platforms is standards, and executive presentations. * Experience in professional services, tax, financial services, or another information\-intensive and regulated environment is a plus. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Applications), Full Stack
jobs.description: Many structural heart patients suffer from heart failure with limited options. Our Implantable Heart Failure Management (IHFM) business's AI, Product and Platforms organization is at the forefront of addressing these unmet patient needs through pioneering technology that enables early, targeted therapeutic intervention. Our innovative solutions are not just transforming patient care but also creating a unique and exciting environment for our team members. It is our driving force to help patients live longer and healthier lives. Join us and be part of our inspiring journey. At Edwards Lifesciences, the Implantable Heart Failure Management (IHFM) AI, Product and Platforms organization designs and builds the software and data products that clinicians and patients depend on. As a Senior Software Engineer (Applications), Full Stack, you own the application and service architecture for a web product area, build the patterns and shared components others follow, and are first in line for the production health of what you ship. Based in Irvine, CA, you'll join a high\-impact medtech innovation hub in the heart of Orange County, collaborating in person with cross\-functional teams to shape patient\-focused technology. **How you'll make an impact:** * Product\-area architecture. Design and own the application architecture for a web product area: state management, routing, data fetching against Platform APIs, rendering strategy, design system implementation, and experimentation. * APIs and security. Define and document the API contracts your product area needs from Platform, consume them through the Platform API gateway, and implement client\-side authentication and authorization flows (OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, SSO); contribute server\-side code to Platform\-owned services where your area requires it. * Performance and reliability. Own customer\-facing performance and quality metrics, such as Core Web Vitals, API latency, and error rates, and build the fixes that move them. * Cloud deployment. Design and deploy your web applications on the cloud (AWS or GCP) using containers, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code, within the standards and security controls that Platform and DevSecOps own. * Patterns and modernization. Build the patterns and shared components others follow, review designs and code against them, and drive targeted modernization in your area, such as Angular to React and BFF to Platform APIs. * Design control. Produce the architecture documents, verification tests, and traceability for your area's design outputs, and understand how they contribute to the Design History File under IEC 62304\. * Production ownership. Serve as a trusted on\-call lead for web surfaces, lead root\-cause analysis, and resolve complex production issues affecting clinicians and patients, including issues that trace into Platform\-owned services you contribute to. * Mentorship. Mentor P1 and P2 engineers, review their designs and code, and participate in hiring. **What you'll need (Required):** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, or related field plus four years of experience \-or\- Master’s degree plus three years of experience. * Deep proficiency in React or Angular with TypeScript and working proficiency in a server\-side stack such as Node.js, Python, Java, Go, or Rust. * Demonstrated experience designing application architecture and API contracts, including state management, data fetching, and integration with internal and third\-party systems. * Experience deploying and operating applications on a cloud platform (AWS or GCP), including CI/CD and containers. * Experience owning the performance, reliability, and production health of end\-user\-facing software. * Strong communication skills, including effective collaboration with distributed teams across time zones, and the ability to set standards within a secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC), including CI/CD and automated testing. **What else we look for (Preferred):** * Experience in medical device software (SaMD), or other regulated classes of device software, under IEC 62304, ISO 13485, and FDA design controls. * Experience leading a frontend modernization, such as Angular to React. * Experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or CDK) and container orchestration (Kubernetes). * Experience with design system implementation and design tokens, including tooling such as Figma and Tokens Studio. * Familiarity with EMR / EHR integration via HL7, FHIR, or IHE. * A cloud certification, such as AWS Solutions Architect or Developer, or a GCP equivalent. * Familiarity with usability engineering and human factors (IEC 62366\-1\). Aligning our overall business objectives with performance, we offer competitive salaries, performance\-based incentives, and a wide variety of benefits programs to address the diverse individual needs of our employees and their families. For California (CA), the base pay range for this position is $108,000 to $153,000 (highly experienced). The pay for the successful candidate will depend on various factors (e.g., qualifications, education, prior experience). Applications will be accepted while this position is posted on our Careers website. Edwards is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer including protected Veterans and individuals with disabilities.

jobs.description: ### **About Eko Health** Eko builds AI and digital tools to enable every healthcare provider to more accurately detect heart and lung disease – the leading causes of death globally. Our FDA cleared, industry leading products are used by hundreds of thousands of clinicians on millions of patients around the world. With Eko, clinicians can detect cardiac and pulmonary disease with higher accuracy, diagnose with more confidence, manage treatment effectively, and ultimately give their patients the best care possible. That work supports Eko's hardware, software, and AI products in human and veterinary health. **Early Projects \& Initiatives** --------------------------------- * Mature and upgrade the deployment pipeline. * Make sure cloud infrastructure continues to goes through the appropriate security processes. * Because the team has shared infrastructure work until now, a valuable first step is turning that shared knowledge into documented, codified practices, including runbooks and system design decisions. **About The Team** ------------------ You will join a team of 5 engineers that report to a team lead. The others on the team are full stack engineers, with some focusing on backend and others in frontend engineering. The team has shared AWS, CI, and CD responsibilities. This hire will take on that ownership and work with the engineers who currently handle it. **Essential Functions** ----------------------- * Design, build, and maintain cloud infrastructure, container orchestration, cloud security posture, and observability monitors/alerts using infrastructure\-as\-code frameworks and best practices * Create and maintain CI/CD pipelines to build, test, artifact and deploy continuously merged code * Build self\-service tooling and paved paths to enable downstream engineers to ship without infrastructure expertise * Upgrade security and vulnerability scanning into our CI/CD layer and help coordinate the triaging of deficiencies * Help harden the software supply chain with artifact signing, SBOM generation, and properly configured build runners * Partner with security/compliance on audits and evidence collection for SOC2/HIPAA/ISO 27001 as applicable * Participate in incident responses that lead to blameless postmortems with tracked follow\-ups * Mentor engineers on operational and secure\-development practices * Contribute to architecture views with a reliability, operability, and security perspective * Help document runbooks, playbooks, threat\-model notes, and system design decisions * Other duties as assigned Note: Job duties may change at any time with or without notice. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * 5 \+ years in DevOps, platform, or infrastructure engineering, including ownership of customer\-facing systems * Deep experience with at least one major cloud provider and IaC practices in a team setting * Strong proficiency in a scripting/programming language (Python, Go, Bash) * Hands\-on experience with container orchestration and CI/CD systems * Working knowledge of cloud IAM and network security fundamentals * Practical SRE experience * Experience with Linux internals, networking, and debugging distributed systems under pressure * Strong communication, organizational, and problem\-solving skills * Expected Travel is less than 10% **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical experience). * Experience in a startup or high\-growth environment, preferably in a regulated environment * Experience supporting audit cycles * Threat modeling or offensive\-security exposure (CTFs, pentest collaboration, bug bounty triage) * Database operations experience * Experience with service mesh, progressive delivery, and chaos engineering ### **Why join Eko Health?** ### **Benefits and Perks We Offer:** * The opportunity to work on products that impact the health of millions of people. * jobs.title: Sr. Principal Engineer - Automation Engineering – Biologics - Lilly Medicine Foundry
jobs.description: At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life\-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. We are a global healthcare leader headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. Our employees around the world work to discover and bring life\-changing medicines to those who need them, improve the understanding and management of disease, and give back to our communities through philanthropy and volunteerism. We give our best effort to our work, and we put people first. We’re looking for people who are determined to make life better for people around the world. Organization and Position Overview Lilly recently announced a $4\.5 billion investment to create the Lilly Medicine Foundry, a new center for advanced manufacturing and drug development. The first\-ever facility of its kind, combining research and manufacturing in a single location, the Medicine Foundry will allow Lilly to further develop innovative solutions to optimize manufacturing processes and increase capacity for clinical trial medicines, while also reducing costs and environmental impact. The Sr. Principal Engineer \- Automation Engineering will work as a member of the Automation Engineering Department at Eli Lilly, Foundry. The Sr. Principal engineer will provide automation support for one or more biologics operating areas across site (such as cell culture, purification, and buffer/media preparation) and/or for capital projects. Process Automation is core to delivering a right first time facility start up and continued support of ongoing manufacturing operations into the future. The Sr. Principal Engineer is also responsible for the productivity and mentorship of the employees with the purpose of ensuring that reliable and compliant\-controlled applications and systems are used in the manufacturing at Foundry. Additionally, the Sr. Principal Engineer, as a key technical expert partners to influence and implement within the process control organization and across functional disciplines to support the process control technical agenda, business plan priorities, and compliance objectives. In the project delivery phase and startup phase of the project (startup expected 2025 to 2028\), automation engineering roles will be fluid and dynamic as we endeavor to support the project delivery, build a new organization, develop and implement the necessary systems and business processes required to support GMP operations, and build the site culture. This will require significant collaboration, creativity and resilience as the site grows to a full scale GMP manufacturing through start up. Responsibilities **Key Objectives/Deliverables:** * Technical Leadership • * Mentor process control team, including design, controls philosophy, implementation and commissioning • * Process control work implementation and coordination • * Review and monitor financial performance; commit to meeting targets • * Develop and implement the Automation Engineering Project Plan. * Operational Excellence • * Technically lead and oversee the work of Site Area leads and System Integrator including Functional Requirements, Design Specifications, DCS Application Software, Test Specifications. • * Lead/Participate in design reviews and DeltaV application software reviews, attend equipment and software FATs • * Lead a team of automation engineers supporting commissioning • * Provide periodic status updates to Project Management • * Devise functional requirements and process control strategies for control systems in collaboration with Process Engineering • * DCS and SCADA software design, coding/configuration and testing (sequence logic, graphics, batch software etc.) for biologics unit operations • * Design, configure and test batch automation for biologics unit operations, including bioreactors and cell culture, harvest, chromatography, ultrafiltration/diafiltration (UF/DF), viral inactivation and filtration, buffer and media preparation, and CIP/SIP • * Lead integration of vendor\-supplied skids, single\-use systems and PLC/HMI\-based equipment packages into the site DCS, MES and historian architecture • * Perform automation engineering activities including design, tuning and troubleshooting of control loops • * Implement and support electronic systems (such as plant historians, applications and software integration) used to capture process automation related producti conjugates) preferred * Experience with CIP/SIP automation, process analytical technology (PAT) and integration of automated skids and OEM equipment into a plant\-wide control architecture preferred * Experience in facilitating and driving decision\-making at an organizational level. * Ability to instill teamwork within the department and demonstrate key interpersonal skills. * Proficient in DeltaV Distributed Control System, Rockwell Allen\-Bradley PLC, and batch process automation. * Experience with ISA\-88 Batch\-control standard models, terminology, recipes and procedural elements. * Prior work with 21 CFR Part 11 and cGMP regulatory requirements, including computer system validation. * Proven ability to influence peers and business partners, including influencing without authority, and to facilitate decision\-making at an organizational level. **Other Information:** * Initial location at Parkwood West, Indianapolis. * Permanent location at the new Lilly Medicines Foundry in Lebanon, Indiana. * Travel Percentage: Some travel required to support equipment/software Factory Acceptance Tests (FATs), typically at vendor or system integrator sites. * Act as an escalation resource for complex operational and process inquiries, delivering advanced support and issue resolution as business needs arise. Need\-based off\-hour support may be needed. Lilly is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. \#WeAreLilly Lilly is dedicated to helping individuals with disabilities to actively engage in the workforce, ensuring equal opportunities when vying for positions. If you require accommodation to submit a resume for a position at Lilly, please complete the accommodation request form (https://careers.lilly.com/us/en/workplace\-accommodation) for further assistance. Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response. Lilly is proud to be an EEO Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, gender expression, sexual orientation, genetic information, ancestry, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status. Our employee resource groups (ERGs) offer strong support networks for their members and are open to all employees. Our current groups include: Africa, Middle East, Central Asia (AMECA), Black Employees at Lilly (BE@Lilly), Chinese Culture Network (CCN), EnAble, Evolve, Lilly Indian Network (LIN), Organization of Latinx at Lilly (OLA), Pride (LGBTQ\+ Allies), Veterans Leadership Network (VLN) and Women’s Initiative for Leading at Lilly (WILL). Actual compensation will depend on a candidate’s education, experience, skills, and geographic location. The anticipated wage for this position is $67,500 \- $173,800 Full\-time equivalent employees also will be eligible for a company bonus (depending, in part, on company and individual performance). In addition, Lilly offers a comprehensive benefit program to eligible employees, including eligibility to participate in a company\-sponsored 401(k); pension; vacation benefits; eligibility for medical, dental, vision and prescription drug benefits; flexible benefits (e.g., healthcare and/or dependent day care flexible spending accounts); life insurance and death benefits; certain time off and leave of absence benefits; and well\-being benefits (e.g., employee assistance program, fitness benefits, and employee clubs and activities).Lilly reserves the right to amend, modify, or terminate its compensation and benefit programs in its sole discretion and Lilly’s compensation practices and guidelines will apply regarding the details of any promotion or transfer of Lilly employees. \#WeAreLilly

Health:** Track usage through scorecard and adoption reporting, notice warning signs, and act on them well before renewal. * **Renewals and Expansion:** Show each client the value it has received, own renewals, and bring in the Sales team and our Legal Solutions Engineer when a client wants to expand. * **Internal Sales Training:** Lead internal sales training with our Customer Enablement Specialist. * **Automation:** Use customer success tools to automate routine account work. * **Process Design:** Help design how our customer success function works as it grows. * **Voice of the Client:** Share adoption data and client feedback with Product. **What You Bring** ------------------ * 4\+ years in customer success or account management in B2B SaaS, ideally in legal technology. * account early, not at renewal. * Confidence advising lawyers and handling nuanced conversations about their work, without needing a lawyer’s depth. * The ability to learn the platform well enough to train users and answer their questions. * Hands\-on use of customer success tools, and daily use of AI in your own work. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience at a law firm, in a corporate legal department, or in legal tech or eDiscovery. * Consulting or advisory experience. * Experience building customer success playbooks or user communities. **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- * Clients use the platform in their daily work after go\-live, and adoption grows. * Accounts you own renew. * Expansion opportunities you flag turn into new use cases and practice groups. \#LI\-KS1 \#1100 Epiq eDiscovery Solutions, Inc. The Compensation range for this role is $150,000 \- $175,000 USD annually and may be eligible for an annual bonus. **In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire.** **Must be authorized to work in the United States for any employer.** Your specific salary will be determined based on several factors: * **Location\-based market rate** for the role * **Your abilities** in relation to the job specification * **Performance** during screening and interview * **Pay parity** with the wider team in the considered location Further details about the package will be provided during the initial screening call with the Talent jobs.title: Senior Embedded Engineer
jobs.description: **Build the Future with Us —** **EquipmentShare is Hiring a Senior Embedded Engineer** ====================================================================================== At EquipmentShare, we're not just filling a role — **we're assembling the best team on the planet to build something that's never been built before**. We're on a mission to transform an industry that's been stuck in the past by empowering contractors and communities through innovative technology, real\-time support, and a team that truly cares. We're hiring a **Senior Embedded Engineer** at our Corporate Headquarters in **Columbia, MO** and we're looking for someone who's ready to grow with us, bring energy and drive to their work, and help us build the future of construction. The Senior Embedded Software Engineer is responsible for the architectural integrity, performance, and reliability of the entire embedded system. ### **Primary Responsibilities** * Lead in the design, building and maintenance of software for embedded systems on vehicles and equipment * Immerse yourself in the full engineering lifecycle of embedded applications * Architect, and integrate embedded systems * Read schematic and layout files to design and debug software * Collaborate with internal and external cross functional partners , leadership and product owners to build solutions * Implementing hardware\-level security, such as Secure Boot and encrypted firmware updates (OTA). * Focus on the continuous improvement of technology and processes * Architect software for modularity and reusability across hardware platforms * Design and document API's, user guides and testing procedures * Analyze and enhance efficiency, stability, and scalability of system resources * Interface with hardware design and development teams * Document design process and report systems results * Support customers in the integration and deployment of the system * Ensure the robustness and security of wireless communication with other devices * Ensure that the firmware is as protected and tamper\-proof as the hardware platform can provide * Ensuring the team's code is "thread\-safe" and optimized for the specific constraints of embedded hardware. * Provide technical guidance and mentoring to more junior engineers. ### **Why EquipmentShare?** Because we do things differently — and we think you'll feel it from day one. We're a people\-first company powered by cutting\-edge technology. That means our proprietary T3 platform doesn't just run our business — it also makes your job easier, safer, and more connected. Whether you're behind the wheel, under the hood, leading a branch, or closing deals — tech supports *you*, and you drive *us* forward. We're a team of problem\-solvers, go\-getters, and builders. And we're looking for teammates who take pride in doing meaningful work and want to be part of **building something special**. #### **Perks \& Benefits** Competitive compensation * Full medical, dental, and vision coverage for full\-time employees * Generous PTO \+ paid holidays * 401(k) \+ company match * Gym membership stipend \+ wellness programs (earn PTO and prizes!) * Company events, food truck nights * 16 hours of paid volunteer time per year — give back to the community you call home * * Career advancement, leadership training, and professional development opportunities ### **About You** You want to be part of a team that's not just changing an industry for the sake of change — we're transforming it to make it safer, more secure, and more productive. You bring grit, heart, and humility to your work, and you're excited about the opportunity to grow within a fast\-paced, mission\-driven environment. We're looking for people who: See challenges as opportunities * Embrace change and continuous improvement * * Bring energy, effort, and optimism every day ### **Skills \& Qualifications** * + Proficient in C programming language; Git, or similar version control systems; Linux build systems and Linux kernel development + Knowledge of digital control interfaces, such as Ethernet, CAN, USB, SPI, I2C or high speed serial + You'll be a great communicator (verbally and with the written word) as you'll work closely with team members to review schematics and new designs. + You've got a strong knowledge of communication buses: CAN, USB, Serial, I2C, SPI. + You're capable of designing hardware solutions using PIC and ARM embedded microcontrollers. + Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team environment. + Involvement in full product life cycle from prototype to production. + Flexible and adaptable with a willingness to work in ambiguous environments. + Broad technical skill set spanning hardware and software, with the ability to work on both hardware and software projects, while learning new skills. + Comfortable learning new tools (including LLMs), technologies, and disciplines as projects demand. ### **Education and Experience:** + Bachelor or Master of science, computer engineering, electrical engineering, computer science or a related field is required + At least 6 years experience with various Embedded Operating Systems: Linux; RTOS; bare metal + Experience with C\+\+, Assembly, Python, and other applicable languages + Experience using Oscilloscope and other embedded test equipment + Experience interfacing with Bluetooth modules + Experience with low\-power design and advanced sleep modes + Strong experience in hands\-on development and troubleshooting on embedded targets + Familiarity with software configuration management tools, defect tracking tools, and peer reviews### **Physical Requirements:** + Must be able to lift 5 \- 10 lbs + Must be able to sit or stand for prolonged periods at a desk and work on a computer. + Ideally, capable of safely maneuvering around and beneath industrial equipment as needed ### **A Workplace For All** At EquipmentShare, we believe the best solutions come from a team that reflects the world around us. Our initiative — *A Workplace For All* — is rooted in the belief that we must work together to solve some of the toughest problems in construction. That means attracting, developing, and retaining great people from all walks of life. We value different backgrounds, talents, and perspectives. We want you to feel like you belong here — because you do. **EquipmentShare is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.** ***Employment is contingent on passing a background check. Additionally, some roles require passing a drug test, depending on the job responsibilities.***

Key Responsibilities * Enterprise Cyber Strategy \& Alignment: Define and champion the federal cyber vision for the Federal Civilian and Health BU, ensuring seamless alignment and synergy with Everforth ECS's broader corporate cybersecurity strategy, center\-of\-excellence capabilities, and cross\-BU initiatives. * SOC Modernization \& Cyber Operations Leadership: Build upon ECS's multi\-agency SOC services footprint to design and scale the next generation of modern federal SOCs—infusing advanced detection engineering, threat hunting, SOAR/automation, and cyber threat intelligence (CTI). * Capability Operationalization \& Scaling: Replicate and expand ECS's proven track record of capability operationalization (exemplified by our work in CDM and cyber data integration) to scale ECS\-developed tools, analytics platforms, and reusable frameworks across customer environments. * Solution Architecture \& Capture: Partner closely with Growth, Capture, and Delivery leaders to shape and architect winning technical solutions for high\-visibility, large\-scale federal cyber opportunities and proposals. * Industry \& Customer Executive Engagement: Serve as a premier technical authority and external voice for Everforth ECS across the federal civilian market, fostering strategic relationships with agency CISOs, security directors, CISA leadership, and strategic OEM/technology partners. * Investment \& R\&D Direction: Guide portfolio recommendations for company\-funded Cyber R\&D, Internal Research \& Development (IRAD), reusable solutions, reference architectures, and targeted demonstrations aligned with agency mission requirements and emerging mandates (e.g., Zero Trust, CIRCIA, OMB/CISA directives). *Salary Range: $200,000\-$300,000* *General Description of Benefits* Requirements: * 12\+ years of experience in cybersecurity, including significant experience supporting Federal Civilian, Health, or broader federal customers * Demonstrated leadership experience in federal cybersecurity operations, SOC modernization, or enterprise cyber programs * Strong understanding of CISA CDM and how CDM capabilities and data are operationalized within federal agencies * Broad technical fluency across security operations, including SIEM/security data, vulnerability and exposure management, asset visibility, threat detection, incident response, Zero Trust, cloud security, and automation * Experience translating cybersecurity technology and data into operational outcomes, measurable risk reduction, and mission value * Experience engaging federal CISOs, cybersecurity executives, and senior technical stakeholders * Demonstrated experience supporting business development, capture, solution development, or strategic federal pursuits * Proven ability to lead through influence across matrixed technical, delivery, growth, and business organizations * Strong executive communication skills and ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear customer and business value * Bachelor's degree in cybersecurity, computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience Req Benefits: Benefits \- Everforth ECS

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer Attack Surface Platforms (Remote)
jobs.description: **Who We Are** ============== Join a team that puts its People First! Since 1889, First American (NYSE: FAF) has held an unwavering belief in its people. They are passionate about what they do, and we are equally passionate about fostering an environment where all feel welcome, supported, and empowered to be innovative and reach their full potential. Our inclusive, people\-first culture has earned our company numerous accolades, including being named to the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For® list for eleven consecutive years. We have also earned awards as a best place to work for women, diversity and LGBTQ\+ employees, and have been included on more than 50 regional best places to work lists. First American will always strive to be a great place to work, for all. For more information, please visit www.careers.firstam.com.**What We Do** ============== The Senior Security Engineer – Attack Surface Platforms serves as the subject matter expert for the organization’s external attack surface management (EASM) capability. This role leads platform operations, asset discovery coverage, exposure analysis, and remediation workflows for internet\-facing assets. The engineer works across security and technology teams to validate findings, direct risk reduction, improve platform quality, and develop repeatable processes and targeted enhancements.**Essential Functions** ======================= * Serve as the technical subject matter expert for our EASM platform. Administer platform configuration, access, integrations, workflows, reporting, and operational health. * Maintain reliable discovery and inventory of internet\-facing assets, including domains, IP addresses, hosts, and services. Review coverage, data quality, changes, and newly observed assets to identify potential gaps or unmanaged exposure. * Validate asset attribution and ownership by correlating EASM findings with available business, cloud, network, DNS, and inventory context. Identify unknown or potentially unauthorized assets and route them for investigation. * Analyze external exposures such as vulnerable technologies, misconfigurations, exposed services, and assets that do not meet security standards. Prioritize response using exposure context, exploitability, business importance, and available threat information. * Lead remediation coordination with cloud, network, infrastructure, application, and business teams. Clarify the risk and recommended action, track progress, verify closure, and escalate urgent or overdue exposures through established processes. * Tune platform policies, risk settings, alerting, and exception workflows to improve signal quality and reduce duplicate or non\-actionable findings. Document the rationale for material changes and validate results after implementation. * Build and maintain integrations between the EASM platform and relevant asset inventory, ticketing, cloud security, or security operations systems. Troubleshoot data flow, mapping, ownership, and workflow issues with platform administrators and vendors. * Develop targeted automation and platform enhancements using available APIs, scripts, dashboards, and workflow features to improve asset review, triage, reporting, and remediation tracking. * Produce operational and management reporting on asset coverage, newly discovered assets, exposure trends, remediation status, recurring issues, and platform health. Explain data limitations and highlight items that require action. * Lead EASM onboarding and change reviews for new domains, business units, cloud environments, brands, and acquisitions. Ensure discovery and ownership processes are updated as the organization changes. * Support security investigations and incident response when an externally exposed asset or service may contribute to risk. Preserve relevant platform evidence and coordinate follow\-up actions with response teams. * Develop runbooks and standards for EASM operations. Guide platform users and partner teams on finding validation, ownership, prioritization, and effective remediation. **Working Relationships** ========================= Partners with Security Operations, Cloud Engineering, Network Engineering, Infrastructure, application teams, IT asset owners, Security Architecture, and business stakeholders. Works with the EASM vendor and internal platform teams to resolve issues, assess product capabilities, and plan changes that improve external visibility and remediation outcomes. **Knowledge and Skills** ======================== * Hands\-on experience operating an external attack surface management or attack surface management platform (EASM or CTEM). * Strong understanding of internet\-facing assets, common network services and protocols, DNS, web infrastructure, cloud\-hosted resources, and how external exposure can create security risk. * Experience validating vulnerability, exposure, and misconfiguration findings and prioritizing remediation using technical evidence and business context. * Working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform, including its core services and terminology; experience across multiple cloud platforms is useful. * Experience integrating security platforms with asset inventory, ticketing, cloud security, or security operations systems and troubleshooting data quality or workflow issues. * Ability to use APIs or basic scripting in a language such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash to investigate findings, validate data, and support platform enhancements. * Ability to establish clear ownership and remediation paths for findings and to communicate risk and recommended actions to technical and nontechnical stakeholders. * Strong analytical, written, and verbal communication skills; able to manage work independently, guide cross\-functional remediation, and provide technical direction to peers. **Typical Education** ===================== Generally requires a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **Typical Range of Experience** =============================== Typically requires 4–6 years of experience in information security, external attack surface management, vulnerability management, cloud security, security operations, or a related technical role. Hands\-on EASM platform experience is required; Cortex Xpanse experience is strongly preferred. **Licenses or Certifications** ============================== Candidates must hold at least one foundational cloud or cloud security certification at the time of selection. The certification must demonstrate familiarity with cloud concepts and the core services and terminology of at least one major cloud provider or be broadly applicable across all security domains. Additional certifications or formal credentials in application security, secure software development, vulnerability management, or cloud security are preferred. Pay Range: $112,400\.00 \- $149,800\.00 Annually This hiring range is a reasonable estimate of the base pay range for this position at the time of posting. Pay is based on a number of factors which may include job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, business requirements and geographic location. **\*\* Note that the following statements only apply to candidates who will be working from an unincorporated area within Los Angeles County. \*\*** First American will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws (e.g., the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act). First American intends to conduct a review of an applicant’s criminal history in connection with a conditional offer. First American reasonably believes that a criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following material job duties for this position potentially resulting in the withdrawal of the conditional offer of employment: handling of confidential, proprietary or trade secret information belonging to First American or its customers, administrating or facilitating financial transactions, and the ability to meet customer\-imposed criminal history requirements. **What We Offer** ================= By choice, we don’t simply accept individuality – we embrace it, we support it, and we thrive on it! Our People First culture is inclusive for all employees \- not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it's the key to our success. We are proud to foster an authentic and inclusive workplace For All. You are free and encouraged to bring your entire, unique self to work. First American is an equal opportunity employer in every sense of the term. Based on eligibility, First American offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, 401k, PTO/paid sick leave and other great benefits like an employee stock purchase plan.

jobs.title: Staff / Platform Security Engineer
jobs.description: The Staff / Platform Security Engineer works under limited supervision and serves as a senior technical contributor responsible for engineering security capabilities that protect FINRA's platforms, endpoints, and workspace environments. This role combines strong hands\-on engineering expertise with ownership of security standards, guidelines, and technical controls designed to reduce risk across the FINRA environment. The engineer will identify security risks, design and implement scalable security solutions, establish practical security requirements and guardrails, and partner across technology teams to drive their adoption. The ideal candidate has the technical depth to engineer and troubleshoot complex security solutions, along with the initiative and leadership to define how technologies should be securely deployed, configured, and operated across FINRA.**Essential Job Functions:** * Partner with stakeholders to promote compliance with internal and external security requirements, policies, and standards, and develop technical approaches for improving and measuring compliance. * Develop, own, and continuously improve security standards, technical guidelines, secure configuration requirements, and guardrails for endpoint and workspace technologies. * Assess the security posture of platforms and technologies against established standards; identify gaps and systemic risks; develop technical strategies and solutions to reduce those risks. * Review, develop, and maintain information security policies, standards, guidelines, procedures, and technical documentation, with particular emphasis on actionable technical standards. * Apply security engineering principles, established processes, and technical expertise to identify, validate, prioritize, and reduce security risks across FINRA's technology environment. * Engineer, automate, operate, and continuously improve security controls, emphasizing scalability, consistency, reliability, and measurable risk reduction. * Provide security engineering guidance and technical expertise for the secure adoption, configuration, deployment, and operation of new and existing technologies. * Architect, design, implement, and maintain security controls and solutions that protect endpoint, workspace, and related technology platforms. * Partner with technology owners, engineers, architects, and other security teams to translate security requirements into practical, scalable engineering solutions and drive adoption of security standards across FINRA. * Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness and health of security controls; investigate discrepancies or control gaps; and drive technical remediation through resolution. * Review and analyze security findings, telemetry, and control output across multiple data sources to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies; prioritize risks; determine root causes; and develop repeatable technical methods for identifying and remediating security issues. * Evaluate emerging security technologies, techniques, capabilities, and tools, and provide technical recommendations based on FINRA's security requirements and technology strategy. * Lead or co\-lead security engineering initiatives and cross\-functional projects that improve security capabilities, processes, automation, and the overall security posture of FINRA. * Identify opportunities to improve existing security processes, controls, and engineering practices and take ownership of driving appropriate improvements. * Provide technical leadership, knowledge sharing, and mentoring to engineers and other technology professionals. * Assist with adherence to technology policies and comply with all applicable security controls. * Ensure work products meet or exceed FINRA standards and demonstrate FINRA's values through technical excellence, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. * Collaborate effectively, both in person and virtually, in furtherance of FINRA's mission of investor protection and market integrity. **Education/Experience Requirements:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or related discipline with at least three (3\) years of related experience, or equivalent training and / or work experience. * Experience must include direct experience in more than one of the following areas: securing networks and systems architecture, design and implementation, secure software assurance, intrusion detection, defense and incident response, security configuration management, access controls design and implementation and security policy and standards development. * Knowledge of communications protocols. * Experience with one or more Cyber Security tools, including: Configuration Assessment, Log Aggregation, Integrity Verification, Web Application Security Testing, Network Access Control System, Network Intrusion prevention systems, and Endpoint Security Solutions. * Strong written and verbal technical communication skills. * Demonstrated ability to develop effe includes military leave, jury duty leave, bereavement leave, voting and election official leave for federal, state or local primary and general elections, care of a family member leave (available after 90 days of employment); and childbirth and parental leave (available after 90 days of employment). Full\-time employees receive nine paid holidays. * Based on full\-time schedule **Important Information** FINRA’s Code of Conduct imposes restrictions on employees’ investments and requires financial disclosures that are uniquely related to our role as a securities regulator. FINRA employees are required to disclose to FINRA all brokerage accounts that they maintain, and those in which they control trading or have a financial interest (including any trust account of which they are a trustee or beneficiary and all accounts of a spouse, domestic partner or minor child who lives with the employee) and to authorize their broker\-dealers to provide FINRA with duplicate statements for all of those accounts. **All of those accounts are subject to the Code’s investment and securities account restrictions, and new employees must comply with those investment restrictions—including disposing of any security issued by a company on FINRA’s Prohibited Company List or obtaining a written waiver from their Executive Vice President—by the date they begin employment with FINRA. Employees may only maintain securities accounts that must be disclosed to FINRA at one or more securities firms that provide an electronic feed (e\-feed) of data to FINRA, and must move securities accounts from other securities firms to a firm that provides an e\-feed within three months of beginning employment.** You can read more about these restrictions here. As standard practice, employees must also execute FINRA’s Employee Confidentiality and Invention Assignment Agreement without qualification or modification and comply with the company’s policy on nepotism. **Washington state applicants:** **click here** **for required notice(s).** **Search Firm Representatives** Please be advised that FINRA is not seeking assistance or accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this employment opportunity. Regardless of past practice, a valid written agreement and task order must be in place before any resumes are submitted to FINRA. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at FINRA without a valid written agreement and task order in place will be deemed the sole property of FINRA and no fee will be paid in the event that person is hired by FINRA. **FINRA is an Equal Opportunity Employer** All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to any legally protected category, including race, color, age, national origin, ethnicity, religion, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status, sex, or any other status or classification protected by state or local law. FINRA strives to make our career site accessible to all users. If you need a disability\-related accommodation for completing the application process, please contact FINRA’s Employee Relations team at 240\-386\-4865 or by email at EmployeeRelations@FINRA.org. Please note that this process is exclusively for inquiries regarding accommodations in the application process. FINRA abides by the requirements of 41 CFR 60\-741\.5(a).
