jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager, Internal Software
jobs.description: **About Fervo Energy** ---------------------- Fervo Energy (NASDAQ: FRVO) is a modern power company developing next\-generation geothermal resources to meet the growing demand for affordable, reliable, 24/7 carbon\-free energy. Our mission is to transform geothermal into America's most dependable and affordable source of clean, around\-the\-clock power. By combining innovations in horizontal drilling, fiber\-optic sensing, and advanced reservoir engineering, Fervo has developed a repeatable approach to building utility\-scale enhanced geothermal systems. Our flagship Cape Station development in Utah is planned to deliver 500 MW of firm, carbon\-free power, and we are advancing a development pipeline of more than 50 GW. Join us and work alongside world\-class engineers, geoscientists, operators, project builders, and business leaders working to make geothermal a cornerstone of a more reliable, affordable, and sustainable energy future. **Position Description** ------------------------ The Senior Technical Product Manager, Internal Software will lead the development of internal software tools across Fervo. This role is the connective tissue between our internal users and the engineers building the tools they need, turning ambiguous internal needs into clear, actionable product requirements. Unlike a traditional product role focused on external customers, you will work across engineering, construction, drilling, completions, supply chain, finance, and operations to understand how work gets done and to identify the workflows that slow execution. The ideal candidate is a deeply technical product manager, or a former software engineer who can code, partner credibly with engineers, and move comfortably between product strategy and software execution. Experience in geothermal, energy, drilling, or construction is not required. In the near term, this role will own product direction, technical scoping, delivery, adoption, and build\-vs\-buy decisions, and over time has the potential to evolve into leadership of Fervo's internal software development team as the function scales. Beyond strong software judgment and product instincts, the ideal candidate brings comfort with ambiguity and the ability to build useful tools quickly in a fast\-moving environment. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * **Product Ownership:** Own internal software product development from idea to adoption. Work closely with teams across Fervo to understand their workflows, pain points, operating rhythms, and decision\-making needs, and translate ambiguous business problems into clear product requirements, technical specs, user stories, and success criteria. Design for a connected software ecosystem rather than one\-off applications, ensuring tools integrate with existing systems, data sources, and future internal platforms. Measure success through adoption, workflow improvement, and business impact, not just shipped features. * **Engineering Partnership:** Partner closely with software engineers, contractors, and technical partners to scope, sequence, and deliver internal tools. Bring enough software fluency to evaluate technical tradeoffs, ask tough questions, and make pragmatic implementation decisions. Write clear technical product requirements, and own delivery cadence, backlog management, sprint planning, stakeholder updates, and risk escalation. Contribute technically when helpful, especially in early prototyping, agentic coding workflows, technical review, or lightweight implementation support. * **Tools for Fast\-Moving Teams:** Develop software that improves how Fervo manages complex work across engineering, construction, project execution, documentation, scheduling, modeling, procurement, and operations. Identify where teams rely on manual processes, disconnected data, or inefficient tools, and build products that are simple, usable, and practical. Sit with users before and after launch, and create feedback loops that drive continuous product improvement. * **Build\-vs\-Buy Decisions:** Audit Fervo's current internal software stack and identify where existing tools are sufficient, where they need better integration, and where purpose\-built software would create meaningful leverage. Recommend build, buy, integrate, or retire decisions based on business value, implementation cost, maintainability, and long\-term scalability. Serve as Fervo's internal expert on the resource requirements and tradeoffs of developing software in\-house, avoiding both overbuilding and tolerating broken workflows. * **AI\-Enabled Workflows:** Partner with Fervo's AI and machine learning team to integrate internal data, models, and automation into the tools you build. Identify practical, high\-value opportunities for LLMs and agentic workflows to reduce repetitive manual work, including document parsing, report generation, data entry, workflow automation, and decision support. Use modern coding and AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate prototypin heduling software, enterprise applications (such as ERP), operational systems, or platform products * Experience in a startup, scale\-up, or small high\-ownership technical team * Experience working with or managing software engineers, contractors, or technical vendors * Experience with AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar platforms * Experience integrating software with third\-party systems, APIs, databases, internal data platforms, or business applications * Experience supporting teams that manage complex operational workflows, such as construction, engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, logistics, infrastructure, or capital projects * Interest in eventually helping build and lead an internal software development team **Location** ------------ This role may be based in Fervo's Houston, TX or Oakland, CA office. Hybrid work is available. Some travel between Fervo offices and project sites may be encouraged. **Compensation** ---------------- Fervo provides a comprehensive suite of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, short\-term and long\-term disability, flexible paid time off, and paid parental leave. Additionally, Fervo offers an incentive stock options program, a bonus incentive program, and a 401(k) plan with an employer match. Fervo Energy is providing the compensation range and general description of other compensation and benefits that the company in good faith believes it might pay and/or offer for this position based on the successful applicant's education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities in addition to internal equity and geographic location. Expected Salary: $180,000 – $250,000 based on location and experience. Fervo Energy reserves the right to ultimately pay more or less than the posted range and offer other compensation, depending on circumstances not related to an applicant's sex or other status protected by local, state, or federal law. **Benefits \& Perks** --------------------- * Fervo offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well\-being, and life outside of work. Benefits for eligible employees include: * Medical, dental, and vision plan options * Employer\-paid basic life insurance and short\-term and long\-term disability coverage * A 401(k) plan with up to 6% match * Flexible paid time off and paid parental leave * Family\-building, fertility, hormonal health, pregnancy, postpartum, and parenting support through Carrot * A dependent care FSA for eligible child and elder care expenses * An annual Lifestyle Spending Account for eligible wellness expenses, including fitness, financial planning, pet insurance, and pet care * Employee ownership opportunities through Fervo's Employee Stock Purchase Program, as well as LTI and bonus opportunities for eligible roles Benefits and programs are subject to eligibility requirements and may change. **Our Workplace** ----------------- Fervo Energy highly values having employees work in the office to foster collaboration and strengthen our company culture. This role follows a hybrid schedule, with team members expected to work in the office three days per week. Fervo considers this in\-office schedule an essential function of the role. Your recruiter can share more information about the schedule. **Equal Opportunity Employer** ------------------------------ Fervo Energy is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, creed, gender, religion, marital status, registered domestic partner status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sex, genetic information, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other consideration made unlawful by federal, state, or local law. Fervo also prohibits discrimination based on the perception that an individual has any of these characteristics or is associated with a person who has or is perceived as having any of these characteristics.

jobs.description: Job Overview Field Nimble developed web\-based and mobile field service management software designed to help small residential service contractors manage customers, scheduling, work orders, estimates, invoicing, and payments. The Web Application Developer role described below is a proposed job description, not a verified current vacancy. The developer would help build, maintain, and improve responsive web applications that simplify business workflows, improve usability, and support reliable data management. Key Responsibilities * Design, develop, test, and maintain responsive web applications. * Build user\-friendly interfaces and reusable front\-end components. * Develop server\-side functionality, APIs, and application integrations. * Work with databases to store, retrieve, and manage application data. * Improve application performance, accessibility, reliability, and security. * Troubleshoot bugs and resolve technical issues across browsers and devices. * Integrate third\-party services and business tools where required. * Collaborate with product, design, QA, and engineering team members. * Participate in code reviews, testing, deployment, and ongoing maintenance. * Document application features, technical decisions, and development procedures. * Contribute to improvements in scheduling, customer management, work orders, and invoicing workflows. Required Skills * Experience developing and maintaining web applications. * Knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. * Familiarity with a front\-end framework such as React, Angular, or Vue.js. * Understanding of server\-side development and REST APIs. * Experience working with relational databases and SQL. * Familiarity with Git and software development best practices. * Knowledge of responsive design, cross\-browser compatibility, and web security. * Strong debugging, problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills. Preferred Skills * Experience with cloud\-hosted applications or software\-as\-a\-service platforms. * Familiarity with payment integrations, invoicing systems, or customer management software. * Experience improving application performance and accessibility. * Knowledge of automated testing and continuous integration/deployment. * Understanding of Agile development practices. * A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. jobs.title: Senior Solutions Architect
jobs.description: From Fivetran's founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We're proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data\-driven. **About Us** Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry\-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we're delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. As we bring our teams and technology together, we're building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It's an exciting time to join us: we're creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites. **About the Role** We're looking to hire a Solutions Engineer, Enterprise to join our Field Engineering team. As a Solutions Architect, you will be a trusted technical advisor to some of our largest and most strategic customers, helping them evaluate, adopt, and expand their use of dbt. You'll partner closely with Sales to understand customers' technical and business priorities, design solutions using the dbt platform, and demonstrate measurable value throughout the evaluation process. You'll work across the customer lifecycle—from technical discovery and evaluation through adoption and expansion—while partnering with Product, Engineering, and our technology partners to bring customer needs back into the business. This is a full\-time position based in the New York City metro area. **Technologies You'll Use** SQL, dbt, cloud data warehouses and lakehouses including Snowflake, Databricks, and BigQuery, AWS, Azure, and GCP, modern data integration and orchestration technologies, and AI\-assisted productivity tools. **What You'll Do** * Lead technical discovery with enterprise customers, connecting technical requirements to business outcomes and measurable success criteria * Design enterprise\-grade data transformation and analytics architectures using dbt * Partner with Sales to communicate the technical and business value of the dbt platform * Lead customer evaluations and technical validation, including trials and proof\-of\-value engagements when appropriate * Build trusted relationships with technical practitioners, data leaders, and executive stakeholders * Guide customers through technical architecture, security, governance, and deployment considerations * Partner across the customer lifecycle to support successful adoption and identify opportunities for expansion * Bring customer and field insights to Product and Engineering to help influence product strategy and roadmap * Build strong relationships with technology and consulting partners, including Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, and other members of the modern data ecosystem * Contribute technical expertise, reusable best practices, and thought leadership to the broader Field Engineering organization and dbt community **Skills We're Looking For** * 4\+ years of experience in sales engineering, solutions architecture, consulting, or a similar customer\-facing technical role within data, analytics, or BI * Strong technical foundation in SQL, data transformation, ETL/ELT, and data modeling * Strong understanding of modern cloud data warehouse, lake house, and analytics architectures * Ability to uncover and translate technical and business requirements into concrete solutions and measurable outcomes * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences * Ability to establish credibility and build trusted relationships with stakeholders ranging from data practitioners to senior executives * Ability to operate effectively in a fast\-paced, evolving environment while collaborating across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer teams **Bonus Skills** * Experience with dbt or analytics engineering * Experience with Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or other modern cloud data platforms * Experience with data modeling methodologies such as dimensional modeling, Kimball, Data Vault, or 3NF * Experience with enterprise data integration or ETL platforms such as Informatica, Boomi, or Talend * Experience supporting complex enterprise technical evaluations, migrations, or transformation initiatives This position qualifies for Fivetran's incentive plan, and it's common for employees in this role to achieve the total on\-target earnings. **Perks and Benefits** * 100% employer\-paid medical insurance**\*** * Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year\-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off. * RSU stock grants\* * Professional development and training opportunities * Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team\-building activities * Monthly cell phone stipend * Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self\-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents. * *May vary by country and worker type \- please reach out to your recruiter for more information* *Click* *here* *to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region.* We're honored to be valued at over $5\.6 billion, but more importantly, we're proud of our core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream. Read about us in Forbes. Fivetran brings together high\-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion \& belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world\-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities. jobs.title: AI & Automation Engineer
jobs.description: The **AI \& Automation Engineer** is a hands\-on technical role responsible for designing, building, deploying, and supporting AI agents, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) capabilities, and automation solutions on Company\-approved AI platforms. The position transforms prioritized use cases into secure, supportable production solutions, develops reusable patterns and knowledge layers, and serves as the primary technical builder for the Company's AI and automation programs under the direction of the Senior Manager of Infrastructure and AI. **This position will require regular (every week) in\-person attendance at one of our Foley Equipment offices with a partial week work\-from\-home opportunity. At this time, fully\-remote is not available. Kansas City or Park City preferred.** **What you will do:****Solution Design and Development*** Design, build, test, and deploy AI agents in Microsoft Copilot Studio and Foundry (topics, actions, tools, connected agents, knowledge sources) and publish them to approved channels such as Microsoft Teams. * Build the Power Platform components behind AI use cases: Power Automate flows, Dataverse data models and security roles, model\-driven and canvas apps, AI Builder prompts, and Adaptive Card review experiences in Teams. * Integrate agents and flows with enterprise systems (ERP, CRM, data platform, Microsoft 365\) using connectors, REST APIs, Microsoft Graph, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool connections. * Move prototypes into production through environment strategy, solution packaging and application lifecycle management (ALM), publishing, and release validation. Assist with evaluating the cost of proposed solutions. * Write supporting code (Python, PowerShell, C\#, or JSON) where low\-code tooling falls short and use AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate delivery and legacy code modernization. **AI Platform and Knowledge Engineering*** Deploy and manage Azure AI Foundry projects, model deployments, and agents using Company\-owned Azure Storage, Azure AI Search, and Cosmos DB so source data and vector indexes remain within the Company's tenant. * Build retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines (ingestion, chunking, embedding, indexing, vector and hybrid search) as reusable knowledge and context layers shared by multiple agents and automations. * Configure network isolation and identity for AI workloads, including private endpoints, private DNS, managed identities, and role\-based access control (RBAC), and troubleshoot connectivity and authorization failures across platform boundaries. * Write system prompts and agent instructions, implements tool calling and orchestration, and run evaluations (test sets, groundedness and accuracy checks, regression tests) before and after each release. **Security, Governance, and Responsible AI*** Build every solution in accordance with Company security and data protection requirements, including least\-privilege identities, scoped security roles, Entra ID app registrations, Power Platform data loss prevention (DLP) policies, sensitivity label requirements, and vendor and customer confidentiality obligations. * Verify each agent’s authentication model, including end\-user, maker, and agent\-author credentials, to ensure the agent returns only information the requesting user is authorized to access. Apply content\-safety controls, input and output validation, and human review for consequential actions. * Support the AI intake and review process with technical assessments, help identify and remediate unsanctioned AI usage, and support Microsoft 365 Copilot readiness, including permissions and oversharing remediation. **Operations, Support, and Enablement*** Monitor delivered solutions for accuracy, performance, usage, security, cost, and continued fit with the business need; track licensing, token, credit, and capacity consumption and recommended actions to control spend. * Provide third\-tier support and root\-cause analysis for production AI and automation solutions, including occasional after\-hours work for urgent issues or production automation failures. * Maintain documentation for each solution (business owner, purpose, architecture, data sources, access model, prompts, testing notes, support owner, change history, retirement criteria) and follow Company change, release, and lifecycle practices. * Deliver demos and technical training on approved AI tools, mentor citizen developers and IT colleagues on approved patterns and review their work for security and supportability before production. * Communicate the status, risks, dependencies, and expected business value of assigned use cases to the Senior Manager of Infrastructure and AI and business stakeholders. **Our ideal candidate:*** Strong understanding of generative AI, AI agents, retrieval\-augmented generation, automation, low\-code/no\-code development, and practical business process improvement. * Hands\-on experience with Micr ate, Power Apps, Dataverse, AI Builder), Fabric, and Microsoft 365 Copilot. * Working knowledge of Azure networking, Entra ID, managed identities, and role\-based access control as they apply to AI workloads. * Proficiency in at least one language (Python, PowerShell, C\#, or TypeScript), REST APIs, JSON, and Git. * Strong knowledge of data privacy, security, access controls, responsible AI practices, and change management. * Ability to diagnose problems across platform boundaries using logs, run histories, and vendor documentation, and to explain technical designs in plain language to leaders at all levels. * Must be well\-organized, practical, collaborative, and pay close attention to detail. * Ability to drive and valid driver’s license required. **Education and Experience*** Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, data analytics, or a related field is required. * Three years of proven experience in application development, automation, data, or related information technology work, including one year of experience building and deploying production generative AI solutions such as agents, RAG solutions, or LLM\-based automations. * Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and Azure AI Foundry required. * Experience with Azure AI Search, Microsoft Fabric, and ERP or CRM integration (Dynamics 365 or similar) preferred. * Microsoft AI\-102, PL\-400, or AZ\-204 certification preferred. **Physical Demands** (The physical demands described here must be met by an employee to perform the essential functions of this job successfully. Reasonable accommodations may enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.) Regularly required to sit, see, speak and hear —frequent and regular use of hands and fingers to handle or feel. Recurring close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus. Constantly use hands and fingers to perform computer keyboard work. The ability to drive, and availability and capability to travel for business purposes. **Work Environment** (The work environment characteristics described here represent those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.) Perform most of the work in a relaxed environment but may be exposed to outside weather conditions. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. Encounter different temperatures while driving and getting in and out of a vehicle. Encounter different climates when traveling. **What We Can Offer You:*** Competitive pay to recognize your valuable contribution * 401(k) with matching * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans * Basic Life \& AD\&D, short\-term disability, \& and long\-term disability * Wellness programs to focus on building healthy habits while earning prizes and cash bonuses throughout the year * Holiday, PTO, and Parental Leave, promoting work\-life balance and personal growth * Casual dress attire * Family\-owned company where you’re more than just another employee Foley Industries – Foley Equipment, Foley Power Solutions, Foley Rental, and SITECH Central – proudly stands at the forefront of progress, serving customers in Kansas and Western Missouri for over nine decades. With a dedicated team of over 1,000 employees, we are committed to delivering exceptional service, top\-quality parts and rentals, and unparalleled sales support across a comprehensive range of Caterpillar and allied construction equipment, power generation solutions, and cutting\-edge SITECH construction technology. As we continue to empower our customers' success, we invite you to explore the endless opportunities that await you at Foley. To learn more about our company and join our team of industry leaders, please visit www.FoleyEq.com.* *At this time Foley does not participate in any Visa sponsorship programs.*

jobs.title: Controls Engineer, Ford Energy
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ At Ford, you’ll work on ideas that matter, alongside passionate people who want to make a global impact. Together, we’re shaping the next era of transportation—grounded in purpose, driven by progress. Make your move. * Job Type: Full time * Work Type: On\-site Ford Energy is a newly formed, wholly\-owned subsidiary of Ford Motor Company dedicated to accelerating U.S. energy independence. Leveraging Ford’s century of manufacturing excellence and world\-class battery energy storage systems (BESS) technology, Ford Energy designs, manufactures, and services grid\-scale and commercial DC battery energy storage systems (BESS). Ford Energy is uniquely positioned to capture the growing demand for reliable, US\-built energy storage systems. We are not just building batteries; we are building the infrastructure for the next generation of the American grid. Why Ford Energy? At Ford Energy, you have the backing of an industrial manufacturing powerhouse with the agility of a dedicated energy startup offering industry leading technology. We offer a competitive compensation package including performance\-based bonuses, Ford vehicle discounts, and the opportunity to shape the energy strategy of one of the world's most iconic brands. **In this position...** As a Controls Engineer, you will be on the ground floor launching a state\-of\-the\-art BESS manufacturing facility in Glendale, Kentucky. As a key member of our start\-up team, you will have a once\-in\-a\-lifetime opportunity to help build and program the automated systems that bring next\-generation energy storage products to the grid. In this critical role, you will: **Optimize with Precision:** Provide technical expertise to optimize highly automated manufacturing equipment and processes through visual systems, automation, and advanced levels of process control. **Innovate:** Apply an entrepreneurial mindset to deliver data\-driven controls solutions for battery cell and BESS module/container manufacturing lines. **Drive Excellence:** Be the go\-to technical expert for automation reliability, ensuring the facility operates with the precision required to deliver world\-class energy products. **What you'll do...** **Operational Excellence – Controls \& Automation** * Program, modify, and troubleshoot machinery utilizing Siemens (SP700\), Omron, or other PLC programming software and HMI screens. * Manage the interaction between servo systems, frequency conversion systems, and upper\-level computers; configure parameters appropriately for varying production loads. * Support and troubleshoot robotic systems (such as Fanuc), including robot programming and integration with other automation systems. * Lead fault analysis and root cause identification for complex automation issues to prevent recurrence; identify and rectify electrical component faults. * Establish preventive maintenance plans for equipment and electrical/controls aspects, and mentor/train technicians to enhance the team's overall competence. * Support feasibility on product design changes and lead modifications, model code updates, and program backups for automation. **Leadership – Culture** * **Embrace the Gemba philosophy:** Regularly engage on the floor to monitor automation health, listen to technicians, and solve problems where the work happens. * **Remove Barriers:** Use Andon data to prioritize efforts to achieve 100% flow; lead Six Sigma project teams focused on efficiency, quality, and reliability. * **Collaborate across functions:** Act as a liaison with IT on IT/Controls interface issues and work with Manufacturing Engineering to ensure efficient installation and validation of new equipment. * Ability to demonstrate leadership behaviors combined with outstanding interpersonal and communication skills. * Ensure adherence to the Ford Production System (FPS) and Safety Operating System practices to achieve zero injuries. **Strategic – Reliability** * Provide input on new equipment design and controls architecture as the site builds out battery cell and BESS assembly capacity. * Support new model and equipment launches as required. * Report out on key metrics around automation performance and equipment reliability. **Capabilities for Success** * **Resilient Problem Solver:** Able to troubleshoot complex automation and controls issues to identify root cause quickly. * **Self\-Starter:** Takes ownership of projects and drives them to completion with limited supervision. * **Strong Communicator:** Bridges the gap between shop floor technicians and corporate engineering teams. * **Agile Mindset:** Comfortable working across shifts and navigating the ambiguity of a startup manufacturing environment. **You'll have...** * Bachelor's degree in engineering required * Maintenance experience, including internships, with the ability to optimize equipment programs and troubleshoot to root cause. * Flexibility to support business needs by working across various shifts * Domestic and international travel may be required **Even better, you may have...** * Master's degree in Engineering * 5\+ years of relevant Controls Engineering experience * Familiarity with Data Collection, AI/ML, IIOT, and Digital Twins * Prior experience with Fanuc, ABB, or Universal robots * Experience with Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and FMEAs * Proficiency in AutoCAD, C, and RSLOGIX * Skills: Computer efficiency; excellent communicator able to train hourly and salary team members You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply! As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? No matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including: * Immediate medical, dental, vision and prescription drug coverage * Flexible family care days, paid parental leave, new parent ramp\-up programs, subsidized back\-up child care and more * Family building benefits including adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, fertility treatments, and more * Vehicle discount program for employees and family members and management leases * Tuition assistance * Established and active employee resource groups * Paid time off for individual and team community service * A generous schedule of paid holidays, including the week between Christmas and New Year’s Day * Paid time off and the option to purchase additional vacation time. This position is a range of salary grade 5\-8 and ranges from $65,100\-$166,200\. Final determination of salary grade will be based on candidate's skills and experience, and base salary will be set within the applicable range according to job scope, responsibility and competitive market value. For more information on salary and benefits, click here: https://fordcareers.co/GSR Visa sponsorship is not available for this position. Candidates for positions with Ford Motor Company must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Verification of employment eligibility will be required at the time of hire. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, age, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status or protected veteran status. In the United States, if you need a reasonable accommodation for the online application process due to a disability, please call 1\-888\-336\-0660\. Company: As Ford establishes a wholly owned subsidiary focused on Battery Energy Storage Systems, this role will initially be employed by Ford and is expected to transition to the subsidiary within one year. \#LI\-Onsite \#LI\-AR3 \#FordEnergy

jobs.title: Development Engineer, Automation
jobs.description: **Forming Our Future together** FormFactor, Inc. (NASDAQ: FORM), is a leading provider of essential test and measurement technologies along the full semiconductor product life cycle — from characterization, modeling, reliability, and design de\-bug, to qualification and production test. Semiconductor companies rely upon FormFactor’s products and services to accelerate profitability by optimizing device performance and advancing yield knowledge. The company serves customers through its network of facilities in Asia, Europe, and North America. Rooted in our core values — Focus on the Customer, Ownership \& Accountability, Respectfully \& Effectively Communicate, and Motivate \& Develop People — we foster an environment where diverse perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated. Everyone can make an impact here. Whether it's improving products, supporting customers, or positively influencing peers and the community, the contributions of our people matter. **Shift:** The regular hours for this position are day shift.**Job Description:** FormFactor is seeking a **Development Engineer, Automation** to support the design, development, integration, validation, and deployment of innovative automation solutions used in the manufacture of advanced semiconductor test and measurement products. Working within a multidisciplinary engineering environment, this role contributes to the development of highly precise automated equipment and systems that combine mechanical design, motion control, machine vision, controls, and software technologies. The Development Engineer, Automation will collaborate closely with mechanical, electrical, systems, and software engineering teams to develop and improve complex manufacturing and test automation platforms. This role requires strong technical problem\-solving skills, hands\-on engineering capability, and the ability to support projects from concept through validation and deployment. **Key Responsibilities**: **Engineering Design \& Development** * Support the design, development, and integration of precision automation equipment, manufacturing systems, and machine subsystems. * Assist in translating product and process requirements into practical automation, motion control, and machine vision solutions. * Participate in design reviews and contribute engineering recommendations to improve machine functionality, reliability, and manufacturability. * Support continuous improvement efforts to enhance equipment performance, throughput, quality, and operational efficiency. **Equipment Build, Integration \& Validation** * Support the procurement, assembly, integration, and qualification of prototype and production precision machines. * Configure, operate, and jobs.title: Principal Full Stack Engineer, B2B eCommerce
jobs.description: **Principal Full Stack Engineer, B2B eCommerce** **Location:** Boston, MA (Hybrid) **Reports to:** Team Lead, eCommerce **Role type:** Full\-time, individual contributor **About Fusion Worldwide** Fusion Worldwide is the preeminent open market distributor of electronic components and products. Founded in 2001 and headquartered in Portsmouth, NH, with offices and quality centers around the world, Fusion sources, inspects, tests and delivers components to OEMs, CMs and ODMs across a wide range of industries. Learn more at fusionww.com. **The Role** You will be a senior technical owner of Fusion's B2B eCommerce platform, which includes fusionww.com, our GraphQL and REST APIs, the internal admin portal, and the event pipeline behind them. You will design and ship customer\-facing and internal commerce features end to end, run the services on Azure, and build AI agents that make our sales and operations teams faster. Our audience is entirely business buyers, including OEMs, CMs and ODMs. Even our smaller transactions are typically for business use, not personal consumption. Our Palantir Foundry platform is the data layer behind customer intelligence and sales workflows. You will consume it through its APIs and SDKs rather than build inside it. Foundry engineers own the data, and you turn it into great commerce experiences. We are an AI\-first team. Claude Code is part of everyone's daily workflow, AI code review is required on every pull request, and Claude\-powered agents run in production. Expect your time to split roughly 80% application development, 10% AI agents and LLM features, and 10% infrastructure and DevOps. **What You'll Do** **Commerce and platform development:** * Design and deliver features across the customer site (Next.js, React, TypeScript), the GraphQL backend (Python, FastAPI, Strawberry, SQLAlchemy), and REST services. * Own core commerce flows such as search and discovery, catalog and pricing display, quoting and RFQ, cart and checkout, and order status. * Build internal tools in the admin portal (Next.js, tRPC, Zod) used by sales, marketing, operations and compliance. * Work across Azure SQL/SQL Server, Redis, Algolia, and event\-driven processing with Celery and Azure Service Bus. * Integrate with HubSpot, Amplitude, Contentful and Fusion's ERP through its API layer. * Consume Foundry data (Ontology objects, OSDK, APIs) to power customer intelligence and sales workflows, and partner with the data team on contracts and requirements. **AI agents and LLM features:** * Build and improve production agents and LLM features on the Claude API, Claude Agent SDK and Model Context Protocol (MCP). * Manage cost, token usage and output quality, and add evals and guardrails so agent behavior can be trusted. * Use Claude Code as a primary development tool, with human judgment on every merge. **Infrastructure and DevOps:** * Operate and extend services on Azure: Container Apps and Jobs, Azure SQL, Front Door and WAF, Key Vault, Service Bus, API Management, Application Insights and Log Analytics. * Manage infrastructure as code with Terraform and CI/CD with GitHub Actions and Azure Container Registry across dev, test, pre\-release and production, including an active/active second region. * Improve observability and alerting and troubleshoot production issues by tracing real data. * Apply secure\-by\-default engineering: Key Vault secrets, least privilege, safe error handling and dependency hygiene. **Engineering ownership:** * Write well\-tested code at every layer and keep it passing in CI. * Own the quality of your own work: test and verify that your code meets requirements before release. This is a developer\-level QA, not a QA function. * Serve as the technical expert for the eCommerce application and development team, as a hands\-on individual contributor. * Triage and resolve user\-reported issues and fix bugs across the customer site, admin portal, and APIs. * Make and document architecture decisions, favoring the existing platform over new parallel infrastructure. * Partner with business stakeholders to assess feasibility and shape requirements. * Document what you learn so the next engineer, and the next AI session, don't have to rediscover it. **What You Bring** Required: * 10\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant time building or running B2B eCommerce or other commercial systems (catalog, pricing, quoting, orders, checkout, or ERP integration). * Expert\-level relational database skills, including schema design, query tuning, and concurrency (SQL Server preferred). * Hands\-on experience with Azure or an equivalent cloud, including containerized services and infrastructure as code with Terraform. * Experience building with LLMs or agents, and daily practical use of AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, with sound judgment about verifying their output. * Experience with Git and GitHub, GitHub Actions, Jira and Agile/Kanban delivery. * Clear written communication and the ability to explain tradeoffs to business stakeholders. Nice to have: * Distribution or marketplace commerce experience, especially with complex pricing, quoting, or inventory. * Experience with Algolia, HubSpot or event\-driven architecture. * Electronic components or supply chain domain knowledge. **What Success Looks Like** * First 30 days: Ship a production feature end to end and take ownership of a core commerce flow. * 3 months: Lead a major commerce initiative and ship at least one production agent or AI feature. * 12 months: Be the go\-to technical owner for eCommerce architecture, with measurable gains in \[conversion / quote cycle time / reliability].

jobs.title: Senior, Data Engineer
jobs.description: Enterprise AI (EAI) builds the data foundations that GSK's AI systems depend on. In our operating model, digital workers do the hands\-on data engineering. They generate pipelines, test and deploy them, monitor them in production and remediate failures. Our engineers direct that work and own the quality of what ships. Humans and digital workers both rely on a governed context layer. It makes data, meaning, permissions and history retrievable at the moment they are needed, and sits above our data platforms and beneath every experience and agent built on them. The Senior Data Engineer leads the design of production data systems for a team and its domains. The role defines the architectural, quality and governance standards the team and its digital workers apply, leads the team's AI\-grade data infrastructure, and mentors junior and mid\-level engineers. * **Leads the design of production data systems** for a team and its domains, including pipelines that serve multiple downstream consumers and the AI\-grade infrastructure beneath them. * **Defines how the team works with digital workers** through the architectural standards, quality checks and review patterns their work must meet within EAI's operating model. * **Raises the engineering bar for the team** by setting the code, documentation and governance standards others use as the baseline, and by mentoring junior and mid\-level engineers. **Key Responsibilities:** ------------------------- **Agent\-Operated Data Engineering** ------------------------------------ * **Lead the design of production pipelines that serve multiple downstream consumers,** and define the architectural standard the team and its digital workers apply. * **Define the team's patterns for agent\-generated work** within EAI's operating model: what digital workers build and remediate on their own in the team's domains, which checks their work must pass, and when it needs human review. * **Design how digital workers integrate** into the team's orchestration, observability and incident workflows, with clear tool design, evaluations, guardrails and human\-in\-the\-loop controls. * **Lead the response to significant data quality incidents,** from detection to permanent resolution, and drive improvements to team\-wide pipeline quality. **Context \& Semantics** ------------------------ * **Set the context standards for the team's domains:** how definitions, contracts, classification jobs.title: (Associate) Software Engineer- Trading Integrations Team
jobs.description: ***We are Gelber Group \- Passion for Trading. Powered by Technology.*** ------------------------------------------------------------------------ For more than 40 years, Gelber has been one of the industry's leading proprietary trading firms, combining entrepreneurial thinking with disciplined execution. Headquartered in Chicago, with offices and remote team members throughout the United States and Europe, we have built a reputation for innovation, longevity, and consistent performance. Through regulated businesses that include a FINRA\-registered broker\-dealer, a self\-clearing Chicago Mercantile Exchange member firm, and an AFM\-licensed MiFID II investment firm, Gelber is positioned to trade across all major global financial markets. Our business is driven by a relentless pursuit of new trading opportunities and a deep commitment to technical excellence. We trade a diverse range of asset classes and financial instruments using strategies that span the full spectrum of trading—from high\-frequency and systematic approaches to longer\-term discretionary trading. This diversity creates an intellectually rich environment where ideas, perspectives, and expertise from across the firm contribute to our continued evolution. Our culture is collaborative, entrepreneurial, and meritocratic. We empower talented people to take ownership, contribute meaningfully, and make an impact early in their careers. We believe our people are our greatest competitive advantage, and we invest in their development by providing meaningful responsibility, exceptional colleagues, and the resources they need to succeed. Our flat organizational structure and focus on a true meritocracy with competitive profit splits attracts individuals with an edge which contributes to our consistent success. This position will require in person presence in our Chicago office located in River North right next to the Merchandise Mart and convenient to public transportation. This position will be flexible for hybrid (Tuesday\-Thursday in office) once fully onboarded. **The Opportunity** ------------------- As an (Associate) Software Engineer on our Integrations Team at Gelber, you will have a real opportunity to have a long\-term career in Engineering at a successful trading firm. You will work side by side with other talented Engineers and interface with Traders every day. This role is for someone who flourishes in a fast\-paced environment, has a strong work ethic, clear communicator, and has a strong interest in the financial markets. This position will report directly into the Manager of our Integrations Engineering team who reports directly into our Chief Technology Officer. *What you'll do:* * Communicate with engineers, traders, and quants to architect, design, develop, deploy, and support our proprietary trading applications and tools * Responsible for managing projects from conceptualization and requirements gathering to user adoption * Have a significant impact in development for our existing infrastructure in C\#, as well as adding new features and applications for our human and algorithmic traders * Bridging the gap and communication between trading and technology and being that technical touchpoint for all trading * Become an expert in the entire trading pipeline and the software and technology that it is built upon, including the back end, front end, and everything in between * Provide real time support and bug fixes for live trading applications *What you'll need:* * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field * 1\-4 years of work experience working in C\#, Java, or C\+\+. C\# Professional Experience Required. * 1\-4 years of work experience working with SQL * Python and Linux experience strongly preferred * Working familiarity of ChatGPT Codex * Strong understanding of and experience with an Object Oriented Programming language * Excellent communication skills specifically when it comes to understanding requirements and translating that into code and fixing bugs * Self\-motivation and ability to work with others in a hybrid environment. * Understanding of the financial markets is not required, but preferred and must have a strong interest **Compensation and Benefits** ----------------------------- *The approximate annual base salary for this position in* ***Chicago, Illinois*** *is $100,000 to $150,000\. The actual offer, reflecting the total compensation package plus benefits, will be determined by a number of factors which include but are not limited to the applicant's experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities; geographic location; and internal equity. In addition to your salary, our total rewards package includes health benefits, a 401(k) plan, PTO, parental leave, professional development, tuition reimbursement and discretionary bonus, enhancing your overall total rewards package.* Gelber offers a wide range of benefits to full\-time employees, including: * Traditional and Roth 401(k) retirement program with discretionary employer match * Comprehensive health benefits including medical coverage provided by Blue Cross and Blue Shield (PPO and HDHP/HSA) and dental coverage; generous employer cost\-sharing * Tuition reimbursement for Undergraduate and Graduate courses * Flexible Spending Accounts for health care and dependent care; pre\-tax commuter benefits for parking and transit expenses * Life insurance and long\-term disability coverage * Health club membership with on\-site facilities (and reciprocal memberships) * Generous vacation time (23\-day accrual in first full calendar year of employment; prorated accrual in initial year), paid holidays, and paid maternity/paternity leave * Weekly catered lunches and monthly continental breakfasts * Social events including sponsored 5k races and annual company party * Enjoyable work environment including golf simulator * Employee referral bonus program * Charitable giving and company matching opportunities * Casual, relaxed dress code *If you are based in California, we encourage you to read the Gelber Privacy Notice for California Employees and Applicants, linked* *here**.*

jobs.title: Engineering Group Manager - Seat Complete
jobs.description: **Job Description** This role is categorized as hybrid. The selected candidate will be expected to work on\-site at the Warren Tech Center at least three days per week, or as otherwise determined by the hiring leader. * **This role is not eligible for relocation assistance.** At General Motors, our product teams are redefining mobility. Through a human\-centered design process, we create vehicles and experiences that are designed not just to be seen, but to be felt. We’re turning today’s impossible into tomorrow’s standard —from breakthrough hardware and battery systems to intuitive design, intelligent software, and next\-generation safety and entertainment features. Every day, our products move millions of people as we aim to make driving safer, smarter, and more connected, shaping the future of transportation on a global scale.. **Role Overview** ----------------- The Seat Complete Engineering Group Manager (EGM) is the technical and people leader responsible for the successful development, integration, and delivery of complete seat systems across assigned vehicle programs. This role leads GMNA seat DREs and seat integration engineers while partnering closely with Seat leadership, program teams, vehicle architecture, interior, safety integration, design studio, manufacturing, purchasing, global development teams, and suppliers. The EGM is accountable for delivering best\-in\-class seat solutions that balance customer expectations, vehicle integration, technical performance, quality, timing, cost, and business objectives. Success requires deep expertise in automotive seating and seat complete integration, sound independent judgment, timely decision\-making, and the ability to act autonomously while maintaining alignment with department strategy and vehicle program priorities. This role requires a hands\-on technical leader who can identify and resolve complex issues, establish a clear path forward, and build trust and confidence across teams and the supply base without unnecessary escalation or lost time. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ ### **Technical Leadership and Seat Complete Integration** * Lead the technical development and integration of complete seat systems from concept through launch for assigned vehicle programs. * Own seat complete technical execution, ensuring that seat structures, mechanisms, components, subsystems, trim, restraint interfaces, electrical content, occupant interfaces, and vehicle integration requirements are understood, compatible, and delivered as an integrated system. * Apply expert knowledge of automotive seating, seat structures, seat mechanisms, component and subsystem development, seat complete integration, packaging, and vehicle interior integration to guide engineering decisions. * Establish and maintain technical direction for the seat system, including requirements, interfaces, design intent, validation strategy, issue resolution, and launch readiness. * Ensure seat solutions meet or balance vehicle technical specifications, seat system technical specifications, customer expectations, quality targets, cost objectives, mass targets, timing, manufacturability, serviceability, and other program imperatives. * Lead technical reviews, peer reviews, DFMEA activities, DFSS application, design assessments, and cross\-functional issue\-resolution forums to drive robust engineering decisions and global read\-across. * Partner with suppliers to develop, mature, validate, and launch seat systems and technologies that meet GM requirements and program objectives. Identify technical risks early, assess tradeoffs, and drive mitigation plans to closure with clear owners, timing, and decision criteria. * ### **Program Execution and Decision\-Making** * Lead GMNA Seat DREs and seat integration engineers in delivering vehicle program milestones, GVDP deliverables, and launch commitments on time and with excellence. * Make timely, well\-informed decisions within the scope of the role, balancing department strategy with the needs of the vehicle and the expected impact on customers and business metrics. * Act autonomously to resolve ambiguity, remove roadblocks, and establish a path forward without waiting for unnecessary intervention. * Ensure technical decisions are clearly documented, communicated, and understood by impacted stakeholders across Seats, the program team, purchasing, manufacturing, and suppliers. * Manage competing priorities and a multitude of assignments with composure, organization, and disciplined execution. * Lead balancing of portfolio imperatives, including HVI, and ensure VTS, SSTS, CTS, and other vehicle and seat requirements are achievable, compatible, and aligned. * Ensure adequate engineering resources are identified and deployed to support program execution and frontloading initiatives, including strategic sourcing, design detail reviews, and other early development activities. Support execution and launch phases through appropriate travel a ing coaching, feedback, talent development, recognition, performance management, and workload prioritization. Willingness to travel as required during development, execution, and launch phases. * **Preferred Skills and Experience** ----------------------------------- * Master of Science degree in engineering or a related technical field. * Master of Business Administration. * DFSS Black Belt certification. * Experience with manufacturing automation and/or product design for automation. Experience with innovation and technical advancement within automotive seating or interiors. * **GM DOES NOT PROVIDE IMMIGRATION\-RELATED SPONSORSHIP FOR THIS ROLE. DO NOT APPLY FOR THIS ROLE IF YOU WILL NEED GM IMMIGRATION SPONSORSHIP NOW OR IN THE FUTURE. THIS INCLUDES DIRECT COMPANY SPONSORSHIP, ENTRY OF GM AS THE IMMIGRATION EMPLOYER OF RECORD ON A GOVERNMENT FORM, AND ANY WORK AUTHORIZATION REQUIRING A WRITTEN SUBMISSION OR OTHER IMMIGRATION SUPPORT FROM THE COMPANY (e.g., H\-1B, OPT, STEM OPT, CPT, TN, J\-1, etc.)** \#LI\-JN1 \&\#xa;\&\#xa;GM does not provide immigration\-related sponsorship for this role. Do not apply for this role if you will need GM immigration sponsorship now or in the future. This includes direct company sponsorship, entry of GM as the immigration employer of record on a government form, and any work authorization requiring a written submission or other immigration support from the company (e.g., H1\-B, OPT, STEM OPT, CPT, TN, J\-1, etc).\&\#xa;\&\#xa;This role is categorized as hybrid. This means the selected candidate is expected to report to a specific location at least 3 times a week {or other frequency dictated by their manager}.\&\#xa;\&\#xa; **About GM** Our vision is a world with Zero Crashes, Zero Emissions and Zero Congestion and we embrace the responsibility to lead the change that will make our world better, safer and more equitable for all. **Why Join Us** We believe we all must make a choice every day – individually and collectively – to drive meaningful change through our words, our deeds and our culture. Every day, we want every employee to feel they belong to one General Motors team. **Benefits Overview** From day one, we're looking out for your well\-being–at work and at home–so you can focus on realizing your ambitions. Learn how GM supports a rewarding career that rewards you personally by visiting **Total Rewards resources** . **Non\-Discrimination and Equal Employment Opportunities (U.S.)** General Motors is committed to being a workplace that is not only free of unlawful discrimination, but one that genuinely fosters inclusion and belonging. We strongly believe that providing an inclusive workplace creates an environment in which our employees can thrive and develop better products for our customers. All employment decisions are made on a non\-discriminatory basis without regard to sex, race, color, national origin, citizenship status, religion, age, disability, pregnancy or maternity status, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran or protected veteran, or any other similarly protected status in accordance with federal, state and local laws. We encourage interested candidates to review the key responsibilities and qualifications for each role and apply for any positions that match their skills and capabilities. Applicants in the recruitment process may be required, where applicable, to successfully complete a role\-related assessment(s) and/or a pre\-employment screening prior to beginning employment. To learn more, visit **How we Hire** . **Accommodations** General Motors offers opportunities to all job seekers including individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to assist with your job search or application for employment, **email** us or call us at 1\-800\-865\-7580\. In your email, please include a description of the specific accommodation you are requesting as well as the job title and requisition number of the position for which you are applying.

jobs.title: Cloud Operations Engineer
jobs.description: Are you passionate about human space exploration, understanding the origins of the universe, and working with a passionate and diverse team to make a difference? If you are, we need you! We need your talent, teamwork, and energy to help us achieve great things that inspire people all over the globe. We need you to bring creative ideas and diverse backgrounds to help us envision, shape, and deliver systems that will enable the exploration of space while benefiting people here on Earth. We are excited about what we do, and we need you on our team as we take on exciting challenges for NASA’s pursuits in deep space exploration. As NASA’s largest engineering solutions provider working together with NASA at centers across the United States. We have an exciting opportunity for a **Cloud Platform Engineer** to join our team GeoControl Systems, a teammate company. As a **Cloud Platform Engineer,** you will: * Developing new cloud\-native platform services spanning all three major cloud environments * Developing best practices for cloud\-native application development and promoting them within the organization * Administering NASA cloud networks and managing requests for deployment of COTS and Cloud Native applications into cloud environments * Writing quality code, providing quality and engaged code reviews for peers * Working with Managed Kubernetes offering across all three major cloud providers * Integrating cloud managed AI and data services with other bespoke and open\-source Kubernetes applications * Developing best practices for cloud\-native application development and promoting them within the organization * Identifying opportunities to abstract Prospective Project requirements and develop Enterprise\-grade, multi\-tenant Platform Services * Collaborate with NASA security and compliance teams to ensure teams are adhering to industry best practices and regulatory requirements * Working directly with NASA human spaceflight missions like Orion, Lunar Gateway, Artemis Perform other duties as required * ### **Requirements** *This position has been posted at multiple levels. Depending on the candidate's experience, requirements, and business needs, we reserve the right to consider candidates at any level for which this position has been advertised.* **Requisition Qualifications:** * Typically requires a bachelor’s degree or equivalent certification in a related area and normally possess 10 years of experience in the field or in a related area. * Strong experience with Kubernetes in production * Ability to manage and use GitLab (preferably very proficient) * Hands\-on experience with CI/CD pipeline tools * Observability Monitoring tools such as Grafana and SuperSet * Proficiency with Infrastructure\-as\-Code utilizing Terraform for infrastructure automation and/or open source alternatives (OpenTofu) * Extensive Linux experience (familiarity with Windows also preferred, but not required) * Expert in at least one programming language (Go and Python is preferred) * Experience with Python, SQL (and R is preferable) Working understanding of Machine Learning Model Lifecycle management (is preferred) * **Requisition Preferences:** * Solution\-oriented mindset, accepts feedback with enthusiasm * Effectively communicates with team members: clear status updates to direct report, regularly establishes unanimous decisions with peers * Self\-motivated and self\-managing, with strong organizational skills * Experience architecting and building cloud\-native applications * Demonstrable success and confidence in owning the full project lifecycle * Good instincts for identifying opportunities for abstraction Balances individual project development tasks at hand with overall platform and company goals * ### **Benefits** GCS health and welfare benefits are designed to invest in you, and in the things you care about. Your health. Your well\-being. Your security. Your future. Typical benefits offered include flexible work schedules and opportunities to work remotely, educational reimbursement, retirement benefits (401K, Roth), health benefits, tax saving options, disability benefits, life and accident insurance, voluntary benefits, paid time off and paid holidays, and parental and pregnancy leave.

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs.description: **Job Description** Goji Labs is seeking an experienced Full Stack Developer to build, enhance, and maintain modern web and mobile applications. This role involves developing responsive user interfaces, implementing reliable backend services, integrating APIs, and collaborating with designers, product managers, and engineers to deliver high\-quality digital products. The ideal candidate has strong full\-stack development skills, an understanding of modern software architecture, and the ability to turn product requirements into scalable, user\-friendly solutions. **Responsibilities** * Design, develop, and maintain web and mobile applications using React, React Native, Node.js, and TypeScript. * Build responsive, accessible, and user\-friendly front\-end interfaces. * Develop backend services, application logic, and RESTful or GraphQL APIs. * Integrate databases and external services to support application functionality. * Troubleshoot software defects and improve application performance, reliability, and security. * Write clean, maintainable, and well\-tested code. * Participate in code reviews and follow software development best practices. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to plan features and deliver project milestones. * Support application deployment, testing, and continuous improvement. **Requirements** * Demonstrated experience in full\-stack software development. * Strong proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript. * Experience with React and modern front\-end development. * Knowledge of Node.js and backend application development. * Familiarity with REST APIs, GraphQL, and database technologies. * Understanding of responsive design, web security, and software testing. * Experience using Git and collaborative development workflows. * Strong analytical, communication, and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to manage development tasks independently and work effectively with a distributed team. **Preferred Skills** * Experience with React Native and mobile application development. * Familiarity with PostgreSQL and database design. * Knowledge of automated testing and CI/CD pipelines. * Exposure to Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud deployment environments. * Experience with modern front\-end tools, component libraries, and state management solutions. **About the Company** Goji Labs is a Los Angeles\-based digital product design and development agency that helps businesses, startups, and organizations transform ideas into digital products. Its services include product strategy, user experience research, UI/UX design, and custom web and mobile application development. The team works with clients to create practical technology solutions that support business goals and improve user experiences. **Benefits** Potential benefits may include health insurance, paid time off, retirement savings options, flexible remote work, and professional development opportunities. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **General Summary:** Reporting to the Director of Information Technology, this position will play a key role in designing, building, and maintaining scalable ingestion frameworks across modern data tools. The ideal candidate should be highly motivated and passionate about creating data pipelines and models to help solve real\-world business problems and should have experience working with cloud\-based data platforms. **Supervisory Responsibilities:** **General Requirements:** This position has no supervisory responsibilities. All duties performed will be done accurately and in a timely manner. * Design, build, and maintain data pipelines and models for business users. * Extract data from various sources using data replication tools and APIs. * Scale and optimize exiting data pipelines to ensure efficient data flow and availability. * Use data transformation and management tools to ensure high\-quality, reproducible, and scalable data models. * Collaborate closely with business stakeholders to understand data needs and implement data models to support business intelligence tools and analytics. * Ensure data integrity, accuracy, and quality across all data\-related projects. * Continuously evaluate and recommend improvements to the data architecture and tools used within the company. **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:** * **Strong experience with Snowflake for data warehousing and managing large datasets.** * **Proficiency in Microsoft SQL Server for querying, data manipulation, and optimization.** * **Experience in Azure or equivalent cloud platform.** * **Strong SQL skills and solid foundation in Python.** * **Proficiency in dbt (or similar) for data transformation, testing, and documentation.** * **Experience in version control (such as Azure DevOps) and collaborative coding workflows.** * **Experience with data replication tools such as Fivetran, Snowflake Openflow or similar replication software.** * **Ability to work on a team and be proficient in collaborating with product owners and development teams.** * **Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously with limited supervision.** * **Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.** * **Detail\-oriented with a strong understanding of incremental logic, schema evolution, and data quality testing.** **Education and Experience:** Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Data Science or related quantitative field preferred. 3\+ years of proven data engineering experience with hands\-on expertise in data integration, data modeling, and ELT processes. **Mental / Physical Requirements:** Requires manual dexterity, sitting, standing, stooping, reaching, Close vision and ability to adjust focus. Must be able to work efficiently under pressure. **Other Duties as Assigned:** The above job description is not intended to be an all\-inclusive list of duties and standards of the position.
