jobs.title: Customer Engineer II, Platform, East Google Cloud
jobs.description: Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **New York, NY, USA; Chicago, IL, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. * 6 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer\-facing or support role. * Experience with cloud engineering, on\-premise engineering, virtualization, or containerization platforms. * Experience engaging with, or presenting to, technical stakeholders or executive leaders. * Experience in programming languages, debugging, systems design, prototyping, demos, or customer workshops. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Experience selling technical solutions in one or more of the following: Infrastructure Modernization, Application Modernization, Data Management, Data Analytics, Cloud AI, Networking, Migrations, Security. * Experience driving the entire business\-cycle (e.g., defining the delivery and consumption plan and transitioning it for execution). * Experience building long\-term technical strategies to uncover new workloads with customers. * Experience migrating applications and services to cloud platforms. * Experience with security concepts (e.g., encryption, identity management, access control, attack vectors, penetration testing). **About the job** ----------------- The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners. As a Customer Engineer, you will partner with Sales teams as the primary technical leader and trusted advisor for our customers. You will work to understand their business issues and translate them into scalable, cloud\-native solutions. You will lead technical discovery, architect solutions, and deliver compelling proofs\-of\-concept and demonstrations. Leveraging a broad technical expertise across infrastructure modernization, application development, and data analytics, you will design solutions that accelerate our customers' business objectives. You will drive the technical win, articulate the value of our portfolio to both business and technical leaders, and define the path for successful adoption. A key focus will be on identifying new workloads and expanding Google Cloud adoption within customer accounts. Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $127000 \- $184000 (USD) \+ 42\.86% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Develop and own the technical account plan and strategy, participating in planning and supporting sales motions. * Combine sales, programming, and solutions architecture expertise to prove the value of Google Cloud Platform across the portfolio through complex demos, pilots and in\-depth workshops. * Architect cross\-pillar solutions, drive technical wins, and define initial delivery plans for customers; continue to lead the technical engagement in the solution phase. * Facilitate the post\-sales transition by supporting pricing activities and transitioning the final delivery plan to implementation teams. * Maintain awareness of progress against the delivery plan, providing support to cross\-functional teams during ramp, delivery, migration or implementation phases. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: Customer and Partner Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: In most instances, this position requires in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process. The application window will be open until at least November 9, 2026\. This opportunity will remain online based on business needs which may be before or after the specified date. Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Atlanta, GA, USA; Boulder, CO, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 3 years of experience coding with one or more programming languages (e.g., Java, C/C\+\+, Python). * 3 years of experience working with client\-side web technologies (e.g., HTML, CSS, JavaScript, or HTTP). * 3 years of experience in technical troubleshooting, and managing internal/external partners or customers. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or a related field. * Experience in an investigative role such as business intelligence, data analytics, or statistics. * Experience working with database technologies (e.g., SQL, NoSQL). * Experience using machine learning and building solutions. * Experience working with systems (e.g., Linux, Unix). **About the job** ----------------- In gTech Users and Products (gUP), our mission is to advocate for Google’s users by creating helpful and trusted experiences across the product ecosystem. We achieve this by meeting partners and consumers where they are with support and help, representing their needs with our product partners and proposing fixes and features that elevate their engagement with Google's diverse product ecosystem. Additionally we provide a range of product services that ensure our products are optimized for every user, no matter where they are in the world (e.g., localization, digitization, partner integration, and more). As a Customer and Partner Solutions Engineer, you will help Google scale its user support and product education initiatives to our users worldwide with the help of AI and other advanced technologies You will partner with our user support teams to develop and implement technical innovations that support and delight our users. You will oversee the integration of our scaled support systems by partnering closely with product support managers and support engineering teams to ensure that users can get the support they need. Google creates products and services that make the world a better place, and gTech’s role is to help bring them to life. Our teams of trusted advisors support customers globally. Our solutions are rooted in our technical skill, product expertise, and a thorough understanding of our customers’ complex needs. jobs.title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer, AQI Data SRE
jobs.description: In most instances, this position requires in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 8 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages. * 3 years of experience leading projects. * 3 years of experience designing, analyzing, and troubleshooting distributed systems. * Experience with large\-scale data processing. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master's degree in Computer Science or Engineering. * Experience in distributed, real\-time systems and high\-throughput data pipelines. * Knowledge or experience with agentic flows/development and with AI\-assisted production/reliability tooling. * Excellent collaboration skills, with a track record of building trusted, blameless partnerships with development teams. * Excellent non\-abstract large systems design skills, with experience building scalable, self\-service reliability and observability. * Proven track record of driving cross\-functional architectural alignment and influencing technical decisions across large engineering organizations. **About the job** ----------------- Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) combines software and systems engineering to build and run large\-scale, massively distributed, fault\-tolerant systems. SRE ensures that Google Cloud's services—both our internally critical and our externally\-visible systems—have reliability, uptime appropriate to customer's needs and a fast rate of improvement. Additionally SRE’s will keep an ever\-watchful eye on our systems capacity and performance. Much of our software development focuses on optimizing existing systems, building infrastructure and eliminating work through automation. On the SRE team, you’ll have the opportunity to manage the complex challenges of scale which are unique to Google Cloud, while using your expertise in coding, algorithms, complexity analysis and large\-scale system design. SRE's culture of intellectual curiosity, problem solving and openness is key to its success. Our organization brings together people with a wide variety of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We encourage them to collaborate, think big and take risks in a blame\-free environment. We promote self\-direction to work on meaningful projects, while we also strive to create an environment that provides the support and mentorship needed to learn and grow. Ads Quality Infrastructure (AQI) Data Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) keeps Search Ads and Ads on Google Experiences (SAGE/SPARK) data processing reliable, so those teams can deliver useful ads that create advertiser value. We own the core infrastructure behind the Google Ads business across Google\-owned surfaces, including Google Search, Google Maps, and Feed Ads, and have a portion of Google business. AQI SRE owns: serving, data extraction and copy, and the platforms that keep those systems fast and healthy. We partner with development teams to co\-build and support this infrastructure. Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next\-generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $207000 \- $300000 (USD) \+ 20% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Define the technical goal, architectural roadmap, and reliability strategy for AQI Data SRE across the SAGE/SPARK production stack. * Partner with dev leadership to lead system design reviews, drive backend simplification and resource isolation, and ensure production readiness for flagship Ads launches. * Architect and lead the implementation of critical infrastructure projects, including data\-pipeline resilience, automated rollback/restart platforms, and consolidated observability. * Mentor and grow engineers on the team, and push for software engineering excellence, AI\-first tooling, and SRE best practices; drive the operational maturity handover that helps partner dev teams mature. * Lead the response to complex production incidents, correlate production signals with customer and business impact, and drive high\-impact post\-incident architectural improvements and blameless postmortems and participate in a healthy tier 2 oncall rotation for core shared SAGE/SPARK infrastructure. This is a builder role. The foundation is in place: the HubSpot data model is built and the roadmap is clear. What we need now is someone to build on top of it. You’ll own a backlog of automation, integration, and analytics projects, decide what to tackle first, and ship each one end to end. You’ll report to our co\-founder and CTO, who is spending more of his time on go\-to\-market and wants a technical partner to build the growth function with him. You’ll also work closely with our Head of Revenue, who owns the sales process and is the main customer for what you build. Expect to run fast experiments, get deep into the details, and help shape how Greenboard grows from here. **What You'll Work On** **HubSpot build and administration** ------------------------------------ * Own HubSpot as a platform: objects, properties, picklist governance, pipelines, lifecycle stages, workflows, permissions, and native integrations * Partner with the Head of Revenue to turn sales process decisions (stage definitions, exit criteria, qualification criteria, forecast categories) into clean, documented HubSpot configuration * Surface rep CRM hygiene gaps (missing meetings, stale stages, unattached call recordings) so Sales leadership can act on them **Automation and data quality** ------------------------------- * Build and maintain the automation layer: deal stage logic, first\-meeting\-held and call\-recording triggers, customer start date rules, lead routing, and handoff workflows * Own technical data hygiene: deduplication, backfills, source reconciliation, bulk corrections, and ongoing data quality monitoring **Conversation and deal intelligence** -------------------------------------- * Own the tooling and analysis behind call review, closed\-lost investigation, and coaching data, and work with the Head of Revenue to turn what you find into changes in how the team sells * Build automated call review and deal intelligence pipelines using LLM APIs on top of Fireflies and HubSpot data **Analytics and automated reporting** ------------------------------------- * Configure the HubSpot dashboards and reports Sales leadership uses: pipeline and conversion by source and rep, bookings, activity, and forecast views * Build and extend our automated Slack reporting (weekly sales report\-out, sales management and sales development reports) pulling from HubSpot and Fireflies * Support event and partner attribution reporting alongside Events Marketing and the partnerships team * Answer ad hoc data questions quickly and turn the recurring ones into durable reports **Who You Are** =============== * A systems thinker who likes owning the whole stack, from schema design to the dashboard on someone's screen * Deep, hands\-on CRM experience: you've built complex workflows, designed custom objects and properties, debugged sync issues, and know where HubSpot's limits are and how to work around them * Comfortable with SQL and at least one scripting language (Python or JavaScript), and with integration through APIs * Experience with agentic coding * Rigorous about data integrity. You treat revenue data like production code: versioned, tested, documented * Able to take a vague business ask ("we need pipeline by first\-touch source") and turn it into requirements, a data model, and a shipped report * High ownership and bias to action in an early\-stage environment; you'd rather ship a v1 and iterate than wait for a perfect spec * Clear communicator who can explain what a number means, why it moved, and what's wrong with it **Qualifications** ================== **Required** ------------ * 4 to 8 years in growth, sales operations, GTM systems, data engineering, or analytics engineering at a B2B SaaS company * Expert\-level CRM administration and development (HubSpot Sales Hub and Marketing Hub; Operations Hub a plus) * Strong SQL; working proficiency in Python or JavaScript * Comfort with dbt, a data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, Postgres), or reverse ETL tooling * Experience building and maintaining integrations between a CRM and adjacent GTM tools (call intelligence, support, marketing) * Experience building executive\-facing dashboards, in HubSpot's reporting layer or a BI tool (Looker, Metabase, Hex, Sigma, or similar) * Track record of shipping systems and automation end to end, not just scoping them **Preferred** ------------- * Experience building with LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI) for internal automation, reporting, or analysis * Exposure to partner or channel sales models and the attribution problems they create * Experience with conversation intelligence tooling (Fireflies, Gong, or similar) and its CRM integrations * Background in fintech, compliance, or financial services software **BENEFITS** * 401(k) with 5% company match * Medical, dental, and vision coverage * 15 days PTO \+ 11 company holidays \+ flexible sick time * 2 additional PTO days for each year of service (up to 10 additional days) * 10 remote days per year plus additional around the holidays * Bi\-annual off\-sites and team retreats * Front\-row seat to building the operating backbone of modern finance Compensation Range: $140K \- $180K

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: **Senior Machine Learning Engineer** ==================================== **Location:** San Francisco or remote · Full\-time **About us** ------------ Hum’s mission is to learn how the Earth changes by building a “world model for the entire world”: one that represents the dynamics of Earth processes, forecasts what a place looks like next, and makes that understanding useful. Founded at the University of Waterloo and backed by top investors like HF0, Climactic, Onto Ventures and angels from Firebase and OpenTable, we are a small team working on some of the largest unsolved problems. **The role** ------------ As our Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you'll own the software and infrastructure that trains and serves our models, so our research scientists can stay focused on the models themselves. The rest of our engineering team is building the pipelines that ingest petabytes of earth observation and remote sensing data, and an agent that uses that data and our models to answer customer questions. You'll own everything in between, the path from ingested data into training, the systems that run experiments and large\-scale training, and the inference path that delivers model outputs to the agent. You'll work closely with those engineers to fit all the pieces together, and with our AI research scientists to make the models they dream up trainable, measurable, and servable at scale, from the first small experiment through full training runs. **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Own the ML platform.** Build and run the systems for experiment tracking, distributed training at scale, and serving inference, and keep them fast, reliable, and reproducible. * **Collaborate on the interfaces.** Work with our engineers and scientists to define and maintain the boundaries between data and training, data and inference, and inference and the agent. * **Enable multimodal training.** Build the data and model plumbing that lets us train on many sensors, observation types, and text in one model. * **Go from small to large.** Help our scientists prove ideas in fast, cheap experiments, then scale the winners to petabyte\-scale training runs. * **Make evaluation real.** Implement and improve our benchmarks and evaluation frameworks, both internal and user\-facing. * **Watch the meter.** Measure and optimize the cost and wall\-clock time of experiments, training, and inference. * **Support the agent.** Work with the product team on how the agent calls the model and consumes its outputs, and build the integration. **Requirements** ---------------- * Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 5\+ years of relevant industry experience, including hands\-on machine learning engineering. * Proficiency building distributed, multi\-node training pipelines in PyTorch and Lightning. * Experience with AWS or another cloud platform, particularly the tooling for training and serving medium\-to\-large models. * Strong software engineering fundamentals: you write production\-quality Python and care about reliability, observability, and cost. * Fluent with modern agentic coding tools (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) and current on how to use them well. **Bonus** --------- * Experience training large diffusion or transformer models, ideally on video or time\-series data. * Experience with multimodal or spatiotemporal data, geospatial data, or geoscience problems. * Experience serving models in production and integrating them with downstream applications or agents. * Startup experience, comfortable with a small, fast\-moving team. **Why us?** ----------- * **Work that matters for the planet.** Our customers in nature conservation, carbon removal, and government use our models to protect ecosystems and respond to a changing climate. We take positive impact seriously, including safety and guardrails, and you'll help us get it right. * **A team worth joining.** Founded at the University of Waterloo by PhDs and engineers who've built and shipped at scale, we're small, technical, and collaborative. You'll work alongside people who care about the problem as much as you do. * **Well backed.** $10M\+ raised from HF0, Inovia Capital, and Propeller Ventures, angels including the cofounders of Firebase and OpenTable, and partners like AWS and the United Nations. * **Compensation and upside.** Competitive salary, meaningful early\-stage equity, health, dental and vision. As one of the first AI hires, your equity stake reflects that.

jobs.title: Controls Engineer, Vehicle Controls
jobs.description: **About Harbinger** Harbinger is an American commercial electric vehicle (EV) company on a mission to transform an industry starving for innovation. Harbinger's best\-in\-class team of EV, battery, and drivetrain experts have pooled their deep experience to bring a first\-of\-its\-kind EV platform to support the growing demand for medium\-duty EVs and Hybrids. Harbinger: Familiar Form, Revolutionary Foundation. ### **Role Overview** Harbinger is looking for a Controls Engineer to join our Vehicle Controls team and help develop, validate, and debug the control algorithms that run our medium\-duty EV and hybrid platforms. Working primarily on supervisory controls (vehicle state management, powertrain and energy management, torque arbitration, and fault handling), you will turn system requirements into production\-quality Simulink/Stateflow models, verify them through model\-in\-the\-loop (MIL) testing, and debug them on real vehicles using CAN data. You will also support other control domains as program needs evolve. You will work closely with systems, EE, and vehicle test teams, and your work will directly shape how our vehicles drive, protect themselves, and perform for fleet customers. ### **Key Responsibilities** * Develop, maintain, and improve control algorithms in MATLAB, Simulink, and Stateflow, with a primary focus on vehicle supervisory controls (vehicle state machine, charging controls, thermal management, drive modes, torque request and arbitration, energy management, and diagnostics/fault reactions). * Write, review, and refine software requirements derived from system\-level requirements; maintain traceability between requirements, models, and test cases. * Develop and execute model\-in\-the\-loop (MIL) test cases and test harnesses; analyze results, report coverage, and drive issues to closure. * Develop and maintain CI pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI) that automate model checks, code generation, and regression testing. * Generate production code from models and review the generated C code to support integration with the embedded software team. * Develop and integrate OBD/UDS diagnostic functions, including DTC definition, fault detection and debounce, fault reactions, and DIDs; maintain diagnostic definitions in CDD/ODX and verify them on bench and vehicle using Vector tools. * Calibrate, tune control parameters and debug control behavior on bench, HIL, and vehicle by capturing and analyzing CAN logs with Vector tools (CANalyzer, CANape, vSignalyzer). * Perform root\-cause analysis on issues found in vehicle testing and in customer fleets using field data and logs, and implement and verify fixes in the model. * Participate in hands\-on vehicle testing at test sites and customer locations, including occasional travel. * Support model reviews, modeling guideline checks (e.g., MAB/MISRA\-style guidelines), and configuration management of models and test artifacts. * Collaborate with systems, calibration, embedded software, and vehicle test engineers to define interfaces (signals, CAN messages) and support vehicle integration and validation activities. * Support other control domains beyond supervisory controls (e.g., chassis, body, and auxiliary systems ) as program needs require. ### **Required Skills \& Experience** * 2\-5 years of experience developing automotive or vehicle control software using model\-based design. * Strong hands\-on proficiency in MATLAB, Simulink, and Stateflow for control algorithm development and debugging. * Experience applying control theory techniques such as PID control, LQR/optimal control, and Kalman filtering/state estimation to real systems. * Experience writing software requirements and developing and executing MIL test cases. * Working knowledge of C, including the ability to read and debug auto\-generated or hand\-written embedded code. * Experience with CAN communication and analyzing CAN logs using Vector tools such as CANalyzer, CANape, and/or vSignalyzer, including working with DBC files. * Experience calibrating control parameters on bench or vehicle (e.g., CANape with XCP and A2L files). * Solid understanding of control systems fundamentals and vehicle systems (powertrain, high\-voltage battery, inverter/motor, or vehicle state management). * Experience with version control (e.g., Git) and working in a structured software development process. * Comfortable working hands\-on with vehicles and safely around high\-voltage systems (HV safety training provided). * Valid driver's license and willingness to travel occasionally to test sites and customer locations. * Strong problem\-solving, debugging, and communication skills; comfortable working in a fast\-paced startup environment. * Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Computer, Mechatronics, or Controls Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with EV or hybrid vehicle supervisory controls, energy management, or powertrain controls. * Experie ), including integrating model\-generated code as AUTOSAR software components. * Experience with Embedded Coder, Simulink Test,, Model Advisor, or Polyspace, and with SIL/HIL testing (e.g., dSPACE, NI, Vector VT System). * Experience building CI pipelines for model\-based development (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, MATLAB CI/CD tools). * Familiarity with EV charging standards (SAE J1772, CCS, ISO 15118\). * Familiarity with ISO 26262 functional safety and ASPICE. * Experience with requirements management tools (e.g., Jama, Polarion, DOORS) and scripting for data analysis or test automation (MATLAB scripting, Python, CAPL). * Experience analyzing field or fleet data to resolve customer issues. * Master's degree in Controls, Electrical, or Mechanical Engineering, or a related field. **Equal Opportunity** Harbinger is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information or characteristics, physical or mental disability, marital/domestic partner status, age, military/veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by law. Harbinger is committed to ensuring that our hiring process is accessible for persons with disabilities. If you have a disability or limitation, such as those covered by the Americans with Disabilities Act, that requires accommodations to assist you in the search and application process, please email us at info@harbingermotors.com. **Candidate Data Privacy** Harbinger may collect, use and disclose your personal information or personal data (within the meaning of the applicable data protection laws) when you apply for employment and/or participate in our recruitment processes ("Candidate Personal Data"). This data includes contact, demographic, communications, educational, professional, employment, social media/website, network/device, recruiting system usage/interaction, security and preference information. Harbinger may use your Candidate Personal Data for the purposes of (i) tracking interactions with our recruiting system; (ii) carrying out, analyzing and improving our application and recruitment process, including assessing you and your application and conducting employment, background and reference checks; (iii) establishing an employment relationship or entering into an employment contract with you; (iv) complying with our legal, regulatory and corporate governance obligations; (v) recordkeeping; (vi) ensuring network and information security and preventing fraud; and (vii) as otherwise required or permitted by applicable law. jobs.title: Senior AI Platform Engineer – Agentic AI
jobs.description: We are seeking a Senior AI Platform Engineer – Agentic AI to join our Data Engineering, AI \& ML Platform team. This role will help design and build the enterprise platform capabilities that enable teams to create, deploy, evaluate, observe, and operate production\-grade AI agents and intelligent applications at scale. You will work at the intersection of software engineering, AI platform engineering, Generative AI, agentic systems, data engineering, and MLOps. A major focus of the role will be building reusable platform capabilities for agent development, including reasoning and orchestration workflows, tool integration, enterprise knowledge retrieval, memory/context management, evaluation, observability, and responsible operation of AI agents. Rather than building one\-off AI applications, you will help establish reusable services, SDKs, patterns, and platform components that accelerate AI development across Honeywell. You will collaborate with data engineers, AI/ML engineers, application teams, architects, product teams, and domain experts to take emerging AI capabilities from experimentation to secure, reliable, production\-grade enterprise services. The role is based in Atlanta, GA on a hybrid basis. Implement observability and tracing for agent execution so developers can understand agent decisions, model calls, tool calls, failures, performance, and resource consumption. * **AI Platform Engineering** * Design, build, and operate scalable platform services and APIs using Python and FastAPI or comparable production frameworks. * Build reusable APIs, SDKs, libraries, templates, and reference implementations that make it easier for engineering teams to develop and deploy AI applications. * Design cloud\-native AI platform services using technologies such as Azure, Kubernetes, Databricks, Azure * Machine Learning, MLflow, or equivalent platforms. * Develop production capabilities for model and application deployment, configuration, versioning, experimentation, evaluation, and lifecycle management. * Build automated CI/CD and testing pipelines for AI services, agent workflows, prompts/configurations, and supporting platform components. * Convert prototypes and notebook\-based experimentation into modular, testable, maintainable, production\-quality software. Design platform patterns for maintaining data quality, lineage, access control, and traceability across AI workflows. * **Production Engineering, Safety \& Reliability** * Build AI services with production software engineering practices covering testing, security, scalability, reliability, and maintainability. * Implement end\-to\-end observability, tracing, monitoring, and alerting across agent workflows, models, APIs, retrieval systems, and platform services. * Establish mechanisms for handling agent failures, tool failures, model errors, timeouts, retries, and degraded dependencies. * Implement appropriate guardrails, access controls, auditability, and human oversight for enterprise agentic AI workflows. * Optimize AI workloads for latency, throughput, infrastructure utilization, and model/token cost. * Diagnose complex production issues spanning AI models, orchestration, data, APIs, infrastructure, and applications. **YOU MUST HAVE** * 8\+ years of software, data platform, ML platform, or AI engineering experience, including designing, building, and supporting production\-grade systems. * Strong Python software engineering expertise, including API/service development, testing, debugging, packaging, design patterns, and modern software development best practices. * Experience building cloud\-native distributed applications and platforms using containers, Kubernetes, public cloud technologies, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and reliability engineering. * Hands\-on experience developing and deploying AI/ML and Generative AI solutions, including model serving, lifecycle management, monitoring, operational support, and production deployments. Experience building LLM and agentic AI applications, including RAG/grounding, enterprise data integration and retrieval (structured and unstructured data), orchestration frameworks, and tool/API integration. * **WE VALUE** * Experience with LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, or equivalent agent orchestration frameworks. * Experience designing multi\-agent systems, agent tool ecosystems, planning/reasoning workflows, agent memory, or human\-in\-the\-loop patterns. * Experience with AI evaluation and observability platforms such as LangSmith, MLflow or equivalent tooling. * Experience with Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI services, Databricks, Kubernetes, or comparable AI/data platforms. * Experience with vector databases, semantic search, knowledge graphs, RDF/SPARQL, Neo4j, ontology engineering, or GraphRAG\-style knowledge systems. * Experience building AI systems that integrate with industrial IoT, operational technology, building systems, digital twins, or high\-volume telemetry. * Experience building developer platforms, SDKs, internal frameworks, or reusable engineering capabilities used by multiple development teams. Bachelor's or advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. * **ABOUT HONEYWELL** Honeywell International Inc. (NYSE: HON) invents and commercializes technologies that address some of the world’s most critical challenges around energy, safety, security, air travel, productivity, and global urbanization. We are a leading software\-industrial company committed to introducing state\-of\-the\-art technology solutions to improve efficiency, productivity, sustainability, and safety in high growth businesses in broad\-based, attractive industrial end markets. Our products and solutions enable a safer, more comfortable, and more productive world, enhancing the quality of life of people around the globe. Learn more here: https://www.honeywell.com/us/en **BENEFITS OF WORKING FOR HONEYWELL** In addition to a performance\-driven salary, cutting\-edge work, and developing solutions side\-by\-side with dedicated experts in their fields, Honeywell employees are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package. This package includes employer\-subsidized Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance; Short\-Term and Long\-Term Disability; 401(k) match, Flexible Spending Accounts, Health Savings Accounts, EAP, and Educational Assistance; Parental Leave, Paid Time Off (for vacation, personal business, sick time, and parental leave), and 12 Paid Holidays. For more information: https://benefits.honeywell.com/ The application period for the job is estimated to be 40 days from the job posting date; however, this may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

jobs.title: Quality Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Role:** The Quality Engineer plays a critical role in ensuring that products and processes meet stringent quality standards and regulatory requirements, particularly within regulated industries such as medical devices. This position is responsible for developing, implementing, and maintaining quality systems that drive continuous improvement and compliance with ISO 13485 standards. The Quality Engineer will lead root\-cause analysis efforts and corrective and preventive actions to resolve quality issues and prevent recurrence. They will collaborate closely with suppliers and cross\-functional teams to ensure that incoming materials and components meet quality expectations through first article inspections and ongoing supplier quality management. Ultimately, this role ensures that products are manufactured consistently to specification, enhancing customer satisfaction and minimizing risk to the organization. **Minimum Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality Management, or a related technical field. * Proven experience with Statistical Process Control (SPC) and Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA). * Familiarity with ISO 13485 standards and quality system regulations. * Experience conducting root\-cause analysis and implementing effective quality solutions. * Strong knowledge of supplier quality management and first article inspection processes. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Certification as a Quality Engineer (CQE) or equivalent. * Experience with Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD\&T) in a manufacturing environment. * Hands\-on experience with control plan development and implementation. * Background in medical device or highly regulated industries. * Proficiency with quality management software and data analysis tools. **Responsibilities:** * Develop, implement, and maintain Statistical Process Control (SPC) methods to monitor and improve manufacturing processes. * Lead Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) investigations by performing root\-cause analysis and driving resolution activities. * Manage supplier quality by conducting audits, evaluating supplier performance, and coordinating first article inspections. * Ensure compliance with ISO 13485 quality management system requirements and maintain documentation accordingly. * Create and maintain control plans and geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD\&T) documentation to support product quality and manufacturing consistency. **Skills:** The required skills such as Statistical Process Control and Corrective and Preventive Actions are applied daily to monitor production quality and address deviations proactively. Root\-cause analytical skills enable the engineer to identify underlying issues and implement sustainable corrective measures. Supplier quality expertise ensures that all incoming materials meet stringent standards through first article inspections and ongoing supplier evaluations. Knowledge of ISO 13485 and quality systems guides the maintenance of compliant documentation and processes, ensuring regulatory adherence. Additionally, skills in Geometric Dimensioning and Control Plan development support precise manufacturing and consistent product quality, fostering continuous improvement across operations.

jobs.title: Staff+ Software Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Description** At **In Tandem**, we build technology that helps families manage everyday routines and navigate life’s biggest transitions. Through our four brands—OurFamilyWizard, Cozi, FamilyWall, and Custody Navigator—we help families stay organized, communicate well, and foster healthy childhoods. We believe technology should strengthen relationships and make daily coordination less complicated. Everything we create is designed to lighten the mental load, reduce conflict, and support families through big and small moments. If you want your work to make a real difference in the daily lives of parents and kids, In Tandem is the place where your impact will truly matter. As a **Staff\+ Builder**, you're on the frontier of continuously redefining how we deliver software and exercise judgement in a constantly evolving landscape — a true AI\-native builder expanding products and how they get built. Some of the best work here starts with no brief, no team and no playbook. We want someone who sees that as the appeal: who takes an idea from zero to one and cares personally whether it gets traction. This role exists to bring that way of working into In Tandem, wherever the organization needs it most. This is an evergreen role. We will shape the specific team and scope with you as we learn where your strengths meet the most important opportunities across our products and platform. As we move through conversations, we will discuss the concrete problem area, collaborators, and expectations for the opening we are considering together.### **What you will do:** * **Seek out problems worth building for.** Talk with users, learn from support and product data, and pay attention to changes in our markets. Turn those signals into a clear view of what matters, then take initiative inside shared priorities, and bring partners along as you learn. * **Take it from zero to one.** Start where there is no structure. Get a first version in front of real users quickly, find out whether anyone cares, and do the unglamorous work that earns early traction. Own the outcome, not just the code. * **Carry useful work into production.** Shape a focused first version, build it, and learn from real use. Define how you will judge success before you build, then use the evidence to improve, expand, or stop the work. * **Raise the pace and quality of engineering.** Identify places where an AI\-enabled workflow can shorten the path from idea to shipped software. Build the tools, context, checks, and feedback loops that let other engineers use it with confidence. * **Own the hard decisions.** Move work forward when requirements are incomplete, make your reasoning visible, and bring consequential tradeoffs to the right partners. Choose when to prototype, when to invest in durable architecture, and how to verify that a system is correct, safe, and useful. * **Connect the pieces.** Work across product and engineering boundaries. Bring depth in a core platform and enough range across APIs, web, mobile, and infrastructure to help a feature succeed end to end. * **Make others stronger.** Share working examples, explain tradeoffs clearly, invite criticism, and help teams adopt what proves effective. ### **What strong work could look like:** The shape of the work will depend on the team. Examples include:* Recognizing a recurring difficulty in a family workflow, validating it with users and partners, and shipping a focused improvement across client and service boundaries. * Launching something small with no existing team or process, getting it to its first real users, and iterating on their feedback until it was adopted or you chose to stop. * Turning a promising agent prototype into a reliable engineering workflow with evaluation, tests, observability, and clear human review points. * Removing a recurring bottleneck in delivery so teams can make more high\-quality changes with less coordination. * Connecting an emerging user or market need to our product strategy, testing the opportunity with a small build, and using the result to decide whether it deserves more investment. These are examples of the work this role might own, not claims that those projects are planned or assigned. ### **What you bring:** **What you bring*** Staff\-level impact as a hands\-on engineer: you have shaped technical direction, built important systems, and helped other people deliver stronger work. * An owner's mindset. You've started something with little structure, such as a product, feature, internal tool, open\-source project or company. You stayed with it through the early phase until it found users or you learned it wouldn't. * Evidence that you can move from an uncertain problem to a useful result. You know how to test a premise with a prototype and how to recognize when a prototype needs stronger engineering before it can be trusted in production. * Product judgment and curiosity about users and markets. You can explain why a problem mattered, how you chose it with others, and what changed for users or the business because of what you built. * Practical fluency with AI\-assisted development. You have used models or agents to build real software or workflows, and you can explain where they helped, where they failed, and how you checked the result. * Strong judgment about architecture, quality, security, and user experience. You know which decisions need close attention and which can be accelerated. * Depth in at least one engineering area, with the curiosity and fundamentals to work effectively across the stack. * Low ego, high integrity, and a habit of making your reasoning visible so others can learn from and improve it. **What will stand out** Show us a piece of work you helped take from an uncertain opportunity to a useful result. If it started from zero, tell us what you did to get the first users and what you did when nobody was available to help. What user or market signal made the problem worth pursuing? How did you choose the direction with your partners? What did you build yourself, what reached production, and how do you know it made a difference? If AI or agents played a part, tell us what you delegated, how you evaluated the output, and what you changed when the first approach fell short. A strong account of a failed experiment and the judgment it sharpened is welcome. You may have built that work in a product company, a small team, open source, or a path that does not fit a conventional résumé. The evidence matters more than a particular employer name or tool list. **Why Join?** *We’re redefining family technology.* In Tandem brings together a growing portfolio of trusted tools that support families, and the professionals who guide them, through the moments that matter most. We bring clarity to chaos and stability to daily family life, helping parents feel less stressed so kids can have healthier childhoods. *Scale meets startup energy.* With more than 20 years of impact and a strong market presence, we’re entering a bold new chapter of growth. We have the foundation, the momentum, and the ambition to go further: expanding our reach, deepening our impact, and elevating the tools families and professionals rely on every day. *Purpose\-driven. Performance\-focused. People\-first.* Our culture is rooted in accountability, curiosity, and collaboration. We value diverse perspectives, thoughtful problem\-solving, and teammates who care deeply about building something that matters. **How We Support You:*** Medical: In Tandem pays 100% of the premium for employees AND 99% for all additional family members * 401k: Up to a 4% match with immediate vesting * Paid leave for all new parents * Learning \& Development stipend for employees * Paid Time Off: 11 Holidays \+ Winter Break (3 Days) \+ Volunteer Time Off (1 Day) \+ Floating Holiday (1 Day) * Personal Time Off: 15 days for 0\-1 years of employment \+ 20 days for 1\-3 years of employment * Supportive and flexible working environment – work from anywhere! **Come As You Are**! In Tandem provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.### **About In Tandem** We believe technology can champion deeper connections within families, strengthen bonds, and improve communication. We're building solutions that foster connection, organization, and peace\-of\-mind throughout key stages and milestones of family life.

We succeed by helping each other succeed. * Energized and communicative. We value clear, open collaboration and trust. * Always evolving. jobs.title: Cloud Engineer
jobs.description: **Description:** AI Cloud Engineer \- RTH **Location:** Hybrid \| Experience: 3\-5 years \| Function: AI Engineering \& Cloud Platforms ABOUT THE ROLE We are seeking a GenAI Cloud Engineer to build and deploy enterprise\-scale agentic AI solutions that support complex business workflows, decision support, operational intelligence, customer engagement, and other signal\-to\-action use cases across the enterprise. This is a hands\-on engineering role responsible for designing, developing, and delivering production\-grade AI agents using AWS Bedrock, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, enterprise data products, semantic layers, and governed cloud\-native architectures. You will implement agent runtimes, orchestration patterns, memory, tool integration, observability, evaluation, and guardrail capabilities while partnering with architects, data teams, product owners, and Responsible AI stakeholders. The ideal candidate has recent experience building enterprise agents, agentic RAG, multi\-agent workflows, and secure integrations with business systems in regulated environments. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Develop cloud\-native microservices, APIs, and event\-driven components using Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, FastAPI, AWS Lambda, EventBridge, and related AWS services. Build and deploy enterprise AI agents using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Bedrock models, AgentCore runtime services, AgentCore Gateway, agent registry patterns, and agent\-to\-agent communication where appropriate. Implement data ingestion, semantic retrieval, embeddings, vector search, knowledge graph, and memory pipelines that allow agents to consume certified data products, Denodo/USBIE sources, Bedrock Knowledge Bases, and governed enterprise content. Develop intent classification, tool routing, workflow orchestration, guardrails, policy checks, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, and fail\-safe escalation patterns for agentic applications. Integrate agents with enterprise systems and workflows such as Salesforce/Elevate, Service Platform, CaseView, Genesys, MAC/MPI, USBIE, Denodo, APIs, MCP tools, and event streams. Build evaluation, monitoring, tracing, and operational controls for agents, including quality metrics, hallucination and safety checks, latency, cost, feedback loops, and incident response readiness. Uphold enterprise standards for application security, IAM/agent identity, data protection, auditability, Responsible AI, ADS/data\-product governance, observability, and production reliability. Stay current with AWS AgentCore, Bedrock, agent frameworks, model evaluation approaches, memory architectures, semantic data products, and enterprise agentic AI patterns. LEADERSHIP, MENTORING \& INFLUENCE (ONLY FOR SENIOR 5\-8 YEARS OF EXPERIENCE) **Lead a workstream:** Take technical ownership of a defined feature area or service \- from design through production support \- coordinating a small group of engineers where needed. **Mentor engineers:** Guide associate and mid\-level engineers through code review, pairing, and design feedback; help them build GenAI and cloud skills. **Contribute to architecture:** Participate actively in design reviews, propose solution options with clear trade\-offs, and help shape the patterns and standards the team adopts. **Influence through delivery:** Partner directly with product owners, architects, and business stakeholders to refine requirements and build credibility through working software. **Improve the team:** Identify and drive improvements in engineering practices, tooling, reusable components, and documentation; share knowledge through demos and internal write\-ups. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS 3\-5 years of software engineering experience, with hands\-on delivery of cloud\-native applications or AI/ML\-enabled platforms. Strong proficiency in Python and JavaScript/TypeScript, including API development, asynchronous processing, test automation, and production debugging. Experience developing microservices, APIs, event\-driven workflows, distributed applications, and secure integrations with enterprise systems. Hands\-on experience with AWS cloud services, including serverless, container, messaging/eventing, IAM, observability, and cloud\-native deployment patterns. Recent experience building enterprise GenAI or agentic AI solutions, including agents, agentic RAG, multi\-step orchestration, chat experiences, or signal\-to\-action workflows. Experience with Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, or comparable enterprise LLM and agent runtime platforms. Experience with LangGraph, LangChain, Strands, MCP, A2A protocols, tool\-use frameworks, or comparable multi\-agent orchestration patterns. Experience with model evaluation, prompt engineering, agent quality testing, feedback loops, LLM\-as\-judge patterns, and reliability measurement. Experience with data ingestion, vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, knowledge bases, memory stores, and retrieval patterns for structured and unstructured data. Experience implementing AI guardrails, safety controls, intent classification, routing logic, access controls, audit logging, evaluation, and human escalation paths. Strong understanding of software engineering best practices, application security, Responsible AI expectations, data governance, scalability, resilience, and production operations. Experience mentoring engineers, leading technical delivery of a defined workstream, and collaborating with architects, product owners, data teams, and platform teams. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Experience with event\-driven and serverless architectures using AWS EventBridge, MSK, SNS/SQS, Step Functions, Lambda, API Gateway, and container services. Experience delivering AI or data products in financial services, insurance, or other regulated environments with privacy, compliance, audit, and control requirements. Familiarity with enterprise data products, semantic layers, Denodo, USBIE, ADS certification, knowledge graphs, Neptune/OpenSearch, and governed data consumption patterns. Experience integrating agents with CRM, service, telephony, document, workflow, or engagement platforms such as Salesforce, Genesys, Service Platform, MAC/MPI, or similar systems. IDEAL CANDIDATE You are a strong software engineer with recent enterprise GenAI and agentic AI experience who enjoys turning ambiguous business use cases into reliable, governed, production\-ready agents. You understand that CNS agents must combine data products, signals, deterministic rules, LLM reasoning, memory, tool use, observability, and human controls. You can work across cloud architecture, data integration, AI orchestration, and production operations while raising the technical bar for the team. **LEVELING:** SENIOR VS. DEV Senior GenAI Cloud Engineer \- 5–8 years. Owns architecture and technical direction for enterprise agentic AI capabilities, sets standards for AgentCore, data, governance, observability, and multi\-agent patterns, leads complex multi\-team initiatives, mentors senior engineers, and influences cross\-team design decisions. GenAI Cloud Engineer \- 3\+ years. Hands\-on technical contributor. Leads implementation of specific agent workstreams, contributes to AgentCore architecture and delivery patterns, mentors associate and mid\-level engineers, and influences within the team through working software. **Rate:** $60\-65/hr \#LI\-PP1

Let us know if you have any career\-related questions. **KECH Job Application Process** -------------------------------- To be considered for a position with KECH, ***applicants must meet the following minimum requirements***: * **LOCATION**: Reside in one of the approved hiring locations (this can differ based on the job position you are applying for) * **JOB QUALIFICATION**: Meet the job’s basic qualifications, as outlined in the job description * **APPLICATION**: Submit an online Job Application * **ASSESSMENT TESTS**: Complete all pre\-hire Assessment Tests (if required by the position) * **INTERNET SPEED**: Run an Internet Speed Test to verify you have a stable internet connection * **TYPING PROFICIENCY**: Take an online typing test to verify your typing speed/accuracy * **RESUME**: Upload an up\-to\-date resume ### **Steps for Applying for a Position with KECH** **Step 1: Review Job Postings** Carefully review our open job postings (see list below), as some positions have ***state residency restrictions***. Ensure you are applying for a position for which you **meet all qualifications**. **Step 2: Complete the KECH Job Application** Submit a KECH Job Application for the desired position. See Job Postings section below to start your application. **Please use a DESKTOP PC to submit your application.** The Internet Speed Test and Typing test must be done on a DESKTOP PC and ***not a mobile device***. **Step 3: Take three Assessments Tests (if required)** Depending on the position, you may be required to complete three short assessment tests. **Step 4: Run an Internet Speed Test** You are required to test your internet connection (remote work may require a fast internet connection). **Do not use a mobile device for this test.** **Step 5: Take a Typing Proficiency Test** You are required to take an online Typng Test to check your typing speed and accuracy. **Do not use a mobile device for this test.** **Step 6: Upload Your Resume** You are required to upload an up\-to\-date resume (in PDF format). **If your application is incomplete (e.g., missing a resume, typing test, etc.) 48 hours after submission, it will be automatically archived and will no longer be eligible for consideration. This work requires close collaboration with the broader development team on planning, technical decisions, dependencies, code reviews, knowledge sharing, and integrated delivery. code analysis, implementation, testing, documentation, or code review, with effective human oversight. * Experience diagnosing production issues across application, database, and integration layers, with demonstrated technical ownership and the ability to deliver with limited supervision. * Strong collaboration, communication, and mentoring ability, including the ability to explain technical decisions to nontechnical stakeholders. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience leading a PHP\-to\-Node.js migration, legacy application modernization, or comparable platform transition. * Experience establishing unit, integration, end\-to\-end, and characterization tests for an existing application. * Experience with one or more of the following: Next.js, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, or reusable component\-based design systems. * Experience with one or more delivery and operations capabilities, such as GitHub Actions, containers, infrastructure as code, advanced observability, or detailed security\-scanning platforms. * Experience with authentication, authorization, multifactor authentication, multi\-tenant application design, or regulated business data. * Experience with Antigravity or another AI coding assistant, agentic development tool, or automated code review platform. * Experience administering or developing WordPress websites. * Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **Technology Environment** PHP, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Next.js, React, TypeScript, Prisma, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, GitHub, GitHub Actions or comparable CI/CD tooling, automated testing, security scanning, AI\-assisted development tools, and potentially WordPress. **What Success Looks Like** * The current application remains stable and supportable while undocumented dependencies and high\-risk technical issues are reduced. * Critical system knowledge is converted into clear architecture, deployment, operating, and support documentation. * Modernization work is delivered in controlled increments that preserve business behavior and data integrity. * Code review, automated testing, release discipline, and security practices become consistent parts of the engineering process. * The DevSecOps pipeline provides repeatable builds, automated quality and security checks, controlled deployments, traceability, and reliable rollback procedures. * AI\-assisted development improves delivery speed and documentation without weakening code ownership, review standards, data protection, or production controls. **How To Apply** Apply through this posting with a resume that describes your role in supporting a production application and leading or contributing to a significant modernization or platform migration. Please identify the technologies involved and the decisions for which you were personally responsible. **Pay Range: $125,000 \- $160,000 depending on experience** ### **Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled** KECH is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees feel welcome and respected. **State Restrictions** You must live in one of the following states to apply for this position: **NM, TX** ### **Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled** KECH is an Equal Opportunity Employer. jobs.title: Staff Solutions Engineer - AI Specialist
jobs.description: **Are you ready to unlock intelligence?** If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box \- we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others. **About the Role:** Are you ready to sit at the epicenter of the API and AI connectivity revolution? As a Staff Solutions Engineer at Kong, you won’t just be selling a platform — you’ll be a trusted technical advisor helping the world’s most innovative enterprises architect secure, scalable API ecosystems while navigating the transition into the agentic AI era. Kong sits at the intersection of API management and AI connectivity, and you’ll be the person who makes that story real for customers. **What you’ll be doing:** ------------------------- * Support field sales in helping customers understand the value of the Kong API and AI connectivity platform. * Conduct discovery conversations to understand customer requirements and map them to Kong solutions, from initial product reviews through to production. * Support POCs throughout the entire evaluation process, owning technical validation and stakeholder alignment. * Ensure customer satisfaction across your assigned set of accounts. * Collaborate with support, product, and engineering teams to advocate for customer needs. * Create technical documentation for DevOps, implementations, and services engagements. * Lead and support API Management and AI Goverance evaluations, including scoping API/AI use cases, LLM traffic management, and governance requirements. * Deliver demonstrations of Kong’s API \& AI governance and agentic connectivity capabilities, including Model Context Protocol (MCP) governance, semantic caching, prompt guardrails, and shadow AI detection. * Run API \& AI\-focused Technical Feasibility Workshops (TFWs) to validate Kong’s fit for modern and/or AI/agentic architectures. * Own the technical strategy for complex, multi\-stakeholder enterprise deals from qualification through close. * Mentor and coach junior SEs on technical skills, discovery methods, and deal strategy. * Drive thought leadership by authoring technical blogs, hosting webinars, speaking at industry events and conferences such as AWS re:Invent, Google Next, API \& AI summit, and regional events * Influence product direction by synthesizing customer feedback and market signals into actionable input for the product team. * And any additional tasks required by manager. **What you’ll bring:** ---------------------- * 7\+ years of software engineering and/or solutions engineering experience at a SaaS, open source, or enterprise software company. * Proven track record owning complex, enterprise\-level deals with multiple technical and executive stakeholders. * Experience mentoring or coaching other SEs or technical team members. * Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud\-native platforms. * Experience with REST and GraphQL APIs, CI/CD pipelines, and API security patterns (OAuth2, OIDC, mTLS). * Hands\-on experience with AI\-assisted development tooling — Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, OpenAI Codex, or equivalent is required. * Working knowledge of AI/LLM architectures, including model routing, rate limiting, semantic caching, and prompt governance. * Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agentic AI patterns. * Solid understanding of cloud computing trends and open source business models. * Strong listener and communicator — you can confidently lead discussions with engineers, architects, and executives. * Enthusiasm for working in a high\-profile, fast\-paced environment at the intersection of API and AI connectivity. **About Kong:** Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500 and AI\-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www.konghq.com. Compensation Range: $222K \- $250K

jobs.title: Senior Android Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Description:** We are seeking an experienced Android Full\-Stack Engineer to join our platform stability team. In this role, you will be responsible for diagnosing, debugging, and resolving complex Android stability issues spanning the entire Android stack both above (System Partition) and below (Vendor Partition) the Treble boundary. You will work deep within Android framework internals, reverse\-engineering issues from source code, providing technical direction for ambiguous problems, and ensuring overall platform robustness across Android version upgrades. This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who thrives on solving the hardest, least\-understanding problems in the Android ecosystem. **Key Responsibilities:** * Design and develop middleware and Android background services for platform\-level functionality * Debug and reverse\-engineer complex issues directly from Android Open\-Source Project (AOSP) source code Own overall Android platform stability and reliability * Resolve Android upgrade and integration issues across releases * Diagnose and fix bugs in system server components (Activity Manager, Window Manager, Package Manager, etc.), Car Service, and Surface Flinger * Investigate and resolve black screen, boot failure, and ANR (Application Not Responding) issues 6\. Resolve and provide technical direction and root\-cause analysis for unknown or hard\-to\-reproduce issues * Address and resolve compliance test failures across CTS, VTS, ATS, and STS **Primary Skills Required:** Kotlin, C\+\+ and Java **Experience Required:** * 3\+ years of hands\-on Android platform/framework development experience. * Proven experience in designing and developing middleware and Android background services (long\-running/foreground service) that expose feature\-rich interfaces (AIDL/Binder, APIs) to applications. * Demonstrated track record of resolving complex, low\-level Android stability issues. * Experience contributing to or modifying AOSP source code * Proven experience working across the full Android stack (framework, native services, vendor layers) **Additional Experience Preferred:** * Experience with Android Automotive OS (AAOS) and Car Service. * Familiarity with HAL (Hardware Abstraction Layer) and vendor integration. * Experience with CTS, VTS, ATS, and STS compliance frameworks. * Knowledge of Android graphics stack and display subsystems * Experience with native debugging tools (gdb, lldb, perfetto, systrace, logcat analysis). * Familiarity with Android build systems (Soong/Make) and partition architecture. * Experience working with SoC/silicon vendors on platform bring\-up **Additional Context for Suppliers:** * This role requires a deep\-dive, problem\-solving mindset and the ability to operate independently on ambiguous, high\-impact issues. * The ideal candidate is comfortable being the technical authority for the most challenging stability problems and can provide direction for other engineers. * Experience in the automotive or embedded Android domain is a strong plus given to our focus on system server, car service and platform stability.

jobs.description: Product Manager, Agentic AI Remote Product Remote Full\-time At Kinetic, a single, powerful mission unites us: Creating the best Workers’ Comp experience. Our culture is the engine that drives this mission forward—a culture built on togetherness, excellence, accountability, and a deep commitment to our customers. **About Kinetic** We’re transforming workers’ comp with technology\-driven solutions for injury prediction, prevention, and management—helping employers create safer, healthier workplaces. Our platform is built for labor intensive industries including parcel delivery, manufacturing, and wholesale/warehousing operations. Our tech\-driven program speeds up return\-to\-work and offers generative AI for claims management. Through these and other products and services, we're redefining what workers' comp can do. We’re a remote\-first team headquartered in New York City, growing fast—10x in the past two years—and driven by accountability, continuous improvement, and collaboration. If you're excited to build a career with impact, we’d love to meet you. Kinetic has been named to: Business Insurance's Best Place to Work in Insurance 2025 \& 2026\. #### **About the role** Kinetic Insurance is building AI agents across the insurance lifecycle. We are seeking a Product Manager to lead our Agentic AI efforts. This role makes sure every agent Kinetic ships is a component of one coherent platform rather than a one\-off automation. You'll decide what gets built as an agent, how it's evaluated, how much autonomy it earns, and how we prove it moved a real business metric. The role has two tracks. You'll own the agent platform outright: orchestration, tooling, observability, and guardrails. You'll co\-own agent solutions with our experience team PMs, who bring the customer problem while you bring the judgment on whether and how an agent should solve it. This role leans more technical than business, though it is not an engineering role. You'll write and test prompts, build evaluation sets, read traces, and prototype ideas. You won't ship production code, but you won't need an engineer to test whether an idea works. You'll report to the VP of Product and sit on the product management team, working alongside the PMs who lead our Broker, Policyholder, Underwriter, Claims, Data, and Business Systems teams. #### **What you'll do** **Agent platform and orchestration (owned outright)** * Own the roadmap for Kinetic's agent orchestration layer: models and routing, tools and memory, observability, and permissions and guardrails. * Run the agent registry. Every agent has exactly one owner, one documented purpose, one autonomy tier, and one place its behavior is logged. * Define how agents are deployed, versioned, and rolled back, with prompts, tool definitions, and model versions managed like code. * Track usage, cost, and latency per agent. Cost per orchestration matters more than cost per token, and you'll know both. * Lead the cleanup of the agents we already have: inventory every script and workflow touching AI, then retire, replatform, or sunset each one. * Keep business logic, specs, and evaluation data portable so a future framework or model change is an engineering project, not a rewrite. **Agent solutions with experience teams (co\-owned)** * Partner with PMs to define the problem or opportunity, and make the call on whether an agent is the right tool or simpler automation will do. * Translate use cases into agent specs: inputs, tools, autonomy boundary, human escalation path, success metric, and baseline. * Write, test, and iterate on system prompts, tool descriptions, and structured outputs side by side with agent and data engineers. * Tie every agent to one business metric before it scales, such as time\-to\-quote, bind rate, override rate, or hours saved. **Evaluation, governance, and quality** * Build golden datasets with our data team for every agent, and run them as a regression suite whenever a prompt, tool, or model changes. * Own the rollout gates from shadow mode to staged rollout to full production, with each go/no\-go decided by evaluation thresholds rather than a calendar date. * Write and maintain Kinetic's autonomy\-tier policy, including which decisions always keep a human checkpoint, such as a decline, a denial, a bind, or a price. * Produce the artifacts a regulator or acquirer will ask for as a byproduct of good practice: architecture map, evaluation history, audit trail, and before\-and\-after metrics. #### **What you've done** * 5\+ years in Product Management, Technical Product Management, or a similar role, including 1\+ years shipping LLM\-powered or agentic products into production, not just demos. * Hands\-on prompt engineering: system prompts, tool definitions, multi\-step chains, and structured outputs. * Built or ran evaluation for LLM systems, such as golden datasets, LLM\-as\-judge graders, and regression testing. * Working knowledge of agent frameworks and platforms such as CrewAI, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, or AWS Bedrock AgentCore, along with RAG, tool calling, and MCP. * Demonstrated ability to convert messy business needs into requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria. * Experience in startups or high\-growth environments. You're comfortable building from scratch. * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain probabilistic systems to business leaders. **Big plus if** * Prior experience at an insurtech, MGA, or carrier, or in another regulated industry such as financial services or healthcare. * Familiarity with workers' compensation, commercial lines underwriting, or claims workflows. * Experience with AI governance frameworks. * Experience with multi\-model routing, cost optimization, or human\-in\-the\-loop design for agents. **What we offer** * Fully distributed, remote team across all continental US time zones * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * 20 vacation days per year * 9 federal holidays off * Parental Leave * Pre\-tax 401k contribution * HSA with compatible health plans * FREE: Health Advocate * FREE: Telehealth Membership * FREE: OneMedical Account **Note** Candidates must reside within the US with existing authorization to work in the United States. This role requires domestic travel for company offsites and team alignment. Verification of government\-issued identity and employment eligibility will be conducted in person prior to employment. *Security Notice: Kinetic is committed to a secure hiring process. All offers of employment are contingent upon successful completion of a comprehensive identity and background verification process. We will never ask for financial information or payment during the application process.*
