jobs.title: Frontend / WebGL Graphics Engineer
jobs.description: About LVIS LVIS Corporation is on a mission to revolutionize the entire continuum of neurological care by enabling AI driven digital analytics to help physicians accelerate patient throughput by transforming signal analysis and visualization. The LVIS software, NeuroMatch®, utilizes brainwave signals from traditional EEG systems to enable AI driven algorithms to perform EEG source localization, spike and seizure event detection. We have an international team with our headquarters located in Palo Alto, California, USA and we have an office in Gangnam, Seoul, South Korea. We are looking for talented individuals to join us in transforming the neurology health care industry. About the Role NeuroMatch renders large volumes of EEG and neurological data through interactive 2D and 3D visualizations in the browser. This includes a custom, low level WebGL2 rendering engine for real time signal and waveform visualization, with GPU accelerated signal processing (GPGPU), plus a Three.js based 3D brain visualization layer, both built on top of our Vue frontend. We're looking for a senior WebGL / graphics engineer to take ownership of this visualization technology: extending the custom rendering engine, maintaining the 3D brain visualization layer, and solving the GPU performance and large dataset problems that come with continuously streamed clinical data. You'll work closely with frontend engineers, neuroscientists, and clinical specialists to translate scientific algorithms and reference implementations into fast, precise, production visualization Software. **Requirements** Own and extend our custom WebGL2 rendering engine used for real time EEG waveform and signal visualization. * Maintain and build out our Three.js based 3D brain visualization components (source localization, spike and seizure networks, and related views). * Design and implement GPU accelerated (GPGPU) signal processing techniques for in browser filtering and data preparation. * Optimize GPU and CPU performance, memory use, and rendering throughput for large, continuously streamed datasets. * Write and optimize GLSL shaders for custom rendering and data processing pipelines. * Integrate visualization components into our Vue based frontend application. * Collaborate with neuroscientists and clinical specialists to implement algorithms and reference implementations as production software. * Profile and resolve rendering performance issues, memory issues, visual artifacts, and browser/GPU compatibility problems. * Contribute to frontend architecture, code quality, and technical design reviews. Basic Qualifications * 5\+ years of professional software development experience, with substantial hands on WebGL 2\.0 / GLSL development (not just framework usage). * Strong JavaScript (ES6\) / TypeScript skills. * Direct experience writing and debugging GLSL shaders, and working with GPU buffers, textures, and render pipelines. * Experience building and maintaining complex, interactive, browser based applications handling large or streaming datasets. * BS or higher degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Three.js and Vue.js. * Hands on experience with digital signal processing, such as digital filter design or noise reduction. * Familiarity with GPGPU techniques using WebGL, and with floating point standards such as IEEE 754\. * Familiarity with OpenGL, Vulkan, Direct3D, Metal, SPIR\-V, HLSL, OpenCL, or CUDA. * Experience with WebAssembly, Web Workers, SharedArrayBuffer, or SIMD based browser performance techniques. * Experience with large scale data visualization (medical, scientific, geospatial, or financial). * Experience with Emscripten or C/C\+\+ to WebAssembly workflows. * Experience with automated testing, CI/CD, and git based code review practices. * Experience with EEG, neuroscience, or medical software is helpful but not required; our science and clinical teams provide the domain knowledge needed. **Preferred Qualifications** * Rendering large EEG waveform datasets smoothly and in real time in the browser. * Visualizing neurological activity on interactive 3D brain models. * Building GPU accelerated signal processing and visualization pipelines. * Improving rendering performance and reducing memory use for long duration EEG recordings. * Building visualization tools that let physicians and researchers explore complex neurological data interactively. **Other Information** * Job type: Full\-time, On\-Site * Location : Palo Alto, CA **Benefits** * Benefits: Comprehensive Health, Dental, and Vision coverage. **Compensation** * Base Salary: $135,000 to $175,000 annually * Actual compensation may vary based on experience, skills, qualifications, and location.

Building on our cybersecurity and data analytics scholarship initiative, we are launching the **Emerging Technologies \& AI Career Readiness Program**, a 12\-week, hands\-on training experience designed to equip students with marketable technical skills. **Our mission is simple: Give back to the community by passing valuable, often expensive technical knowledge to talented individuals who might otherwise never have the opportunity to access it.** Position Overview We are seeking an experienced and passionate technical instructor with strong industry expertise in Python, data analytics, modern cloud data platforms, and artificial intelligence application development. The ideal candidate is more than a technical expert. We are looking for someone who **genuinely enjoys teaching, mentoring, and sharing knowledge**, particularly with individuals facing financial or educational barriers. Our students will include veterans, military reservists, high school students, career changers, recent graduates, and professionals from diverse academic backgrounds. Many will receive scholarships. The instructor will help students progress from foundational technical knowledge to practical, job\-oriented competencies through live demonstrations, industry\-relevant examples, and project\-based instruction. The objective is not simply to teach technologies, but to prepare students to demonstrate their skills to potential employers. Required Technical Expertise **1\. Python Programming – Intermediate to Advanced** * Strong practical experience with Python, including data structures, functions, modules, object\-oriented programming, APIs, exception handling, and debugging. * Proficiency with Pandas, NumPy, data manipulation, automation, and practical application development. * Ability to teach coding concepts to learners without computer science degrees. **2\. Excel, Data Analytics \& SQL** * Advanced Excel capabilities, including PivotTables, XLOOKUP, data cleaning, reporting, and analytical models. * Working knowledge of SQL, relational databases, querying, and data transformation. * Ability to connect Excel, Python, and SQL to real business problems. **3\. Cloud Data Platforms \& Data Engineering** * Practical knowledge of Databricks, Snowflake, or comparable modern data platforms. * Understanding of data warehouses, data lakes, lakehouse architecture, ETL/ELT processes, and data pipelines. * Ability to design realistic exercises using accessible training environments and sample datasets. **4\. Artificial Intelligence \& AI Application Development** * Strong understanding of machine learning fundamentals, generative AI, and large language models. * Hands\-on experience integrating AI APIs into Python applications. * Familiarity with prompt engineering, embeddings, vector databases, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), and AI agents. * Ability to demonstrate practical AI applications, basic deployment, testing, and responsible AI practices. **5\. Software Development \& Project Delivery** * Experience with Git/GitHub, application documentation, testing, and debugging. * Familiarity with Streamlit, FastAPI, or similar technologies for building practical applications. * Ability to guide students through developing a functional, portfolio\-ready capstone project. Key Responsibilities * Collaborate with LES to finalize a structured 12\-week curriculum aligned with entry\-level industry requirements. * Deliver **live instruction and technical demonstrations every Saturday for the first 11 weeks**. * Develop or review weekly instructional slides, practical examples, labs, assignments, and supporting learning resources. * Coordinate with LES teaching assistants, who will facilitate an additional two hours of supervised hands\-on laboratory work each Saturday. * Use relatable business examples and real\-world applications to explain complex technical concepts. * Design a cumulative capstone project integrating data processing, Python, cloud data concepts, and AI application development. * Support capstone evaluation, technical demonstrations, and project\-quality standards. * Align relevant course content with industry certification objectives and entry\-level technical interviews. * Provide constructive feedback to help LES continuously improve the learning experience. Qualifications * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline preferred, **demonstrated industry experience.** * Ideally five or more years of relevant professional technical experience. * Previous teaching, corporate training, university instruction, technical mentoring, or bootcamp experience strongly preferred. * Demonstrated ability to build real\-world applications using Python and modern data technologies. * Excellent communication and instructional skills. * Relevant cloud, data engineering, Python, or AI certifications are desirable but not mandatory. The Personal Qualities We Value Most We are particularly interested in instructors who: * Believe that education can transform lives and create economic opportunities. * Are motivated to give back to society by sharing their knowledge and professional experience. * Find personal satisfaction in helping students succeed, particularly those who cannot afford expensive technical programs. * Are patient, approachable, encouraging, and capable of inspiring beginners. * Understand that technical skills must translate into practical workplace performance. * Are committed to quality, continuous learning, mentorship, and student success. **We are not looking for someone who simply delivers lectures. We want an instructor who sees teaching as an opportunity to make a meaningful difference in people's lives.** Job Types: Part\-time, Contract Pay: $80\.00 \- $100\.00 per hour Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Founding Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** ----------------------- AI agents are becoming how software gets chosen. Developers ask Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and ChatGPT which tool to use, and more and more they let the agent pick and integrate it. If an agent doesn't recommend you, or loops trying to figure out how to use your product, it moves on to something else. Lightsage gets companies ready for the agent economy: visible to agents, so they get recommended, and usable by agents, so integrations work the first time. We track how often coding agents and AI answer engines recommend a company against its competitors, run real coding agents against its APIs, CLIs and MCP servers to find where they fail, and tell the team exactly what to change. We work with category leaders in AI and developer tools, including Firecrawl, Reducto, Scalekit, TinyFish, Daytona, Rime and Meetstream, and we run DevToolArena.com, a public benchmark that ranks developer tools by how well coding agents use them. We've raised a $4M seed led by Nexus Venture Partners, and we're backed by growth leaders and founders of Postman, Apollo, Firecrawl, Resend, Daytona, TinyFish and others. Our goal is to be the default for any company that wants to win with agents. **Role Description** -------------------- This is one of the first engineering roles at Lightsage. You'll join the founding team in San Francisco. You'll own systems end to end across frontend, backend, infrastructure and data, and work directly with customers to turn their problems into shipped features. Early projects include: * Improving recommendation quality, and measuring whether a recommended change actually helps a customer * Designing the experiments and benchmarks that tell us which changes actually make agents recommend and use a product * Building agents that write, publish and re\-test documentation changes for customers * Adding support for new coding agents and models as they're released * Scaling eval and data pipelines for enterprise customers New models ship every few weeks, so the work changes constantly. The team builds with AI coding tools and our own agent orchestrator, and reviews all code before it ships. **Requirements** ---------------- * Track record of taking a loosely defined customer or product problem to a shipped solution with little direction * Strong backend experience, including building reliable systems that handle production load * Hands\-on experience shipping quickly with AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Codex * Clear thinking about technical trade\-offs, and clear written communication * Experience doing research or running rigorous experiments, such as LLM evals, benchmarks or A/B tests, and drawing sound conclusions from noisy results is a plus * Experience with Next.js, FastAPI, Supabase or Microsoft Azure is a plus * Prior founder or early\-stage startup experience is a plus This is a full\-time, on\-site role in San Francisco. It's a demanding schedule that regularly includes weekends, with significant ownership over the company's technical direction. Compensation Range: $120K \- $200K

jobs.title: AI Residency Program, Physical Sciences
jobs.description: **Your Impact at LILA** The Lila Sciences AI Residency is a full\-time research program at the intersection of artificial intelligence and materials science. Residents join a cohort of researchers tackling open\-ended scientific challenges alongside Lila's scientists and engineers, with the option to focus on fundamental or applied research. Residencies run 6 to 12 months, with extension possible. First residencies begin in spring 2027, with rolling applications and additional intakes in fall 2027\. Residents are paired with technical mentors, receive feedback from cross\-functional teams, and work with proprietary datasets, high\-performance compute, and Lila's research infrastructure. Publishing is encouraged but not required. What matters most is pushing the frontier of scientific discovery. Priority research areas for the 2027 cohort span four domains: * **Soft matter and formulation intelligence:** composition\-process\-property modeling, representation learning for mixtures and formulations, physics\-informed and simulation\-augmented predictive models, and generative models for 3D soft\-material structures at the mesoscale and microscale (colloidal assemblies, phase\-separated domains, particle networks, film and bulk morphologies) * **Physics\-based simulation and in silico discovery:** agentic frameworks for physics\-based and multiphysics or multiscale simulations, and methods that orchestrate and bridge across simulation scales * **Chemistry\-aware AI and molecular design:** molecular representations (graphs, protein\-ligand structures, MD trajectories), chemistry\-reasoning agents, predictive models for synthesis, analysis, and purification, and experimental decision\-making under uncertainty and operational constraints * **Foundational AI for materials science:** sequential decision\-making under real\-world constraints, multimodal learning, reasoning and benchmarking, generative models and representation learning, and scientific machine learning Applications require a resume and a research proposal of up to three pages (unlimited references) outlining the project you would pursue during your residency. Submit the research proposal as your cover letter. Applications without both documents will not be considered. Optional supporting materials such as recommendation letters, publications, or research artifacts are welcome. **What You'll Be Building** * Design and execute independent research projects in AI for materials science * Pursue work in one or more of the 2027 priority research areas * Collaborate with Lila scientists and engineers on open\-science initiatives * Co\-develop novel approaches to scientific discovery with the wider team * Use Lila's datasets, compute, and infrastructure to test ambitious hypotheses * Share findings internally and externally; publication is welcome, not mandatory **What You'll Need to Succeed** * Degree in materials science, chemistry, computer science, AI/ML, physics, mathematics, or a related field (Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD) * Proficiency in Python and deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch * Experience working with large\-scale datasets or simulations * Familiarity with modern AI/ML architectures and training techniques * Strong research background shown through publications, thesis work, or open\-source projects **Bonus Points For** * Prior ML work in scientific domains such as materials discovery, chemistry, or simulation * Experience in one or more of the 2027 priority research areas * Open\-source contributions or collaborative research experience * Clear writing and communication on complex scientific ideas **About LILA** Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard\-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves. LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai. Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply. **We're All In** Lila Sciences is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. Information you provide during your application process will be handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy. **A Note to Agencies** *Lila Sciences does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than candidates. The submission of unsolicited resumes by recruitment or staffing agencies to Lila Sciences or its employees is strictly prohibited unless contacted directly by Lila Science's internal Talent Acquisition team. Any resume submitted by an agency in the absence of a signed agreement will automatically become the property of Lila Sciences, and Lila Sciences will not owe any referral or other fees with respect thereto.*

jobs.title: Staff/Principal Engineer, Search & Retrieval
jobs.description: **Your Impact at LILA** Lila Sciences is building the infrastructure for autonomous science: AI systems that design experiments, run them in physical labs, and close the loop across life sciences, chemistry, and materials science. Our platform enables this to operate reliably at scale for external customers who require security, auditability, and operational rigor. We're hiring a **Staff/Principal Engineer, Search \& Retrieval (Enterprise AI)** to own how scientists and agents ask questions of scientific knowledge at Lila: published literature and patents, customer\-supplied documents, lab protocols, and the structured experimental record. Your work will involve building **RAG over unstructured text** and a **scientific knowledge graph** that links literature to the structured experimental record. Enterprise customers require one retrieval platform that any scientific workload can build on, with tenancy enforced in the index and the graph rather than the application layer. You will own that stack end to end, from ingestion to retrieval to cited answers a scientist can trace back to the evidence. This is a deeply technical senior individual contributor role. We move fast, ship often, and look for engineers who do well with ambiguity and enjoy shaping the problem as much as solving it. **What You'll Be Building** * **Technical leadership** across platform engineering, infrastructure, AI/ML, and scientific teams. Broad architectural influence, high autonomy, direct ownership of critical platform systems. * **Define the shared retrieval foundation.** Your architecture decisions become the default for scientific workloads across the company, well beyond the first one you ship. * **Knowledge graph and graph retrieval.** Build one scientific knowledge graph from literature and the structured experimental record. Own graph retrieval and its fusion with vector and lexical search into a single cited answer. * **Agentic search.** Build the autonomous research loop, from query planning through retrieval to traceable reasoning. * **Retrieval quality.** Own the retrieval pipeline end to end and the evaluation harness. * **Ingestion and extraction.** Own the pipeline that turns the many types of scientific data (PDFs, patents, lab protocols, and more) into semantically searchable evidence. **What You'll Need to Succeed** * 8\+ years of software development experience, including production ownership of a search, retrieval, RAG, or knowledge graph system that real users depended on. * Production experience building semantic search: embedding models, vector indexes (HNSW/IVF), hybrid lexical and vector retrieval, and reranking. Graph database experience is a strong plus. * Track record in high\-growth environments where speed\-to\-value mattered as much as long\-term architecture. * You can describe how you measured retrieval quality (recall, groundedness, citation accuracy) and how you caught regressions. * Hands\-on coding in Python and modern backend frameworks (FastAPI, async Python). * Modern cloud\-native architectures (Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS). * Strong cross\-functional communication and the ability to influence architecture across teams. * BS, MS, or Ph.D. in Computer Science or a related field of study, or equivalent experience. **Bonus Points For** * Shipped RAG or semantic search in a regulated or enterprise context, through security and compliance review under regimes such as SOC 2, HIPAA, GxP (including ALCOA\+ data integrity), or FedRAMP. * Permission\-aware retrieval over access\-controlled data. * Document understanding at scale: OCR, layout\-aware parsing, table and figure extraction from scientific literature. * Agentic retrieval and GraphRAG patterns, and how to evaluate them. * Platforms serving scientific or laboratory data such as LIMS, ELN, bioinformatics, or materials informatics, with an understanding of provenance and traceability requirements. * Domain\-specific corpora and scientific ontologies (UMLS, MeSH, ChEBI, GO, UniProt, Materials Project) where specialized vocabulary limits general\-purpose embeddings and entity linking. * Knowledge graph construction and graph retrieval: property graph or RDF stores. **About LILA** Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. jobs.title: Data Systems and DevOps Engineer/Scientist
jobs.description: **Come Work With Us** *Be Exceptional. Deliver Excellence. Make A Difference.* LimnoTech is a leading environmental engineering and science firm with clients who face water\-related problems that are more challenging and costly than ever before. It is our job to help our clients make decisions based on the best available science and real\-world constraints. At LimnoTech, our values are to: honor the science, lead through innovation, act through partnership, commit to the long\-term, and pursue big, bold actions. Are you ready to join a team of smart, talented people who are motivated every day to deliver excellence and make a difference for our clients, our partners, and the environment? The position will primarily focus on data systems operations and DevOps for our environmental data platforms for LimnoTech’s subsidiary, Freeboard Technology. In addition, the position will support LimnoTech's day\-to\-day technology/IT operations as an IT Coordinator, working under the direction of the Senior Technology Officer and alongside our managed IT services provider. This position is an in\-person role at our Ann Arbor, MI headquarters. jobs.description: **Location:** Remote (home\-based) — occasional in\-person meetings in the Los Angeles area **Employment Type:** Full\-Time, Benefitted **About LANES** LANES is a community\-based Health Information Organization (HIO) whose mission is to transform healthcare delivery across Los Angeles County by enabling secure, cost\-effective electronic exchange of patient medical records among public and private providers and health plans. We make personal health information available when and where it's needed for patient care — safely and securely. **About the Role** We're a team of healthcare IT experts solving real\-world interoperability problems, and we're looking for a driven, detail\-oriented Front\-End UI Developer to help build the interfaces our provider and health plan partners rely on every day. You'll design and build responsive, accessible, and secure user interfaces using Angular and TypeScript, working closely with our Business Analysts to translate requirements into intuitive experiences and with our architects, DevOps, and Security Engineers to ensure everything you ship meets our standards for performance, privacy, and HIPAA compliance. This is a front\-end focused role — we have dedicated DevOps and Security teams — so your energy stays where it matters most: crafting clean, reliable, well\-tested UI that makes sensitive health data easy and safe to work with. **What You'll Do** **UI/UX Development** * Design, build, and maintain responsive, accessible front\-end applications using Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS * Build and style interfaces using Bootstrap with the Falcon theme, maintaining a consistent, polished look and feel across the application * Implement reactive, data\-driven UI patterns using RxJS * Build rich data views and inputs using component libraries such as ngx\-datatable, ng\-select, and Chart.js * Translate wireframes, mockups, and business requirements into polished, production\-ready interfaces * Build reusable Angular components and maintain consistent design patterns across the application **Data Integration** * Integrate front\-end applications with backend services and REST APIs (built on Node.js/Express.js) that source data from PostgreSQL and Google BigQuery * Work with JSON and JSONata\-based data transformations when consuming and shaping API responses for the UI * Collaborate with backend and integration engineers to define clean, efficient data contracts between front\-end and API layers * Apply working knowledge of HL7 FHIR R4 resources and structures where they surface in the UI **Security \& Compliance** * Build UI features with privacy and security by design, ensuring proper handling of Protected Health Information (PHI) at every layer of the interface * Work within our SAML 2\.0 SSO authentication flow (built on node\-saml/passport\-saml) and session\-based authentication model * Support and extend our custom role\-based access control (RBAC) in the UI, ensuring users see only what their role permits * Partner with our Security Engineers on authentication, authorization, and session management best practices * Follow HIPAA requirements and internal security standards in all front\-end data handling, display, and storage decisions **Cross\-Functional Collaboration** * Work closely with Business Analysts to clarify requirements, refine user stories, and validate delivered features against business needs * Coordinate with DevOps Engineers on build pipelines, environment configuration, and deployment of front\-end applications * Partner with Solution Architects and backend/integration engineers to ensure front\-end designs align with overall system architecture **Testing \& Quality** * Write unit and integration tests to ensure UI reliability and catch regressions early * Conduct cross\-browser and cross\-device testing to ensure consistent experiences for all users * Participate in code reviews and contribute to front\-end coding standards and best practices **Documentation \& Agile Practice** * Document component libraries, UI patterns, and front\-end architecture decisions using tools like JIRA, Confluence, and SharePoint * Participate actively in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, standups, and retrospectives **What You Bring** * **3\+ years** of professional front\-end development experience, ideally within healthcare, insurance, or another regulated industry * Strong proficiency with **Angular** (v13\+), **TypeScript**, **JavaScript**, **HTML5**, and **CSS** * Experience with **Bootstrap** and theming/styling frameworks (experience with the **Falcon** theme is a plus) * Working knowledge of **RxJS** and reactive/observable\-based UI patterns * Familiarity with UI component libraries such as **ngx\-datatable**, **ng\-select**, and **Chart.js** * Comfort consuming **REST APIs** and working with **JSON**, ideally with exposure to data transformation tools like **JSONata** * Familiarity with **PostgreSQL** and/or **Google BigQuery**\-backed data, and general SQL literacy * Working knowledge of web application security best practices, with an understanding of **HIPAA** and handling sensitive/PHI data in a UI context * Exposure to **SAML 2\.0 SSO**, session\-based authentication, or role\-based access control (RBAC) patterns is a strong plus * Experience with responsive design and building accessible (WCAG\-compliant) interfaces * Proven ability to collaborate effectively with Business Analysts, architects, and engineers across security, DevOps, and backend disciplines * Strong communication skills — comfortable explaining technical trade\-offs to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders * Comfort with **npm** and the **Angular CLI** in a day\-to\-day development workflow **Nice to Have** * Experience with **HL7 FHIR** (R4\) and its representation in front\-end applications * Familiarity with **Node.js/Express.js** APIs, even if primarily consuming rather than building them * Familiarity with state management libraries (e.g., NgRx) and modern Angular build tooling * Experience with design/prototyping tools (e.g., Figma) and design systems * Familiarity with Agile frameworks and tools like JIRA, Confluence, and SharePoint * Comfort working independently in a fast\-paced, performance\-driven environment **Requirements** * Successful completion of background check and reference verification *LANES is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.* Pay: $110,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year Work Location: Hybrid remote in Los Angeles, CA 90064

jobs.title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer
jobs.description: Lunon is an AI\-native consulting firm in New York City, backed by General Catalyst. Most companies don't need another deck about AI. They need an engineer who can walk in, understand the operation, and ship. That's what we do: we embed engineers inside the business and stay until the software runs without us. Our open\-source research system ranks first on DeepResearch Bench. The team is young and moves fast. Everyone here has a wide skill set, works with the newest tools as they land, and owns what they ship end to end. Nobody hands you a ticket. You own the model side of an engagement: choose the right model, adapt it to the client's data, prove it works, and make it fast and cheap enough to run every day. You work beside a Forward Deployed Data Engineer who owns the data. First up: helping an ERP company make its product AI\-native. * Fully remote, US\-based. Lunon is headquartered in New York City. **What you'll do** * Pick the right model for each job, from frontier APIs to open\-weight models, and know when fine\-tuning beats a better prompt. * Fine\-tune when it pays off: supervised fine\-tuning, preference optimization, and parameter\-efficient methods like LoRA. * Build the evaluation harnesses and benchmarks that tell us whether a change made things better. * Take models from training to serving, and tune inference cost, latency, and quality. * Sit with the client's team, find where AI moves their numbers, and say no to work that won't pay back. **What you'll need** Experience matters here. We judge it by what you've shipped and kept running, not by a number of years. * You've fine\-tuned or post\-trained a model and can explain what worked and what didn't. * You've built evals that changed a decision. * You've shipped LLM features that real users depend on. * You've served a model in production and cared about its cost and latency. * You use AI coding tools every day and judge the result by the system and its output, not the language. **Nice to have** Apply even if none of these are true. * You've built on or integrated with an ERP, CRM, or accounting system. * You've shipped extraction or search over messy business documents. * You've done consulting, agency, or forward\-deployed work and know how to be useful in someone else's building on day two. **How we hire** * A 30\-minute conversation with the team about what you've shipped and what we're building. * A technical deep\-dive on one system you owned, from the business problem to production. * A working session on a real client problem with the team. * References, then an offer. We aim to finish in two weeks. **Beware of recruitment fraud.** All official correspondence comes from a lunon.ai email address. We will never ask you to share bank account information, cash a check, or purchase equipment as part of the hiring process. Compensation Range: $160K \- $195K

jobs.title: Director, AI Manufacturing Enablement
jobs.description: Meta's Manufacturing Engineering \& Operations (MEO) organization is responsible for bringing Reality Labs' most ambitious hardware products to life at scale. Across our functions — Manufacturing Operations, DFx, Manufacturing Test Engineering, and Quality — hundreds of workflows involve data analysis, decision\-making, documentation, and cross\-functional coordination that are ripe for AI\-driven transformation.We are seeking a Director, AI Manufacturing Enablement to lead a dedicated team that systematically identifies, prioritizes, and deploys AI and automation solutions across the MEO organization and its adjacent partners. This leader will operate at the intersection of manufacturing domain expertise and applied AI, delivering measurable productivity gains, quality improvements, and workflow automation across real production environments.This is a founding leadership role reporting to the Director of MEO. You will build the team, define the AI strategy for manufacturing, and serve as the connective tissue between Meta's broad AI capabilities and the practical realities of hardware manufacturing. ### **Director, AI Manufacturing Enablement Responsibilities:** * Conduct systematic workflow audits across all MEO functions to identify high\-value AI/automation opportunities — categorized by efficiency gain, quality improvement, or full automation potential * Develop and maintain an AI opportunity roadmap prioritized by impact, feasibility, and strategic alignment * Scout adjacent organizations (SW Engineering, Data Science, XRT, Production Engineering) for existing tools, models, and frameworks that can be adapted for manufacturing use cases * Stay current on Meta's internal AI platform capabilities (LLMs, computer vision, anomaly detection, generative AI) and translate them into manufacturing applications * Build and ship AI\-powered tools for MEO workflows including automated defect classification, AI\-assisted DFx review, predictive yield modeling, intelligent test sequencing, natural language interfaces for manufacturing data queries, and automated reporting and documentation * Define success metrics for each deployment (time saved, error reduction, decision quality improvement) and own the end\-to\-end lifecycle from problem definition through production deployment and iteration * Build partnerships with Meta's AI/ML infrastructure teams to leverage internal platforms and partner with Manufacturing Test Engineering on AI\-enabled test optimization * Collaborate with contract manufacturers on AI readiness, data infrastructure, and tool deployment at factory sites * Recruit, hire, and develop a team of applied AI/ML engineers and manufacturing\-domain technologists * Build a team culture that values rapid prototyping, user\-centric design, and measurable impact * Establish frameworks for evaluating build\-vs\-buy\-vs\-adapt decisions for AI tools ### **Minimum Qualifications:** * 12\+ years of experience across manufacturing/operations and applied AI/ML/automation, with demonstrated depth in at least one and working fluency in the other, including at least 5 years in a leadership role * Experience deploying AI/ML solutions in production environments, or diverse leadership experience leading complex operations through changes involving the introduction of technology to improve productivity and quality of decision making * Understanding of manufacturing workflows — assembly, test, quality, supply chain — and where AI adds genuine value * Experience building and leading technical teams that ship products/tools iteratively * Experience operating in ambiguity — defining the problem space, not just solving well\-scoped problems * Experience in process transformation and organizational change management — driving adoption of new tools and ways of working across engineering teams * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience demonstrated through a track record of leading process transformation, automation, or applied technology deployment in a manufacturing or operations environment ### **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience with manufacturing data systems (MES, SPC, historian databases) and the data quality challenges they present * Experience in consumer electronics or precision hardware manufacturing environments * Familiarity with large\-scale AI/ML platforms or similar large\-scale AI platforms * Hands\-on familiarity with LLMs, computer vision, time\-series anomaly detection, or reinforcement learning in industrial settings * Track record of building new functions or teams from zero — particularly 'AI for X' teams embedded in non\-AI organizations ### **About Meta:** Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics. Meta is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Meta participates in the E\-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law. Please note that Meta may leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies in connection with applications for employment. Meta is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations\-ext@meta.com. $245,000/year to $309,000/year \+ bonus \+ equity \+ benefits Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. jobs.title: Senior Application & AI Security Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description:** We’re KSM, one of the top 50 largest independent advisory, tax, and audit firms in the United States. But more than our size, it’s our people and culture that set us apart. We believe great things happen when people are supported, challenged, and given the freedom to do their very best work. That’s why we’ve built a workplace where your career and personal life can thrive together – where you have the flexibility to manage your time, the resources to grow, and a team that genuinely cares about your success. We’ve been employee\-owned since 2001, giving every team member a stake in our collective success. This ownership mentality fosters a culture of collaboration, curiosity, and excellence – where new ideas are welcomed, different perspectives are valued, and you’re encouraged to explore what excites you most. Whether you’re expanding your skills, tackling new challenges, or making an impact beyond the office, we provide the resources and support to help you grow in the direction that’s right for you. At KSM, your contributions matter – not just to the firm, but to your colleagues, clients, and the communities we serve across the U.S. If you’re looking for a place where you can do meaningful work, build lasting relationships, and grow in ways that align with what’s most important to you, we’d love to meet you. **Position Summary** ==================== The Senior Application \& AI Security Engineer is a hands\-on individual contributor responsible for improving the security of KSM’s internally developed applications, APIs, AI\-enabled solutions, and supporting integrations. This role partners directly with software developers, architects, and engineering teams to identify vulnerabilities, strengthen application designs, and implement and validate practical fixes. The engineer integrates security into application and AI development workflows, with particular attention to authentication, authorization, sensitive client data, and risks associated with large language models (LLMs), AI agents, and connected tools. Application and API security remain the primary focus of this position. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== * Assess internally developed applications and APIs for vulnerabilities involving authentication, authorization, access control, and sensitive data exposure. * Perform hands\-on application security testing, source code reviews, and architecture assessments; prioritize findings by exploitability and business impact. * Partner with developers to design and implement fixes, then independently validate that identified vulnerabilities are resolved. * Evaluate legacy applications, integrations, and application\-to\-application communications for security weaknesses. * Improve API protections, including service authentication, object\-level authorization, secrets management, rate limiting, and abuse prevention. * Integrate practical security requirements and testing into the software development lifecycle and CI/CD pipelines. * Implement and maintain appropriate SAST, DAST, software composition analysis, and secrets\-scanning capabilities. * Establish secure coding guidance and reusable patterns for traditional and AI\-assisted development; review significant changes before production release. * Review application and AI architectures across AWS, Azure, and development environments, including client\-data isolation and access to sensitive information. * Work with Security and Development to strengthen application, API, and AI integration logging, monitoring, and detection of unauthorized activity. * Assess AI\-enabled applications, LLM integrations, and agent workflows for prompt injection, sensitive data disclosure, insecure tool execution, and excessive permissions. * Review how AI systems access, process, and transmit client information; evaluate controls for AWS Bedrock and other approved AI services. * Develop practical security testing for AI features, including adversarial tests of LLM integrations and agent tool calls. * Support investigations involving application or AI integration compromise and drive corrective actions to prevent recurrence. Track application security findings through remediation and communicate material risks, priorities, and progress to leadership. * **Qualifications \& Experience** ================================ **Required** ------------ * 6\+ years of hands\-on experience in software development, application security engineering, or closely related technical roles. * Strong knowledge of web application and API security, including authentication, authorization, session management, and access control. * Demonstrated experience identifying, remediating, and validating vulnerabilities in production applications. * Ability to read, understand, and review application source code and collaborate directly with software developers. * Practical experience with application security assessments, manual testing, and code reviews. * Familiarity with OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10, and OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications. * Understanding of LLM application architectures, AI agent permissions, prompt injection, and the security implications of AI tool integrations. * Experience securing REST APIs, service\-to\-service authentication, and application credentials. * Experience incorporating security testing into CI/CD pipelines and software development workflows. * Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and explain technical risks and remediation to developers and business stakeholders. **Preferred** ============= * Professional software development experience in languages and frameworks used by KSM’s development teams. * Experience securing applications and APIs hosted in AWS or Azure. * Experience with SAST, DAST, software composition analysis, and secrets\-scanning tools. * Experience with application penetration testing, threat modeling, or secure architecture reviews. * Experience protecting sensitive financial, personal, or confidential client information in multi\-tenant applications. * Familiarity with OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, and modern identity integration patterns. * Experience improving application/API logging, monitoring, and detection capabilities, including AI integrations. * Hands\-on experience securing production AI applications or integrations, including AWS Bedrock or comparable platforms. * Experience with AI security testing, adversarial evaluation, or assessing prompt injection and agent tool access. Relevant credentials such as OSWE, CSSLP, or GWAPT, or equivalent demonstrated expertise. * *We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, genetic information, national origin, race, religion, veteran status, or any other protected category.* *KSM only accepts resumes directly submitted by a candidate and referrals submitted by current KSM employees. Unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles sent by staffing agencies and fee\-based referral services will not be considered outside of a signed KSM vendor contract. KSM will not pay a fee to recruiters or agencies that do not have a signed KSM vendor contract.*

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: Momentic is building the definitive verification layer for software: an AI\-native testing platform that helps engineering teams catch bugs before they ship. As AI accelerates software development, teams need a reliable way to verify that their products work. Engineering teams at Notion, Webflow, Xero, and Whatnot use Momentic to ship with confidence. You’ll join our engineering team and work closely with our CTO to improve the models and agents behind Momentic. We’re looking for a hands\-on AI engineer who can fine\-tune models, build evaluations, and turn production data into more reliable, efficient agents. Momentic executes more than 1 million tests daily and processes more than 1 billion tokens per hour at peak, giving your improvements a direct impact on the product. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * Fine\-tune models for long\-running agents, including agents that investigate whether test failures come from infrastructure, recent code changes, or test authorship. * Build and curate training and evaluation datasets from production workflows, using failure patterns to identify opportunities for improvement. * Develop LLM evaluations and observability that connect offline results with production behavior and help the team verify improvements. * Tune prompts, context, and model behavior to improve task success, reliability, latency, token usage, and cost. * Design repeatable experiments and help publish benchmarks that demonstrate our core agents’ performance on testing and browser workflows. * Own technical projects from problem definition through delivery, working with the engineering team to make practical tradeoffs and ship improvements. **You’re perfect for this role if…** ------------------------------------ * You have relevant software engineering experience, typically 3\+ years, including hands\-on contributions to AI\-powered capabilities used in production. * You have hands\-on experience with supervised fine\-tuning, including preparing training data and evaluating model behavior. * You’ve worked with prompt and context tuning, evaluation datasets, and LLM observability to diagnose failures and measure improvements. * You have strong engineering fundamentals, code efficiently, and know what you’re great at and where you have room to grow. * You use AI agents to build software, breaking down work, tracking progress, checking results, and redirecting agents when they get stuck. * You’re comfortable with autonomy and ambiguity. You can turn an unclear problem into a plan, manage your own work, and follow through to delivery. We’re interested in the depth of your contributions and what you’ve shipped. Your experience may come from owning an AI capability within a larger product. **Nice to haves** ----------------- * Experience with reinforcement learning fine\-tuning, RL environments, or LLM\-as\-judge evaluators. * Experience with long\-running agents, recovery from failed steps, or coordinating multiple agents. * Experience publishing benchmarks or running rigorous experiments on AI systems. **About us** ------------ * Raised a $15M Series A led by Standard Capital, with backing from Y Combinator, FCVC, Transpose Platform, and Dropbox Ventures. * Our customer base has grown 4× year to date. * A team of 17 and growing. * Based in person in San Francisco at 650 5th Street. **Benefits** ------------ * Medical, dental, and vision insurance. * 401(k). * Unlimited PTO and sick days, plus company\-observed US holidays. * Daily lunch and a fully stocked kitchen. * Commuter benefits. * Team offsites and events. Compensation Range: $175K \- $250K

jobs.title: Principal Engineer - Data Retrieval
jobs.description: NVIDIA is seeking an engineering lead to architect and scale the data acquisition infrastructure that powers our foundation models. Starting with code and STEM data for Nemotron, you will build the systems that discover valuable sources, crawl the open web at scale, and deliver reliable, high\-quality data to training pipelines. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role spanning distributed systems, crawl infrastructure, and third\-party data ingestion. You will own the architecture of a unified platform covering source discovery, URL indexing, crawl frontiers, predictive ranking, scheduling, distributed fetching, and ingestion. We have existing infrastructure to build on, and the goal is to bring it to pretraining scale and extend it to additional model families, modalities, and acquisition workflows over time. Along the way, you will lead architecture reviews and critical implementation work, mentor engineers, and help build the team. **What you’ll be doing:** * Work with storage and scaling teams to design scalable frontier storage and queueing systems with high\-throughput writes, efficient lookups, deduplication, and scheduling based on data quality, diversity, and freshness. Build a continuous discovery loop that extracts links and feeds new candidates back into the crawl frontier. * Develop a shared crawl execution layer that fetches reliably and politely at scale, handling dynamic websites while keeping resource use under control. * Build extensible pipelines for open\-web, licensed, and partner content, including text, PDFs, code repositories, and multimodal assets. Define stable interfaces for source connectors so teams can add sources without rebuilding the platform. * Partner with parsing and curation teams to preserve valuable code, math, and structured content, and improve accepted data yield. * Implement provenance and policy enforcement with legal, privacy, security, and data governance partners. Translate approved publisher preferences, opt\-outs, licensing terms, and use restrictions into auditable controls that follow the data downstream. * Own production readiness, including capacity planning, observability, fault tolerance, recovery, and cost efficiency. Instrument the pipeline end to end and set service objectives for throughput, freshness, reliability, and meeting training cutoffs. * Work with research and product teams to evaluate internal crawls and external datasets through comparable pilots. Deliver reproducible data releases that tie source coverage and processing quality to controlled training experiments. Coordinate dependencies across teams and make clear tradeoffs between immediate data delivery and long\-term platform development. * **What we need to see:** * A BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience. * 15\+ years of relevant experience in software engineering, including designing and operating large\-scale distributed systems, setting technical direction, and delivering complex infrastructure across multiple teams. * Deep experience with web crawling or closely related discovery, indexing, or ingestion infrastructure, including distributed scheduling, stateful services, storage, and high\-throughput data processing. * Strong hands\-on engineering and system design skills. Ability to move between architecture, implementation, performance analysis, and production debugging. * Experience building batch or streaming pipelines and reasoning about consistency, retries, duplicate processing, backpressure, and recovery. A track record of improving throughput, latency, resource efficiency, or operational reliability. * Experience delivering data platforms for research, ML, search, or other demanding technical users. Ability to translate evolving requirements into clear interfaces and measurable engineering outcomes. Strong technical communication and leadership through influence across engineering, product, research, and governance teams. * **Ways to stand out from the crowd:** * Experience architecting a web\-wide crawl platform, scaling crawl frontier storage, or consolidating multiple acquisition systems into shared infrastructure. * Direct experience supplying foundation\-model pretraining data, including targeted discovery, quality\-aware crawl ranking, and acquisition of code or technical content. * Experience implementing publisher consent, training\-use opt\-outs, dataset licensing controls, or provenance infrastructure at scale. * Background with browser\-based or agentic data collection, programmable extraction, and sandboxed environments for tool\-use data or post\-training evaluation. Experience onboarding licensed or multimodal datasets, building reusable partner integrations, or delivering streaming feeds with low latency for retrieval and grounding. * The platform is a core capability for NVIDIA’s AI models and directly shapes the reach and quality of our training data. If you enjoy solving difficult distributed systems problems and building platforms that other teams depend on, we want to hear from you. jobs.title: Data Scientist, Geospatial
jobs.description: Imagine having the power to stress\-test an entire power grid against a hurricane or thunderstorm before the clouds even gather. That is the reality we are creating at Neara. We use advanced machine learning to create engineering\-grade, physics enabled digital twins of electricity grids across four continents, this helps asset owners understand their biggest challenges and bring the most viable solutions to life across millions of kilometres of infrastructure. By simulating extreme weather and structural stress at a network\-wide scale, we empower the world’s largest utilities to pinpoint risks, optimise investments and build a more resilient global energy future. Our team is a collection of brilliant minds who are fanatical about making a tangible difference in the real world, utilising AI and machine learning to accelerate everything from data classification to complex scenario analysis. We have built a special culture where innovation thrives because everyone owns the mission and we need smart, creative people to help us scale this impact to every corner of the globe. **Data Scientist, Geospatial** We're looking for a Data Scientist, Geospatial to join our Houston team, supporting a key regional electric utility. You’ll work directly with their team to build physics\-backed models on Neara, leveraging complex datasets like LiDAR, GIS, asset records, and weather data. Your work will directly prevent wildfires by simulating vegetation encroachment, predict grid failures under extreme weather loads, and inform capital investment decisions to harden critical infrastructure. **What You Will Do:** * Embed and collaborate directly with customer geospatial and GIS teams in a hybrid setting, spending time on\-site at their offices to deeply understand their data workflows, integrate systems, and solve complex spatial challenges. * Build predictive risk models on Neara that combine LiDAR, terrain models, and weather data to simulate conductor sag, sway, and vegetation fall\-in risks to directly prevent wildfire ignitions. * Translate complex spatial and structural risk metrics into defensible, data\-driven insights that inform utility capital investment decisions for grid hardening. * Build and maintain robust spatial data pipelines to ingest, clean, vectorize, and integrate diverse geospatial data formats from our utility partner. * Establish QA/QC benchmarks for spatial accuracy, coordinate reference system (CRS) transformations, and structural alignment across disparate data sources. * Mentor others in best practices for model training, data analytics, and building data\-driven products. **Who You Are:** * 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in data science or machine learning. Geospatial data or power grid domain experience is a plus. * Strong quantitative intuition for data, with excellent communication skills and proven experience presenting complex findings to customers and senior leaders. * Experience working in fast\-paced, high\-growth scale\-up technology environments is a plus. * Self\-driven with a bias for action; comfortable taking full ownership of complex projects and adapting quickly to shifting priorities. * Natural collaborator who thrives at the intersection of technical teams (ML, Software) and external customer stakeholders. * Grounded, resourceful approach to problem\-solving, with a track record of navigating messy, real\-world datasets to deliver clear, business\-driven outcomes. **What We Offer:** * Work with an industry\-leading, multi\-modal spatial data stack \- including airborne LiDAR, high\-resolution satellite imagery, and physics\-enabled digital twins \- to solve real\-world engineering challenges at immense scale. * Your spatial modeling will directly mitigate wildfire risks, optimize utility vegetation management, and harden critical infrastructure across millions of kilometers of energy grids. * Shape the spatial architecture of our core product line while collaborating with top\-tier ML and software engineers. * Enjoy a highly competitive compensation package with a significant equity component, ensuring you are a true stakeholder in our rapid global scaling. \#LI\-NT1 \#LI\-DNP Compensation Range: $140K \- $160K

jobs.title: Lead Electrical and Automation Engineer
jobs.description: At Nestlé Health Science, we believe that nutrition, science, and wellness must merge, not collide. Here, we embrace the intrinsic connections of these three pillars, harnessing their collective strength to empower healthier lives. Our broad product portfolio includes renowned brands like Garden of Life®, Nature's Bounty®, Vital Proteins®, Orgain®, Nuun®, BOOST®, Carnation Breakfast Essentials®, Peptamen®, Compleat Organic Blends®, and more. We also have extensive pharmaceutical expertise, offering innovative medicines that aim to prevent, manage, and treat gastrointestinal and metabolic\-related diseases. At Nestlé Health Science, we bring our best for better lives. Our people are challenged to bring fresh, diverse views and make bold moves to empower healthier lives through nutrition. We know brilliant ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. Here we embrace the entrepreneurial spirit and collaborate with teams that champion focused and forward thinking. We are committed to fostering professional growth and celebrating the achievements of our people along the way. We offer dynamic career paths, robust development, opportunities to learn from talented colleagues around the globe, and benefits that support physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing. Join us to innovate for impact and reimagine the future of health and nutrition for patients and consumers. **POSITION SUMMARY** As a Lead Digital and Automation Engineer at Nestlé Nutrition \& Health, your mission is to identify, develop and scale automation and digital manufacturing solutions that strengthen performance across the Nutrition \& Health manufacturing network. At our R\&D center in Bridgewater, US, we develop science\-proven nutrition products, processes and packaging, while providing technical support to Nestlé Nutrition \& Health factories worldwide. You will make a difference by collaborating closely with factory, engineering, quality, operations, research and development, digital and automation teams, technology partners and strategic suppliers. This is an opportunity to grow your expertise and deliver meaningful results that help improve lives through nutrition innovation worldwide. You can expect travel both domestically and internationally up to 30% of the time. **JOB DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES** * Leading the identification, development, technical support and global deployment of digital manufacturing and automation solutions that improve reliability, efficiency and operational performance across factories. * Driving the standardization and continuous improvement of automation, process control, manufacturing execution systems and operational technology solutions across Nutrition and Health sites. * Building strong partnerships with factories, project teams and technology suppliers to turn emerging automation and digital technologies into scalable business value. * Delivering expert guidance in the field of electrical, automation and digital for investment projects, from design and commissioning to qualification, validation and handover to operations. * Enabling secure, reliable and actionable manufacturing data through data integration and engineering initiatives that support digital transformation. * Coaching teams and sharing best practices that strengthen digital and automation capabilities across a global manufacturing community. **EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS** * Bringing strong expertise in automation, process control and digital technologies applied to manufacturing, supported by a Master’s, Bachelor’s or equivalent degree in Engineering with a background in automation and digital technologies. **EXPERIENCE \& SKILLS REQUIREMENTS** * 8\+ years of experience in automation, process control, digital manufacturing solutions, AI and robotics, manufacturing execution systems (DMO/MES), and digital engineering, preferably within manufacturing or food industry environments. * Use solid knowledge of process mastery applications, control system platforms such as Rockwell, Wonderware or AVEVA, and process simulation tools Siemens SIMIT / Tecnomatix to strengthen operational performance. * Collaborate across multidisciplinary teams to deliver engineering projects, commissioning, start\-up and continuous improvement in manufacturing facilities, ideally within aseptic Ready to Drink and Oral Solid Dose (VMS) supplement manufacturing processes. * Demonstrate courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value. \#LI\-hybrid \#LI\-BB1 Salary: jobs.title: Outbound AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Nimble:** ----------------- Nimble is the real\-time web search platform built for enterprise accuracy, completeness, and trust. We run Web Search Agents that actively navigate live websites using real browsers and reasoning, turning the public web into governed, decision\-grade data for AI systems and high\-stakes business use. Unlike index\-based “AI search” tools or brittle legacy scraping, Nimble makes the live web queryable on demand, delivering structured outputs that teams can verify and rely on. Our platform powers use cases where correctness matters: financial due diligence, real\-time pricing and promotions, market intelligence, and AI systems that depend on fresh, complete data. Trusted by leading enterprises like Home Depot, Uber, and Coca\-Cola and backed by top\-tier investors, Nimble sits at the intersection of AI, automation, and real\-time web intelligence. As demand accelerates across AI, LLMs, and data\-driven decisioning, we’re scaling quickly and looking for high\-energy, driven teammates who thrive in fast\-moving environments and want to help define a new category. **Why join Nimble?** * Work on a deeply technical platform powering real\-time AI and enterprise decisions * Help define the future of Web Search Agents and live web intelligence * Build alongside a sharp, mission\-driven team that moves fast, ships often, and takes ownership **About the Role:** ------------------- As an Outbound AI Engineer at Nimble, you’ll support a focused Enterprise pod and help that pod create pipeline and ARR. You’ll own the work traditionally associated with top\-of\-funnel, but your role will not stop at booking meetings. You’ll use AI agents, automation, account research, GTM assets, and follow\-up support to help the pod open doors, progress opportunities, and generate revenue. The goal is simple: help the pod create more pipeline and ARR from the accounts we care about. **You do not need to be a software engineer.** **You do need to be resourceful, AI\-native, and comfortable using modern AI tools to replace manual BDR work with better research, stronger personalization, faster execution, and more useful sales support.** Being good at prompting is helpful, but it is not enough. We’re looking for someone who understands how to connect AI into actual GTM workflows and can think in terms of agents, workflows, tools, and repeatable systems. **What Makes This Role Different** Most BDR roles are built around activity volume. This role is built around pod outcomes. You’ll be expected to open doors and book meetings, but also to help the pod create better account strategies, better messaging, better assets, better follow\-up, and better ways to engage the accounts we care about. You are not just passing meetings to AEs and moving on. You are part of the Enterprise pod and share the goal of creating pipeline and ARR from the accounts assigned to that pod. The role combines the accountability of outbound with the leverage of AI, agents, automation, and GTM tooling. **What You’ll be Doing:** ------------------------- * Support a pod of 2–3 Enterprise AEs * Research accounts, stakeholders, buying committees, market signals, and relevant business initiatives * Build AI\-executed outbound campaigns across email, LinkedIn, phone, and other channels * Book qualified meetings with target accounts * Use AI agents, workflows, and automation to improve account research, personalization, messaging, sequencing, and follow\-up * Build repeatable account research workflows for assigned accounts and segments * Build lightweight tools, workflows, dashboards, and automations that help the pod prioritize accounts and execute faster * Create account\-specific or segment\-specific GTM assets that help AEs open and progress conversations * Support post\-meeting follow\-up, stakeholder mapping, and multi\-threading * Partner closely with AEs to help move opportunities from first meeting to pipeline and ARR * Stay focused on assigned accounts and strategic GTM priorities rather than chasing easy meetings outside the target list **How We Expect AI to Be Used** This role is not about occasionally using ChatGPT or Claude to write outbound emails. We’re looking for someone who can use AI agents, workflows, automation, and agentic loops to make outbound faster, sharper, and more scalable across a focused set of target accounts. You should be comfortable using AI as a research, workflow, automation, and GTM execution layer. That means using LLMs where useful, but also connecting them to tools, data sources, workflows, and repeatable processes that help the pod operate more effectively. **Examples of how you might use AI in this role:** * Build repeatable account research agents for assigned accounts and segments * Create agentic workflows that gather, summarize, and structure public web signals across accounts * Build account briefs that summarize company priorities, business model, public web presence, competitive landscape, and relevant business initiatives * Identify relevant stakeholders and buying committees across target accounts * Turn account research into relevant outbound angles by persona, account, and use case * Build repeatable messaging frameworks for different segments, buyer types, and use cases * Create personalized outreach based on account\-specific signals, not generic AI\-written copy * Use AI agents to analyze websites, documentation, product pages, job postings, news, company updates, customer stories, technical content, and other public web signals * Build lightweight workflows, automations, dashboards, and internal tools that help the pod prioritize accounts and execute faster * Connect AI tools like Claude to external tools, data sources, workflows, and internal systems through Skills, APIs, automations, or similar approaches * Use agentic loops to monitor accounts, surface changes, identify triggers, and suggest next actions * Use AI to create GTM assets that help AEs open conversations and move opportunities forward * Improve follow\-up after meetings by summarizing context, identifying next stakeholders, creating tailored follow\-up assets, and helping the AE multi\-thread the account * Continuously test and improve outbound messaging, targeting, and account strategy based on what is converting **Success in this role means contributing to:** * Pipeline created by the pod * ARR generated by the pod * High\-quality account engagement * Opening doors in strategic target accounts * Supporting AEs with research, assets, tools, and follow\-up * Stronger pipeline creation and deal progression You will not be measured by activity volume, emails sent, or meetings booked for the sake of meetings. **What You Should Have for the Role:** -------------------------------------- **We’re looking for someone who can combine outbound execution with AI\-native thinking.** **You should be comfortable doing the hard parts of outbound, but also curious enough to build better ways of doing the work.** You are: * Commercially minded and revenue\-oriented * Comfortable with outbound prospecting, including email, LinkedIn, and phone * Strong at account research and business writing * Able to understand business problems and turn them into relevant outreach * Able to use AI as a workflow and research engine, not just as a copywriting tool * Comfortable connecting AI tools like Claude to external tools, data sources, workflows, and internal systems * Familiar with Skills, APIs, automations, no\-code / low\-code tools, or similar ways to extend AI beyond a chat interface * Able to build repeatable processes with AI, automation, spreadsheets, enrichment tools, and lightweight dashboards * Able to turn public web data and account signals into specific outbound angles * Aware that good AI\-assisted outbound still requires judgment, business context, and strong sales instincts * Disciplined about working assigned target accounts and GTM priorities * Strong at follow\-up, organization, and CRM hygiene * Able to work closely with AEs and support opportunities after the first meeting * Excited by a role that blends outbound, AI, GTM strategy, and sales execution **Helpful Background** You may be a fit if you have jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)
jobs.description: Olive Systems partners with fast\-growing AI and technology companies across the United States to help them build and scale their engineering teams. We’re looking for experienced **Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs)** who can bridge the gap between complex customer challenges and real\-world technical solutions. Rather than hiring for a single position, we’re building a network of strong engineers interested in working with innovative startups and technology companies. Based on your technical background, experience, and career preferences, we’ll connect you with relevant opportunities across our partner companies. **This is not an internal engineering position at Olive Systems.** **What You’ll Do** As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you’ll work closely with customers and engineering teams to solve complex technical challenges, often without predefined requirements. Your responsibilities may include: * Working directly with customers to understand business challenges and translate them into technical solutions. * Designing, developing, and deploying production\-ready applications and systems. * Building prototypes and turning successful concepts into scalable products. * Working across backend, frontend, APIs, cloud infrastructure, data, and AI technologies. * Making architectural and technical decisions independently. * Collaborating with founders, product managers, and engineering teams. * Identifying opportunities to turn custom solutions into reusable product capabilities. * Taking full ownership of technical solutions, from initial discovery through production deployment. **Who We’re Looking For** We’re interested in engineers who combine strong technical expertise with product thinking, problem\-solving skills, and the ability to work independently. You might currently be a: * Forward Deployed Engineer * Senior / Staff Full\-Stack Engineer * Founding Engineer or Technical Founder * AI / Applied AI Engineer * Solutions Architect with hands\-on development experience * Senior Software Engineer with end\-to\-end product ownership **What matters most:** * Strong hands\-on software engineering experience. * Proven track record of building and shipping production systems. * Ability to take ownership of complex technical challenges from start to finish. * Experience designing software architecture and making technical trade\-offs. * Confidence working with ambiguous or evolving requirements. * Strong communication skills and experience collaborating with technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Ability to move quickly from problem discovery to implementation. **Nice to Have:** * Experience building AI\-powered applications using LLMs, RAG, or AI agents. * Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure. * Background in early\-stage startups or fast\-paced product environments. * Previous experience working directly with enterprise customers. * Experience developing MVPs, prototypes, or custom integrations. **Our Hiring Process** **1\. Initial Technical Evaluation** We’ll invite you to a short AI\-powered interview focused on your real engineering experience. We’ll explore systems you’ve built, architectural decisions, technical challenges, and how you approach solving complex problems. No algorithm puzzles or generic coding questions. **2\. Conversation with Olive Systems** We’ll discuss your professional background, career goals, compensation expectations, preferred working environment, and availability. **3\. Introduction to Relevant Opportunities** When we identify a suitable opportunity, we’ll introduce you to the company and coordinate the next steps. jobs.description: Build the software that helps bring new GPU data centers online. Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is expanding the infrastructure that powers demanding AI, machine learning, and high\-performance computing workloads.
