We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join the Inventory and Hardware Ingestion team. You will build backend services, APIs, and automated workflows that track hardware identity, location, configuration, and lifecycle state, from incoming equipment through installation and ongoing operations. The accuracy and reliability of these systems directly affect how quickly teams can bring new GPU capacity online. This is a hands\-on software engineering role on a fast\-moving project with significant business impact. You will solve distributed systems and data consistency problems, integrate with services across the infrastructure lifecycle, and turn complex operational workflows into reliable, maintainable software. You will own meaningful components from design and implementation through testing, deployment, and production operation. We are looking for engineers who enjoy building, take ownership of outcomes, and work effectively as requirements evolve. We value clear technical judgment, simple designs, strong collaboration, and thoughtful use of AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate delivery without compromising quality. **Key Responsibilities** * Design, implement, and operate backend services and APIs for hardware inventory and onboarding. * Develop data models that accurately represent hardware identity, physical location, component relationships, and lifecycle state. * Build ingestion workflows that validate incoming hardware data, reconcile discrepancies, and coordinate with partner systems. * Implement reliable asynchronous processing, including retries, idempotency, concurrency control, and recovery from partial failures. * Maintain consistent inventory information across services and integrations as hardware fleets and deployment sites grow. * Work with hardware, networking, data center operations, and software teams to translate real\-world workflows into robust software. * Write automated tests, participate in design and code reviews, and improve service performance, observability, and reliability. * Investigate production issues and replace recurring manual fixes with durable engineering improvements. Use AI\-assisted coding tools responsibly, reviewing and validating generated code before it reaches production. * **Required Qualifications** * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production backend services, distributed systems, or cloud platforms. * Strong programming skills in Java or another backend language such as Go, Python, or C\+\+. * Experience designing APIs, relational data models, and database\-backed services. * Understanding of distributed systems concepts, including concurrency, consistency, fault tolerance, and recovery. * Experience delivering software through implementation, automated testing, deployment, and production support. * Ability to explain technical decisions and tradeoffs, troubleshoot complex problems, and deliver maintainable solutions. Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to make progress in a fast\-moving environment with evolving requirements. * **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with hardware inventory, asset lifecycle management, bare\-metal provisioning, or infrastructure automation. * Experience building ingestion pipelines, event\-driven services, or durable workflows that coordinate multiple systems. * Experience reconciling conflicting data and maintaining accurate state across distributed services. * Familiarity with Linux, networking fundamentals, server hardware, or GPU infrastructure. * Experience with database performance tuning, schema migrations, and backward\-compatible APIs. * Substantial hands\-on use of AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor for implementation, testing, refactoring, and code review. * Experience validating AI\-generated code for correctness, security, maintainability, and production readiness.

jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer - Mobile
jobs.description: **Jr Software Engineer \- Mobile** *(Remote, US\-Based Only)* **Build software that matters.** At Pulsara, we build technology that helps healthcare teams communicate, coordinate care, and make critical decisions when every second counts. Our mobile applications put that technology directly into the hands of the people who need it. We're looking for a **Software Engineer – Mobile** who enjoys building things, solving problems, and learning along the way. You'll work alongside an experienced team to develop and improve our Android and iOS applications, helping create software that's reliable, intuitive, and easy to use. You don't need to know everything coming in. If you love figuring out how things work, enjoy turning ideas into working software, and want to see the impact of what you build beyond the screen, you might be exactly who we're looking for. **Keep reading.** **What is Pulsara?** **Pulsara connects people when seconds matter.** Pulsara is a secure, user\-friendly platform that connects care teams across departments and organizations. By replacing fragmented communications with one unified patient channel, Pulsara simplifies workflows, helps reduce treatment times and costs, and improves the experience for patients and caregivers. **Who we are:** Pulsara is a 100% remote team made up of people with backgrounds in technology, healthcare, emergency services, business, and beyond, united by a common purpose: to improve the lives of people in need and those who serve them. Working remotely gives us flexibility, but great remote work takes more than being able to work from home. We communicate intentionally, collaborate across teams, take ownership of our work, and depend on one another to follow through. We are a company that continues to evolve. We value people who are curious, comfortable learning, willing to challenge how things have always been done, and interested in helping us make both our product and the way we work better. ***Want to learn more?*** *Explore our technology at* *pulsara.com* *and discover our team, culture, and benefits on our* *Careers page**.* **What You’ll Be Building** Pulsara isn't a single mobile application. Our technology environment includes: Native Android and iOS applications Web\-based patient care, administration, and reporting tools * ️ A highly scalable AWS cloud environment Internal and public APIs ️ Relational databases and complex data workflows Secure, HIPAA\-compliant systems connecting healthcare organizations Mobile development here means understanding how applications, services, and workflows work together—not just writing code for a single screen. **Your Primary Job Focus and Day\-to\-Day Activities Will Include:** **Build and improve mobile applications** Develop features, maintain functionality, and write clean, reliable code for our native Android and iOS applications. **Write code and learn from feedback** Use tools such as Android Studio and Xcode. Submit pull requests, participate in code reviews, and apply feedback to strengthen your skills and your code. **Use AI\-assisted development tools** Use AI tools to support coding, debugging, testing, and problem\-solving. Learn to evaluate AI\-generated code and apply sound engineering judgment. **Solve problems and troubleshoot issues** Investigate bugs, identify causes, and work with teammates to develop and verify solutions. **Collaborate throughout development** Work with Software Engineers, Product Managers, and Test Engineers to clarify requirements, share ideas, and deliver quality software. **Create intuitive mobile experiences** Build with usability in mind, considering platform\-specific design, customer workflows, and how mobile applications connect with APIs and other services. **Keep learning with the customer in focus** Explore new technologies, ask thoughtful questions, and improve your skills while recognizing that healthcare professionals depend on the software you build. **What Will Help You Succeed** ✅ Hands\-on Android and/or iOS development experience through professional work, coursework, or personal projects ✅ Familiarity with Kotlin, Java, Swift, or comparable programming languages ✅ Understanding of basic software development principles and writing clean, maintainable code ✅ Familiarity with Android Studio, Xcode, Git, or similar development tools ✅ Interest in developing native applications for both Android and iOS ✅ Experience using AI\-assisted tools in software development ✅ Basic debugging, problem\-solving, and troubleshooting skills ✅ Appreciation for intuitive design, software quality, and customer experience ✅ Curiosity, attention to detail, clear communication, and a willingness to learn and collaborate **Additional Experience That Can Be Helpful** ➕ A mobile application or software project you've built and can share ➕ Familiarity with Google's Material Design or Apple's Human Interface Guidelines ➕ Exposure to APIs, databases, backend services, web applications, or full\-stack development ➕ Experience with Agile development, code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, or DevOps ➕ A degree or coursework in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field A degree or number of years doesn't necessarily tell us what someone can accomplish. We value demonstrated skills, curiosity, and a willingness to learn. We're interested in what you've built, the problems you've solved, and the potential you bring. **What Makes Someone Great at This Job** **You're curious.** You ask thoughtful questions, explore new approaches, and enjoy figuring out how things work. **You think like the customer.** You understand that reliability, usability, and simplicity matter when healthcare professionals are coordinating time\-sensitive care. **You enjoy building things.** You like turning ideas into working software and take pride in creating something useful. **You welcome feedback.** You see code reviews and collaboration as opportunities to learn and grow. **You care about quality.** You pay attention to details and look beyond whether the code simply runs. **You collaborate and take ownership.** You communicate openly, follow through, contribute ideas, and ask for help when needed. **Travel:** This position requires 0% travel **What We Offer** Competitive Pay: $70K \- $80K (based on experience) All\-Team Profitability Incentive Plan Medical, Dental, Vision, Life/AD\&D, and LTD benefits Employer 401(k) Match Competitive PTO Cell \& Internet Reimbursement 100% Remote – Work From Anywhere in the USA **Interested?** Whether your experience comes from professional development, coursework, or personal projects, we'd love to hear from you. **Ready to grow your skills while building software that makes a difference? Show us what you can bring to Pulsara.** **A Little More About You — Cover Letter (required)** We'd like to get to know the person behind the resume! Please include a brief cover letter (a few paragraphs is plenty) telling us: * **What excites you about mobile development?** What do you enjoy most about building software or solving problems? * **Why Pulsara?** What interests you about developing technology that helps healthcare professionals communicate and coordinate care? We're not looking for a perfectly polished letter. We're interested in what motivates you, how you approach learning, and why this opportunity interests you. **Please include your cover letter with your application.** **Candidate \& Recruiter Notes** * **Application Review:** Only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted. * **E\-Verify\+:** Used to verify identity and employment eligibility. * **U.S.\-Based Only:** Applicants must reside in the U.S. * **Work Authorization:** Must be authorized to work for any U.S. employer without sponsorship, now or in the future. * **Background Checks:** Conducted after acceptance of a conditional offer. * **Recruiters \& Staffing Firms:** Please do not respond.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer
jobs.description: Remote, Massachusetts, United States of America Remote, California, United States of America Sales Ref ID: JR\-023657 **Our Mission** At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real\-world problems with cutting\-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place. **Who We Are** In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real\-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us! This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters. **Job Summary** As a Platform Engineer, you will serve as the technical execution and operational owner for a specific identity security product pillar's representation, enablement, and execution across our global technical sales motion. This role sits within the Technical Solutions Center of Excellence and is responsible for defining key use cases and managing the technical readiness of our scaled demo and evaluation environments. You will partner closely with Product Management, Product Marketing, Technical Marketing, and GTM Strategy teams. The Platform Engineer ensures that product strategy translates into high\-quality, scalable, and repeatable technical execution across live demos, customer evaluations, and new product releases. This is a senior individual contributor role requiring deep product expertise, strong systems engineering thinking, and significant hands\-on technical execution—specifically bridging the gap between DevOps practices, cloud infrastructure, and technical sales engineering. Your Impact * **Demo Engineering \& Cloud Infrastructure:** Architect, build, and maintain scalable, cloud\-native demo environments, use\-case flows, and value framing for the product pillar. Ensure seamless product representation within shared cloud lab environments via heavy hands\-on contribution to infrastructure\-as\-code (IaC) and automated provisioning pipelines. * **DevOps \& Solution Building:** Act as a core technical builder, applying DevOps methodologies to create robust, automated, and ephemeral evaluation environments that simulate complex, real\-world customer architectures. * **Technical Evaluation Architecture:** Define technical evaluation use cases, success criteria, and best practices. Continuously update evaluation guidance and automation scripts as the product evolves, ensuring alignment with modern enterprise technology stacks. * **Release Readiness \& Field Enablement:** Serve as the technical lead for new product releases within the assigned pillar. Partner with Product and Marketing teams to ensure the field has the technical tools, automation scripts, and stable cloud environments needed to demonstrate new capabilities effectively at scale. * **Analytics, Insights \& Continuous Improvement:** Monitor the health and adoption of shared technical environments. Identify execution gaps, environment instability, or technical friction, and drive corrective action through code refactoring, pipeline improvements, or infrastructure optimization. **Qualifications** * 8\+ years of experience in Cloud Engineering, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Solutions Engineering, or a related highly technical role. * Deep hands\-on expertise in identity and access management (IAM), privileged access management (PAM), or adjacent enterprise security platforms. * Demonstrated experience deploying, managing, or integrating with CyberArk Secrets Manager (formerly Conjur) for secrets management and DevOps security workflows. * Advanced strength with Cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, and/or GCP), including containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and scaling distributed enterprise environments. * Proven experience building, deploying, and managing infrastructure\-as\-code using tools such as Terraform or Ansible. * Experience deploying, managing, or integrating AI tools and autonomous AI agents into cloud infrastructure or development workflows. * Advanced system administration skills across Windows and \*nix environments, with strong CLI proficiency and troubleshooting capabilities. * Fluent in scripting and programming languages needed for automation, API integration, and CI/CD workflows: Python, Bash, and PowerShell. * Experience architecting, supporting, or leading complex, automated lab/demo environments or sandbox platforms is highly preferred. * Strong systems thinking with the ability to translate business strategy into scalable, automated technical execution. * Possessing the ability to build credibility working with senior field architects, sales engineers, and cross\-functional core engineering partners. * Comfortable operating as a senior individual contributor in a fast\-paced, highly technical matrixed environment. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, capable of explaining complex architectural designs to both technical and business audiences. **Compensation Disclosure** The compensation offered for this position will depend on qualifications, experience, and work location. For candidates who receive an offer at the posted level, the starting base salary (for non\-sales roles) or base salary \+ commission target (for sales/com\-missioned roles) is expected to be the annual range listed below. The offered compensation may also include restricted stock units and a bonus. $139,200\.00 \- $191,400\.00/yr **Our Commitment** We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com. Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

jobs.title: Safety Relief Engineer
jobs.description: **Safety Relief Engineer** **The Opportunity** •Safety Relief Engineer at a growth\-oriented downstream energy company •Competitive salary with a strong comprehensive benefits package •Opportunity to work in a positive, collaborative, and inclusive work environment •Career growth and development opportunities within a unique and growing energy company •Reporting to the Process Engineering Supervisor, you’ll conduct safety facilities studies for the Par Montana refinery. Key activities include: •Perform and/or lead pressure relief system analysis in support of projects and site activities •Responsible for delivering efficient and accurate Process Safety Pressure Protection Manager (PSPPM) studies and solutions •Assist site with risk based decision making on the recommendations that result from pressure relief studies •Evaluate change management proposals for impact to Safety Relief systems; conduct analysis and recommend mitigations, and maintain current SRR documentation •Manage refinery relief system design basis documentation including SV sizing basis, heat and material balances, and flare model basis •Support Business Teams by providing input for risk screenings, mitigation options and guidance, and justification needed for prioritization and execution timing of mitigations •Create MOC’s related to relief devices and/or relief device piping modifications •Responsible for all work associated with RIK safety valve replacements, facilitating vendor interface and aligning with the vendor on spec sheet or bill of materials, to allow Mechanical Planner to execute purchase of material. •Perform SRR related PSSR’s when assigned. Note: This description is intended to give you a general overview of the position. Additional responsibilities and opportunities may be identified based on current business needs. **Qualifications** To meet the basic qualifications for this role, you will have legal authorization to work permanently in the United States for any employer without requiring a visa transfer or visa sponsorship. Additional qualifications include: Required: •Bachelor of Science or higher degree in Chemical Engineering •A minimum of 5 years of previous experience in the oil, gas, or petrochemicals industry •Previous academic and/or practical experience with flare modeling tools, such as Pressure Protection Manager (PPM), Visual Flow / Visual Flare, or FlareNet •Previous practical experience with a steady state process simulation tool, such as PROII or HYSYS •Familiar with OSHA PSM 29 as pertains to Relief System Design and Basis as well as Process Hazard Analysis •Solid understanding of Process Design fundamentals with respect to safety, including, overpressure scenario identification and PSV sizing via API 520/521 methodology; pipe sizing and hydraulic calculations; pipe pressure and temperature rating; control valve sizing; and heat exchanger rating •Strong oral and written communication skills and proven ability to influence others •Effective analytical problem\-solving capabilities Preferred: •A minimum of 2 years of experience performing contingency analysis with PSPPM •Demonstrated experience leading or mentoring technical teams •Fundamental understanding of various refinery unit processes and associated safety relief considerations and needs •Experience in Process Safety and Risk fundamentals including Risk Assessments and HAZOPS •Experience in Process Engineering/Refining Process Technologies preferred •Direct experience working at oil and gas operating site **About Us** At Par Pacific, we own and operate market\-leading energy and infrastructure businesses in logistically complex markets. We have built a team of downstream industry veterans and subject matter experts to lead our organization with an entrepreneurial spirit and a collaborative, problem solving approach. We bring our diverse strengths and motivation to complex markets where we seek out diamonds in the rough. As a nimble, growing organization, we actively pursue new opportunities with corporate financing know\-how, respond to local market demands, and adapt to changing external environments. **More Good Reasons to Work for Par Pacific** **Unique Culture and RICH Values** There is nothing ordinary about Par Pacific \- a niche player in the energy space. And there's certainly nothing ordinary about Par Pacific employees. We are driven, hardworking, entrepreneurial\-minded professionals who love to win. Our RICH values describe how we approach our work: Respect for Others, Integrity, Collaborative Innovation, and Heart. If that describes you, you'll fit right in. **Location, Location, Location** Because Par Pacific operates in some of the most beautiful places throughout the country, our employees get to make these places their home and enrich their lives. You will work in Billings, Montana, the heart of Yellowstone Country. We have outdoor recreation in all directions and are less than an hour from the mountains. And, as Montana’s largest city, Billings offers options to balance life, work and play — with trails for walking and biking, historic sites, plenty of dining options, a myriad of cultural choices, and the largest healthcare sector between Minneapolis and Spokane. **Opportunistic Growth Strategy** At Par Pacific, we look for operations with strong fundamentals and great employees who can move a business forward. Our management team has deep experience in the energy industry, as well as in leading mergers, acquisitions, and integrations of newly acquired companies. **Focused on the Future** We are an energy company that has recognized the imperative and embraced the opportunity to begin the transition from fossil fuels. We are developing products that help reduce greenhouse gas emissions. **Excellent Compensation and Benefits** In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a strong comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental and vision insurance, a robust allotment of paid time off, a 401(k) with company match, retirement savings plans, educational reimbursement, and more. Full\-time employees (and their families) are offered medical (with prescription coverage), dental, vision, voluntary critical illness, accident, life/AD\&D insurance, Flexible Spending Account and Employee Assistance Program. Employees can purchase company stock at discounted prices through the Employee Stock Purchase Program. **Our Headquarters** Par Pacific Holdings, Inc., based in Houston, Texas, owns, manages and maintains interests in energy and infrastructure businesses. We are a growing energy company focused on renewable and conventional fuels in the Western United States. Par Pacific also owns 46% of Laramie Energy, LLC, a natural gas production company with operations and assets concentrated in Western Colorado. Our common stock is publicly traded on the NYSE under the trading symbol "PARR". **Our Refineries and Logistics Operations** We own and operate refineries in Hawaii, Montana, Washington, and Wyoming, with total operating throughput capacity of over 219 Mbpd. Par Pacific owns and operates one of the largest energy networks in Hawaii with 94,000 bpd of operating refining capacity, a logistics system supplying the major islands of the state and 90 retail locations. In the Pacific Northwest and the Rockies, Par Pacific owns and operates 125,000 bpd of combined refining capacity and related multimodal logistics systems. **Our Retail Operations** We own and operate over 90 retail locations in Hawaii under the Hele and 76 brands and over 30 retail locations in Washington and Idaho under the nomnom brand. **Par Pacific Is an Equal Opportunity Employer** Par Pacific prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type and affords equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information or any other status protected by applicable law. Note: Par Pacific will not accept calls or unsolicited resumes from third\-party recruiters. All candidates are required to apply through this web posting.

jobs.description: ##### **About Peraton** Peraton is a next\-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure. ##### **About The Role** **Peraton Labs** **hiring for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer** ================================================================== Own the reliability of our enterprise application end\-to\-end: define and enforce SLOs and error budgets, build the dashboards and alerting that tell us how the system is actually behaving, and write production code in our Python and Rust services to make them observable, self\-checking, and resilient. This is an engineering role first. You’ll spend real time in the application codebase, not just around it. **Job Responsibilities** ======================== * Own end\-to\-end reliability of the enterprise application; define SLIs/SLOs with product and engineering, enforce error\-budget policy, and use burn rates to guide release and prioritization decisions. * Write, review, and ship production Python and Rust code to fix performance, concurrency, and failure\-handling issues and make services observable and resilient. * Instrument services with metrics, structured logging, and distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry or equivalent). * Own monitoring and alerting (CloudWatch, Prometheus/Grafana): build low\-noise, SLO\-based burn\-rate alerts, manage alert routing and on\-call hygiene, and design service, SLO, and executive dashboards. * Build in\-application health checks and synthetic user\-journey tests that exercise real auth flows and critical transactions. * Lead incident response, run blameless postmortems, and drive corrective actions to closure. * Operate Amazon EKS/Kubernetes (Helm, RBAC, pod identity, GitOps, upgrades) and core AWS services, managed through OpenTofu/Terraform. * Maintain GitHub Actions/GitLab CI pipelines with reliability and performance gates, supporting trunk\-based, MR\-driven Agile delivery and progressive (canary/blue\-green) rollouts. * Enforce secrets management and least privilege, and produce audit evidence for NIST 800\-171, CMMC, FedRAMP, or DoD/ATO environments. * Drive load testing, capacity planning, and chaos engineering, and mentor engineers on reliability practices. ##### **Qualifications** **Required Qualifications** =========================== * Bachelor’s Degree and 8\+ years in SRE, platform, or software engineering roles with production reliability ownership * Strong software engineering in Python; Rust experience strongly preferred. Comfortable reading, debugging, and shipping changes to production application code, including performance, concurrency, and failure\-handling fixes. Working effectively in unfamiliar codebases, including with AI\-assisted development tools, counts. Judgment and code review rigor matter more than language tenure. * **SLOs and error budgets.** Defining SLIs with product and engineering, setting SLO targets, running error\-budget policy, and using burn rates to drive release and prioritization decisions * **Monitoring and alerting ownership.** CloudWatch, Prometheus/Grafana, or equivalent; building actionable, low\-noise alerts tied to SLOs and multi\-window burn rates; owning alert routing and on\-call hygiene * Designing service, SLO, and executive\-level dashboards in Grafana or equivalent that answer real operational questions * **Application instrumentation.** Adding metrics, structured logging, and distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry or equivalent) directly in Python and Rust services * **Synthetic and transactional health checks.** Building health\-check capabilities into the application and scripted user\-journey checks (CloudWatch Synthetics, Grafana k6, Checkly, or equivalent) that exercise real auth flows and critical transactions * **Incident management.** Leading incident response, running blameless postmortems, and driving corrective actions to closure * Strong Amazon EKS / Kubernetes operations background: Helm, RBAC, pod identity, GitOps, upgrades, troubleshooting * Solid AWS experience across core services (VPC, IAM, S3, RDS, CloudTrail, CloudWatch, KMS) * CI/CD experience in GitHub Actions and/or GitLab CI, including reliability and performance gates in pipeline * Infrastructure\-as\-code (OpenTofu / Terraform) * Agile delivery: trunk\-based development, MR\-driven change, automated quality gates * Security and compliance awareness: secrets management, least privilege, audit evidence, ideally in NIST 800\-171, CMMC, FedRAMP, or DoD environments * US Citizenchip is required **Desired Qualifications** ========================== * Production Rust experience (async/Tokio, FFI with Python via PyO3, or similar) * Load and performance testing (k6, Locust, or equivalent) and capacity planning * Chaos engineering and fault\-injection testing * Progressive delivery (canary/blue\-green with automated rollback on SLO or health\-check failure) * Experience with Big Bang (Platform One), IronBank, or hardened\-image pipelines * Prior work on systems pursuing or holding an ATO * Contributions to observability tooling or Rust/Python open\-source projects ##### **Details** **Target Salary Range:** $104,000 \- $166,000\. jobs.title: Hardware Engineer
jobs.description: **About Perry Weather** Perry Weather is the weather safety standard for organizations that operate outdoors. We combine on\-site weather hardware with a software platform that automates alerts, siren activations, and safety decisions for more than 3,000 organizations — from the PGA of America, the NFL, and MLB to Turner Construction, thousands of school districts, cities, and golf courses. We've grown 80%\+ annually for five consecutive years, and are continuing to grow. We're headquartered in Dallas at The Centrum, in the Oak Lawn neighborhood, where our teams work together every day to help organizations make faster and safer decisions when weather puts people, assets, and operations at risk. **About the role** Perry Weather builds field\-deployed weather monitoring and outdoor warning hardware —lightning detection, weather sensors, sirens, and strobe warning units. These units run unattended on solar and battery power through extreme weather, and when something fails, it fails at a customer site, not on a bench. We're hiring an Electrical Engineer to join and contribute to the hardware platform: PCB verification and manufacturing readiness, component sourcing and obsolescence management, power system design, and root\-cause investigation when field hardware misbehaves. **Responsibilities** * **Schematic capture \& PCB layout execution.** Work in Altium Designer on new revisions and design changes under the Staff Engineer's architectural review — not from a blank sheet, but with real ownership of the layout and component placement. * **Impedance \& DFM verification.** Confirm controlled\-impedance nets (e.g. USB differential pairs at 90Ω, Ethernet at 100Ω) against fab documentation, and manage the CM / Fab House submission and review process — including catching placement/conversion errors in PnP/CPL files before they become a bad board run. * **Component sourcing \& BOM management.** When parts go obsolete or out of stock, find and validate drop\-in or near\-equivalent replacements (electrical spec \+ footprint), and keep the BOM current as revisions ship. * **Power system design.** Prototype and characterize 12V/24V power architectures, select load\-switch/eFuse ICs for new switched rails, and run battery/solar runtime characterization (current draw across operating modes, worst\-case load estimation). * **Protocol\-level hardware integration.** Bring new sensors and peripherals onto the Custom PCB Carrier through its approved expansion interfaces — GPIO, Modbus RS\-485, I²C, and Ethernet/IP — working within the platform's defined GPIO/bus budget rather than requesting ad hoc hardware revisions. * **Field hardware RCA.** Reproduce field\-reported hardware issues (siren/strobe not clearing, speaker output degradation, sensor readings out of range) on the bench using scopes, DMMs, and electronic loads/shunts, isolate root cause, and drive the fix into the next design or manufacturing revision. * **Manufacturing process improvement.** Own discrete process problems end\-to\-end — e.g. grounding/ESD compliance fixes on the line, reducing manual bottlenecks in assembly/configuration steps, and building out the automated manufacturing test fixture (hardware harness \+ pass/fail criteria) the team doesn't have yet. **Requirements** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent hands\-on experience. * 5\-7 years of hands\-on electrical/hardware engineering, ideally on field\-deployed products. * Real experience in Altium Designer (or similar) for schematic capture and PCB layout — this should be work you've shipped, not coursework. * Comfort verifying board designs against fab constraints: controlled impedance, differential pairs, power trace sizing. * Experience selecting components from datasheets, including sourcing alternates under supply constraints. * Working knowledge of power electronics fundamentals: regulation, load switching, battery/solar\-powered system design. * Practical familiarity with I²C, RS\-485/Modbus, and Ethernet/IP at the level of integrating a real device, not just protocol theory. * Bench instrumentation skills: oscilloscope, DMM, electronic load, and comfort measuring current/voltage under dynamic or switched load. * Experience with root\-cause analysis on returned or field\-failed hardware. * Direct experience working with contract manufacturers or PCB fab houses (DFM/DFT, build readiness, process improvement). **Nice to Have** * Familiarity with embedded C/C\+\+ and embedded Linux (U\-Boot, device tree, board bring\-up) — useful for reading firmware well enough to help isolate whether a failure is hardware or firmware, not for owning the codebase. * Exposure to OTA update/bootloader concepts. * Experience with cellular modems (Quectel or similar). * Basic scripting (Python) for test automation or tooling. * Exposure to outdoor/ruggedized enclosure design, solar/battery systems, or safety\-critical/regulated hardware. **Benefits** * **You'll want to come into the office.** Our Oak Lawn office isn't just a place to sit — it's where ideas move fast and culture stays strong. The whole team is here Monday through Friday, which means real collaboration, no chasing people down over Slack, and a genuinely fun place to spend your work days. * **Your wellbeing is covered.** Competitive health insurance, 401(k) with employer matching, and a full suite of voluntary benefits, because you shouldn't have to think twice about the basics. * **Good people, good times.** Monthly All\-Hands, Office Olympics, happy hours, and more. We take the work seriously and the culture seriously too. * **You're getting in early, and that matters.** We're growing fast, but the biggest opportunities are still ahead. The people joining now will help shape what Perry Weather becomes.

Headquartered in Silicon Valley with operations in the United States and Europe, Plus was named by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies. Partners including TRATON GROUP’s Scania, MAN, and International brands, Hyundai Motor Company, Iveco Group, Bosch, and DSV are working with Plus to accelerate the deployment of next\-generation autonomous trucks. If you’re ready to make a huge impact and drive the future of autonomy, Plus is looking for talented individuals to join its fast\-growing teams. Improving the models that drive our trucks depends on a data flywheel: among petabytes of fleet recordings, we curate the moments that matter, label them, train and evaluate onboard models, deploy, and collect again. Labeling is where this loop usually stalls, because human labeling does not scale with the fleet. Auto\-labeling closes that gap: offline models and compute, free of the vehicle's real\-time limits, draft the labels, and people verify and correct only where it matters. This role focuses on 3D obstacle auto\-labeling: producing accurate 3D object labels from curated multi\-sensor recordings, at a quality that lets reviewers verify rather than draw and at a cost that scales. The underlying problems are general: fusing cameras and lidar into consistent 3D estimates, keeping objects consistent through time and occlusion, and knowing when a machine label is good enough. The role starts with 3D obstacles and can expand into other parts of the data flywheel over time. We are open to candidates at either the Research Engineer or Senior Research Engineer level. Level will be determined by experience, technical depth, scope of responsibility and demonstrated impact. You do not need experience with every technology in our stack; we value strong fundamentals, a sense of responsibility and the ability to learn. ### **Responsibilities** * Develop and evaluate methods that turn multi\-sensor recordings into accurate 3D object labels offline, using models and compute the vehicle cannot afford in real time, and measure them against reviewed ground truth * Raise label quality and reduce the human review it needs: find where machine labels fail and fix the causes in models, sensor fusion or data; bring state\-of\-the\-art perception and foundation models into offline use and adapt them to our vehicles and sensors * Build and operate the labeling pipelines at fleet scale: batch GPU inference, data extraction and alignment, selection of what goes to human review, annotation\-tool integration, monitoring, throughput and cost, and regression tests that catch quality drops before data reaches training * Close the loop with the modeling teams: deliver training\-ready labels, feed model failures and long\-tail scenarios back into what gets curated and labeled next; at the senior level, lead designs and mentor * Ensure that your work is performed in accordance with the company's Quality Management System (QMS) requirements and contribute to continuous improvement efforts ### **Required Skills** * BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience * Hands\-on experience developing and evaluating 3D perception methods (detection, tracking, sensor fusion or related) with a framework such as PyTorch, including experimentation, error analysis, principled metrics, built on solid fundamentals in 3D geometry, coordinate frames, and camera and lidar calibration * Strong Python (NumPy, Pandas, SQL) and working C\+\+ where performance matters; experience running large offline workloads with GPU batch inference * Foundations for data\-centric machine learning: how training\-data composition shapes model behavior, how to evaluate against ground truth, and how to measure and reduce annotation cost * Self\-driven with a strong sense of responsibility: a quick learner who takes problems from ambiguous to shipped; for the senior level, a system you were responsible for end to end, design documents others built on, and mentoring ### **Preferred Skills** * Auto\-labeling, offline perception, or ground\-truth generation for autonomous driving or robotics, including integrations with annotation tools and vendors * Experience improving models through data: active learning and data flywheels, hard\-example mining, uncertainty or disagreement signals, dataset curation * Lidar SLAM, structure\-from\-motion, factor\-graph optimization (GTSAM, Ceres), or stereo and monocular depth estimation * Foundation and multimodal models: open\-vocabulary detectors, promptable segmentation, vision\-language models, embeddings and vector search * Heavy\-truck specifics (articulated vehicles, trailer state estimation, multi\-platform calibration) or lane and road\-geometry labeling pipelines **Your opportunities joining PlusAI** Work, learn and grow in a highly future\-oriented, innovative and dynamic field. Wide range of opportunities for personal and professional development. Catered free lunch, unlimited snacks and beverages. Highly competitive salary and benefits package, including 401(k) plan. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: Description: **Company Overview** At Procure Analytics, we are passionate about driving continuous value for our 800\+ members, and we are passionate about doing so with cutting\-edge technology. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, USA, Procure Analytics is the leading tech\-enabled global purchasing organization for MRO and Packaging, leveraging $1B\+ in buying power to achieve up\-front and ongoing savings for member companies. The nature of MRO supplies (millions of SKUs, thousands of individual transactions, hundreds of potential suppliers, and the relatively small cost for individual products) make MRO an under\-managed category within most organizations. MRO comprises 1\-3% of most companies’ total purchases. In the last decade, Procure Analytics has grown from 2 employees and $5 million in total managed spend to over 100 employees and more than a billion dollars in spend, while maintaining its high\-touch service model and member\-focus. Procure Analytics has continued to evolve, adding new categories and geographies in response to members’ needs. Procure Analytics is the fastest growing company in its sector. Procure Analytics’ team serves as an extension of their member organizations, leading change management, driving adoption, and increasing compliance at member locations, while providing analytical tools, savings reporting, and buyer training to drive continuous value growth for mid\-size to Fortune 500 companies. These services, resources and data analytics are provided at no cost to members. Procure Analytics has a very collaborative, humble, and values\-driven culture that upholds these guiding principles: * Act with integrity and in compliance * Drive value creation * Be disciplined entrepreneurs * Be innovative * Treat others with dignity and respect **Strong Private Equity Ownership** In December 2021, Genstar Capital invested in Procure Analytics, along with a large rollover from Bregal Sagemount and the management team. Genstar Capital is a leading private equity firm that has been actively investing in high quality companies for over 30 years. Based in San Francisco, Genstar has developed a strong market reputation of working in partnership with management teams and its network of strategic advisors to build industry\-leading businesses while generating outsized returns. Genstar’s vision is to help build lasting, impactful companies that will continue to succeed well beyond their ownership. Genstar currently has approximately $33 billion of assets under management and targets investments focused on targeted segments of the software, industrials, healthcare, and financial services industries. In 2020, Genstar was ranked 2nd worldwide in aggregate private equity fund performance (out of 529 PE firms) and ranked 3rd in 2019 (out of 497 PE firms) by HEC\-Dow Jones. For more information, please visit www.gencap.com. The Company had previously been backed successfully by Bregal Sagemount, who rolled a significant equity stake into the new investment to continue with the company as a minority investor. **The Opportunity** As a Software Engineer, you will design, build, and maintain the internal and member\-facing software that powers our analytics, reporting, and procurement tools. You will write production code daily, work closely with senior engineers on system design, and use AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude Code to accelerate your work. AI tools speed up our work, but they do not replace engineering judgment. You will make sure that what you ship is correct, secure, tested, and maintainable, and you will help raise the quality bar for the whole team. Responsibilities include: * Design, develop, and maintain production applications, services, and features that support our members and internal teams. * Use Claude Code and other AI\-assisted tools to accelerate development, and review, test, and validate all generated code for correctness, security, and maintainability before it is merged or deployed. * Contribute to system designs and technical plans and document design decisions clearly. * Build and maintain unit and integration tests and contribute to CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes. * Integrate with cloud platforms and enterprise systems, including authentication, identity providers, and secure API access. * Apply security best practices in everyday development, including input validation, authentication and authorization checks, secrets management, and review of AI\-generated code for security weaknesses. * Apply secure development practices across the software lifecycle: follow secure coding standards, manage secrets and access credentials properly, scan dependencies for vulnerabilities, and remediate findings promptly. * Diagnose and resolve complex production issues and conduct root cause analysis to prevent recurrence. * Work with business stakeholders to translate requirements into well\-scoped, well\-engineered solutions. * Participate in code reviews, and support the team’s engineering standards for quality, testing, and documentation. **Location** Atlanta, GA (Hybrid Schedule \- We work onsite Monday through Thursday, and work from home on Fridays\_ **The Person** We are looking for a hands\-on software engineer who writes, reviews, and ships code daily, and who ensures our AI\-assisted development output is accurate, secure, and production\-ready. With the breadth of technologies we use, the successful candidate will manage multiple priorities, make sound tradeoffs, and communicate those tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non\-technical colleagues. Time allocation for this role is approximately 60% building and maintaining software, 20% reviewing, testing, and validating code (including AI\-generated code and security validation), 10% architecture and technical planning, and 10% documentation and cross\-team collaboration. Requirements: **Successful candidates should have:** * Five or more years of professional software engineering experience. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Strong proficiency in full\-stack development, including modern front\-end development (such as React with TypeScript) and a back\-end language and its ecosystem (such as Python, C\#, or Java). * Solid understanding of software design principles, data structures, algorithms, and database design (SQL and/or NoSQL). * Software architecture skills, or experience contributing to the design and build of large\-scale enterprise applications, including service boundaries, data models, and integration patterns. * Strong security awareness in code development: working knowledge of secure coding practices (such as the OWASP Top 10\), authentication and authorization, secrets management, and dependency and vulnerability management. * Experience implementing authentication and authorization with enterprise identity providers (OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, SSO). * Demonstrated experience writing automated tests, including unit and integration tests, and building CI/CD pipelines. * Experience with version control (Git) and collaborative code review workflows. * Familiarity with Jira and Confluence for tracking and managing work and maintaining technical documentation. * Experience with cloud platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure or another major cloud provider. * Hands\-on experience using AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, with a clear understanding of their strengths and limitations. * Experience building or integrating with Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, or with other tool\-use and API integration patterns for AI assistants. * A strong eye for code quality, security, and edge cases, with the discipline to verify AI\-generated output rather than accept it at face value. * Ability to write clear technical documentation and design notes. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills. * Detail oriented, with strong follow\-through on commitments. **Preferred:** * Experience designing or building systems for reliability, observability, and performance. * Experience with data analytics, reporting, or procurement systems. * Experience building or integrating with MCP servers or other AI tool integrations.

jobs.title: Mobile QA Engineer (iOS)
jobs.description: **About the Team** We are Quadcode, a fintech company excelling in financial brokerage activities and delivering advanced financial products to our global clientele. Our flagship product, an internal trading platform, is offered as a Software\-as\-a\-Service (SaaS) solution to other brokers. We are looking for a **Mobile QA Engineer** for our **iOS team**. We are currently undertaking a major redesign of our flagship trading platform, used by millions of users worldwide, with three key goals: delivering an adaptive UI across different screen sizes and device families, expanding automated regression coverage, and transitioning to native Swift\-based test automation. We follow an AI\-first approach, actively integrating AI tools into our daily engineering workflows, including test design, automation development, code reviews, and debugging. We work in 2\-week Scrum sprints, with daily meetings at 11:00 EET/EEST. Your role will involve owning the testing process end to end, from reviewing requirements and identifying potential risks to designing test cases, executing manual tests, and automating them where appropriate. Our ideal candidate has a strong product mindset, takes ownership of features, proactively identifies issues and opportunities for improvement, collaborates with different teams, and drives features through testing to a successful release. ### **Tasks** * **Manual Testing:** Perform functional, regression, smoke, end\-to\-end and integration testing of new and existing iOS functionality. Review specifications, identify risks and edge cases, prepare test cases and checklists, and validate the redesigned UI across different screen sizes, device families, and iOS versions. * **Test Automation:** Develop and maintain automated tests to expand regression coverage across product domains. Contribute automated tests for new functionality, including end\-to\-end tests, and add coverage for features that are not yet covered by developer\-written tests. * **Automation Migration:** Help migrate the existing test automation framework to Swift\-based automation, improving maintainability, reliability, and regression coverage. * **API Testing and Debugging:** Test REST APIs and JSON responses, validate integrations and real\-time data flows, analyze network traffic using Charles Proxy or Proxyman, and investigate issues using device logs and debugging tools. * **Cross\-Platform Testing:** Collaborate with the Android team to verify cross\-platform functionality and identify inconsistencies between iOS and Android implementations. * **CI/CD:** Integrate and maintain automated tests in CI/CD pipelines, helping ensure reliable execution and timely feedback on product changes. * **AI\-Assisted Workflows:** Use AI tools in day\-to\-day QA activities, including test design, test automation, code reviews, and debugging. ### **Requirements** * **Mobile Testing Experience:** 3\+ years of experience testing native mobile applications, with a focus on iOS. Understanding of platform\-specific features, guidelines, and limitations (Apple Human Interface Guidelines, Material Design). * **Test Automation:** Hands\-on experience building and maintaining mobile automated tests using Appium, XCUITest, and/or Espresso. Ability to design a scalable test automation framework from scratch using patterns such as Page Object or Screenplay. * **Programming Skills:** Proficiency in at least one programming language used for test automation: Kotlin, Java, Swift, Python, or TypeScript. Ability to write clean, readable, and maintainable test code. * **Testing Theory and Test Design:** Solid understanding of functional, regression, smoke, integration, and end\-to\-end testing. Experience with test design techniques, including equivalence partitioning, boundary value analysis, decision tables, and pairwise testing. Ability to write clear test cases, checklists, and bug reports. * **API Testing:** Experience testing REST APIs and working with JSON. Familiarity with Postman, Swagger, API automation tools such as REST Assured, Retrofit, or requests, etc.). Basic understanding of WebSockets and real\-time data testing. * **Debugging and Traffic Analysis:** Experience using Charles Proxy, Proxyman, or Fiddler for traffic interception and mocking. Ability to inspect logs using Xcode Console, Android Studio Logcat, and adb. * **CI/CD and Test Infrastructure:** Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or Bitrise. * **AI Tools:** Willingness to use AI\-assisted tools in everyday engineering workflows, including test design, test automation development, and debugging. * **Languages:** English at B1 level or above and Russian at C2 level. ### **Nice to have** * Experience writing mobile automated tests in Swift using XCUITest. * Experience migrating legacy automation frameworks or transitioning between programming languages and testing technologies. * Experience testing financial applications, trading platforms, or other products where data accuracy and reliability are critical. ### **We offer** * Full\-time remote work (service provider contract). * Competitive compensation (EUR). * Flexible working hours. * Corporate AI subscriptions (Claude, Gemini, GPT, etc.). * Access to a rewards marketplace offering products and language courses, redeemable using the company’s internal currency. * A strong team of engineers. * Positive and friendly atmosphere. With a team of 500\+ creative and tech\-driven people across the globe, Quadcode is the place where ideas turn into impact, where every project is a chance to grow, innovate, and make your mark. **Join us today, and let's shape the future of fintech together!** *Note: All applications will be treated with strict confidence. We thank all applicants for their interest, however, only those candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.* \#LI\-JM1

jobs.title: Sr. Security Engineer
jobs.description: Make it rain. Make Snow. Make Earth Habitable. Rainmaker builds and deploys audacious technologies that work with nature to create an abundant, habitable planet. We are modernizing proven cloud\-seeding science with weather\-resistant UAS, radar and satellite observations, numerical weather prediction, novel sensing and validation systems, and sustainable seeding technologies. We are building an integrated system to make more freshwater available to farms, ecosystems, and communities. Our ambition is bold, but we pursue it with humility. We take on difficult problems in the real world with technical rigor, grit, integrity, and an openness to learning and course\-correcting. We are hiring individuals with evidence of exceptional ability. If you want to build systems that endure, restore, and deliver the future we were promised, we want to hear from you. Engineering builds the software, infrastructure, and aircraft systems that power Rainmaker’s cloud\-seeding operations. We work with scientists and field operators to turn weather data into reliable systems that help make more freshwater available. ### **About the Role** Rainmaker is hiring a Sr. Security Engineer to build security into how we develop software and hardware, and how we run field operations. You’ll write production code and design secure defaults across AWS, our applications, and company systems, protecting scientific data and the systems our aircraft and field teams depend on. You’ll automate routine controls and checks, reducing recurring manual work as the company grows. You’ll work closely with engineers to test, operate, and improve the systems you build while keeping secure workflows straightforward to use.### **What You’ll Do** * Map critical systems, data flows, and access paths, then turn the highest\-priority risks into a practical plan. * Build reusable, secure\-by\-default AWS infrastructure with platform engineers, including least\-privilege access, network boundaries, and logging for scientific and operational systems. * Review application designs and code, build reusable authentication and authorization patterns, and fix vulnerabilities at their source. * Automate access provisioning and revocation, secrets management, and credential rotation across production and company systems, with clear audit trails and recovery paths. * Build security checks into development and deployment workflows to catch exposed secrets, vulnerable dependencies, and unsafe configuration changes before release. * Build useful detections and automate evidence gathering for investigations. Work with system owners to test incident response and recovery. * Make Google Workspace and device configurations secure by default, working with People and Operations to make onboarding and offboarding reliable and easy to use. * Partner with aircraft and field teams on secure remote access and communications for systems that operate with intermittent connectivity. * Test, monitor, and document security automation so other engineers can maintain it. Simplify controls that create unnecessary alerts, exceptions, or recurring manual work. ### **What We’re Looking For** * Experience building and maintaining security automation in production. You can show what risk it reduced, how you tested it, how failures are handled, and what manual work it eliminated. * Strong software engineering skills in Python, TypeScript, or a similar language, including testing, code review, deployment, and operating what you build. * Hands\-on cloud security experience, with the ability to turn access policies, network boundaries, and logging requirements into reusable infrastructure as code. * Practical understanding of application security, authentication, authorization, secrets management, and common web and API vulnerabilities. * Experience investigating security findings and carrying fixes through to deployment and verification. * Sound judgment about risk, reliability, and maintenance costs. You can choose a simple, effective control and explain what should happen now versus later. * Ability to work independently, communicate clearly with engineers and non\-engineers, and follow through on work that spans teams. ### **What Will Set You Apart** * Experience with AWS, Pulumi or Terraform, and GitHub or Buildkite deployment workflows. * Experience with Tailscale or WireGuard * Security work involving robotics, aerospace, scientific computing, or remote field systems. * Experience building self\-service security tools or reusable controls that other engineering teams adopted. ### **What Success Looks Like In the First 90 Days** You’ve mapped our critical systems and access paths and agreed on the highest\-priority risks with the team. A secure configuration or access control is deployed on a critical system, with tests that catch unsafe changes. One recurring security workflow now runs automatically, with monitoring, a tested recovery path, and documentation so it can operate without your daily intervention. You’ve tested a detection and response path with the engineers who will use it and agreed on the next improvements. **Supporting the people behind the mission** Making Earth more habitable is ambitious work. We want the people doing it to feel supported—in the work we share and the lives they’re building. * **A stake in what we build.** Meaningful stock options and the opportunity to help shape Rainmaker as an early member of the team. * **Support for your health.** Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance. * **An investment in your future.** A 401(k) with employer matching to help you build long\-term savings. * **Time to recharge.** Unlimited PTO for rest, exploration, and the people and pursuits that matter to you. * **Time for a growing family.** Paid parental leave for both parents to welcome a child and spend time together. * **Lunch together.** Daily lunch provided at our El Segundo headquarters—a chance to share a meal and connect with teammates. * **Help making the move.** Relocation assistance for eligible roles to support your transition to Rainmaker.

jobs.title: Red Team Engineer
jobs.description: **Who we are.** --------------- Reality Defender is an award\-winning cybersecurity company helping enterprises and governments detect deepfakes and AI\-generated media. Utilizing a patented multi\-model approach, Reality Defender is robust against the bleeding edge of generative platforms producing video, audio, imagery, and text media. Reality Defender's API\-first deepfake detection platform empowers teams and developers alike to identify fraud, disinformation campaigns, and harmful deepfakes in real time. Backed by world class investors including DCVC, Illuminate Financial, Y Combinator, Booz Allen Hamilton, IBM, Accenture, Rackhouse, and Argon VC, Reality Defender works with leading enterprise clients, financial institutions, and governments in order to ensure AI\-generated media is not used for malicious purposes. *Youtube: Reality Defender Wins RSA Most Innovative Startup* **The Red Team Role** --------------------- Reality Defender's AI Red Team exists to break our own detection models before adversaries do. As a Red Team Engineer, you'll get your hands on the newest deepfake tools the moment they appear — voice clones, real\-time face swaps, injection attacks, multimodal impersonations — use them the way real attackers would, and turn every failure you uncover into a measurable fix shipped alongside our AI and Data teams. This is a full\-time role based at our NYC headquarters or remote within the U.S., reporting to VP of Product. Responsibilities include: * Run continuous adversarial testing against our detection models across audio, video, image, and text, reproducing new generative tools and techniques as they're released and stress\-testing them against production models. * Build realistic, end\-to\-end attack simulations that mirror how bad actors actually operate — cloned voices in call centers, real\-time synthetic video in onboarding flows and job interviews, virtual camera and media injection, and coordinated cross\-channel impersonation. * Build and maintain repeatable red team infrastructure: test harnesses, attack catalogs, and an evolving adversarial dataset that every model release is validated against. * Close the loop on findings — prioritize them, hand them to AI scientists and engineers with clean reproduction steps, and verify fixes through regression testing so they stick. * Track the generative AI landscape (open\-source models, commercial tools, research papers, and threat actor tradecraft) and triage which techniques are most likely to be weaponized next. * Partner with Product to shape roadmap priorities based on what red team findings reveal. * Support Sales, Marketing, and Solutions Engineering with credible, publishable research and threat briefings for enterprise and government customers. * Contribute to adversarial testing of the broader platform — APIs and integrations — in partnership with Security. * Help define the ethical guidelines and safe\-handling practices for synthetic media used in testing. **Who you are.** ---------------- * 4\+ years of experience in offensive security, adversarial ML, AI red teaming, or ML engineering with a strong adversarial focus. * Hands\-on experience generating synthetic media — voice cloning and TTS, face swap, lip\-sync, diffusion\-based image and video tools — in an offensive or research context, not just reading about it. * Strong Python skills and practical ML fluency (PyTorch or similar): you can build attack tooling, automate testing pipelines, and reason about why a model fails, not just that it did. * Working knowledge of adversarial ML techniques — evasion, adversarial perturbations, compression and post\-processing attacks, data poisoning — and how to measure model robustness. * Clear communicator who can turn technical findings into prioritized, actionable guidance for engineers and non\-technical audiences alike, and who thrives with ambiguity and minimal supervision. * Background in media forensics, signal processing, speech/audio, or computer vision. (nice to have) * Traditional red team or penetration testing experience (cloud, APIs, web), relevant certifications (e.g., OSCP), or familiarity with AI security tooling such as Garak, PyRIT, or the Adversarial Robustness Toolbox. (nice to have) * Published research, conference talks, CVEs, or open\-source contributions in adversarial ML, deepfakes, or AI security. (nice to have) **Within 1 month, you'll…** --------------------------- * Get up to speed on our detection model architecture across modalities, the current red team program, test harnesses, and adversarial dataset. * Meet your AI, Data, Product, and Security counterparts to understand how findings are triaged and remediated today. * Reproduce a set of recently released generative tools and techniques and run them against our production models. * Deliver your first written findings report with prioritized detection gaps. **Within 3 months, you'll…** ---------------------------- * Own a defined attack area end\-to\-end (e.g., real\-time voice attacks or media injection). * Have expanded the attack catalog and test harness with new techniques and automation that reduces manual testing time. * Have driven at least one finding through remediation and verified the fix through regression testing. * Have established a regular cadence for sharing threat landscape updates with the AI and Product teams. **Within 6 months, you'll…** ---------------------------- * Have made red team testing a standard step in the model release process for your attack area. * Have built multimodal, real\-time attack simulations (combined voice and video, conversational attacks) that reflect real operating conditions. * Be showing measurable improvement in model robustness against the adversarial dataset, tracked release over release. * Have contributed research to at least one external publication, customer briefing, or sales enablement asset. **Within 12 months, you'll…** ----------------------------- * Be recognized internally as a go\-to authority on how deepfakes are made and how they evade detection. * Have built adversarial testing infrastructure that scales across every modality with minimal manual effort. * Have red team insights directly shaping the product roadmap and how we talk about risk with customers and government partners. * Be identifying and leading testing on the next generation of threats — such as AI agent callers and real\-time multimodal impersonation — before they show up in production. **What we offer.** ------------------ Reality Defender offers the following benefits to all our employees, regardless of location: * Healthcare plans with 100% premium coverage for employees and partial coverage available for dependents * Dental and Vision plans with 100% premium coverage for employees and their dependents * Short/Long\-term disability and life insurance plans with 100% premium coverage for employees * FSA/HSA and 401k programs * Equity compensation * 20 days of PTO per year * 12 weeks of Parental Leave * Learning and Development budget * Monthly wellness benefits * Annual company\-sponsored offsite For employees working from Reality Defender's HQ in NYC, we offer the following benefits: * Daily in\-office lunch through UberEats * Commuter benefits * Remote Fridays * Happy Hours and other local events Base salary range: $155,000 \- 185,000 based on experience and location. Includes equity. Compensation Range: $155K \- $185K
