Must be able to demonstrate practical problem solving and trouble shooting skills. Ability to demonstrate practical problem solving and trouble shooting skills. Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables. * Strong communication, organization, and prioritization skills. Must have the ability to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing, with internal staff and management. Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations. Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals. Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and the general public. * Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference, and fundamentals of plane and solid geometry and trigonometry. Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations. **Preferred Qualifications** * Master’s degree in engineering or related field. * Six Sigma, Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) and/or Lean Manufacturing certification. * Project Management certification (PMP, etc.). * Electrical license in the state of California. * Knowledge of FDA Regulations, failure investigation principles and/or statistical principles and analysis. * Knowledge of CFR Part 211 cGMP regulations as applicable to engineering. * Bilingual in English/Spanish. Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Engineering Support Technician
jobs.description: Description: The Engineering Support Technician 1 provides critical technical and operational support across product development, CAD modeling, reverse engineering, quality assurance, and prototype manufacturing. This role requires exceptional technical writing skills to document processes, specifications, and installation instructions, ensuring alignment with rigorous engineering standards. **Key Responsibilities:** **Documentation, Quality Control \& Inspection** * Interpret engineering drawings and assist in drafting technical schematics and production models. * Design and deploy custom inspection fixtures, gauges, and quality control tools to conduct rigorous dimensional inspections. **CAD, Reverse Engineering \& Product Design** * Create and maintain product installation instructions. * Utilize 3D laser scanning hardware and reverse engineering software for precise data acquisition. * Process point cloud data to construct accurate 3D CAD modeling environments for engineering teams. * Develop and maintain comprehensive Technical Manufacturing documentation and standard operating procedures. * Leverage CAD and CNC tube\-bending software to generate digital product models, collaborating with R\&D and Manufacturing to validate and optimize fitments. **Manufacturing, Fabrication \& Process Improvement** * Operate fabrication equipment, including bandsaws, tube cutters, deburring machinery, sizing dies, metal benders, and CNC systems. * Execute assigned technical tasks in a timely and accurate manner against time and quality standards. * Conduct weekly audits of Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) and 6S operational standards to enforce shop\-floor compliance. * Propose continuous improvement initiatives to optimize manufacturing processes, tooling capabilities, and equipment efficiency. * Assist with engineering projects as needed. Requirements: **Education and Experience:** * Associate degree in Mechanical Engineering Technology, Manufacturing Technology, or equivalent technical accreditation preferred. * 0–3 years of hands\-on experience in a technical or precision manufacturing environment. **Technical Skills:** * Proficiency in CAD/CAM software, 3D laser scanning applications, and reverse engineering software platforms. * Strong proficiency in interpreting engineering blueprints and technical schematics. * Advanced mathematical capability applied to measurement and problem\-solving. * Demonstrated competence in operating precision hand tools, measurement instrumentation, and shop equipment. **Soft Skills:** * Proven ability to maintain high productivity levels to meet strict project milestones and throughput targets. * High adaptability and agility within a fast\-paced, high\-precision R\&D/manufacturing environment. **Physical Requirements:** * Ability to sit or stand for extended periods of time * Ability to lift, carry, or move items up to approximately 55 pounds (Packaged Exhaust). **Accountabilities:** Success in this role is measured by: * Quality and accuracy of work, as measured by your Supervisor. * Volume of work, as dictated and measured by your Supervisor. * Adherence to employee handbook and company policies. * Attendance clock in and out, including lunch break. We believe in building better together. AWE welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and is a proud fair chance employer. We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels respected, valued, and supported.

jobs.title: Director, Quality Engineering
jobs.description: SI\-BONE is a fast\-growing, publicly traded medical device company that is an industry pioneer in minimally invasive sacropelvic solutions. Our mission is to help patients rise up and reach for the stars, and our vision is to work together as the global leader to make sacropelvic conditions universally recognized and effectively treated through innovation, evidence, education, and advocacy. SI\-BONE® is focused on helping patients in one of the most under\-served, under\-diagnosed, and under\-treated areas in orthopedics, the sacroiliac (SI) joint. SI\-BONE developed an innovative, patented implant to fuse the SI joint. The iFuse Implant System® provides a less invasive alternative to traditional sacroiliac (SI) joint fusion surgery and has been used in over 90,000 procedures to date. We are a medical device company that is focused on improving the lives of patients with sacroiliac pelvic conditions. We are looking for people who are passionate about our mission and who are willing to work hard to achieve it. We are also looking for people who are: * Agile: We work in a fast\-paced environment and need to be able to learn and adapt to change quickly. * Creative: We embrace creativity, and we need people who are not afraid to challenge the status quo. * Team Players: We roll\-up our sleeves and work together as one team to achieve our goals. **Position Summary:** The Director of Quality Engineering leads the technical quality function supporting product development, manufacturing, suppliers, and sustaining engineering. The Director manages the Quality Engineering team and partners with Research and Development, Operations, Supply Chain, Regulatory Affairs, and other Quality functions to translate product requirements and risks into effective design, manufacturing, supplier, and inspection controls. This is a technically engaged leadership position requiring substantial engineering depth, strong statistical capabilities, and sound judgment. The Director is expected to challenge assumptions, assess the strength of technical evidence, and guide practical solutions, not just oversee completion of quality documentation. **Key Responsibilities:** **Technical Leadership and Team Development** * Manage and develop the Quality Engineering team, and inspection personnel if assigned; establish clear responsibilities, technical expectations, priorities, and development plans. * Define the Quality Engineering strategy across new product development, design transfer, and sustaining activities, and allocate resources according to product risk, business priorities, and project needs. * Provide independent quality judgment in cross\-functional decisions, clearly communicating technical risks, evidence gaps, and recommended actions. * Partner with the Senior Director of Quality and the Quality Systems function so that engineering activities align with quality\-system processes and are appropriately controlled, traceable, and documented. **Product Development and Design Assurance** * Partner with R\&D to establish clear, measurable product requirements and appropriate methods for demonstrating that those requirements are met. * Lead Quality Engineering contributions to product risk management, including identification of failure modes, evaluation of risk controls, and assessment of residual risk. * Guide verification and validation strategies, including test methods and test\-method validation, acceptance criteria, and worst\-case configurations; provide technical oversight of mechanical and functional testing and, as applicable, biocompatibility, cleaning, sterilization, packaging, and distribution testing. * Review technical protocols, results, deviations, and reports for scientific rigor, appropriate statistical treatment, and defensible conclusions. * Support design transfer by ensuring that manufacturing processes and supplier capabilities can consistently achieve product requirements. * Evaluate design, material, manufacturing, supplier, and quality\-process software changes to determine their effects on product performance and risk, and the qualification, validation, or testing required. **Manufacturing, Inspection, and Process Quality Engineering** * Lead Quality Engineering support for manufacturing and sustaining activities, including contract manufacturing and risk\-based process qualification and validation. * Provide technical oversight of inspection methods, sampling plans, acceptance criteria, and critical controls, supported by appropriate validation and measurement\-system analysis. * Evaluate process capability, stability, and sources of variation; lead engineering improvements to reduce recurring failures and improve product conformity and manufacturing performance. * Lead technical evaluation and significant nonconforming\-product disposition decisions using objective evidence and risk assessment. **Supplier Quality Engineering** * Lead the technical quality interface with suppliers and contract manufactur ce and investigate complex failures. * Substantial applied statistical experience, including sampling and sample\-size justification, inference, process capability and control, measurement\-system analysis, experimental design, and reliability methods. * Proficiency with statistical software; ability to independently analyze data, critically review others' analyses, and interpret assumptions, uncertainty, and engineering significance. * Working knowledge of applicable medical\-device requirements and standards, including 21 CFR Part 820, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, and the EU Medical Device Regulation. * Experience with risk\-based validation or assurance of quality\-process software. **Leadership and Communication** * Ability to balance technical rigor, risk, timelines, and business needs without compromising product quality, moving readily between detailed analysis and broader organizational priorities. * Demonstrated effectiveness influencing cross\-functional teams, resolving technical disagreements using evidence, and explaining complex technical issues and recommendations to senior leadership. * Strong prioritization, accountability, and follow\-through. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with orthopedic implants, surgical instruments, and associated manufacturing processes, including applicable ASTM and ISO test standards. * Experience with sterile products, packaging validation, cleaning validation, and sterilization. * Experience with dimensional metrology, geometric dimensioning and tolerancing, and inspection of precision\-manufactured components. * Quality engineering experience with human tissue products, particularly process characterization, variability assessment, test\-method development, validation, and product acceptance criteria. * ASQ Certified Quality Engineer or comparable certification; advanced degree in engineering, statistics, or a related technical discipline. **Quality Authority and Professional Conduct** The Director has the authority to place affected product or processing activities on hold when there is a reasonable concern regarding product conformity, safety, or compliance, and is responsible for promptly escalating those concerns through the appropriate Quality, Regulatory, and management channels. The Director conducts business honestly, ethically, and lawfully, consistent with SI\-BONE's Code of Conduct and applicable company policies. SI\-BONE does not tolerate retaliation for good\-faith reporting of suspected violations. Salary range: $210,000 \- $235,000\. The compensation range for this position is specific to the location and is in good faith what SI\-BONE expects to pay for the position taking into account the wide variety of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including job\-related knowledge; skillset; experience, education and training; certifications; and other relevant business and organizational factors. Supplemental pay: bonus and stock There are potential risks associated with the iFuse Implant System. It may not be appropriate for all patients and all patients may not benefit. For additional information on the company or the products including risks and benefits, please visit www.si\-bone.com/risks. We are aware of active recruitment scams using the SI\-BONE name, in which individuals pose as our recruiters and post fake remote job openings and make fake job offers on the Internet. Please note, we will never make an offer of employment without conducting multiple rounds of interviews face\-to\-face using secure video\-conferencing technology. We will never ask candidates to cash checks or make a payment in order to be considered for a position. SI\-BONE only uses company email addresses, which contain "@si\-bone.com" to communicate with candidates. If you believe you've been a victim of a phishing scam, please visit the Cybersecurity \& Infrastructure Security Agency at https://www.cisa.gov/be\-cyber\-smart/report\-incident learn how to report it.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer, Application Platform
jobs.description: **Senior Backend Engineer, Application Platform** ================================================= **Hybrid in Palo Alto (Mon / Wed / Thurs) · $185k–$215K base \+ meaningful early\-stage equity \+ full benefits** **About Sodalis** ----------------- Specialty pharmacy is where the most complex and expensive drugs reach the most in\-need patients, and it still runs on faxes, phone tag, and manual data entry. Patients wait weeks for therapies that can't wait. Sodalis is building AI agents that run those operations end to end: reading and validating prescriptions, handling phone calls, and moving prescriptions through eligibility and fulfillment. The ambition goes beyond that. We want to be the rails every specialty prescription runs on, and the first system to perform clinical review at the standard of a pharmacist. We're already in production, processing tens of thousands of prescriptions a week. Backed by Gradient Ventures (Google's AI fund), and founded by veterans of Apple's Applied ML, Included Health, and Avella Specialty Pharmacy (scaled to $1\.5B\+ before its acquisition by OptumRx). **The Opportunity** ------------------- Every pharmacy works from the same building blocks: prescriptions, directions, insurance claims, rejects. But each one handles them a little differently, so today every implementation means custom code. We want implementation to be configuration, done by a technical solutions team using internal tools, with no engineer in the loop. That's the engine you'd build. It's a classic backend problem with real stakes. You'll model the shared primitives so one system can absorb each pharmacy's nuances, build the configuration layer and the backend behind the tools, and define the contract between the engine and the people tuning it. That includes how new versions roll out only to the customers who want them, on a system that's already live and can't break. You'd own the application platform: the domain model, configuration layer, and tooling. You'd work directly with the founders and the early engineering team on the architecture and where the platform goes. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Model the shared primitives (prescriptions, directions, insurance outcomes) and build the backend that turns each pharmacy's differences into configuration, so one system serves many pharmacies. * Decide where the line between configuration and code sits: what a solutions team can safely configure, and what stays in the engine. * Build the backend services and APIs behind the internal tools a solutions team uses to implement a new customer without an engineer. * Define and version the contract between our engines and whoever configures them, so upgrades ship safely and selectively. * Ship changes to a system that's live, where every prescription is a patient and a bad migration isn't an outage, it's a delayed therapy. Zero\-downtime rollouts and safe versioning are table stakes here. * Partner with the founders and early engineering team on architecture and roadmap. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * 5\+ years building backend systems in production. * Strong system design: you can take an open prompt, design a coherent system, and explain the trade\-offs clearly. * Solid data modeling and API design: you build systems that generalize, not one\-offs. * You've built something config\-driven that other people operated: a rules engine, a multi\-tenant platform, a feature\-flag or rollout system, a workflow DSL. You know where those designs go wrong. * You've shipped 0 1 in startups and are comfortable with ambiguity. * You'll spend time with the solutions team and with pharmacies to understand how their workflows actually differ. No healthcare background required. **How we work** --------------- We're a handful of people going all in on a problem we think is worth it, holding a high bar and shipping work that reaches real patients. It's intense, and it isn't for everyone. We want people who want to build something that matters, alongside others who care as much as they do. If that's you, we should talk. Compensation Range: $185K \- $215K

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Infrastructure
jobs.description: **Software Engineer, Infrastructure** ===================================== **Hybrid in Palo Alto (Mon / Wed / Thurs) · $185K–$215K base \+ meaningful early\-stage equity \+ full benefits** **About Sodalis** ----------------- Specialty pharmacy is where the most complex and expensive drugs reach the most in\-need patients, and it still runs on faxes, phone tag, and manual data entry. Patients wait weeks for therapies that can't wait. Sodalis is building AI agents that run those operations end to end: reading and validating prescriptions, handling phone calls, and moving prescriptions through eligibility and fulfillment. The ambition goes beyond that. We want to be the rails every specialty prescription runs on, and the first system to perform clinical review at the standard of a pharmacist. We're already in production, processing tens of thousands of prescriptions a week. Backed by Gradient Ventures (Google's AI fund), and founded by veterans of Apple's Applied ML, Included Health, and Avella Specialty Pharmacy (scaled to $1\.5B\+ before its acquisition by OptumRx). **The Opportunity** ------------------- Everything we run today is cloud\-based, and so are the pharmacy management systems we integrate with. But most of the specialty pharmacy market runs on\-prem. To reach it, our system has to run on the pharmacy's systems instead of ours. Whether that's the full stack on\-site or a hybrid split with our cloud is one of the first decisions you'd make. That's the problem you'd own. We've never shipped an on\-prem deployment, so there's no pattern to follow. You'll decide how our architecture gets packaged and deployed into environments we don't control, what has to change in our current infrastructure to make that possible, and how we maintain and see into those deployments once they're live. We don't yet know what these environments look like in detail. Some pharmacies may have restricted outbound access, legacy hardware, or IT teams that can't give us a login; others may be more open. Part of the job is going in with our customer, finding out what's actually there, and designing something that works across the range. You'll start with our AI pharmacy tech product, rolling out with a committed customer, so you build against a real deployment instead of a hypothetical one. You'd work directly with the founders and the early engineering team on the architecture. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Decide how our architecture runs in a pharmacy's environment, starting with the AI pharmacy tech product: full stack on\-site, a hybrid split with our cloud, or something in between. * Adapt our current infrastructure and build the packaging and deployment path that installs and updates Sodalis at each pharmacy. * Own those deployments over time: upgrades, rollbacks, and observability into health and failures without being on site. * Go in with our customer and pharmacy IT teams to learn what their environments actually allow, and design for the range. * Partner with the founders and early engineering team on architecture. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * 5\+ years in infrastructure or platform engineering. * You've taken an AWS\-native stack and made it run on Kubernetes or similar in environments you don't operate, including stateful services. * You've shipped and maintained software running in environments you don't control: on\-prem, customer\-hosted, edge, or embedded. * You've kept a fleet of remote installs updated, observable, and recoverable without being able to log into them. * You've set the first pattern for something in a startup and are comfortable with ambiguity. * You'll spend time with pharmacy IT teams and need to understand their constraints firsthand. No healthcare background required. **How we work** --------------- We're a handful of people going all in on a problem we think is worth it, holding a high bar and shipping work that reaches real patients. It's intense, and it isn't for everyone. We want people who want to build something that matters, alongside others who care as much as they do. If that's you, we should talk. Compensation Range: $185K \- $215K

jobs.title: Finance Engineer
jobs.description: SPRCHRGR (pronounced "supercharger") is a professional services consultancy providing highly skilled team members across a variety of complementary disciplines. We like to say, "cut out the vowels, get there faster!" because we prioritize creativity, efficiency, and performance in our work, and we have fun doing it. Our exceptional staff \+ innovative approach set us apart from stuffy traditional accountancies and commoditized outsourced bookkeeping agencies. We think differently about our work supporting high\-growth startups, forward\-thinking SMBs, and nonprofits located all across the US. We specialize in **cutting\-edge technology** and partner with dynamic businesses across diverse industries. Our team culture emphasizes **collaboration**, **learning**, and **process\-driven efficiency**. We're looking for someone who reads a trial balance and writes software. You'll build the client\-facing financial tools for our fractional CFO firm: interactive dashboards and forecasting models, AI assistants that answer finance questions from live accounting data, and automations that take real recurring work off our clients' plates. We're small, we move fast, and we build our own tools instead of buying and configuring someone else's platform. **Who we are** -------------- SPRCHRGR combines executive financial leadership, fractional CFO work and controllership with data, systems integration and workflow automation. Our clients run $1 million to $50 million in revenue and get a white\-glove build, not a template. We're small, we move fast, and we build our own tools (when it makes sense) instead of buying and configuring someone else's platform. **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Build and own our client dashboards.** Interactive financial models delivered as web apps, with scenario sliders, drill\-down tables, and Excel exports a client's own finance lead can audit. * **Build AI automations.** Small, versioned automations that do one job properly, like turning a client's billing spreadsheet into reconciled QuickBooks invoices with built\-in approval gates. * **Get the data in yourself.** Write the database queries behind our reporting and connect them to live client accounting data. Our VP of Technology owns the platform and will hand you the tools and procedures to work independently, not a ticket queue. * **Be the person we trust when two numbers disagree.** Work discrepancies to a documented answer, and know a genuine variance from two figures that were never comparable. * **Teach the rest of us.** Help our accountants and operators build their own tools instead of depending on you for every one. * **Work directly with clients.** Meet (virtually) with key client stakeholders to work out what they need, then build it. No layer in between, although you'll have full access to collaborate with other accounting \+ finance experts within our firm. **Who you are** --------------- **You have both halves. Finance \+ Engineering.** * **Finance:** real depth in accounting, financial statements, month\-end close, receivables and payables, reconciliation, how a general ledger actually works. CPA or CMA is a strong signal; demonstrated judgment matters more. * **Building:** you write and maintain real code and real database queries. Our VP of Engineering partners with you to architect, maintain, and enhance the secure data warehouses, APIs, and hosted web app platform underneath. You can take a system with wrong or missing documentation, work out what it actually does, and build against reality. You've built AI tools, not just used them. **Minimum requirements** * Bachelor's degree with a focus in Accounting, Finance, Computer Science, or a related field. * 10\+ years of combined experience across accounting or finance and software or systems development. * CPA or CMA preferred, not required. * Proficiency in SQL preferred, not required. * Experience with at least one accounting system in depth, such as QuickBooks, NetSuite, Sage Intacct, or Dynamics. * Clear and concise communication, both written and verbal. * Comfortable working independently in a fully remote environment. * A dedicated workspace and access to reliable, secure, high\-speed internet. * An unwavering commitment to confidentiality. * Based in the United States * Embrace SPRCHRGR's Core Values. **What this job isn't** ----------------------- * Not a reporting role. If you just want to produce monthly financial packages, this is the wrong job. * Not a coordinator between finance and engineering. You build. * Not a management role in year one. * Not a place to learn accounting on the job. **Compensation and benefits** ----------------------------- * *Fully Remote:* Work from home with a structured schedule. * *Career Growth:* Gain hands\-on mentoring and opportunities to work directly with our Founder \& CEO. * *Team\-Oriented Environment:* Collaborate with Software Engineers, Sr. Controllers, CFOs, and Accounting Managers to synthesize bespoke solutions for our clients. * *Competitive pay:* $150,000 \- $180,000 Base Salary, DOE. * *Phantom Equity:* Eligible for consideration after your first year. * *Bonus*: Annual performance\-based bonus compensation plan. * *401k:* Up to a 4% match and no vesting period. * *Benefits:* Customizable options. **What will make you stand out** -------------------------------- Send us something you built: a repository, a working file, or a written account of an automation you shipped end to end, with the before\-and\-after time it took. That matters more to us than a cover letter. If your best example is client work you can't share, tell us what it did and how you'd rebuild it! bcarotta@sprchrgr.com **Application Notice** At SPRCHRGR, we value fairness, clarity, and attention to detail in our hiring process. To ensure an equitable process, we ask that you submit your application only through the official posting for this role. * Do not contact our hiring managers, team members, or leadership directly (via personal email, LinkedIn, or other channels). Applications received in this way will be automatically disqualified. Please direct all questions and inquiries to bcarotta@sprchrgr.com **Notice to External Recruiters** Please do not send unsolicited candidate submissions to our team. Our system automatically blocks domains that repeatedly send unrequested outreach. **WHO WE ARE** **Ethical** We do good. We act with integrity, earning trust instead of asking for it, and we do what is right even when it isn't easy. We are transparent, promptly sharing information and feedback directly and freely with all relevant stakeholders. **Positive** We love what we do. It shows in the positive and constructive attitude we bring every day. We realize work is more than just output; it's about the life experiences we share along the way. **Passionate** We care. A lot. We expect high performance of ourselves and our teammates. We constantly look to innovate and improve. We play to win and keep raising the bar to deliver results. **Professional** We are one team, focused on the "we" rather than the "I." We're consistently organized and accountable. Our work speaks for itself and stands the test of time. **Inclusive** By design, our team members believe, act, feel, and look differently from each other. We foster a sense of belonging and respect for every individual and we expect the same from our clients and partners. **HOW WE OPERATE** **We focus on what matters** We work efficiently but don't cut corners or compromise on best practices. We prioritize long\-term value over short\-term gains. We value simplicity over complexity. **We reward it** We reward the effort of our peers with matched enthusiasm. We share the spotlight and credit generously. We celebrate our successes, even the small ones. **We own it** We take pride in our work. We see projects through from start to finish. We continuously update process documentation and fix things we find broken along the way. **We're a service\-first organization** We exemplify a customer\-first mindset across everything we do internally \& externally, always learning from our colleagues, partners, and clients. While the customer isn't always right, we value their trust in us and strive to reciprocate value by anticipating their needs, priorities, and expectations.

We're small, we move fast, and we build our own tools (when it makes sense) instead of buying and configuring someone else's platform. **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Build and own our client dashboards.** Interactive financial models delivered as web apps, with scenario sliders, drill\-down tables, and Excel exports a client's own finance lead can audit. * **Build AI automations.** Small, versioned automations that do one job properly, like turning a client's billing spreadsheet into reconciled QuickBooks invoices with built\-in approval gates. * **Get the data in yourself.** Write the database queries behind our reporting and connect them to live client accounting data. Our VP of Technology owns the platform and will hand you the tools and procedures to work independently, not a ticket queue. * **Be the person we trust when two numbers disagree.** Work discrepancies to a documented answer, and know a genuine variance from two figures that were never comparable. * **Teach the rest of us.** Help our accountants and operators build their own tools instead of depending on you for every one. * **Work directly with clients.** Meet (virtually) with key client stakeholders to work out what they need, then build it. No layer in between, although you'll have full access to collaborate with other accounting \+ finance experts within our firm. **Who you are** --------------- **You have both halves. Finance \+ Engineering.** * **Finance:** real depth in accounting, financial statements, month\-end close, receivables and payables, reconciliation, how a general ledger actually works. CPA or CMA is a strong signal; demonstrated judgment matters more. * **Building:** you write and maintain real code and real database queries. Our VP of Engineering partners with you to architect, maintain, and enhance the secure data warehouses, APIs, and hosted web app platform underneath. You can take a system with wrong or missing documentation, work out what it actually does, and build against reality. You've built AI tools, not just used them. **Minimum requirements** * Bachelor's degree with a focus in Accounting, Finance, Computer Science, or a related field. * 10\+ years of combined experience across accounting or finance and software or systems development. * CPA or CMA preferred, not required. * Proficiency in SQL preferred, not required. * Experience with at least one accounting system in depth, such as QuickBooks, NetSuite, Sage Intacct, or Dynamics. * Clear and concise communication, both written and verbal. * Comfortable working independently in a fully remote environment. * A dedicated workspace and access to reliable, secure, high\-speed internet. * An unwavering commitment to confidentiality. * Based in the United States * Embrace SPRCHRGR's Core Values. **What this job isn't** ----------------------- * Not a reporting role. You build. * Not a management role in year one. * Not a place to learn accounting on the job. **Compensation and benefits** ----------------------------- * *Fully Remote:* Work from home with a structured schedule. * *Career Growth:* Gain hands\-on mentoring and opportunities to work directly with our Founder \& CEO. * *Team\-Oriented Environment:* Collaborate with Software Engineers, Sr. Controllers, CFOs, and Accounting Managers to synthesize bespoke solutions for our clients. * *Competitive pay:* $150,000 \- $180,000 Base Salary, DOE. * *Phantom Equity:* Eligible for consideration after your first year. * *Bonus*: Annual performance\-based bonus compensation plan. * *401k:* Up to a 4% match and no vesting period. * *Benefits:* Customizable options. **What will make you stand out** -------------------------------- Send us something you built: a repository, a working file, or a written account of an automation you shipped end to end, with the before\-and\-after time it took. That matters more to us than a cover letter. If your best example is client work you can't share, tell us what it did and how you'd rebuild it! bcarotta@sprchrgr.com **Application Notice** At SPRCHRGR, we value fairness, clarity, and attention to detail in our hiring process. To ensure an equitable process, we ask that you submit your application only through the official posting for this role. * Do not contact our hiring managers, team members, or leadership directly (via personal email, LinkedIn, or other channels). Applications received in this way will be automatically disqualified. Please direct all questions and inquiries to bcarotta@sprchrgr.com **Notice to External Recruiters** Please do not send unsolicited candidate submissions to our team. Our system automatically blocks domains that repeatedly send unrequested outreach. **WHO WE ARE** **Ethical** We do good. We act with integrity, earning trust instead of asking for it, and we do what is right even when it isn't easy. We are transparent, promptly sharing information and feedback directly and freely with all relevant stakeholders. **Positive** We love what we do. It shows in the positive and constructive attitude we bring every day. We realize work is more than just output; it's about the life experiences we share along the way. **Passionate** We care. A lot. We expect high performance of ourselves and our teammates. We constantly look to innovate and improve. We play to win and keep raising the bar to deliver results. **Professional** We are one team, focused on the "we" rather than the "I." We're consistently organized and accountable. Our work speaks for itself and stands the test of time. **Inclusive** By design, our team members believe, act, feel, and look differently from each other. We foster a sense of belonging and respect for every individual and we expect the same from our clients and partners. **HOW WE OPERATE** **We focus on what matters** We work efficiently but don't cut corners or compromise on best practices. We prioritize long\-term value over short\-term gains. We value simplicity over complexity. **We reward it** We reward the effort of our peers with matched enthusiasm. We share the spotlight and credit generously. We celebrate our successes, even the small ones. **We own it** We take pride in our work. We see projects through from start to finish. We continuously update process documentation and fix things we find broken along the way. **We're a service\-first organization** We exemplify a customer\-first mindset across everything we do internally \& externally, always learning from our colleagues, partners, and clients. While the customer isn't always right, we value their trust in us and strive to reciprocate value by anticipating their needs, priorities, and expectations.

You'll partner with the AI Solution Architect (who owns the agents) and the MLOps Engineer (who owns the data platform) to ship the user\-facing layer. You report to the Head of AI \& Data Strategy. Responsibilities include but are not limited to: **Reviewer Workbench \& application engineering** * Reviewer\-facing application — triage incoming documents, accept or override AI recommendations, annotate decisions * UI/UX patterns that match how reviewers actually work today (comment logs, page\-level evidence links, override flows) * Feedback capture — every reviewer interaction trains the model and refines the rule packs * Application performance at scale — handling high document volumes with thousands of pages of supporting context * Surfacing of agent outputs, confidence scores, and citations to reviewers in a way they trust **Reporting, dashboards \& executive visibility** * Power BI dashboards on Databricks SQL Warehouse — review throughput, accuracy, time saved, operational metrics * Executive reporting layers for SLT and business leadership * Portfolio analytics — cross\-domain benchmarks, trend analysis, anomaly surfacing * Quarterly reporting infrastructure for SteerCo and AI Program Council reviews **Data products \& analytics engineering** * Clean, documented Gold\-layer data products on Unity Catalog — reusable across business stakeholders, IT Delivery, AI team * Output generators — auto\-produce Excel \+ Word \+ linked evidence outputs per reviewed item, audit\-ready by default * APIs and integration patterns surfacing platform outputs to enterprise systems and business workflows * Analytics engineering standards — dbt or equivalent modeling, version control, lineage, documentation **User research \& adoption** * Direct work with business users — flows for end users and report consumers * Cross\-functional partnership with the AI Solution Architect, MLOps Engineer, business stakeholders, IT Delivery, SLT **THE DETAILS:** * Location: Denver, CO * Travel: Under 10% * Benefits: Healthcare, Dental Care, Vision Insurance, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Paid Leave Programs * Must be eligible to work in the United States * Must pass comprehensive background and drug screening **MUST\-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS:** * 5\+ years building data\-intensive applications, internal tools, or data products in production * Full\-stack capability — modern web frameworks (React, Vue, or equivalent), Python or TypeScript, SQL * Production experience with at least one BI/reporting tool (Power BI preferred) * Strong SQL on Databricks SQL Warehouse, dbt, or equivalent lakehouse modeling * Proven UX intuition — you have shipped internal tools real users adopt and improved them based on observed behavior * Experience designing reporting consumed by executive stakeholders — balancing detail, accuracy, clarity * Microsoft 365 and Azure ecosystem familiarity (Power BI, SharePoint Online, Azure App Services, Entra ID) * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field **Nice to have** * Power BI Data Analyst Associate or Databricks Data Analyst Associate certifications * Document\-heavy UX experience — PDF viewers, annotation At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go\-getter with unrivaled passion. Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now! #### **Overview** Our integration technology landscape is currently centered on MuleSoft and SAP BTP and will continue to evolve as our business and technology ecosystem grows. We are looking for a hands\-on Senior Integration Developer who brings strong integration fundamentals, depth in MuleSoft, exposure to SAP BTP, and the curiosity and flexibility to learn and adopt new integration technologies over time. #### **What you'll do** Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick\-up truck \& rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following: * Contribute to the design, development, implementation, and support of the enterprise Integration Platform, currently leveraging MuleSoft Anypoint Platform and SAP BTP Integration Suite. * Design, develop, test, deploy, and support APIs and integrations connecting enterprise applications, SAP systems, SaaS platforms, cloud services. * Develop scalable and reusable integrations using MuleSoft, SAP BTP, and other integration technologies as the platform evolves. * Design and implement APIs using REST, SOAP, OData, and event/message\-based integration patterns based on business and technical requirements. * Develop MuleSoft applications using Mule 4, DataWeave, Anypoint Studio, API Manager, and Anypoint Platform capabilities. * Develop and support integrations using SAP BTP Integration Suite, particularly for SAP and enterprise application integration use cases. * Create reusable APIs, integration components, templates, and common patterns to improve development speed and consistency. * Implement appropriate error handling, logging, retry, exception management, and security within integration solutions. * Work with messaging and event technologies such as Kafka, queues/topics, and related technologies where required. * Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support automated build, testing, and deployment of integration applications. * Perform unit and integration testing and troubleshoot technical issues throughout development, testing, and production support. * Monitor integrations and proactively identify and resolve performance, connectivity, data, and application issues. * Optimize integrations for performance, scalability, reliability, and maintainability. * Maintain technical documentation for APIs, interfaces, mappings, integration flows, deployment procedures, and operational support. * Follow established development, security, API, and integration standards and contribute to improving those standards as the platform matures. * Participate in technical design and code reviews and provide recommendations based on integration development best practices. * Collaborate with application teams, SAP teams, security, DevOps, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver integration solutions. * Provide technical guidance and mentoring to other developers and contribute to a culture of engineering quality and continuous learning. * Learn and adopt new integration technologies and patterns as the enterprise integration landscape continues to grow. **Location \& Travel Expectations**: * This role will be based out of the Scout Motors location in Charlotte, North Carolina. * This role requires 4 days per week in the office, with regular in\-person meetings and events. * Applicants should expect that the role will require the ability to convene with Scout colleagues in person and travel to participate in events on behalf of the comp ML, XSD, CSV, and SQL. * Experience with messaging or event\-streaming technologies such as Kinesis, Kafka or similar technologies is a plus. * Experience integrating with SAP S/4HANA or other SAP applications is a plus. * Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git\-based source control, and DevOps practices for integration applications. * Working knowledge of integration and API security concepts such as OAuth 2\.0, certificates, JWT, TLS/mTLS, and secrets management. * Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure. * Experience with application and integration logging, monitoring, troubleshooting, and production support. * Strong understanding of error handling, performance optimization, reliability, and maintainability in enterprise integrations. * Ability and willingness to learn additional integration platforms and technologies as the enterprise integration ecosystem evolves. * Strong problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills. When a problem occurs, you run toward it, identify the root cause, and help drive it through resolution. * Effective communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work across technical and business teams. * Ability to provide technical guidance to less\-experienced developers while remaining hands\-on with development and delivery. #### **What you'll gain** The benefits of joining Scout include the chance to build products and a company from the ground up. jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: SEE Headquarters \- Charlotte Sealed Air designs and delivers packaging solutions that protect essential goods transported worldwide, preserve food, enable e\-commerce and digital connectivity, and help create a global supply chain that is touchless, safer, less wasteful, and more resilient. We strive to foster a caring, high\-performance growth culture that will deliver consistent, sustainable profitable growth and accelerate our performance – a culture where accountability is clear and aligned, and where we reward business outcomes and impact. That culture guides everything we do, including how we partner with our customers and suppliers, how we attract and retain top talent, and how we create and deliver value to our stakeholders. In 2025, Sealed Air generated $5\.4 billion in sales and has approximately 16,100 employees who serve customers in 119 countries/territories. To learn more, visit www.sealedair.com. ***What will you do as a Senior AI Engineer at Sealed Air?*** ------------------------------------------------------------- Sealed Air is seeking a hands\-on **Senior AI Engineer** to design, develop, deploy, and support AI\-enabled applications for supply chain and manufacturing operations. The role combines software engineering and solution architecture with predictive machine learning, industrial IoT, MES integration, and generative AI to improve equipment reliability, work center performance, product quality, and operational productivity. The engineer will partner with supply chain leaders, plant operations, maintenance, OT, data engineering, and IT teams to turn business problems into secure, reliable production solutions and measurable outcomes. ***Why do we need you?*** ------------------------- * **Manufacturing AI and predictive analytics.** Develop and operationalize ML solutions for predictive maintenance, anomaly detection, equipment failure risk, cycle time and throughput forecasting, quality prediction, and work center bottleneck analysis. Define baselines and measure operational impact with plant stakeholders. * **Industrial data and MES integration.** Integrate machine and sensor telemetry, historian data, MES events, maintenance records, and ERP data. Connect equipment signals with production orders, assets, work centers, downtime reasons, and quality results to create meaningful analytical features. * **Model engineering and lifecycle.** Build reproducible data preparation, training, evaluation, deployment, and retraining pipelines. Address time\-series alignment, missing data, data leakage, class imbalance, and changing operating conditions; monitor model drift, false alarms, and prediction quality. * **LLM and RAG applications.** Build applications using LLMs, embeddings, vector search, and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) for manufacturing knowledge, troubleshooting, and operational assistance. Evaluate retrieval quality, grounded responses, access controls, latency, and cost. * **AI automation.** Develop AI\-assisted workflows that turn predictions and retrieved knowledge into alerts, recommendations, maintenance requests, and approved business actions. Apply human review, auditability, and appropriate OT controls to actions affecting plant operations. * **Full stack engineering and Azure operations.** Design and build APIs, backend services, databases, and web interfaces. Deploy, configure, monitor, troubleshoot, and support applications in Azure App Service, including identity, secrets, networking dependencies, availability, and application performance. * **DevOps and production ownership**. Use Azure DevOps for source control, work tracking, pull requests, automated testing, and CI/CD across development, test, and production. Maintain deployment approvals, rollback procedures, monitoring, incident diagnostics, and support documentation. * **Technical leadership and collaboration.** Translate business needs into technical designs and delivery plans; conduct code reviews, mentor engineers, and establish reusable patterns. Use approved AI coding tools and validate generated code for security, correctness, and maintainability. ***What do you need to succeed?*** ---------------------------------- Candidates must demonstrate hands\-on capability across all areas below. Experience limited to AI tool usage, proofs of concept, or managerial oversight does not meet the requirements. * **Engineering background.** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field; 10\+ years of overall IT experience, including 7\+ years of hands\-on software development. Demonstrated solution design and architecture experience. * **Supply chain and manufacturing domain.** Strong understanding of production planning and execution, work centers, asset maintenance, quality, inventory, and material flow. Ability to translate downtime, throughput, yield, scrap, and overall equipment effectiveness (OEE) into practical AI use cases and success measures. * **Industrial Io t Fabric, and production MLOps or LLMOps practices. (Preferred) * Experience integrating SAP or other ERP platforms with MES, historians, maintenance systems, and event\-driven services; familiarity with industrial edge deployments. (Preferred) * **Predictive AI and ML engineering**. Hands\-on experience building and deploying predictive models using machinery, work center, or manufacturing process data. Strong Python, SQL, feature engineering, time\-series analysis, model validation, and ML framework skills; ability to integrate model outputs into operational workflows. * **LLMs and RAG.** Demonstrated experience developing AI applications using LLMs and RAG, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, retrieval, prompt design, API integration, and evaluation. Understand hallucination risks, prompt injection, data privacy, and permission\-aware retrieval. * **Azure application management.** Hands\-on experience deploying and operating web applications in Azure App Service. Understand Microsoft Entra app registrations, service principals, managed identities, authentication and authorization, Key Vault, and Azure role\-based access control. Understand VNets, subnets, private endpoints, DNS, and App Service network integration sufficiently to troubleshoot application connectivity with infrastructure teams. * **Azure DevOps.** Working proficiency with Azure Repos or Git repositories integrated with Azure DevOps, Boards, pull requests, branching, CI/CD pipelines, service connections, environment configuration, release approvals, and rollback practices. * **Software engineering and collaboration.** Strong hands\-on Python for AI/ML and deep expertise in at least one primary backend stack: Python, .NET/C\#, or Java. Experience with APIs, databases, automated testing, production troubleshooting, and modern web interfaces. Communicate clearly with plant, business, and technical teams and mentor engineers. * Experience with Azure AI services, Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI Search, Microsoft Fabric, and production MLOps or LLMOps practices is preferred. Experience integrating SAP or other ERP platforms with MES, historians, maintenance systems, and event\-driven services; familiarity with industrial edge deployments is preferred. ***Pay Transparency*** ---------------------- **Base Compensation:** $93,100 \- $160,655 \+ bonus eligibility The range disclosed complies with applicable state and local pay transparency laws. Offers within this range will be determined by considering relevant factors including education, experience, and internal alignment. This position may also be eligible for annual performance bonuses and other incentive programs. jobs.title: Senior Identity Governance Engineer
jobs.description: **Ready to be a Titan?** ------------------------ At ServiceTitan, we are building a next\-generation identity fabric, and this role engineers the governance layer on top of it. Identity spans cloud environments, SaaS applications, data systems, machine identities, and now AI agents, which makes it one of the most sprawling attack surfaces in the enterprise. You will make sure every identity, whether a Titan, a third\-party contractor, a service account, or an AI agent, has the right access, for the right reason, at the right time, and that we can prove it. Corporate Engineering (IT) administer our identity platforms, including Okta and Lumos, and run lifecycle operations. InfoSec defines identity governance requirements and validates that controls work. You sit in InfoSec and engineer the governance layer: authentication and authorization design standards, entitlement models, access review automation, and audit\-ready evidence. You administer Veza with Corporate Security, Security Architecture, Product Security, and Security Operations, work with Corporate Engineering and System Owners to put governance requirements into practice, and you will be a key owner of our ISPM and IGA program. **What you'll do:** ------------------- You engineer identity governance: the tooling, automation, and design standards that make access reviewable and provable. Corporate Engineering and IT administer the identity platforms, and InfoSec GRC owns the policies and the review program. * **Access Request Governance:** Define governance requirements and design patterns for access request workflows across privileged systems (code repositories, databases, infrastructure), including role\-based, time\-bound, delegated, and just\-in\-time access, and measure adoption so access is not granted outside the governed workflow. Corporate Engineering and IT administer Lumos and implement the workflows; you specify the requirements, build the monitoring that detects bypass, and validate that they work. * **Authentication \& Authorization Design:** Partner with Security Architecture to define authentication and authorization design standards (SSO, MFA and phishing\-resistant requirements, OIDC/SAML/SCIM patterns, least\-privilege role models) for enterprise tools, and review integrations against them. * **Authorization Governance \& Entitlement Design:** Provide the technical design for authorization decisions on job functions and privileged data access, including critical systems such as ST Admin roles, Snowflake, Salesforce, and other high\-risk entitlements. Build role models scoped to job function and normalize entitlement data across applications in Veza so access can be reviewed like for like. * **Access Review \& Lifecycle Automation:** Build and operate the tooling and automation behind the user access review program (SOX ITGC, PCI DSS, SOC 1/2, ISO 27001\), which InfoSec GRC owns, and behind joiner/mover/leaver control assurance, including leaver access\-reversion evidence, reconciliation against the authoritative HR source, and orphaned account detection. * **Privileged Access Governance:** Build visibility into standing privileged access across core cloud infrastructure and the data platform and drive it down, moving toward time\-bound elevation (PIM and JIT) with governed exceptions for the access that must remain. * **Identity Fabric Architecture:** Define the target\-state governance architecture across Okta, Veza, and Lumos and the risk\-based identity lifecycle it supports. You administer Veza in combination with Corporate Security, Security Architecture, Product Security, and Security Operations, building its data source integrations, policies, and alerts. Corporate Engineering and IT administer Okta and Lumos, and you partner with them on lifecycle and workflow integration. * **ISPM \& Continuous Governance:** Add continuous monitoring to periodic certifications. Build identity analytics that detect over\-privileged accounts, shadow identities, dormant access, and identity drift, and automate remediation workflows with named owners. * **Non\-Human Identity \& AI Security:** Build the inventory and governance workflows for service accounts, API keys, personal access tokens, and AI agents, including ownership, rotation, and attestation requirements, and drive remediation with owning teams. Ensure AI integrations are covered by rigorous entitlement management, in partnership with our AI governance review process. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Work with Corporate Engineering, the administrative owner of identity platforms and lifecycle operations, alongside Security Architecture and System Owners to ensure every enterprise tool is integrated with identity by design, while InfoSec GRC defines identity governance requirements and validates control effectiveness. * **Compliance as Code \& Audit Support:** Provide the technical identity evidence for audit requests (SOX, PCI, ISO 27001, SOC 1/2\), partnering with our SOX I  be a tailwind, not a headwind. You build identity governance that lets Titans move faster and collaborate safely. * **Data\-Driven:** You use identity analytics to find high\-risk areas and prioritize work based on actual risk data. **Why This Role Matters** ------------------------- As ServiceTitan scales and integrates AI across our platform, identity governance is what keeps access defensible. Your work protects customer data, supports the trust our customers place in us, and lets our teams move faster with confidence. **Be Human With Us:** Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. We need amazing people like you to help us challenge the conventional and think differently about the problems that we’re solving. We’re in this together. Come be human, with us. **Use of AI Technology:** We use technology, including automated and AI\-assisted tools, to support certain aspects of our recruitment process. These tools are designed to improve efficiency and enhance the candidate experience. AI tools are not used to make hiring decisions; all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. **What We Offer:** When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career: * **Flextime, recognition, and support for autonomous work**: Flexible time off with ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career. We offer a comprehensive onboarding program, leadership training for Titans at all levels, and other programs and events. Great work is rewarded through Bonusly, peer\-nominated awards, and more. * **Holistic health and wellness benefits:** Company\-paid medical, dental, and vision (with 100% employer paid options and 90% coverage for dependents), FSA and HSA, 401k match, and telehealth options including memberships to One Medical. * **Support for Titans at all stages of life:** Parental leave and support, up to $20k in fertility services (i.e. IUI and IVF), surrogacy, and adoption reimbursement, on demand maternity support through Maven Maternity, free breast milk shipping through Maven Milk, pet insurance, legal advisory services, financial planning tools, and more. At ServiceTitan, we celebrate individuality and uniqueness. We believe that the convergence of fresh perspectives and experiences from all walks of life is what makes our product and culture so great. We strongly encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply. We do not discriminate against employees based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity or expression, age, disability, pregnancy (including childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical condition), genetic information, protected military or veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. ServiceTitan is committed to fair and equitable compensation for all of our employees. We thoughtfully consider a wide range of factors when determining individual compensation, which may change over time. We comply with all applicable minimum wage laws. For candidates in the United States, the good faith salary ranges estimate for this role is Zone 1: $134,500 USD \- $201,700 USD Applicable for: CA, CT, DC, MD, MA, NJ, NY, VA, and WA Zone 2: $125,700 USD \- $188,500 USD Applicable for: All other US locations. International Compensation for candidates residing outside the United States will vary by location and will be discussed during the hiring process. Actual compensation within a range is determined by factors including relevant experience, skill set, qualifications, and performance. In addition to base salary, our total compensation package includes an annual bonus, equity, and a holistic suite of benefits.

jobs.title: AI Engineer- Remote
jobs.description: **Job Description:** Sharecare is a digital healthcare company that delivers software and tech\-enabled services to stakeholders across the healthcare ecosystem to help improve care quality, drive better outcomes, and lower costs. Through its data\-driven AI insights, evidence\-based resources, and comprehensive platform, including benefits navigation, care management, home care resources, and health information management, Sharecare helps people easily and efficiently manage their healthcare and improve their well\-being. Across its three business channels, Sharecare enables health plan sponsors, health systems and physician practices, and leading pharmaceutical brands to drive personalized and value\-based care at scale. AskMD by Sharecare, the company’s **free AI health app**, helps people describe a symptom, ask a health question, and get evidence\-based guidance and a clear next step. AskMD is available in the U.S. on the **App Store**, **Google Play**, and the **web**. To learn more, visit sharecare.com. **Job Summary:** As the AI Engineer, you will play a critical role across vision, strategy, operations, and execution for defining and driving the transformation of Sharecare into the era of agentic engineering. We are looking for engineers who can take a big problem domain we hand to them, disappear into it, and they come back with it working, documented, and theirs. We don’t need to check their work or meddle, because checking isn’t unnecessary. The people who have struggled here waited for scoped tickets to tell them what to do, but that’s what we have agents for. What "a fit" looks like, concretely: * Demonstrate you can ship daily at high volume with a fleet of AI agents. In the interview we'll ask to see your actual setup and what you let it do unsupervised. "I use Copilot sometimes" is not this. * You've owned architecture across multiple companies or many codebases: staff\-plus IC, chief\-architect, or platform\-consulting background. You've seen a dozen ways teams ship and you have opinions with scars behind them. * When handed an ambiguous, ugly, load\-bearing problem, your instinct is to take it whole: read everything, decide, build, write the doc, tell us what you decided. Not to schedule a meeting about scope. * Prior experience working in healthcare and/or clinical research, on health data products including electronic health records, claims, wearables, etc. and/or remote patient monitoring technologies is a plus * You communicate proactively in writing. For example: a Sunday text that says "took care of it, here's the PR and what I changed." * 6\+ years and multiple systems owned end to end What you will own: * The Factory spine. Develop and improve our existing factory to maximize and align in the era of agentic engineering. Increase our throughput by 50% while maintaining a lean team. Your job is to evolve our factory platform: Merge gates, migration safety, canary and rollback on a system where a bad deploy can touch patient care. * The application work spine. The layer that lets AI agents and humans act on patient care with auditability and fail\-closed checks. jobs.title: Founding Design Engineer
jobs.description: **About Skiffra** ================= Skiffra is building the intelligence layer for operational decision\-making in physical industries. We're developing AI\-native orchestration systems that turn complex, high\-stakes operations into intelligent, adaptive workflows. We're starting with mining and natural resources, where decisions move people, equipment and capital, and where the consequences of getting them wrong are real. Our ambition extends well beyond mining. We're building a platform designed to change how physical industries make decisions. **The Role** ------------ We're hiring our founding Design Engineer: a deeply skilled senior frontend engineer with exceptional product design instincts. You'll own the experience end to end, from understanding the problem in the field to designing the solution, writing production code and shipping it. As our first dedicated design hire, you'll set the foundations: the design system, the interaction patterns and the quality bar every Skiffra product after this one is built on. The hardest problem you'll work on is trust. Our users are experienced operators, planners and site leaders who have seen plenty of software come and go. Your job is to make AI\-driven recommendations clear enough to act on, honest about what they don't know, and easy to question or override. You'll spend real time on site with the people who use what you build. You'll learn how mines actually run, then turn that understanding into software that feels simple, fast and dependable. If you're equally at home shaping an experience in Figma and building it in React and TypeScript, we'd love to talk. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Own frontend development and product design for Skiffra's products, taking features from first concept through production * Design how people work with AI: surfacing recommendations, showing confidence and uncertainty, explaining the reasoning behind a suggestion, and keeping humans in control of the final call * Turn complex operational workflows and real\-time data into interfaces that help planners, site leaders and operators make better decisions quickly * Build Skiffra's design system, reusable component library and frontend standards from the ground up * Design for the full range of environments our users work in, from administrative offices and control rooms to site conditions with unreliable connectivity and time\-sensitive decisions * Spend regular time on site with operators and our field teams, observing real workflows, testing prototypes and bringing what you learn back into the product * Work closely with product, engineering and field teams to prototype, ship and keep improving what we've built **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * 5\+ years building and shipping complex production frontends * Strong production\-level React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML and CSS, with the ability to independently build and ship complex frontend applications * Exceptional product design and UX judgment, strong visual design skills and fluency in Figma * Hands\-on daily use of AI tools like Claude Code or Codex to prototype and ship faster, with the depth to review, debug and own everything that goes to production * A track record of owning products or significant features end to end, from design through engineering and deployment * Experience designing complex workflows or data\-rich applications, such as dashboards, planning tools or decision\-support software, and making them intuitive * Experience designing AI\-driven or data\-driven products where users need to understand, trust and act on what the system tells them * Experience building 0 1 products, including establishing a design system and frontend standards where none existed * A solid grasp of frontend architecture, component libraries, responsive design, accessibility and performance * Curiosity about how physical operations really work, and a willingness to go to site to find out * A builder's mentality: comfortable with ambiguity, quick to move, clear on when something is good enough to ship, and proud of the quality of what you ship **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience in mining, resources, energy, logistics or other industrial settings * Experience with offline\-first, mobile or field\-based applications * Experience with real\-time data or agentic workflows * Experience as an early hire at a startup ### **How We Work** We value speed, clarity, and technical rigor. We favor simple systems over clever ones, prototypes over over\-planning, and ownership over handoffs. You’ll work directly with founders and ship things that matter quickly. ### **Location \& Work Model** This is a hybrid role with regular in\-person collaboration in Los Angeles or the San Francisco Bay Area. We are not a remote\-only company. ### **Work Authorization** Candidates must be authorized to work in the country where this role is based. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position. ### **Benefits \& Eligibility** This position is eligible for Skiffra’s standard benefits, including health insurance and retirement plans, and may also qualify for participation in the Company’s bonus and incentive programs. ### **Equal Opportunity** Skiffra is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Compensation Range: $200K \- $235K
