All roles listed are with Solventum, and we’re committed to protecting your personal information—learn more in our Privacy Policy: https://www.solventum.com/en\-us/home/legal/website\-privacy\-statement/applicant\-privacy/ **Job Description:** **Senior Data Engineer (Solventum)** **3M Health Care is now Solventum** **At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game\-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients’ lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.** **We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.** **The Impact You’ll Make in this Role** As a Senior Data Engineer supporting Commercial Operations Analytics, you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative and diverse people around the world. You will design trusted data products for order\-to\-cash reporting, operational dashboards, scorecards, productivity measurement, and AI\-enabled decision support. Here, you will make an impact by: * Designing and maintaining scalable analytical data models, semantic layers, reporting tables, views, and business definitions for productivity, unbilled activity, write\-offs, accounts at risk, payer segmentation, organizational hierarchies, and other commercial operations measures. * Building and optimizing reliable ETL/ELT workflows, SQL transformations, database views and tables, stored procedures, and scheduled processes that integrate structured and semi\-structured data into analytics\-ready products using platforms such as Snowflake and cloud services. * Creating automated data\-quality and regression\-testing frameworks that encode business rules, reconcile results to authoritative sources, identify anomalies, and protect existing models when changes are introduced. * Owning delivery from requirements through development, version control, peer review, validation, user approval, production deployment, monitoring, and post\-production issue resolution while documenting data lineage, definitions, dependencies, and support procedures. Using approved AI assistants and focused engineering agents to accelerate SQL analysis, code development, pipeline configuration, debugging, documentation, and test creation, while applying human review for accuracy, security, performance, governance, and business\-rule fidelity. * **Your Skills and Expertise** To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications: * Bachelor’s Degree or higher AND eight (8\) years of professional experience in data engineering, data architecture, analytics engineering, information systems, or analytics application development in a private, public, government, or military environment OR High School Diploma/GED AND twelve (12\) years of professional experience in data engineering, data architecture, analytics engineering, information systems, or analytics application development in a private, public, government, or military environment * AND In addition to the above requirements, the following are also required: * Five (5\) years of hands\-on experience developing complex SQL, analytical data models, and production ETL/ELT solutions in a cloud data warehouse environment. * Three (3\) years of experience designing dimensional models, semantic layers, reusable reporting datasets, or governed business metrics for enterprise analytics. * Three (3\) years of experience with version\-controlled development, automated testing, controlled deployments, and production support for data solutions. Three (3\) years experience translating complex business requirements and rules into reliable technical solutions while communicating effectively with technical and nontechnical stakeholders. * Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include: * Experience using AI\-assisted development tools responsibly, including validation of generated code, recommendations, tests, and documentation before production use. * Advanced experience with Snowflake, SQL, Python, dbt or a comparable transformation framework, GitHub, Visual Studio Code, and cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS. * Experience creating automated reconciliation, data\-quality, observability, or validation solutions and optimizing SQL or warehouse workloads for performance and cost. * Experience enabling Tableau, Power BI, natural\-language analytics, machine learning, retrieval\-augmented generation, or agent\-based solutions through trusted and governed data products. * Experience supporting order\-to\-cash, revenue cycle, billing, collections, productivity, customer service, healthcare, medical technology, or other regulated commercial operations. Demonstrated technical leadership through mentoring, engineering standards, architecture decisions, or coordination of complex cross\-functional data deliveries. * **Work location: Remote – United States** **Travel: May include up to 15% domestic travel** **Relocation Assistance: Will not be authorized** **Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status).** **Supporting Your Well\-being** Solventum offers many programs to help you live your best life, both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, Solventum regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope. Applicable to US Applicants Only:The expected compensation range for this position is $143,200 \- $196,900, which includes base pay plus variable incentive pay, if eligible. This range represents a good faith estimate for this position. The specific compensation offered to a candidate may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, the candidate’s relevant knowledge, training, skills, work location, and/or experience. In addition, this position may be eligible for a range of benefits (e.g., Medical, Dental \& Vision, Health Savings Accounts, Health Care \& Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts, Disability Benefits, Life Insurance, Voluntary Benefits, Paid Absences and Retirement Benefits, etc.). Additional information is available at: https://www.solventum.com/en\-us/home/our\-company/careers/\#Total\-Rewards Responsibilities of this position include that corporate policies, procedures and security standards are complied with while performing assigned duties. Solventum is committed to maintaining the highest standards of integrity and professionalism in our recruitment process. Applicants must remain alert to fraudulent job postings and recruitment schemes that falsely claim to represent Solventum and seek to exploit job seekers. Please note that all email communications from Solventum regarding job opportunities with the company will be from an email with a domain of **@solventum.com** . Be wary of unsolicited emails or messages regarding Solventum job opportunities from emails with other email domains. Please note, Solventum does not expect candidates in this position to perform work in the unincorporated areas of Los Angeles County. Solventum is an equal opportunity employer. Solventum will not discriminate against any applicant for employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status. **Please note: your application may not be considered if you do not provide your education and work history, either by: 1\) uploading a resume, or 2\) entering the information into the application fields directly.** **Solventum Global Terms of Use and Privacy Statement** Carefully read these Terms of Use before using this website. Your access to and use of this website and application for a job at Solventum are conditioned on your acceptance and compliance with these terms. Please access the linked document by clicking here . Before submitting your application you will be asked to confirm your agreement with the terms.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Legal - Product Counsel
jobs.description: **Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?** Sony Interactive Entertainment isn't just the Best Place to Play — it's also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we're part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting\-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity. **Senior Director, Legal \- Product Counsel** **San Mateo, CA** \| Hybrid \- **2\+ days per week in our San Mateo office** *Full relocation assistance available for qualified candidates* **Role Summary:** Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE or PlayStation) seeks an experienced attorney to lead the Product Counsel function for SIE, spanning Hardware, Software, and Services. As Senior Director, Product Counsel, you will work with a variety of teams across our global business, including product, design, engineering, hardware, software and services teams that are focused on the development and operations of our PlayStation platform, spanning console, software, and commerce services (PlayStation Store and PlayStation Subscription Services). You will also establish the model of product counsel teams engaging with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) in privacy, online safety, competition, product compliance, and other SME legal teams. You must have excellent judgment in balancing legal risks with business strategy and a proven ability to act as an effective product counsel leader. The best candidates will have broad legal knowledge of the international laws and regulations impacting PlayStations products and the ability to leverage subject matter expertise and senior leaders within the Legal Department to provide nuanced and informed legal advice to key elements of SIE's business. You will use your drive and experience to make a big impact on a major segment of SIE's global business. **What You'll Be Doing:** * Lead the Product Counsel function, managing and leading a team of legal professionals who provide product counsel legal support to all of PlayStation's product teams. * Collaborate with and advise multiple stakeholders across product, engineering, product management, security, privacy, and legal departments throughout the product development cycle (from the initial stages of product development, through launch, to market strategy) on all of the regulatory, legal and compliance issues impacting PlayStation products. * Understand and stay up\-to\-date on U.S. and international laws and regulations related to product issues, including privacy, safety, online safety, hardware regulatory compliance, etc. * Work to formulate global legal advice collaborating closely with legal department members in Europe and Asia. * Strong ability to explain complex legal issues in basic terms for the non\-legal stakeholders across the company. * Provide pragmatic day\-to\-day and strategic advice to minimize legal risks while advancing business goals and initiatives. * Comfort with technology generally and business\-to\-consumer user experience interfaces and consumer electronics devices and connected platforms. * Ability to draft clear and concise communications, including public and client facing materials. * Transactional experience and strong skills in that area. * Manage internal projects, provide training, processes and procedures, and drive cross\-functional efforts to successful completion. **What We're Looking For:** * At least 18 years of progressive experience, particularly working as product counsel in a technology company with experience working as a global lead across an organization. * JD or LLM degree from top law school; being a member of a U.S. state bar is required, and California State Bar membership is preferred. At a minimum, the candidate must be qualified for and quickly obtain Registered In\-House Counsel status in California and maintain that status during employment. * Experience counseling product development, technical, business and support teams and working closely with designers, engineers, and product management. * Experience leading the formulation of legal advice across global markets. * Experience leading and managing teams of legal professionals. * Legal expertise in several of the following areas: consumer protections laws and regulations, FTC or DPA regulatory actions, consumer online account issues, e\-commerce and digital entertainment distribution, intellectual property, privacy, data security, social media law, content regulation, FCC regulations and legal issues impacting consumer hardware products. * Enthusiasm and passion for technology, law, and business. Experience in the video game industry is a strong plus. * Ability to thrive in a team environment. * Superior organizational skills, attention to detail. * Superior ability to influence and persuade across business, technical and support functions within a large, multi\-national corporation. * Eagerness and drive to continue learning. \#LI\-SF1 Please note, Sony Interactive Entertainment conducts background checks at the offer stage for all new employees (which may include criminal background checks for some roles) and will need to process personal information to support these checks. Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice for more information about what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and your data protection rights. **Equal Opportunity Statement:** *Sony is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All persons will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender (including gender identity, gender expression and gender reassignment), race (including colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin), religion or belief, marital or civil partnership status, disability, age, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, trade union membership or membership in any other legally protected category.* *We strive to create an inclusive environment, empower employees and embrace diversity. We encourage everyone to respond.* *Sony Interactive Entertainment is a Fair Chance employer and qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records will be considered for employment.*

jobs.description: **Company Description** SquareTrade is the fastest growing company of its kind. We’re revolutionizing a $30b industry with service innovation and attention to customer satisfaction. A member of the Allstate family, SquareTrade has headquarters in San Francisco and London. We are currently expanding in Europe and Asia Pacific, including Japan and Australia. **Job Description** Our leading\-edge Agile team in the engineering group is looking for a motivated and energetic Senior Software Engineer who is eager to learn and make big changes to our mission critical applications. This is an exciting time to join, as we continue to rapidly expand and look for new ways to improve our architecture and solution offerings to serve the millions of customers around the globe. Your opportunities for achievement are limitless with SquareTrade/Allstate. We embrace a fast\-paced Agile XP environment where we practice pair programming and TDD. You’ll have the opportunity to work with the engineering leads, product and design teams, as well as other developers to deliver applications which are scalable, secure, robust and highly performing. We adopt microservices architecture, distributed technologies, latest frontend frameworks and sophisticated monitoring tools. **Key responsibilities** * Design, build, and operate production\-grade Python and Spring Boot applications and services, including APIs, microservices, and distributed backend systems. * Build and evolve cloud\-native applications designed to run reliably and scale in modern containerized environments. * Develop agentic AI and Generative AI applications that integrate LLMs, tools, enterprise services, and business workflows. * Deploy and operate services using jobs.title: Data Analytics Engineer II
jobs.description: ### **About Switch** At Switch, we don't just design, build and operate data centers—we are enabling the technology of the future. Led by Founder \& CEO, Rob Roy, we believe in revolutionary innovation, operational excellence and the principle of karma. Switch is where talented people come together to EVOLVE the digital world. We believe that innovation isn't just about technology—it's about the people, culture, and purpose that make it happen. Every Switch team member contributes to a mission greater than themselves: to create the world's most advanced digital infrastructure that powers the progress of humanity. **The Role: Data Analytics Engineer II** ---------------------------------------- The Data Analytics Engineer II develops engineering, statistical, and data solutions that support the performance and lifecycle management of critical infrastructure across Switch data centers. This role works with data related to power, water, cooling, and other infrastructure systems to support utility resourcing, capacity management, efficiency, root cause analysis, design feedback, condition\-based maintenance, end\-of\-life planning, and continuous improvement. You will build and maintain data pipelines, analytical models, warehouses, applications, and automation that turn infrastructure data into reliable information for engineering and operational decisions. You will also support statistical and machine\-learning workflows and help integrate emerging AI capabilities into practical engineering and business applications. This role partners closely with Operations, Commissioning, Construction, Engineering, and other stakeholders to ensure data solutions address real operational needs and support reliable data center performance. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Build and operate end\-to\-end data systems, including acquiring data from APIs, databases, and external systems. * Design data models and develop scalable ETL/ELT pipelines that load, cleanse, transform, and unify data for analytics. * Design, optimize, and maintain analytical data warehouses and supporting schemas. * Develop high\-performance Starburst SQL queries, views, and transformations to support large\-scale reporting and analysis. * Build and maintain data\-driven web applications that connect backend APIs with analytical databases. * Partner with application development teams to deploy data applications securely and reliably at scale. * Support machine\-learning and statistical workflows by developing automated feature\-generation pipelines and providing clean, accessible datasets. * Develop automation that reduces repetitive data\-processing work and improves consistency. * Design and deploy generative AI applications and autonomous agents using large language models, APIs, and orchestration frameworks. * Apply AI capabilities to automate workflows, improve user experiences, and support scalable engineering and operational solutions. * Monitor and optimize data pipelines, databases, applications, and supporting systems for reliability, performance, and scalability. * Establish and maintain data\-quality standards and controls. * Implement appropriate data security and compliance measures to protect sensitive information. * Develop engineering and statistical models that support analysis jobs.title: Sr AI Engineer
jobs.description: Syniverse is the world’s most connected company. Which is why we work with some of the world’s most recognized brands. Eight of the top 10 banks. Four of the top 5 global technology companies. Over 900 communications providers. And how we’re able to provide our incredible talent with an innovative culture and great benefits. **Who We're Looking For** Syniverse is scaling AI capability across the company, and this role is responsible for turning that strategy into working, production\-grade systems. The Sr AI Engineer takes the patterns and standards set by the AI Architect and implements them as integrations, agentic automations, internal tooling, and the evaluation harnesses that measure whether each capability is actually performing as intended. This is a hands\-on\-keyboard role. The engineer will spend most of their time writing code, debugging integrations, and shipping capability that colleagues across the company use daily.* **Some of What You'll Do** **Job Description:** * Design, build, and maintain AI\-powered integrations, agentic automations, and internal tooling on Syniverse's AI stack (Azure OpenAI, Claude Enterprise, and self\-hosted models on AWS/EKS behind the Bifrost AI Gateway). * Develop production\-grade Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers/tools that connect internal data and systems to LLMs. * Build and maintain evaluation harnesses and test suites that measure model and system quality, catch regressions and drift, and report objectively on whether a given AI capability is working. * Take architectural patterns and standards defined by the AI Architect and turn them into working, supported, production systems — not just proof of concept. * Write, test, and ship code (primarily Python, Java, and SQL) implementing new AI capability and integrations end to end. * Debug and troubleshoot issues across the AI stack — API layers, the AI gateway, model endpoints, and downstream integrations — including root\-cause analysis of production issues. * Evaluate tradeoffs between frontier LLMs and locally hosted models (e.g., Qwen, Gemma) and select the model best suited to a given requirement based on cost, latency, accuracy, and data sensitivity. * Use agentic software development tools (Claude Code preferred; Codex or Cursor as viable alternatives) to build and ship production applications. * Automate deployment, infrastructure, and operational tasks using DevOps tooling such as Ansible and Terraform, primarily on AWS. * Create design documentation for new integrations and automations, and maintain operational runbooks for systems in production. * Review code, designs, and evaluation results from peers to ensure accuracy, completeness, and adherence to requirements and standards. * Partner cross\-functionally across business units to gather requirements, integrate AI capability into existing workflows, and support adoption. * Report on the status, metrics, and outcomes of AI initiatives to stakeholders and leadership. **Required Experience and Education:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent work experience. * 5\+ years of software engineering experience — direct, hands\-on experience programming and shipping software, not just prompting or “vibe coding.” * Proficiency with Agentic AI \& RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generalization). * Proficiency with Relational DBMS (Postgres, MySQL). * Proficiency with AWS, Python, Java, and SQL. * Experience building and maintaining automated test suites. * Experience with multi\-layer architectures and API design/integration. **AI \& Agentic Development:** * Experience building production applications (not just proofs of concept) using agentic software development tools — Claude Code preferred; Codex or Cursor are viable alternatives. * Direct experience with Syniverse's AI tech stack, or equivalent: Azure OpenAI; Claude Enterprise; AWS with the Bifrost AI Gateway and self\-hosted models on EKS (e.g., Qwen, Gemma). * Hands\-on experience with RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) development. * Hands\-on experience with vector databases and embedding\-based retrieval (pgvector, FAISS, Pinecone, or equivalent) * Hands\-on experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) development. * Direct experience with both frontier AI (LLMs) and locally hosted models, including a working understanding of the tradeoffs and the ability to identify the right model for a given requirement. * Demonstrated experience improving the quality of a generative AI system through structured iteration. **Infrastructure \& Cloud:** * Experience using AWS as a platform for software development and automation. * DevOps background, including experience with Ansible and Terraform is preferred. **Professionalism:** * Ownership and accountability for tasks and projects. * Strong cross\-functional collaboration skills across the organization. * Comfortable reporting on status and metrics to stakeholders. * Works well within a team environment; excellent oral and written communication skills. * Independent work habits with a proven ability to deliver quality software on time. * Acts with a sense of urgency and maintains composure in a stressful environment. * Strong analytical, business logic, and problem\-resolution skills. **\#LI\-Hybrid** * **Why You Should Join Us** Join us as we write a new chapter, guided by world\-class leadership. Come be a part of an exciting and growing organization where we offer a competitive total compensation, flexible/remote work and with a leadership team committed to fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and transparent organizational culture. At Syniverse connectedness is at the core of our business. We believe diversity, equity, and inclusion among our employees is crucial to our success as a global company as we seek to recruit, develop, and retain the most talented people who want to help us connect the world. **Know someone at Syniverse?** Be sure to have them submit you as a referral prior to applying for this position. Pay Transparency In accordance with applicable pay transparency requirements, Syniverse will provide information regarding the salary range or compensation for this position during the recruitment process and prior to any compensation discussions.

Encourages a culture of problem solving and calculated risk taking, while fostering innovation and process improvement. Seeks input from a range of perspectives when appropriate and weighs both short\- and long\-term implications. **Leadership Without Authority** Leads by example, acting as a visible role model of the organization's values, integrity, and high standards. Provides clear direction, support, and inspiration to team members while ensuring alignment with organizational goals. Offers coaching, feedback, and mentorship to foster professional growth and encourage adaptability, ownership, and resilience. Builds trust, influences outcomes through strong relationships, and empowers others to contribute their best. jobs.title: Traveling Senior Scheduling Engineer - Data Centers
jobs.description: Job Summary The ATL Homemaker is seeking an experienced and highly organized Traveling Senior Scheduling Engineer to support the planning, development, and monitoring of data center construction schedules. This role is suited to a scheduling professional with strong project controls experience, an understanding of complex construction activities, and the ability to travel to project sites as needed. The Senior Scheduling Engineer will coordinate with project managers, construction teams, engineers, subcontractors, and vendors to develop reliable schedules, track progress, identify risks, and help ensure projects meet established milestones. The ideal candidate combines technical scheduling expertise with effective communication, analytical thinking, and the ability to manage changing project priorities. Key Responsibilities * Develop, maintain, and update detailed schedules for data center construction and related infrastructure projects. * Establish project activities, milestones, dependencies, critical paths, and completion targets. * Coordinate scheduling activities with project managers, design teams, field supervisors, subcontractors, and equipment vendors. * Monitor actual progress against planned schedules and identify potential delays or resource constraints. * Analyze critical path activities and recommend corrective actions to help maintain project timelines. * Prepare baseline schedules, progress reports, look\-ahead schedules, and schedule forecasts. * Track major data center construction activities, including site preparation, structural work, electrical systems, mechanical systems, cooling infrastructure, and equipment installation. * Coordinate schedules for long\-lead equipment, material deliveries, commissioning, testing, and project handover. * Review contractor and subcontractor schedules for consistency with overall project milestones. * Conduct schedule reviews and progress meetings with project stakeholders. * Evaluate the scheduling impact of design changes, scope adjustments, site conditions, and unforeseen issues. * Maintain accurate scheduling documentation, progress records, and project controls data. * Use scheduling software and project management tools to analyze performance and communicate schedule updates. * Travel to project sites to collaborate with local teams, validate progress, and resolve scheduling concerns. * Support risk assessments, recovery planning, and schedule optimization initiatives. * Communicate significant scheduling risks and recommended solutions to project leadership. Requirements and Qualifications * Bachelor's degree in construction management, engineering, project management, or a related field is preferred. * Significant experience in construction scheduling, project controls, or planning for complex construction projects. * Experience with data centers, mission\-critical facilities, industrial construction, or large\-scale commercial projects is highly desirable. * Strong understanding of construction sequencing, critical path methodology, schedule logic, and progress measurement. * Proficiency with Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, or comparable scheduling software. * Ability to interpret construction drawings, technical specifications, project plans, and contractor schedules. * Experience coordinating multiple contractors, engineering teams, and construction activities. * Strong analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving skills. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to prepare clear schedule reports and present progress information to project stakeholders. * Willingness and ability to travel to project sites as required. * Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a deadline\-driven environment. * Professional judgment, attention to detail, and commitment to maintaining accurate project records. Work Environment This position combines scheduling and project controls work with regular coordination across construction sites. The role may involve office\-based planning, construction\-site visits, meetings with project teams, and travel to different locations. Candidates should be comfortable working in active construction environments and following site\-specific safety requirements. What We Offer * Opportunities to contribute to complex data center construction projects. * Professional development in construction scheduling and project controls. * Collaboration with multidisciplinary engineering and construction teams. * Opportunities to expand expertise in mission\-critical infrastructure projects. * Compensation, travel arrangements, and eligible benefits in accordance with company policy and applicable requirements. How to Apply Interested candidates should submit an application highlighting their scheduling and project controls experience, relevant technical qualifications, software proficiency, and experience with complex construction projects. Applicants should include examples of their work with project schedules, critical path analysis, contractor coordination, and schedule recovery planning where applicable. Join The ATL Homemaker as a Traveling Senior Scheduling Engineer – Data Centers and help coordinate complex construction activities while supporting project milestones, schedule reliability, and successful delivery. Pay: $41\.66 \- $45\.66 per hour Expected hours: 40\.0 per week Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * 403(b) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Relocation assistance * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Lead AI Experience Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description** At Thomson Reuters™, we’re transforming Service Management from a reactive, process\-bound group into an AI\-native, intelligence\-driven organization. Operational data flows into intelligence, intelligence into orchestration, and orchestration into execution, in a closed loop with AI embedded in detection, decision, and action. Our AI Operations and Automation (AIOps) function is the intelligence layer of that model. Intelligence only matters if people can see it, question it, and act on it. As more of our operations run through AI agents, the layer where people and agents meet the data decides whether any of it gets trusted. You’ll build that layer. **Key Responsibilities** This role sits where three disciplines meet: dynamic data visualization, applied AI, and UI/UX. You’ll define how our AI agents exchange information with one another and hand it to the engineers who depend on it. You’ll design and build interactive visualizations that make dense operational telemetry immediately readable, showing what’s happening, why, what the system has already done about it, and what still needs a person. And you’ll own the experience end to end, from first prototype to the tools our teams run on every day. This is an internal role and an exciting one that never existed before. Your users are our own people: the Global Command Center, site reliability and platform engineers, service managers, and the leaders who need to read the health of our systems at a glance. Their trust in what they see is the product. We don’t have a template for this role, and that’s the point. You’ll help define what it becomes. You’ll join Service Management and Transformation, part of the CIO segment of our Technology organization, and work alongside AIOps, the team building the models and automation behind the interfaces you design. We keep a clear separation between building and running, so you’ll have room to build. The role is hybrid, based in our Dallas, TX office. * Build dynamic data visualization. Design and engineer interactive, real\-time views of operational data, including topology and dependency graphs, event and alert streams, incident timelines, and predictive signal. Think D3, WebGL, and modern front end, not drag\-and\-drop BI. * Define the agent\-to\-agent interface. Establish the interfaces and data contracts that let AI agents pass structured, verifiable information to one another, and hand it to engineers in a form they can inspect and challenge. * Make automated action visible. Our L0 tier is where AI and automation resolve issues ahead of human responders. Show what it did, why, and how confident it was, so engineers supervise machine decisions rather than simply receive them. * Design the experience. Lead the UI/UX and information architecture: research how responders work under pressure, decide what they need to see and when, shape the interaction model, and make a complex system feel simple to someone working an incident at 3 am. * Prototype and ship. Turn ambiguous problems into working software quickly, then harden the strongest ideas into tools our teams depend on. * Set technical direction. As a lead, you’ll set the standard for the experience layer, make the architectural calls, and mentor engineers and designers. A builder first, a coach alongside. * Partner closely. Work day to day with AIOps, Service Data and Insights, Configuration and Topology, Workflow Engineering, and the Global Command Center. In your first year, you might: * Replace an operational report our teams read line by line with an interactive view that answers the question in seconds. * Publish the first version of our agent\-to\-agent data contract, and prove it with two agents working together in production. * Ship the interface that lets engineers see, and trust, every L0 resolution they’re accountable for. * Establish the shared patterns the rest of the organization builds on: components, guidelines, and working prototypes. **Required Qualifications** * Experience. 8\+ years designing and building software, including data\-rich, user\-facing products, hands\-on applied AI or agentic work, and time setting technical direction for others. A degree in computer science, human\-computer interaction, design, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * A hybrid background. jobs.description: Technology Backend Software Engineer \- Data Retention \- TikTok Privacy and Security **Location :** San Jose **Employment Type :** Regular **Job Code :** A05652 Responsibilities The TikTok Privacy and Security (PnS) R\&D team creates privacy solutions that are intuitive for users, auditable for regulators, and sustainable for the company, making TikTok a platform where people can safely discover, create, and connect. We build user\-facing privacy features, including privacy settings, consent management, data access and export, and age\-appropriate experiences. We protect personal data across its full lifecycle, from collection and transfer through access, storage, retention, and deletion. We develop the platforms, technical controls, and governance tools behind privacy protection and regulatory compliance in global markets, and we bring privacy\-enhancing technologies and research into production at scale. We tackle challenges unique to operating a platform at global scale: translating rapidly evolving laws and policies into reliable technical controls, providing transparency and auditability across highly complex data systems, supporting different regulatory requirements across regions, and making privacy protection work at the quality and speed production systems demand. You will work across product privacy, data lifecycle management, data protection and residency, privacy engineering platforms, AI governance, and privacy\-preserving technologies, using techniques including automated compliance enforcement, data lineage and taxonomy, differential privacy, trusted execution environments, AI fairness, and privacy protection for generative AI. The systems you build will protect hundreds of millions of people, and the privacy decisions you make will reach every one of them. TikTok's Privacy and Security (PNS) Data Retention team makes sure that data across the platform is kept only as long as it is needed, and is then deleted reliably and verifiably. The data covers online services, offline warehouses, logs, backups, and ML training datasets. Global privacy rules keep getting stricter, and the data estate keeps growing to exabyte scale. The team owns the policies, platforms, and technical controls that turn retention commitments into guarantees we can enforce and audit. As a Backend Engineer \- Data Retention, you will design and build scalable, reliable, high\-performance systems that manage the lifecycle of data at TikTok scale. That includes finding and classifying data, applying retention policies, running deletion, and proving that deletion happened. You will turn fast\-changing privacy and regulatory requirements into concrete platform capabilities. You will work closely with storage infrastructure, data platform, ML platform, product, privacy, legal, and security teams to ship solutions across thousands of services and storage systems. Responsibilities: \- Design and build large\-scale data lifecycle management systems that enforce retention policies across heterogeneous storage: RDBMS, KV stores, caches, message queues, data warehouses (Hive/HDFS), object storage, logs, and backups. \- Build and run high\-throughput deletion pipelines, such as TTL enforcement, user account deletion propagation, and partition and snapshot expiry. They must be correct, idempotent, and observable, and must not hurt the stability or performance of production systems. \- Build data discovery and inventory capabilities, including metadata collection, data lineage, and classification of personal and sensitive data. These keep retention policies accurately mapped to real storage assets. \- Build verification, auditing, and reporting systems that prove deletion is complete and on time. Provide evidence for internal audits and regulator inquiries. \- Support exception workflows such as legal holds, retention extensions, and policy approvals, with fine\-grained access control and full audit trails. \- Work with ML platform teams to extend retention and deletion controls to training datasets, feature stores, and derived artifacts such as embeddings and model checkpoints. \- Work with privacy, legal, and compliance teams so that systems meet applicable regulations (GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, and other global and regional privacy laws) and TikTok's own data commitments. \- Help shape the technical roadmap for the data retention platform, and find and evaluate new techniques and tools that improve coverage, efficiency, and reliability at scale. Qualifications Minimum Qualifications \- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field. \- 3\+ years of backend development experience in Go, Java, C\+\+, or Python. \- Strong background in large\-scale distributed systems, databases, messaging and streaming systems (such as Kafka or Flink), and caching. \- Solid understanding of storage internals and data lifecycle concepts, such as TTL, compaction, partitioning, snapshots and backups, and consistency models. \- Experience buil age systems. jobs.title: Hiring: Cloud Security / AI Security Engineer | AWS IAM & Cedar Policies | Remote | 15+ Years
jobs.description: **Job Description** **Role: Cloud Security Engineer / AI Security Engineer** **Location: Los Angeles, CA** (Remote – 10% Travel; must be comfortable traveling to client sites for workshops and meetings) **Duration: 3\+ Months (Extension Possible)** **Experience:** 15\+ Years **Primary Skills:** IAM Policy Templates, Cedar Policies **Role Overview:** Seeking an experienced Security Engineer with 15\+ years of experience in cloud security and identity management to secure enterprise AI applications on AWS. The role focuses on authentication, reusable IAM policy templates, Cedar\-based authorization, and secure access to tools, APIs, and enterprise resources. **Key Responsibilities** **1\. IAM Policy Templates \& Access Management** * Design, develop, and maintain reusable AWS IAM policy templates for AI agents and AgentCore infrastructure. * Implement role\-based access control (RBAC) and least\-privilege security principles. * Define IAM roles, trust policies, permission boundaries, and resource\-based policies. * Configure IAM execution roles for AgentCore Runtime and AgentCore Gateway. * Develop standardized IAM templates for accessing AWS services such as Lambda, S3, Bedrock, API Gateway, Secrets Manager, and CloudWatch. * Automate IAM policy deployment and configuration using Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or AWS CDK. * Conduct IAM access reviews, permission audits, and policy validation. * Troubleshoot access\-denied issues, role\-assumption failures, and authorization misconfigurations. **2\. Cedar Policies at AgentCore Gateway** * Design, author, test, and deploy Cedar authorization policies using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Policy. * Implement fine\-grained authorization for AI agents accessing tools through AgentCore Gateway. * Define policies specifying which identities can invoke particular tools, APIs, and operations. * Configure policy engines and associate them with AgentCore Gateways. * Implement attribute\-based access control (ABAC) using identity attributes, roles, scopes, and contextual conditions. * Develop policies that restrict sensitive tool operations based on business roles, permissions, and security requirements. * Validate Cedar policies against gateway schemas and test permitted and denied access scenarios. * Enforce default\-deny authorization and prevent unauthorized tool execution. * Monitor and troubleshoot authorization decisions and policy evaluation failures. **3\. Security Governance \& Compliance** * Implement security controls for enterprise AI agents and Generative AI applications. * Develop security standards for agent identities, API integrations, and access management. * Support audit logging, access traceability, and security monitoring using AWS CloudTrail and CloudWatch. * Identify and mitigate risks including excessive privileges, credential exposure, unauthorized tool access, and privilege escalation. * Conduct security reviews of agent architecture and integrations. * Collaborate with AI engineering and DevOps teams to ensure secure production deployments. **4\. Security Automation \& DevSecOps** * Automate security policy deployment through GitHub Actions and infrastructure\-as\-code pipelines. * Integrate IAM and Cedar policy validation into CI/CD workflows. * Implement automated security checks and policy compliance testing. * Maintain version\-controlled security configurations across development, testing, and production environments. * Support security incident investigation, access troubleshooting, and remediation. **Required Technical Skills** * **AWS Security:** IAM, IAM roles, policies, STS, AWS Secrets Manager, CloudTrail, CloudWatch. * **Authorization:** Cedar policy language, RBAC, ABAC, fine\-grained access control. * **Authentication:** OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, JWT, AWS IAM authentication. * **Infrastructure as Code:** Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation. * **Automation:** Python, GitHub Actions, CI/CD security integration. * **Cloud Security:** Least\-privilege access, identity federation, credential management, and secure API integrations. **Additional Information** All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

non\-technical teams. * Experience administering data vendor tools, such as ingestion, orchestration, BI, and data quality platforms. * Experience with infrastructure as code and CI/CD for data or document\-heavy industry such as legal or financial services. **Who Thrives Here (Core Values)** We don't hire on resumes alone. Strands SDK, LangChain, A2A, and MCP) * Experience working in the full model lifecycle – planning, training, deploying and maintaining AI systems. * Good knowledge of AWS AI Infrastructure and AI services. * Proficiency in containerization and orchestration tools such as **Kubernetes** and **Docker**. * Experience in working with a diverse set of stakeholders to deliver AI solutions. **Preferred Qualifications:** *  horized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time. jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.description: TripleLift is the Creative SSP powered by TL Spark, our agentic intelligence layer. We orchestrate creative, supply, audience, and measurement into a single outcome\-driven system across the open internet, retail media, and CTV. Our platform enables brands and agencies to drive measurable performance while helping publishers maximize yield and preserve high\-quality user experiences. **Overview** ------------ The Data Scientist / Machine Learning Engineer plays a critical role in improving the performance of TripleLift's bidding algorithms and developing scalable machine learning solutions that drive better outcomes for our customers. Within the Data Science team, this role combines statistical analysis, experimentation, and machine learning engineering to uncover market insights, optimize bidding performance, and build production\-ready systems. In this position, you will partner closely with engineering, product management, and business stakeholders to identify opportunities, test hypotheses, and translate data\-driven insights into measurable business impact. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, working with large\-scale datasets, and building reliable machine learning systems in a collaborative, fast\-paced environment. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Design and run experiments to improve bidding algorithm performance and maximize outcomes for TripleLift's customers. * Apply statistical analysis and advanced analytics techniques to understand market dynamics and deliver actionable insights and recommendations. * Develop, implement, and maintain scalable, production\-ready machine learning pipelines and systems, applying best practices in ML engineering. * Collaborate with engineering, product management, and business stakeholders to identify opportunities, solve challenges, and drive data\-informed decisions. * Monitor and evaluate deep learning and machine learning systems to ensure performance, reliability, and effectiveness in production environments. **Core Technologies** --------------------- The Data Science team uses a wide range of technologies to solve complex problems and support scalable data science and machine learning solutions. We believe in using the right tools for the right job and continually evaluating new technologies as our needs evolve. * **Languages:** Python * **Frameworks and Tools:** Spark, Airflow, Databricks, ONNX, Docker * **Databases and Data Storage:** MySQL, Snowflake, Amazon S3, Parquet * **Cloud Infrastructure:** Amazon Web Services (AWS) * **Machine Learning Libraries:** TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit\-learn, Spark * **Monitoring and Visualization:** Prometheus, Grafana **Education \& Requirements** ----------------------------- * A degree in a technical or quantitative field is preferred. Candidates with relevant professional experience and degrees in other disciplines will also be considered. * At least five years of professional experience in data science and/or machine learning within a collaborative work environment. * At least two years of professional experience developing data science and machine learning models in a programmatic advertising environment. * Strong foundation in statistical analysis, deep learning, and machine learning techniques. * Hands\-on experience with TensorFlow or PyTorch to prototype models for high\-volume, distributed systems. * Experience monitoring and measuring statistical model performance using tools such as Prometheus and Grafana, including building dashboards and alerts to identify performance issues and ensure models function effectively. * Strong organizational, communication, and attention\-to\-detail skills. * Ability to work efficiently and independently with minimal oversight. * Openness to feedback and constructive criticism, with a commitment to continuous learning and professional development. * Strong work ethic and a demonstrated commitment to delivering high\-quality work At TripleLift, we believe great work starts with great people. We foster a culture built on collaboration, curiosity, and a shared commitment to making each other better. We move with urgency, challenge convention, and continuously innovate to elevate digital advertising. We value people who bring new perspectives, take ownership, and work together to drive meaningful impact. Learn more about TripleLift and our culture on our LinkedIn Life page. Please review our Privacy Policy for information about how TripleLift handles personal information. *TripleLift does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment search firms. Any resume submitted without a signed agreement in place will become the property of TripleLift, and no fee will be due.*

jobs.description: Full Stack Software Engineer II – Web Portal **Who We Are:** USCS is dedicated to advancing, innovating, and serving companies seeking "Best in Service", facilities, and logistics in the cold chain. We are an employee\-focused, equal opportunity employer and would love to have you join our team. USCS is one of the largest providers of third\-party logistics solutions in North America. The Center of Digital Excellence (CoDE) is the IT division responsible for the company's digital footprint, including custom software development, enterprise integrations, customer\-facing applications, data platforms, automation solutions, and infrastructure services. **The Job Details:** As a third\-party logistics provider, we are entrusted with managing and safeguarding our customers' inventory throughout the supply chain. Providing customers with timely access to information and self\-service capabilities is critical to delivering an exceptional customer experience. We are seeking a Full Stack Software Engineer to help design, develop, deploy, and enhance the Web Portal, a modern customer\-facing platform that provides visibility into inventory, orders, reporting, and operational activities. The portal is designed to deliver a modern user experience, leveraging natural language capabilities and contextualized content so customers can quickly find what they are looking for—or be informed of what they should know. It also forms the basis for the APIs and hooks that allow our customers' systems to integrate with ours. In this role, you will develop web applications, APIs, integrations, and data\-driven solutions that support both customers and internal business operations. You will collaborate closely with business stakeholders, product owners, analysts, quality assurance professionals, and fellow engineers to deliver secure, scalable, reliable, and user\-friendly solutions. The portal is built with React and Next.js for the front end and Node.js (Express) and Java (Spring Boot) for backend REST APIs, with PostgreSQL and Snowflake data platforms, authentication through NextAuth.js, JWTs, and Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), and automated testing and CI/CD delivery. jobs.description: **The opportunity** Unity is looking for a Staff Engineer, Data Platform to help build and scale the data infrastructure powering our Ads business and Unity Commons, our internal platform that supports teams across Unity. In this role, you will work at the intersection of large\-scale distributed systems, data engineering, and platform architecture. You will own and evolve critical data platform capabilities that enable high\-throughput, reliable, and trusted data flows across Unity's advertising ecosystem, while also supporting common internal services used broadly across the company. This is a senior individual\-contributor role for an engineer who thrives on solving complex platform problems, raising the technical bar, and building systems that serve many teams at scale. You will partner closely with engineers, product managers, data scientists, infrastructure teams, and downstream data consumers to deliver platforms that are resilient, extensible, and easy to adopt. **What you'll be doing** * Own the design, build, and evolution of scalable platform services, backend systems, and self\-service tooling used across Unity. * Work across a broad technical surface area, including distributed systems, data pipelines, cloud infrastructure, observability, reliability, automation, and developer experience. * Partner with engineering teams across Ads, jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: This is a grant funded, 18 month, Limited Appointment position. Certain terms and conditions of employment for this position, including the rate of pay, benefits, etc., are currently subject to negotiation with the appropriate union. This position is considered flexible, 2 days on\-site, and must be available for lab on\-site meetings that may happen once per week or bi\-weekly, based on needs of the department. The Machine Learning and Data engineer role will lead the development, implementation, and maintenance of data pipelines and infrastructure to support the deployment and continuous monitoring of Machine Learning (ML) and generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools within UCSF’s APeX Enabled Research (AER) team. Most projects will be in partnership with other UCSF technical teams and involve highly customized research solutions. Communication skills and inventive technical solutioning are crucial. The AER team provides a large array of services to the UCSF Research community, including project consultation, grant support, budget estimations, and project implementation and support. Project examples include: * Development of EHR\-based interventions via clinical trials embedded within healthcare delivery systems to generate scientific evidence while delivering healthcare. + Enabling UCSF researchers with algorithms, digital tools and / or clinical interventions with strong evidence of feasibility and acceptability. + Develop technical approaches and budgets in order to implement these tools within the electronic medical record. + Supporting the development of scalable, low cost infrastructure to enable ongoing research. This role primarily involves managing and optimizing the data and monitoring pipelines of the Health IT Platform for Advanced Computing (HIPAC), a cloud infrastructure that supports the development and deployment of AI/ML tools, including large language models (LLMs) in the EHR. Specifically, the ML/data engineer will work on implementing new data integrations, enhancing HIPAC’s ETL functionalities, productionizing AI/ML tools developed by UCSF data scientists/researchers, and designing and implementing metrics to continuously monitor AI/ML tools deployed at UCSF Health. Competitive applicants for this position are software, machine learning, or data engineers with 6\+ years of experience in implementing and maintaining AI/ML pipelines. Proficiency in MLOps, Python, SQL, and CI/CD is required. This role also requires a deep understanding of Epic data models (Clarity and Caboodle). Successful candidates either have or are able to obtain Epic Clinical/Clarity data model certification shortly after onboarding. **Department Overview** The University of California, San Francisco (UCSF) Department of Information Technology Academic Research Systems (ARS) group is chartered to provide data services and infrastructure that support the UCSF Research Community’s computing and analytic requirements through centralized informatics services in the areas of Data, Tools, Secure Compute Environments, and Consulting Services. **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related area and / or equivalent experience / training. * 6 years of experience in positions of increasing responsibility designing, implementing, and maintaining complex AI/ML applications. * Experience with data analysis and machine learning tools such as Jupyter, Pandas, scikit\-learn, Numpy/Scipy, PyTorch, etc. * Demonstrated advanced knowledge of full software development lifecycle * Advanced experience with Python; ability to write clean, efficient, and production\-level Python code * Advanced experience with SQL (e.g., SQLServer, PostgreSQL) * Demonstrated experience deploying, monitoring, and maintaining AI/ML models and pipelines * Advanced experience in database systems, data warehousing solutions, and understanding of ETL pipelines * Advanced experience in designing, building, or maintaining data infrastructure for efficient ML model training and inference. * Demonstrated experience working with MLOps, DevOps, and CI/CD pipeline toolsets * Experience in developing complex, automated testing * Experience with cloud\-based architecture in platforms such as AWS, GCP, Azure * Demonstrated effective communication and interpersonal skills * Demonstrated ability to communicate technical information to technical and non\-technical personnel at various levels in the organization * Self\-motivated and works independently and as part of a team. Able to learn effectively and meet deadlines * Demonstrated broad problem\-solving skills * Demonstrated ability to interface with management on a regular basis * Excellent project leadership and management skills. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Master’s Degree or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related area and / or equivalent experience / training. * Experience with large language models and other generative AI technologies, especially supporting the deployment of GenAI\-based tools in a production environment * Familiar with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau) * Experience with Epic data structures * Epic Clarity Certification * Cloud Development certifications **About UCSF** The University of California, San Francisco (UCSF) is a leading university dedicated to promoting health worldwide through advanced biomedical research, graduate\-level education in the life sciences and health professions, and excellence in patient care. It is the only campus in the 10\-campus UC system dedicated exclusively to the health sciences. We bring together the world’s leading experts in nearly every area of health. We are home to five Nobel laureates who have advanced the understanding of cancer, neurodegenerative diseases, aging and stem cells. **Pride Values** UCSF is a diverse community made of people with many skills and talents. We seek candidates whose work experience or community service has prepared them to contribute to our commitment to professionalism, respect, integrity, diversity and excellence – also known as our PRIDE values . In addition to our PRIDE values, UCSF is committed to equity – both in how we deliver care as well as our workforce. We are committed to building a broadly diverse community, nurturing a culture that is welcoming and supportive, and engaging diverse ideas for the provision of culturally competent education, discovery, and patient care. Additional information about UCSF is available here . Join us to find a rewarding career contributing to improving healthcare worldwide. **Equal Employment Opportunity** The University of California is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, protected veteran status, or other protected status under state or federal law. **Salary Information** The final salary and offer components are subject to additional approvals based on UC policy. Your placement within the salary range is dependent on a number of factors including your work experience and internal equity within this position classification at UCSF. For positions that are represented by a labor union, placement within the salary range will be guided by the rules in the collective bargaining agreement. To learn more about the benefits of working at UCSF, including total compensation, please visit: https://ucnet.universityofcalifornia.edu/compensation\-and\-benefits/index.html

jobs.description: **Job Description Summary** =========================== Organizational Summary Statement: This position is available within the University of Maryland’s Division of Information Technology (DIT). This position is for a High\-Performance Computing (HPC) Engineer with the University of Maryland's Division of Information Technology (DIT). The Engineer participates in the design, deployment, maintenance, and operation of UMD's enterprise cutting\-edge technology HPC resources. This includes installing, configuring, documenting, troubleshooting, and maintaining hardware, operating system software, and application software on a variety of platforms running Linux. The hardware presently resides in College Park, MD and McLean, VA, and will require frequent travel between locations. The position entails collaborating nationally with the HPC community, staying in touch with emerging HPC technologies, and implementing best practices. Additionally, the Engineer, in partnership with the rest of the HPC team, will present at national conferences like SuperComputing and PEARC. The Engineer also interfaces closely with industry solutions providers in the HPC ecosystem to keep abreast with developments in HPC architectures that work for the spectrum of research conducted at UMD from the social sciences to the natural sciences. The Engineer collaborates with campus constituents to understand their computing needs. Familiarity with HPC technologies such as parallel file systems, schedulers, Infiniband and Ethernet networking, cloud integration, automated configuration management, and large scale software deployments is highly desirable. The Engineer should also be familiar with working with compliance frameworks, such as CMMC, NIST 800\-171, and CUI. This position will occasionally require off\-hours and weekend work for problem resolution and maintenance. \*\*This position is considered essential and may be required to work at the normal work location or an alternative location during a major catastrophic event, weather emergency, or other operational emergency to help maintain the continuity of University services.\*\* \*\*May be required to work evenings, nights, weekends, or different shifts for extended periods.\*\* Physical Demands: Predominantly operates in an office environment. jobs.title: Cloud Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Opportunity** The Cloud Solutions Engineer designs, develops, deploys, and supports cloud\-based solutions that advance enterprise digital transformation initiatives. This position combines expertise in AWS cloud services, application deployment, infrastructure automation, and emerging artificial intelligence technologies to deliver scalable, secure, and innovative solutions that support system\-wide platforms and business objectives. The position is responsible for architecting and implementing cloud\-native applications, enterprise integrations, serverless solutions, AI\-enabled services, and automated deployment pipelines. Working collaboratively with business stakeholders, developers, data engineers, and technology teams, the Cloud Solutions Engineer translates business requirements into reliable technical solutions while promoting cloud best practices, operational excellence, and continuous innovation. The ideal candidate possesses strong AWS technical expertise, experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC), cloud application deployment, AI service integration, and enterprise platform engineering. This role requires a combination of strategic thinking, and hands\-on implementation skills. This position is a remote work arrangement with occasional travel required to the UNC System Office located in Raleigh, NC. UNC System employees are generally required to reside in North Carolina, within a 2\-hour commuting distance of their assigned duty station. **About the UNC System Office** The UNC System Office includes the offices of the President and other senior administrators of the multi\-campus University of North Carolina System. The UNC System is a treasured public institution dedicated to serving the people of North Carolina through world\-class teaching, research, and community engagement. Today, nearly 250,000 students are enrolled in our 16 universities across the state and at the NC School of Science and Mathematics. System Office staff is responsible for executing the policies of the UNC Board of Governors and providing University\-wide leadership in the areas of academic affairs, business and financial management, long\-range planning, student affairs, research, legal affairs, and government relations. The UNC System Office also has administrative oversight of a number of University affiliates, including PBS North Carolina, the North Carolina Arboretum, the NC State Education Assistance Authority, and University of North Carolina Press. **About the Team** The Information Technology division works collaboratively with UNC constituent institutions to help ensure efficient and cost\-effective integration of new technologies that meet common and unique needs of the 17 institutions. The division is also charged with managing the highly complex enterprise\-wide data modernization efforts that will enable the System to better monitor, evaluate, and manage our enterprise; as well as facilitate timely comparisons across the 17 institutions and create better data\-sharing capabilities for smarter and more efficient data\-driven decisions. The Digital Transformation Department drives innovation and modernization across the organization by leveraging emerging technologies, cloud platforms, data\-driven solutions, and artificial intelligence to improve operational efficiency, enhance user experiences, and advance strategic objectives. The department partners with business and technology stakeholders to identify opportunities for process improvement, develop scalable digital solutions, and implement enterprise\-wide platforms that increase collaboration, automation, and service delivery. Through continuous evaluation of evolving technologies and best practices, the department enables organizational transformation while ensuring solutions remain secure, accessible, sustainable, and aligned with system goals. **Minimum Education, Experience, and Skills** Masters' and 2\-4 years' experience; or Bachelors and 3\-5 years' experience; or will accept a combination of related education and experience in substitution. **Required Competencies** Minimum of three years of progressive experience in the information technology field including experience in technology support, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. **Preferred Education, Experience, and Skills** Experience in designing and implementing AWS\-based cloud solutions, with expertise in cloud\-native application architecture, multi\-account AWS environments, enterprise integration patterns, and hybrid cloud connectivity. Strong background in platform engineering and automation, including Infrastructure as Code using AWS CDK, CloudFormation, and Terraform; CI/CD pipeline development; shared services platforms; serverless application deployment; and monitoring and observability. Skilled in developing AI and intelligent solutions through generative AI integration, Amazon Bedrock and related AI services, intelligent automation workflows, AI\-powered application features, and the evaluation of emerging AI technologies. Proven ability to modernize and integrate applications through API development and management, event\-driven architectures, enterprise system integration, and microservices\-based serverless solutions. Knowledgeable in security and governance, including IAM and identity management, Landing Zone Accelerator (LZA), cloud security best practices, compliance and governance controls, and risk management. Effective at collaborating with business and technical stakeholders, providing solution consulting and requirements analysis, producing technical documentation, driving continuous improvement initiatives, and researching innovative technologies to deliver business value. * **Classification:** IT Architect/Engineer * **Appointment Type:** Permanent * **Full\-Time/Part\-Time:** Full\-Time * **Employment Type:** EHRA * **EHRA Category:** Exempt Professional Staff (EPS) * **Location:** Raleigh, NC USA * **Position Number:** 20064048 * **Special Instructions to Applicants:** The posting remains open until filled, but applications received by Monday, November 9,2026, will receive priority consideration. **Equal Employment Opportunity and Other Information** The UNC System Office (includes PBS NC, NCSEAA, and NC Arboretum) is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Platform (Remote)
jobs.description: **Senior Software Engineer, AI Platform** (Remote) **Overview:** Weedmaps is hiring a **Senior Software Engineer** to build the AI systems our company runs on: the agents that do real engineering and operational work, and the "AI brain" that gives them trustworthy context about our business. You will work on an autonomous coding agent that picks up Jira tickets, opens pull requests and responds to review feedback; a shared platform (an internal MCP server) that gives every agent common skills, tools and processes; and a knowledge layer that connects our Snowflake semantic layer, internal documentation and a growing knowledge graph so agents and people get consistent answers. Success means agents that are measurably useful, cheap enough to run at scale, and safe to trust with production systems. This role sits on the AI Platform team and partners closely with Developer Experience, Data and product engineering teams across the company. **The impact you'll make:** * Design, build and operate production AI agents, including an autonomous coding agent that works from Jira and Slack, opens PRs, fixes its own CI failures and applies review feedback. * Build the retrieval and context layer behind our "AI brain": embeddings and semantic search, knowledge\-graph modeling, and integration with our Snowflake semantic layer and internal docs, so agents pull the right context in one pass instead of several. * Extend our internal MCP server with shared skills, tools and processes that other teams can reuse, and help product teams bring agents into their own workflows. * Own evaluation: build offline test sets and online metrics that show whether a change to a prompt, model or retrieval step made an agent better or worse, and gate releases on them. * Drive cost and latency down: route work to the cheapest model that can do it, use caching and structured outputs, and track spend per agent and per task on AWS Bedrock. * Harden agents against prompt injection, memory poisoning and over\-broad permissions: least\-privilege tool access, auditable actions, human approval where the risk warrants it. * Instrument agents with tracing and logging so failures can be diagnosed and fixed quickly, and take part in on\-call for the systems you own. * Evaluate new models and tools with a practical eye, adopting what holds up and passing on what doesn't. * Write clear design docs, review code, and mentor other engineers on building with LLMs. **What you've accomplished:** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. * Minimum of 6 years of professional software development experience, including owning production services end to end. * At least 1 year of hands\-on experience shipping LLM\-powered features or agents to production (not only prototypes): tool/function calling, prompt design, structured outputs, and handling model failures gracefully. * Experience building retrieval systems: embeddings, vector or hybrid search, chunking and ranking, and measuring retrieval quality. * Strong proficiency in at least one of Python, TypeScript or Ruby, and comfort working across a polyglot codebase. * Experience with a major cloud platform (AWS preferred), CI/CD, and observability tooling. * A track record of measuring what you build: evals, A/B tests or clear before/after metrics. **Bonus points:** * AWS Bedrock, and experience managing model cost and latency at scale. * Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers or other agent tool frameworks. * Knowledge graphs or semantic layers (for example, Snowflake semantic views, dbt metrics or graph databases). * Agents that act on developer workflows: GitHub Actions, Jira and Slack integrations, automated code review or code generation. * LLM security: prompt\-injection defenses, sandboxing, permission models and red\-teaming. * Entity matching or classification at large scale (millions of records) using ML combined with LLM reasoning. * Experience with Ruby on Rails, Elixir or Node.js services. * Experience at a marketplace, e\-commerce or regulated\-industry company. *The base pay range for this position is $180,000\.00 \- $222,000\.00 per year, and a competitive bonus* **2026 US Benefits for Full Time, Regular Employees:** * Physical Health (Medical, Dental \& Vision) * + 100% employer\-paid premium for employees + Up to 80% coverage for dependents + Company HSA contribution with the High Deductible Health Plan * 401(k) Retirement Plan (employer will match contribution up to 3\.5% of employee contribution) * Basic Life, Voluntary Life and AD\&D Insurance options * Supplemental, voluntary benefits * + Student Loan Repayment/529 Education Savings with a monthly company contribution + FSA (Medical, Dependent, Transit and Parking) + Voluntary Life and AD\&D Insurance + Critical Illness Insurance + Accident Insurance + Short\- and Long\-term Disability Insurance + Pet Insurance + Identity theft protection + Legal access to a network of attorneys * PTO, paid sick leave, and company holidays (including a 2026 holiday shutdown) * Paid parental leave **Why Work at Weedmaps?** Life at Weedmaps means innovation and heart.
